jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, India
jobs.description:
Who We Are
Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.
Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.
About the Role:
Notion is looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer focused on migrations to join our growing team in India. You will help deliver complex, production-grade data migrations, integrations, and automations for customers across APAC.
This is initially an internally focused, hands-on engineering role. You will partner closely with regional Forward Deployed Engineers, who own customer discovery, solution architecture, stakeholder communication, risk management, and final customer validation. You will own the behind-the-scenes technical execution layer from feasibility assessment and implementation through testing, production rollout, QA, reconciliation, reporting, and operational handoff.
You will work across multiple customer environments and source systems, often with incomplete requirements, imperfect data, and real-world constraints. Success requires strong engineering fundamentals, sound judgment, careful validation, and the ability to turn one-off delivery work into reusable tools and repeatable playbooks.
As a founding engineer in India, you will help build a new regional engineering capability from the ground up. You will create migration infrastructure, standards, and reusable tooling used by FDEs across APAC, while establishing practices that can scale globally. The role offers an opportunity to become a technical authority for production migration delivery, shaping how Notion approaches reliability, validation, and operational quality across complex customer environments. As the team grows, the role may also expand toward customer-facing FDE work, technical leadership, or a deeper engineering path, depending on business needs and demonstrated capability.
What You'll Achieve:
Own the technical execution layer after customer requirements, scope, and solution architecture have been established with the regional FDE. Contribute to feasibility assessment, estimation, implementation planning, and risk identification while the regional FDE remains accountable for customer discovery, scope, architecture, stakeholder communication, and final acceptance.
Apply a repeatable migration lifecycle covering source inventory and sampling, scope and pruning decisions, compatibility and degradation assessment, transformation design, pilot or dry run, user acceptance testing, production cutover, reconciliation, remediation, hypercare, and documented handoff.
Translate approved customer and regional FDE requirements into clear technical designs, implementation plans, test strategies, runbooks, and delivery estimates.
Build production-quality migration utilities, backend services, data pipelines, integrations, and automations using Python, SQL, APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure.
Investigate source-system behavior, data quality issues, permissions, rate limits, authentication constraints, and edge cases, then recommend practical solutions.
Design and validate permissions, ownership, and inheritance mappings against the approved migration plan. Make unsupported or ambiguous access requirements explicit, obtain the required decision or approval, and preserve evidence of validation.
Design migrations for reliability, scale, security, observability, idempotency, failure recovery, and safe reruns.
Execute migrations only through approved environments, devices, accounts, and tooling. Follow least-privilege access, customer-specific security and data-residency requirements, and approved handling procedures. Do not store customer data in unmanaged local or external systems, and escalate privacy, security, or sovereignty concerns before execution.
Build validation and reconciliation frameworks that provide clear evidence of migration completeness, accuracy, and exceptions.
Debug failures across application code, infrastructure, customer data, third-party systems, and the Notion platform, then drive issues through resolution.
Manage multiple implementation workstreams, dependencies, and priorities while communicating scope, progress, risks, and trade-offs clearly.
Surface scope changes, unsupported requirements, timeline risks, and material effort increases early. Document assumptions and trade-offs, and escalate with options and a recommended path rather than silently absorbing additional work.
Maintain an auditable record of scope, decisions, risks, approvals, validation evidence, and customer acceptance criteria in the agreed shared workspace or channel.
Convert repeated delivery patterns into reusable components, automation, documentation, and playbooks that improve speed, quality, and cost over time.
Bring field learnings back to Notion's Product and Engineering teams as actionable platform feedback and technical requirements.
Skills You'll Need to Bring:
3 to 6 years of hands-on experience in backend engineering, data engineering, integration engineering, implementation engineering, technical consulting, solutions engineering, or a similar technical role.
Strong hands-on Python development experience.
Working experience with Node.js, JavaScript, or TypeScript.
Strong SQL skills and a solid understanding of relational databases, data modeling, and data transformation.
Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, authentication, webhooks, and system integrations.
Experience owning a production migration, integration, or technical implementation through mapping, transformation, testing, rollout, validation, and handoff.
Experience taking a technical problem from requirements and design through development, testing, deployment, and production operation.
Experience with Git, code review, automated testing, release practices, and production deployment.
Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills across code, data, infrastructure, and external systems.
Evidence of working on production systems, not only prototypes or proof-of-concept projects.
Clear written and verbal English communication, with the ability to explain technical decisions, constraints, and risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
High agency and ownership. You are comfortable making progress with incomplete information, challenging assumptions, and escalating with options and a recommendation.
Nice to Haves:
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, job orchestration, or infrastructure automation.
Experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure.
Familiarity with message queues, event-driven systems, distributed-system patterns, retries, concurrency, and rate limits.
Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, or other observability tools.
Experience with enterprise SaaS applications, professional services, or large-scale customer implementations.
Experience migrating large volumes of content or structured data between enterprise platforms.
Experience with AI or LLM applications, retrieval-augmented generation, evaluation frameworks, or agentic workflows.
Familiarity with MCP, tool calling, Notion Workers, Custom Agents, or similar extensibility platforms.
Experience working with distributed global or APAC teams.
What success looks like:
In your first 90 days, you will:
Learn Notion's migration and implementation ecosystem, engineering standards, and APAC delivery model.
Establish a productive working rhythm with regional FDE partners.
Contribute to at least one migration or integration workstream through production delivery.
Leave behind clear technical documentation, validation evidence, and an operational runbook.
Within your first six months, you will:
Independently own production migration or integration workstreams from technical design through rollout and handoff.
Deliver measurable improvements in migration turnaround time, validation quality, delivery cost, or regional FDE execution hours through reusable engineering.
Help establish repeatable quality controls, code review practices, runbooks, and observability patterns for the India team.
Demonstrate effective prioritization and communication across multiple concurrent APAC engagements.
Turn at least one repeated delivery pattern into a reusable tool, component, or playbook that is adopted by a subsequent engagement.
Location:
This role is based in Hyderabad, India. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, our Anchor Days, because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We're looking for someone who's excited to work alongside the team during those days.

jobs.title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.
Key Responsibilities
System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:
–Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools.
–Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems.
–Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met.
–Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).
–Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
–Design performance and load testing.
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:
–Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
–Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.
–Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.
–Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:
–Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems.
–Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health..
System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:
–Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems.
–Design complex test scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.
–Implement data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.
Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:
–Take a proactive role in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation, and mentor others in these processes.
–Implement strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.
–Maintain expertise in owned components and systems to ensure effective troubleshooting and performance.
–Meet operational readiness expectations through design and implementation.
–Serve in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations.
Compliance & Security:
–Implement robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption techniques and access controls.
–Execute remediation plans to address identified security gaps.
–Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up to date.
Automation & Change Management:
–Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure.
–Create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and begin designing systems and components to allow for automation of these processes.
Core Responsibilities
Planning & Execution:
–Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.
Collaboration & Partnership:
–Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.
Problem Solving:
–Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.
Continuous Learning:
–Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.
Continuous Improvement:
–Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.
Performance and Development:
–Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.

It focuses on disciplined control of site works, construction processes, quality, commissioning readiness, and handover in live or new-build data center environments.

Proven experience delivering data center construction and/or mission-critical infrastructure in a site leadership role.
Strong understanding of MEP and critical-systems construction, including construction-to-commissioning handover.

jobs.title: Principal Systems Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Firmware connects hardware capability to cloud reliability. At OCI, you will work where those layers meet—investigating challenging failures, developing lasting fixes, and improving how firmware is tested, deployed, and operated across our infrastructure.
As a Principal Systems Firmware Engineer, you will design, develop, and improve BMC firmware or BIOS/UEFI and the tools that support its deployment across OCI’s server and GPU infrastructure. You will own complex engineering problems across firmware, hardware, and operating systems, delivering changes that improve platform reliability, diagnosability, security, and recovery.
Your initial focus will be engineering improvements for platforms already operating in our fleet. You will use production findings to identify design weaknesses, develop and validate firmware fixes, extend automated testing, and eliminate recurring failure modes. Success means delivering durable improvements that reduce failures and the need for manual intervention.
You will also participate in an India daytime on-call rotation, complementing US engineering teams. This responsibility connects your engineering work directly to how platforms behave in production and includes incident investigation, mitigation, and coordinated handoffs.
As the team grows, its scope is expected to expand into new server and GPU platform development, with opportunities to work alongside silicon suppliers and ODM/JDM partners on firmware integration, platform bring-up, and validation.
This role offers the opportunity to help shape a new team’s engineering practices while remaining deeply involved in design, code, and complex technical investigations.
Key Responsibilities
Own firmware development and integration. Design, develop, debug, and maintain BMC or BIOS/UEFI components and supporting systems software. Define clear interfaces across firmware, hardware, operating systems, and fleet management services.
Resolve complex fleet issues. Lead investigations into boot failures, management controller faults, firmware update problems, hardware initialization failures, and other platform reliability issues. Develop mitigations, establish root cause, and deliver durable fixes.
Provide operational support. Participate in the India daytime on-call rotation, coordinate investigations and handoffs with US teams, and communicate impact, progress, and resolution clearly.
Build automation and preventive controls. Develop tools for firmware provisioning, updates, diagnostics, recovery, and validation. Improve telemetry, logging, and failure analysis to reduce recurring incidents and manual intervention.
Drive software quality and security. Write maintainable code, lead design and code reviews, and develop functional, regression, negative, and recovery tests. Apply secure development practices and support firmware vulnerability remediation.
Contribute to platform bring-up. Diagnose interactions across firmware, hardware, bootloaders, and operating systems. Use platform logs and appropriate hardware debugging tools to isolate faults and validate end-to-end behavior.
Collaborate with engineering and vendor partners. Work with hardware, silicon, operating system, validation, and fleet operations teams. As product development scope grows, work with ODM/JDM partners on requirements, defect resolution, firmware releases, and platform readiness.
Provide technical leadership. Own delivery of complex engineering work, identify dependencies and risks, document designs and debugging methods, mentor engineers, and contribute to hiring and continuous improvement.
Required qualifications
Meet one of the following education and software development experience combinations:
11 years of software development experience; or
A bachelor’s degree/B.Tech in a relevant engineering, computing, information technology, mathematics, physics, or related field, with 7 years of software development experience; or
A master’s degree/M.Tech in one of these fields, with 5 years of software development experience; or
A doctorate in one of these fields, with 3 years of software development experience.
At least 6 years of experience using programming and scripting languages, with strong C/C++ skills and the ability to build diagnostic and automation tools.
Substantial hands-on development and debugging experience in BMC firmware or BIOS/UEFI, with the ability to investigate interactions across the broader server platform.

jobs.title: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
Designs, implements, and optimizes components in distributed systems with an emphasis on scalability, resiliency, and operability. Delivers features and load/performance tests; leverages data plane platforms and distributed state tools for high-volume retrieval, storage, and processing; and reviews peers’ implementations for scalability compliance. Builds fault-tolerant paths (redundancy, replication, automatic failover), applies recovery‑oriented principles, and implements retries, circuit breakers, and timeouts. Proactively detects and mitigates issues via tests, alarms, dashboards, and telemetry; authors runbooks and participates in incident response and RCAs. Implements standard replication and synchronization, develops automation/IaC for troubleshooting and maintenance, and applies advanced security controls (encryption, access, remediation) while ensuring change, compliance, and documentation standards are met.
Key Responsibilities
System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:
–Implements and contributes to the development for components of distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling including leveraging distributed state management tools.
–Optimizes code and/or systems for large-scale data processing in large-scale systems.
–Implements scalability requirements for assigned components and reviews implementation of team members.
–Leverages components of data plane platforms to handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
–Implements performance and load testing.
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:
–Collaborates with team to build fault-tolerant components capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
–Applies recovery oriented computing principles to design components that effectively handle service disruptions.
–Implements retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts to help handle network unreliability.
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:
–Implements tests and alarm configurations to proactively detect and address issues/failures.
–Supports efforts to recover from failures by drafting and executing runbooks and operational procedures.
–Builds and customizes dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health.
System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:
–Designs and implements functional requirements and testing for assigned features within an existing system.
–Implements tests scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.
–Implements standard data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.
Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:
–Diagnoses, debugs, and resolves issues in system components to support ongoing operation.
–Implements basic strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.
–Designs and implements automation scripts and tooling used to troubleshoot operational issues.
–Participates in operational support rotations, assisting in incident responses and root cause investigations.
Compliance & Security:
–Applies advanced security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption and access controls.
–Implements remediation plans to continuously improve security.
–Collaborates with the team to ensure cloud infrastructure complies with relevant industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up-to-date
Automation & Change Management:
–Maintains automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) for managing cloud infrastructure.
–Adheres to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications.
Core Responsibilities
Planning & Execution:
–Track timelines with minimal supervision, ensuring work is completed in a timely manner and is in alignment with project requirements.
–Prioritize and adjust work as resources or timelines change, with some guidance
Collaboration & Partnership:
–Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others.
Problem Solving:
–Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices
Continuous Learning:
–Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools, and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members..
Continuous Improvement:
–Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work.

The Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) team can provide you the opportunity to build and operate a suite of massive scale, integrated cloud services in a broadly distributed, multi-tenant cloud environment. At every level, our engineers have a significant technical and business impact designing and building innovative new systems to power our customer’s business critical applications.

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is building next-generation cloud security and compliance solutions, and we’re looking for skilled Software Engineers to join our Cloud Guard / Assurance Service team. Be part of our mission to create the most secure cloud environment. In this pivotal, hands-on engineering role, you will architect and develop scalable, innovative solutions that ensure OCI resources start secure and remain secure. We are looking for engineers with distributed systems experience. You should have experience with the design of major features and launching them into production. You’ve operated high-scale services and understand how to make them more resilient. You work on most projects and tasks independently. You have experience working with services that require data to travel long distances, but have to abide by compliance and regulations.
The ideal candidate will own the software design and development for major components of Oracle’s Cloud Infrastructure. You should be both a rock-solid coder and a distributed systems generalist, able to dive deep into any part of the stack and low-level systems, as well as design broad distributed system interactions. You should value simplicity and scale, work comfortably in a collaborative, agile environment, and be excited to learn.
What are the biggest challenges for the team?
The biggest challenges for the team are reliability, performance and keep up in cybersecurity space. The dynamic and fast growth of the business is driving us to improve the ability of our systems to scale out and handle traffic patterns with full coverage that are several orders of magnitude greater than what we can support today.
We understand that software is living and needs investment. The challenge is making the right tradeoffs, communicating those decisions effectively, and crisp execution.
We need engineers who can build services that can reliably protect our customer cloud environment. Code contributes across the entire Atlassian product suite, providing exceptionally broad engineering exposure

Architect and implement robust application integrations using Python, JavaScript, or similar languages, with a focus on APIs, microservices, and enterprise-scale systems.

5+ years of experience in backend software development.

Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience influencing cross-functional teams without formal authority.
Experience with AI risk assessment, data privacy, and compliance (e.g., GDPR).
Strategic and innovative thinking, with a track record of aligning technical solutions to business goals.

Experience with Atlassian Intelligence, Rovo AI, or AI-powered Atlassian features.

Job Description
Senior Principal Digital IC Design Engineer - Digital Compute Team About Us
At onsemi, we help improve lives through silicon solutions every day. Our intelligent power and sensing technologies solve the world’s most complex challenges and lead the way in creating a safer, cleaner, and smarter world. Our group develops MCU and DSP systems as well as hardware accelerators that are used in a large variety of different products and markets.
The Role
We are expanding the team to India and are looking for a Senior Principal IC Design Engineer with experience in the development of embedded MCU/DSP systems. You will develop and benchmark such systems for a variety of processor cores and consult the product integration teams during the integration of these solutions into semiconductor products.
Strong ability to translate Specifications to Microarchitecture
Strong understanding of core digital design concepts: FSM, Timing diagrams, Combination/ sequential circuits, timing analysis
Proficiency in Verilog/Systemverilog
Familiarity with tools like Lint, CDC, RDC, DC (Design Compiler)
Experience with standard interfaces:
APB, AHB, AXI
SPI, I2C, DMA
Experience in MCU/CPU subsystems like ARM processor
Experience is design techniques like
Pipelining, Low latency, Power optimization
Experience in Technical documentation for specification, design, waveform
Scripting/Automation languages:
Python, PERL
Have also some experiences in mentoring younger engineers and leading small projects or methodology aspects
Writing specifications based on high-level requirements
Nice to Have:
Understanding of DFT, FuSa, Cryptography, Security
Low Power design techniques

*Description for Internal Candidates
Responsibilities:
OnSemi is seeking a Prin Digital design engineer, NEW PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT, Power Management, to join our growing team in Bengaluru, India. This group is responsible for development of Power management products including DC-DC PMIC/POL, Multiphase controllers, Dr. MOS, AC-DC converters, LED drivers, SiC drivers, Switches and efuses for consumer, industrial and automotive applications. In this role, you will focus on the following:
The candidate will lead the digital design architecture, digital RTL, low power design, synthesis and timing analysis, and behavioral coding teams for the power management chips as well as executing various tool flows for IP quality control
The candidate will be able to work as part of a large and focused team of engineers and will be able to collaborate successfully as needed with design architects, digital verification, project management, and digital and analog design teams in multiple worldwide geographies
Drive architecture to micro-architecture to RTL implementation with the refining of features requirements throughout the design process
Support the bring-up of various features at a system level in various pre-silicon platforms like SOCV, Emulation, FPGA.
Knowledge of development of digital control peripherals, MCU systems
Own technical outcome of design, verification, implementation, and execution of Power Management ICs with complexities that can span from simple regulators to complex designs, control loops, and digital interfaces
Identify, recommend, and implement new systems, tools, processes, and technologies to improve design, reuse organizational processes and decision-making
Support post-silicon validation activities for your designs.
BS in Electrical Engineering or related + 10 years of experience, or MS + 8 years of experience in working and leading Digital Design, Architecture and ASIC/Mixed signal chip developments
The ideal candidate should have thorough understanding of the end-to-end digital design flow in order to accurately and efficiently collaborate with all members of the technical staff, both analog and digital, regarding overall project development progress and status
Solid understanding of RTL design, CDC, ASIC synthesis, timing analysis and CDC, P&R, UPF and system Verilog (assertion)
Solid understanding of Verilog, TCL and Perl/Python/XML programming languages
Experience in developing ASIC/Mixed signal ICs for various Power Converters such as multiphase converter, DC-DC PMIC/POL, AC-DC converters, LED drivers
Good understanding of topologies and architectures for Constant-on-time, Peak, and Valley Current/Voltage Mode control mechanism, Hysteretic, Multi-Phase Controllers, and Smart Power Stages
Understanding of digital architecture trade-offs for power, performance, and area
Must have good written and verbal cross-functional communication skills
BE/BTech in Electrical Engineering or related + 10 years of experience, or MTech + 8 years of experience

jobs.description:
Job Description – Communications and CSR engagement specialist
About the role
This role is responsible for employee communications along with employees’/volunteers’ engagement for CSR efforts. The role will be under the communications and brand marketing team at TI India and the team member will manage employee connect activities and internal communication efforts along with managing volunteer engagement for CSR efforts by TI in India.
This is an entry-level role for someone who:
Can tell impactful stories through internal communication channels to connect with the employees and position TI as a great employer.
Enjoys working with people, coordinating events, communicating with different stakeholders, and creating positive community impact. The ideal candidate will help plan and execute volunteer activities, coordinate with employees and community partners, and ensure smooth communication before, during, and after CSR events.
Key responsibilities:
Internal communication
Manage internal communication campaigns and internal storytelling channels’ content
Intranet (Infolink) management, maintenance of pages, and review metrics on reach and impact.
Manage internal events such as technical conference, town halls, employee celebration events, along with volunteering events such as Back to School, Science and Tech quiz and others.
Draft and coordinate emails, announcements, invitations, reminders, and other communications related to internal events, CSR and volunteering activities.
Manage with agency partners on content and collaterals creation for internal
events.
CSR and employee volunteering
Support planning and execution of employee volunteering events, including logistics, schedules, registrations, materials, and on-ground coordination.
Create engaging content for internal newsletters, social media, presentations, and CSR updates.
Collect stories, photographs, testimonials, and other content that demonstrate the impact of our initiatives.
Communicate with volunteers before events and provide them with necessary information and instructions.
Maintain an organized database of volunteers, partners, and CSR activities.
Key skills
A genuine interest in communications along with community development, volunteering, and social impact.
Should possess excellent communication and event coordination skills
Manage multiple stakeholders
Meticulous in planning campaigns and execution of events
Manage documentation and reporting for campaigns and CSR campaigns/events
Be a team player and a problem-solver
Attention to detail
Job travel
Occasionally within India and to the U.S. or Germany

Preferred qualifications & experience
Employee or corporate communications experience
Knowledge of the high-tech industry
Approximately 1-2 years of related experience
Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in communications, journalism, or business

jobs.title: RF Device Modeling Engineer
jobs.description:
About TI
Texas Instruments Incorporated (TI) is a global semiconductor design and manufacturing company that develops analog ICs and embedded processors. By employing the world’s brightest minds, TI creates innovations that shape the future of technology. TI is helping about 100,000+ customers transform the future today. We’re committed to building a better future – from the responsible manufacturing of our semiconductors, to caring for our employees, to giving back inside our communities and developing great minds. Put your talent to work with us – change the world, love your job!
About the Job
Join TI's elite SPICE Modeling Group and drive cutting-edge semiconductor innovation. You'll extract and optimize compact (SPICE) models for next-generation devices while collaborating with world-class engineers across analog, digital, and mixed-signal design and process technology teams.
Location: Bangalore, India
What You'll Do:
Extract compact models for advanced semiconductor devices (HBT/BJT, RF CMOS, RF Passives, GaN)
Partner with designers and technologists to deploy modeling solutions for breakthrough RF circuit topologies and drive design-technology co-optimization
Develop innovative model formulations for emerging device technologies
Automate modeling infrastructure to accelerate technology development
Develop AI/ML-enhanced models and parameter extraction methodologies
Validate models through comprehensive measurement and analysis
The person performing this role must be capable to plan effectively, drive schedules, meet critical deadlines on multiple tasks in parallel, lead technical discussions in their area of expertise, and work effectively across organizational boundaries. They must be able to clearly communicate project status and actions. Additionally, they must be able to interface with multiple organizations and work well on a diverse team to accomplish goals.
Why This Role Matters:
Your modeling expertise will directly impact TI's next-generation products, from automotive to industrial to embedded applications. You will work at the intersection of process, device physics, and circuit design, solving complex challenges and delivering cutting edge solutions.
Ready to model the future? Apply today.

Minimum requirements:
Ph.D./Masters in Electrical Engineering or related field
5+ years in compact (SPICE) RF modeling for HBT/BJT and CMOS
Preferred qualifications:
Expert-level experience with RF characterization, modeling, and circuit-level validation for s-parameters, noise figure, linearity, IMP3/IP3, and harmonic distortion
Strong understanding of RF test-structures, layouts, and calibration/de-embedding techniques
Experience with models (BSIM, MEXTRAM, HICUM, MVSG-GAN, ASM) and parameter extraction tools (ICCAP, BSIMPROPLUS, MBP, etc.)
Deep understanding of semiconductor physics and circuit analysis
Proficiency in EDA tools (Cadence), SPICE simulators (Spectre) and Verilog-A
Programming skills in MATLAB/Python
Strong data analysis skills with AI/ML expertise and TCAD experience are highly valued

jobs.title: Analog Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Change the world. Love your job.
Texas Instruments (TI) is out front and ready for the next big challenge. Our innovations are at the core of nearly every electronics product in use today. And it doesn't stop there. We're developing breakthrough technology to power the world's future innovations as well. TI is committed to building a better future — from the responsible manufacturing of our semiconductors, to caring for our employees, to giving back inside our communities. Put your talent to work with us.
This is a great opportunity to be part of an established team that's continuing to look for growth opportunities, working with worldwide leading customers and developing cutting edge solutions in the areas of consumer electronics, mobile computing and communications.
Who are we and what do we do?
The advanced circuits and power solution business is known for delivering industry leading custom IC system solutions including display and touch power products, charger power products, camera PMICs, power path devices, sensing devices and high-performance communication interface products. Our products integrate precision signal-chain and highly efficient power components in ultra-small form factors that enable TI’s best-in-class customer to translate their ideas to high value products that revolutionize the personal electronics market.
In this team, you will get to work with, and learn from incredibly talented technical leaders, who have influenced TI technology, productivity and way of working in a creative and impactful way. You will get to directly interact with one of TI’s valued and high-volume customers, by way of intense technical reviews and architecture discussions!
By enabling designs that are highly impactful to TI revenue and working with a critical customer on a versatile set of products, you will find yourself on an accelerated career path.
About the job If you are looking to join an ingenious, vigorous & ambitious team that consistently delivers groundbreaking technologies into the custom mobile electronics world, here is an opportunity for you!
Analog Design Engineer
Location: Bangalore, India
Experience: 2+ Years
What will you be doing in this role?
Analog Chip/Sub-section/IP architect and design with complete ownership and responsibility from definition to release to manufacturing.
Direct, guide and participate in activities of a research or technical design function responsible for designing, developing, modifying and evaluating electronic parts, components, integrated circuits for a variety of applications.
Evaluate intermediate and final results of projects during the design phase and during silicon evaluation, to ensure accomplishment of technical objectives.
Collaborate with Design Verification teams during the pre-PG phase of a project to ensure completion of all technical tasks before PG.
Collaborate with validation, product engineering and test engineering teams to enable successful transfer to production.

Basic Requirements (Must-Haves)
Bachelor’s & Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or related field of study
2+ years of analog circuit design.
Preferred Skills & "Good to Have"
Active involvement with a customer. Candidate would be expected to interact and collaborate with a sense of ownership with customers and all product development team members including design, layout, systems, verification, validation, test and program management
IC system partitioning and architectural tradeoff analysis
Block level topology selection, hand analysis, and IC transistor level implementation
Schematic generation and simulation on modern CAD tools (Cadence tool set)
Worst case identification, top level simulation, Monte Carlo analysis, and simulation data analysis
Expertise in tools e.g. Spectre, Simplis, Matlab and AMS
System level understanding and analysis; and the ability to translate requirements to an IC spec level
Physical layout management, signal grounding and routing tradeoffs, die area optimization
Post layout parasitic extraction and simulation, verification of all IC level performance metrics
Top level verification, block level modelling, top level simulation
Knowledge of device physics and process technologies tradeoffs that are applicable to Power IC design
Must budget time, manage schedule and complete complex IC design tasks on time
Must have depth of experience and meticulous approach to assure high quality results
Must account for limitations of system level specifications, testability, debug, characterization, production and yield targets in the IC design phase.
Must work well with colleagues and customers to foster a highly creative, interesting, productive and fun working environment.
Organizational Skills: Ability to work well with internal cross functional teams. Must successfully and appropriately interface with external customers. Project management, time management, multi-tasking, problem solving and communication (written and oral) are important skills in this role. Must be able to manage assigned tasks with minimal supervision.
Team and People Skills: Candidate must be team oriented and must be able to work with TI-internal and external groups (systems, test, sales, marketing, customers, etc.) to resolve issues and generate business success. The ability to work well with others and to perform in a team environment is essential.
Projects and Deliverables: The main deliverable is the timely release of meticulously analysed and simulated IC designs or sub-sections of designs for custom designs with tight schedules. These designs should lead to cost-effective, high quality, bug-free products that fully meet our customer’s end-system requirements.

Our products integrate precision signal-chain and highly efficient power components in ultra-small form factors that enable TI’s best-in-class customer to translate their ideas to high value products that revolutionize the personal electronics market.
In this team, you will get to work with, and learn from incredibly talented technical leaders, who have influenced TI technology, productivity and way of working in a creative and impactful way. About the job
If you are looking to join an ingenious, vigorous & ambitious team that consistently delivers groundbreaking technologies into the custom mobile electronics world, here is an opportunity for you!
Senior Analog Mixed-Signal (AMS) Verification Engineer
Location: Bangalore, India
Experience: 3–10 Years
What will you be doing in this role?
Verification Strategy: Develop detailed coverage-driven Verification Plans by collaborating closely with System, Application, and Design teams.
Modelling & Simulation: Create high-fidelity analog behavioural models using Verilog-A, Verilog-AMS, Wreal (RNM) or EENet to enable efficient top-level simulation.
Environment Development: Build and enhance mixed signal testbenches using a combination of schematic, models, and RTL.
Checkers & Assertions: Implement real-time analog checkers and post-processing checker strategies to ensure functional correctness.

Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering (EE) or Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE)
Experience: Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in Analog Mixed-Signal (AMS) design verification.

Verification Flow: Direct experience with mixed-signal verification involving a combination of schematic, behavioural models, and RTL.
Tool: Strong command of Cadence Virtuoso/AMS Designer toolsets and debug environments or other standard mixed-signal simulation tools
Communication: Clear ability to present technical analysis and conclusions to internal stakeholders and business leaders.

Advanced DV: Knowledge of SystemVerilog (SV) and UVM, as the top-level environments are built on these frameworks.
Automation: Proficiency in scripting (Python, Perl, or Shell) to automate simulation flows and data analysis. Exposure and interest in building AI-driven verification methodologies.
Domain Expertise: Experience in signal processing, PMICs, or high-speed communication interfaces.
Silicon Interaction: Experience in silicon debug and working alongside silicon validation teams.

jobs.description:
Change the world. Love your job.
Texas Instruments is seeking an Sr. Network Security Engineer responsible for designing, implementing, and operating highly resilient Enterprise, Manufacturing (OT/Fab), and Data Center network security solutions. You will protect TI's global infrastructure, hybrid cloud environments, remote users, and business-critical applications. This role requires a seasoned engineer with deep expertise in Palo Alto Networks and Fortinet technologies, Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), Data Loss Prevention (DLP), and secure enterprise architecture. You will define and implement network security strategies that support global business growth, safeguard intellectual property, and minimize operational risk across our global footprint.
Experience & Core Requirements
Total Experience: 8+ years of experience in enterprise network engineering and information security environments.
Palo Alto Expertise: 4+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience deploying, configuring, and managing Palo Alto Networks Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW) and Panorama.
Advanced SASE/Cloud Experience: Proven track record working with Palo Alto Strata Cloud Manager (SCM) and Prisma Access for global secure access service edge deployment
Key Responsibilities
Security Architecture: Design, implement, and maintain global enterprise network security architectures, ensuring alignment with TI’s security frameworks and engineering standards.
Firewall & Perimeter Management: Lead the deployment, configuration, and lifecycle management of Palo Alto NGFW, Panorama, Fortinet firewalls, SCM, Prisma Access, and advanced threat prevention modules (WildFire, URL Filtering, DNS Security).
Zero Trust & Segmentation: Develop and execute Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA), network segmentation, and micro-segmentation strategies to isolate critical manufacturing (OT) environments from IT networks.
Data & IP Protection: Design and implement enterprise Data Loss Prevention (DLP) solutions and data protection controls to safeguard high-value semiconductor designs and intellectual property.
Hybrid Cloud Security: Secure multi-cloud connectivity (AWS, Azure) and hybrid environments using cloud-native security controls and virtual appliances.
Operations & Incident Response: Provide Tier-3/4 engineering support for complex network security issues and collaborate with the global SOC during major security incidents.
Automation & DevSecOps: Drive security automation initiatives using Python, Ansible, and Terraform to deploy Network Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and streamline policy management via APIs.
Collaboration & Leadership: Partner closely with global Infrastructure, IT Cloud, IAM, and manufacturing automation teams while mentoring junior engineers in the India design center.
Leadership & Strategic Planning
Roadmap Development: Evaluate emerging security technologies and help define TI's future-state network security roadmap.
Cross-Functional Influence: Act as a trusted technical advisor, presenting architectural recommendations clearly to cross-functional global stakeholders and leadership.
Standards & Governance: Author and maintain technical design documents, security standards, and operational governance procedures.
Preferred Certifications
Palo Alto: PCNSE / PCCSE (Highly Preferred)
Cisco: CCNP Security / CCIE Security
Industry Standard: CISSP / Certified Information Security Manager (CISM)
Cloud: AWS Certified Security – Specialty / Azure Security Engineer Associate

Minimum requirements:
Required Degrees:B.E. / B.Tech / M.E. / M.Tech in Computer Science (CSE), Information Technology (IT), Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE), or a related engineering discipline from a recognized Indian university.
Alternative Qualifications:MCA (Master of Computer Applications) or an M.Sc. in Computer Science/Information Security combined with relevant, deep technical field experience.
Preferred qualifications:
Core Technology Expertise: Deep technical mastery of Palo Alto NGFW, Panorama, Fortinet, SCM, Prisma Access, GlobalProtect, and associated cloud security suites.
Network & Traffic Management: Hands-on experience with core network services, specifically Infoblox (DNS/DHCP/IPAM) and A10 or F5 Load Balancers.
Segmentation & Remote Access: Deep knowledge of Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), Network Access Control (NAC/802.1X), and secure remote access for global engineering teams.
Cloud & SASE: Practical experience with SASE/SSE architectures, hybrid networking, and securing cloud infrastructures (AWS, Azure).
Security Automation: Strong automation and scripting skills using Python, Ansible, Terraform, REST APIs, and Git version control.
Monitoring & Analytics: Experience integrating network security platforms with SIEM systems (e.g., Splunk) and network monitoring tools for proactive threat visibility.

jobs.title: Test Engineer
jobs.description:
Position/Role: Sr Test Engineer for Power Path Protection Devices (4+ years exp).
Location: Bangalore, India
Description
Linear Power team is looking for bright engineers to drive our next generation of cutting-edge power products across Automotive, Industrial, Data Center, and Personal Electronics markets. As traditional power architecture rapidly transitions toward higher power, higher voltage, and functionally safe systems, our team is actively developing highly differentiated solutions by pushing the boundaries of silicon process, advanced packaging, IP design, and test engineering. We believe in acquiring deep end-equipment knowledge, solving complex high-voltage challenges to achieve the best performance for the application. Our teams define, design, verify, validate, and take products to high-volume manufacturing through deep involvement with customers and a thorough understanding of the market - across a broad portfolio of Power Path Protection, High-Side Switches, Precision References, Power Monitoring Solutions, and best-in-class LDOs. Join this team if you want to be at the forefront of power design and shape the future of semiconductors.
Sr Test Engineer
Summary
This role owns test solution for new product development of power path protection devices. Engineer will work with cross functional team during system definition, DFT planning, project plan, product release and support solving post production issues. The engineer leads root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and cross-functional problem solving across design, quality, and operations teams.
What You Will Do
As Test lead for your device, you will own quality and test cost entitlement for your product (test solution including hardware and software releases) and leading cross functional team to make decision, resolving critical manufacturing, test, yield, and reliability issues with urgency while eliminating recurring problems through rigorous root-cause and permanent corrective action and meet customer demand requirements. You will also be responsible to drive other projects and lead young engineers.
You will develop and execute strategies to continuously improve yield and reduce test cost across the product portfolio, working directly with factory teams to implement solutions and sustain gains on the production floor. You will partner closely with Test, Product, Design, Quality, Manufacturing, and Operations teams to close complex issues and build a structured feedback loop that transfers sustaining learnings into development to improve future designs and test strategies.
What We Are Looking For
We are looking for 4+ years experienced engineer with hands-on ATE test experience - including expertise in hardware and software (ETS or V98K tester platforms (software and hardware)). Ideal candidate combines deep technical judgment, strong analog fundamental skills and pcb design experience with cross-functional leadership - able to work across design, quality, factory, and operations teams, influence without direct authority, and build systems and processes that scale
Qualifications
Minimum requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering
4+ years of relevant experience
ATE experience on Teradyne Eagle or equivalent analog ATE (iFlex, LTX, VLCT), although Eagle experience is preferred and is a differentiator
Characterization test program and hardware development experience.
Production test program and hardware development experience
Strong technical knowledge of electronic devices and circuits, and Analog test techniques
Data analysis skills.
Experience with product engineering activities such as yield improvement and test time reduction
Strong understanding of the analog electronics, IC product development process, from concept to volume production
Preferred qualifications:
Analog/Mixed signal test techniques and experience
Experienced with test program and hardware offload to TI offshore manufacturing sites
Demonstrated strong analytical and problem solving skills
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions
Strong time management skills that enable on-time project delivery
Demonstrated ability to build strong, influential relationships
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and rapidly changing environment
Ability to take the initiative and drive for results

Build timing constraints and implementation architectures that meet power and area targets while closing on time, including low-power techniques for advanced nodes
Close timing and physical signoff on mixed-signal designs with complex analog/digital boundaries, and drive methodology decisions that affect constraint strategy and integration
Develop and maintain automation in Perl, Tcl, and Python to make the implementation flow repeatable across process nodes and IP ports
Work daily with front-end, analog, CAD, and product teams to resolve integration issues, boundary timing, and the problems that surface when SerDes meets the rest of the chip
Represent implementation decisions in design reviews and customer engagements, and travel internationally when the program requires it
The Impact You Will Have
Your closures enable Synopsys to deliver high-speed SerDes IP that powers next-generation data center, AI, and enterprise infrastructure
The timing and floorplan decisions you make directly affect whether a product tapes out on schedule or slips a quarter
Your leadership keeps a small team unblocked, technically sharp, and accountable to tapeout commitments
The methodology and automation you build get reused across multiple nodes and IP families, multiplying your impact beyond a single project
Your ability to work the analog/digital interface reduces integration risk and prevents late-stage surprises that derail schedules
The constraints and architectures you develop become the foundation for future ports and derivative products
Your technical judgment under pressure protects the team from thrash and keeps the program moving when the spec is still evolving
What You'll Need
MSEE with 8+ years of digital or physical design experience, or BSEE with 10+ years, with recent tapeouts where you were a technical driver or project lead
Hands-on experience taking designs from RTL to GDSII, including chip-level integration and physical and timing signoff
Recent work on advanced FinFET nodes at 5 nm and below, including low-power design techniques
Strong scripting ability in Perl, Tcl, and Python for methodology development and CAD automation
Solid understanding of digital design, architecture, and implementation flows, with a working knowledge of mixed-signal verification and SoC integration
Prior project leadership experience, including scope definition, team coordination, and accountability for tapeout deliverables
Ability to travel internationally as required by program commitments
Who You Are
You can explain a timing closure or floorplan tradeoff to an analog designer, an architect, or a customer in two minutes without losing the technical nuance
When your team is stuck on a constraint set or a power closure, you open the tool, work the problem with them, and show the path forward instead of delegating and disappearing
You make decisions under interrupts and incomplete information, and you are comfortable being the person who calls it and moves the team forward
You know what breaks at an analog/digital boundary, and you build constraint strategies and integration plans that account for it before it becomes a crisis
You stay disciplined on methodology even when the schedule is tight, because you have seen what happens when the flow is not repeatable
You represent your work honestly in reviews and customer meetings, whether the news is good or the closure is still in progress
The Team You'll Be Part Of
Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process.

jobs.description:
The Software (CE-SW) group is responsible for developing and improving the software ecosystem around Arm's next generation architectures and systems. This means working with processors and other hardware technology not yet available to the public. You will join a team of Software Engineers who share a passion for leaving their mark on the future of computing.
We are looking for highly capable software engineers with practical experience of programming the Baseboard Management Controller (BMC). The successful candidate will be working with vibrant software and hardware teams across multiple geographies on ground breaking products and will be presented with opportunities to vastly grow their technical understanding.
If you are similarly passionate about innovative technologies, then we would love to hear from you!
Responsibilities
We are seeking those who will perform both software development and actively participate in the OpenBMC community.
Your day-to-day role will involve develop, enhance, and maintain the OpenBMC firmware stack for Arm-based server platforms, ensuring robust and reliable system management capabilities.
BMC firmware bring-up and platform enablement activities for new Arm-based server boards, including hardware integration, driver configuration, debugging, and validation.
Develop and port BMC functionalities across multiple Arm-based server platforms, promoting software reuse, scalability, and consistency across platforms.
Working closely with colleagues who develop SoC firmware to ensure that the BMC operates correctly within the complete system.
Contribute to the upstream OpenBMC community to ensure that common server manageability features and Arm-specific platform requirements are well supported, maintained, and aligned with industry standards.
Required Skills and Experience
We need the following experience and skills from our candidates:
5+ years of strong proficiency in C/C++ programming and Linux shell scripting for embedded firmware development, debugging, and automation.
Hands-on experience with U-Boot, Linux kernel development, and device driver integration for hardware interfaces such as GPIO, I2C, I3C, SPI, PCIe, and Ethernet.
Good understanding of OpenBMC architecture, system management services, D-Bus communication, and systemd service management, with experience in developing, integrating, and debugging OpenBMC components.
Good Linux debugging skills.
Familiarity with Git.
Strong interpersonal skills; excellent written and spoken English.
“Nice To Have” Skills and Experience
We would look favourably at the following:
Knowledge of DMTF specifications and protocols, including PLDM, MCTP, and SPDM, with an understanding of their application in server management and platform security.
Familiarity with OCP specifications and standards related to server manageability, including DC-SCM and other relevant platform management requirements.
Experience contributing to upstream open-source projects, particularly OpenBMC, including patch submission, code reviews, and collaboration with the open-source community.
Hands-on experience with BMC SoCs from vendors such as ASPEED or Nuvoton, including platform bring-up, peripheral integration, and firmware development.
Ability to read and interpret hardware schematics, understand board-level interfaces, and collaborate with hardware teams to debug platform integration issues.

The successful candidate will be responsible for creating, designing and delivering SAP core reporting capabilities to the supported business units, especially Finance, working collaboratively to ensure optimised reporting availability driving process benefit and real-time data driven decisions.
Build and lead the SAP reporting team focused on rationalising existing, building new and standardising reporting templates and dashboards to drive wider business adoption and usage.
Driving the strategic design, development and support of SAP reporting using Core BI, SAC and Data Sphere to provision optimal reporting capabilities across the organisation.
Technical owner and reporting champion of the SAP reporting solutions, end to end, provisioning the 'business enabler' of data driven business decisions.
Responsibilities:
Providing optimal SAP Reporting functional expertise and guidance, driving technology as the 'business enabler' for strategic organisational reporting and decision making.
Designing and implementing a best in class reporting competency within the Arm SAP CoE, leading the business towards centralised, rationalised and standardised reporting, provisioning optimal data and reporting repositories that empower the supported business functions to implement fast and accurate decision making.
Influencing key business and senior leadership resources on adoption of SAP reporting capabilities, road mapping new functionality that would directly benefit to successfully drive change.
Leading and mentoring the BI, SAC, and Data Sphere functional team. Implementing optimal methodologies for the reporting lifecycle. Designing, developing, and supporting standardised SAP and non-SAP reporting templates and dashboards for strategic decision-making.
Required Skills and Experience:
Extensive hands-on technical skills in SAP Data Sphere and SAC, and prior experience in SAP Data products, to enable clear direction and effective evaluation of SAP reporting capability design and development.
Strategic understanding of SAP data and analytics roadmap. Validated experience in driving continuous improvements and leading SAP reporting development and support in a large organization.
Experienced in stakeholder management and relationship building. Skilled at adapting communication for senior leaders and presenting complex technical proposals to non-technical audiences.
Develop and mentor team members and key business users, providing coaching where necessary. Strong leadership and influencing skills, able to act swiftly with confidence.
“Nice To Have” Skills and Experience:
Experience of SoX governed environments.
Relevant SAP certifications in the reporting areas, such as SAP Certified SAC or Data Sphere!
Reading and debug knowledge of ABAP.
Experienced with development practices such as Waterfall, Agile.
Mentoring technical colleagues and key business users.
Experienced working in a global, diverse and multicultural environment!
In Return:
You will step into a role with significant strategic influence, where your expertise in SAP reporting leadership directly shapes how the organisation leverages data to make faster, smarter decisions. This is an opportunity to build and lead a high‑performing reporting capability from the ground up, setting the standards, vision and methodologies that will define the future of enterprise analytics across the business.

jobs.description:
Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
We are looking for a Staff AI Engineer to be the technical anchor for Agentic AI in IT Quality Engineering – setting the architecture, standards and roadmap for custom Agentic AI applications across an Enterprise IT landscape spanning Salesforce, SAP, custom Licensing and Entitlement management applications, and AI Custom Quoting, Provisioning and ITSM platforms. You will decide how agents plan, act, retrieve context and hand back to a human across these systems; how they are evaluated, governed and operated in production; and how the wider engineering team builds them well. This is a hands-on role: you will still design and write the hardest parts yourself.
At Palo Alto Networks we are moving towards an AI-First engineering culture. You will shape the direction of our own internal AI platform tools for test generation, automation scripting, execution and quality reporting, and lead the engineers who build on them.
Qualifications
Architecture & Technical Direction
Agentic Architecture: Define the reference architecture for agentic systems across the landscape — planner-executor orchestration, multi-agent coordination, state, memory and recovery — and choose frameworks such as LangGraph, ADK, LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen or CrewAI on evidence rather than fashion.
Event-Driven Enterprise Integration: Architect event-driven pipelines that connect Salesforce (Platform Events, Change Data Capture, Apex, Flows), SAP (OData/BAPI services and business-object events) and custom Licensing, Entitlement, AI Custom Quoting, Provisioning and ITSM applications to AI processing with production OAuth2 lifecycle, least-privilege access and idempotent writes to systems of record.
Context & Knowledge Architecture: Set the retrieval strategy across the estate — vector and graph stores (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate or Milvus; Apache AGE or Neo4j), advanced topologies (Graph RAG, Corrective RAG, HyDE, agentic retrieval), and the ingestion, freshness and access-control rules that keep context correct.
Tool & Protocol Standards: Own the standards for tool definitions, JSON function schemas and MCP servers across teams, so that agent tool calls are schema-validated, auditable and traceable back to Jira.
Model Strategy: Decide when prompting and retrieval are enough and when model customisation is justified — and lead resource-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA) where it is.
Quality, Safety & Governance at Scale
Evaluation Strategy & Release Gates: Define how AI agents — ours and the ones other teams build that the business depends on — are evaluated before release: golden sets, calibrated LLM-as-judge, adversarial testing, and risk-tiered release gates that block what should be blocked.
Autonomy & HITL Governance: Set the autonomy model — which decisions an agent may take alone, which need human approval, and how that changes as evidence accumulates — and make sure it is enforced in code, especially where agents write to systems of record.
LLMOps & Platform Reliability: Architect secure AI gateways, token-budget and rate-limit controls, model deployment pipelines, drift monitoring and automated rollback; own service levels, cost and incident response for production agents.
Responsible AI & Data Governance: Partner with security and data-governance owners to define guardrails on intellectual property and data privacy — managed secrets, explicit opt-in for any step that sends content to an external service, and an audit trail a reviewer can follow.
Leadership & Influence
Design & Review Board: Lead design reviews for agentic and AI-integrated systems across Salesforce, SAP and custom platforms, and set the code and design standards for both human-written and AI-generated code.
Roadmap & Strategy: Partner with engineering leadership, QE leads, product managers and enterprise architects to turn quality and business goals into a sequenced AI engineering roadmap — and say plainly what will not work.
Mentorship & Capability Building: Mentor Senior AI Engineers and AI Engineers, grow the next AI Architects, and shape the reference implementations and training that move engineers up our AI capability ladder.
Cross-Organisation Influence: Represent IT Quality Engineering in enterprise architecture and AI governance forums, and drive adoption of AI-native engineering practice beyond your own team.
Qualifications
Required Skills & Experience
Experience: 7–10 years of professional software engineering experience, including 3+ years in applied AI/ML, of which at least 2 years building LLM-based or agentic systems that reached production.
Leadership Track Record: 2+ years as a technical lead, staff engineer or architect driving architectural decisions and leading cross-functional technical initiatives to production.
Programming Mastery: Expert proficiency in Python and strong proficiency in Java or TypeScript/Node.js; excellent software design is a given.
Agentic Systems Architecture: You have designed and led production agentic systems — planner-executor orchestration, multi-agent coordination, state and memory, HITL control — and can explain the trade-offs you made and what you would change.
Distributed & Event-Driven Systems: Deep experience with microservices, event-driven architecture and message queues (e.g., Kafka, Pub/Sub), including idempotency, ordering, back-pressure and failure recovery.
Retrieval at Scale: You have designed production RAG systems over vector and/or graph stores, including access-controlled ingestion and measured retrieval quality.
Evaluation & Governance: You have established evaluation and release-gating practice for LLM systems — golden sets, LLM-as-judge calibration, adversarial and prompt-injection testing — that was adopted beyond your own team.
Enterprise Integration: Deep experience integrating with enterprise platforms — Salesforce, SAP or comparable CRM, ERP or ITSM systems — including OAuth2 lifecycle, safe write patterns and data-governance constraints.
Cloud, LLMOps & CI/CD: Strong experience with GCP/AWS/Azure, Docker and Kubernetes, CI/CD at enterprise scale, and operating AI services with observability, cost controls and rollback.
AI-Assisted Development: Deep fluency with tools such as Cursor, Claude Code or GitHub Copilot, and a track record of setting team practice for reviewing what they produce.
Education: B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
Preferred Qualifications
Model Customisation: Hands-on fine-tuning with resource-efficient methods (LoRA/QLoRA), including data preparation and evaluation of the tuned model against its base.
Integration Platforms: Event-driven enterprise integration in practice — SAP business-object events and workflow triggers, Salesforce Platform Events or Change Data Capture, and middleware such as SnapLogic or MuleSoft.
Model Context Protocol: Designing MCP server estates used across teams — tools, resources and prompts, with versioning and access control.
Managed AI Platforms: Production experience with Vertex AI or an equivalent managed AI platform.
AI Security: Threat modelling for agentic systems — prompt injection, tool misuse, data exfiltration and red-teaming practice.
Quality Engineering at Scale: Architecting test automation or quality platforms (Playwright, REST Assured, Selenium or PyTest), including AI-assisted test generation or self-healing automation.
Domain Expertise: Deep grounding in B2B sales, Partner Relationship Management (PRM), the Quote-to-Cash lifecycle, or licensing, entitlement and provisioning flows.
Industry Contribution: Publications, conference talks or significant open-source contributions in agentic AI, retrieval or LLM evaluation.
WAYS OF WORKING
Evidence over Assertion: You measure before and after, you publish the number with its method attached, you say plainly when a result is inconclusive — and you hold the team's claims to the same standard.
Curiosity with Rigour: You enjoy new tooling but you test it before you trust it, and you know the difference between a demo and a system.
Strategic Influence: You change direction with evidence and clear writing rather than authority, with technical and non-technical stakeholders alike.
High Autonomy: You take ambiguous, cross-system problems and turn them into a plan a team can execute, and you raise risks early rather than late.
Builder's Bias: You would rather ship a narrow capability that works and is trusted than a broad one that only demos well — and you set that standard for the team.
GROWTH PATH
This role sits at the AI Architect tier of our internal AI capability ladder (AI User → AI Engineer → AI Architect), and you will operate there from the start: planner-executor orchestration at scale, multi-agent systems with human-in-the-loop control, event-driven integration across the enterprise IT landscape, and model customisation. From here the role grows in scope from a single programme to the AI engineering direction of IT Quality Engineering — and in the number of engineers you bring up the same ladder.
THE TEAM
You will be part of a growing, passionate and dynamic team, with the opportunity to work on challenging and exciting projects centred on what we believe is one of the most significant mission statements in the world. We also strive to be the most people-centric company ever — that means we are constantly working to make your experience amazing, and you are part of the team breaking the boundaries of what the workplace can be.
Our Commitment
We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
