jobs.title: Layout Design Engineer, Sr Staff
jobs.description:
We Are
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
You Are
You have spent years in the trenches of full-custom analog layout, and you know that the difference between a SERDES block that closes timing and one that doesn't often comes down to a routing decision you made three weeks before tape-out. You think in layers, in parasitic budgets, in current density maps.
What You'll Be Doing
Own top-level layout integration for Analog/Mixed-Signal IP, driving floorplan optimization, block assembly, power distribution architecture, signal routing strategy, and full chip-level physical implementation from concept through tape-out
Drive Bump Map architecture and co-design with package teams, including signal and power bump assignment, ESD discharge path verification, IR-drop and current density analysis, substrate noise isolation strategy, and reliability validation
Develop full-custom layouts for high-speed SERDES blocks including TX/RX datapaths, PLL, VCO, LDO, Bandgap, Bias circuits, CTLE, VGA, and Clock Distribution Networks, optimizing for signal integrity, matching, area, and performance
Implement and validate layout techniques including differential routing with shielding, common-centroid and interdigitated device placement, symmetry-based matching structures, parasitic-aware routing, and ESD/latch-up mitigation
Execute physical verification and sign-off using Calibre DRC/LVS/ERC, ICV, StarRC/StarRCXT for extraction, PERC for parasitic analysis, and EMIR tools for electromigration and IR-drop validation
Mentor and technically develop junior layout engineers through structured design reviews, hands-on guidance on complex blocks, knowledge-sharing sessions on advanced layout techniques, and day-to-day problem-solving collaboration
Work directly with circuit designers, verification teams, and package engineers to resolve layout-driven performance issues, close timing on critical paths, and ensure manufacturability and reliability across advanced process nodes
The Impact You Will Have
Enable tape-out success for high-performance Analog IP that powers SERDES, AI, and compute products across Synopsys customer base by delivering layouts that meet aggressive PPA targets on the first pass
Reduce re-spin risk and schedule slip by catching EM, IR, signal integrity, and reliability issues early through disciplined physical verification and proactive collaboration with design and package teams
Accelerate layout closure timelines by building reusable floorplan templates, optimized routing strategies, and verified layout cells that can be leveraged across multiple IP variants and technology nodes
Strengthen the layout engineering capability of the Bangalore team by mentoring junior engineers, establishing best practices, and building institutional knowledge around advanced nodes like 5nm, 3nm, and Intel 18A
Improve cross-functional collaboration between layout, circuit design, and verification by translating complex parasitic and reliability constraints into actionable design guidance that circuit teams can use upstream
Contribute to Synopsys IP competitiveness by delivering layouts optimized for the latest FinFET and Gate-All-Around (GAA) process technologies, enabling customers to achieve differentiated performance in their silicon
Drive quality and reliability outcomes by ensuring every layout you touch passes EM, IR, ESD, latch-up, and DRC/LVS clean on submission, reducing downstream verification cycles and freeing up team bandwidth for new development
What You'll Need
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics Engineering, VLSI Design, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
8+ years of hands-on experience in full-custom Analog/Mixed-Signal CMOS layout design, with demonstrated ownership of blocks from floorplan through tape-out
Strong expertise in high-speed SERDES layout, including TX/RX datapaths, PLL, VCO, and clock distribution networks, with a track record of meeting timing, signal integrity, and performance targets
Proficiency in layout techniques including differential routing and shielding, common-centroid and interdigitated matching, symmetry-based placement, parasitic-aware routing, and ESD/latch-up mitigation strategies
Deep working knowledge of physical verification and sign-off flows using Calibre (DRC/LVS/ERC), ICV, StarRC or StarRCXT for extraction, PERC, and EMIR tools for electromigration and IR-drop analysis
Experience with Synopsys Custom Compiler or equivalent custom layout tools (Cadence Virtuoso, Mentor Pyxis), and comfort learning new toolsets as needed
Experience with advanced technology nodes such as 5nm, 3nm, Intel 18A/18AP, or equivalent FinFET/GAA processes is a strong plus, as is exposure to scripting with TCL, Perl, or Python for layout automation
Who You Are
You can look at a floorplan and immediately spot the routing bottleneck, the IR-drop risk, or the matching problem that will surface three weeks later, and you speak up before it becomes a schedule issue
You do not treat physical verification as a checkbox exercise. When an EM violation appears, you trace the current path, understand the circuit intent, and propose a fix that does not break something else downstream
You are comfortable sitting with a circuit designer who is frustrated about parasitic capacitance on a critical node and walking out with a routing plan that gives them the 50 femtofarads they need without blowing up area or DRC

jobs.title: WX HSE Manager, Hyderabad Hub
jobs.description:
Job Title: WX HSE Manager, Hyderabad Hub
Location: Hyderabad
Job Type: Permanent/Fulltime
About the job
Our Team:
The Real Estate & Workplace Team aims to offer the best workplace experience to all Sanofi employees so that all of them can bring the best version of themselves to work.
To do so, we put Sanofi employees’ needs, wellbeing and sustainability at the heart of all our strategic and investments decisions.
Our Sanofi workplace experience is rooted in hospitality principles and integrates the latest technologies to enable our employees to live a positive and inclusive work experience.
We believe that providing employees with innovative services and a well-supported workplace will help promote productivity, wellbeing, collaboration, innovation, and ultimately will result in greater employee engagement.
Main responsibilities
The Health Safety & Environment (HSE) Manager is responsible for leading the implementation of the HSE program, collaborating with Senior Management, Line Management, and Residents to ensure the effective implementation of a proactive Health Management System that complies with local regulations and Sanofi HSE requirements. Key responsibilities include implementing the HSE management system, monitoring ongoing HSE construction, expansion and MAC projects, deploying HSE cultural excellence initiatives, analysing hazardous situations, and regularly measuring strategies and programs to ensure continuous improvement.
The HSE Manager works in close alignment with HSE country, regional and global teams. Priorities and Programs include HSE Leadership & Governance, improvement programs such as Workplace Safety, Road Safety, Health Promotion, Environment and Sustainability projects, HSE Audit support, Training & Development, Crisis Management and Wellness programs.
General Responsibilities
Lead and implement strategic HSE priorities in partnership with Hospitality Management, maintaining full alignment with the Global HSE Policy and framework
To identify, analyze and mitigate risks related to HSE
To ensure compliance with regulatory and Sanofi HSE requirements
To improve HSE performance (accidents and incidents reduction, reduction of chronic effects, waste, emission decrease, natural resources conservation)
Road safety programs implementation and Progress monitoring
Lead Sustainability program implementation in the Hub
HSE Governance, Leadership & Program Coordination
HSE Strategy & Global Alignment: Ensure seamless alignment of the site and country HSE strategy with Global Operations objectives, Group standards, and broader corporate policies. Lead and support global, regional, and local HSE initiatives, strategic priorities, and governance programs
Committee Governance & Culture: Establish, chair, and govern the HSE Committee and cross-functional forums; oversee annual planning, active agenda management, action tracking, and timely closure to drive Health, Wellness, and Sustainability mandates across the Hub
Management Reviews & Assurance: Conduct structured, periodic HSE performance reviews, including regulatory compliance gap analyses, standards implementation assessments, KPI tracking, and follow-up on corrective and preventive action plans (CAPAs) arising from internal and external HSE audits
Business Partnering: Partner collaboratively with business functions, workplace experience (WX) teams, and external service partners to cultivate a robust safety culture, enhance workforce well-being, and drive operational sustainability
HSE Management System (HSEMS) & Operational Risk Management
HSEMS Implementation & Continuous Improvement: Architect, deploy, and maintain an integrated HSE Management System across Hub operations, driving rigorous governance, statutory compliance, and ongoing performance improvement
Risk Profiling & Assessments: Conduct thorough risk assessments covering routine workplace operations, facility expansion projects, high-risk work environments, and internal/external events, implementing effective hierarchy-of-control measures
Contractor Safety & Safe Systems of Work: Direct the Contractor Safety Management program and oversee the Permit-to-Work (PTW) system, ensuring stringent on-site verification, pre-qualification standards, and adherence to safe operating procedures across routine services and capital expansion projects
Chemical & Process Safety Management: Oversee and enforce hazardous substance protocols, process safety assessments, chemical handling standards, and storage containment measures across site operations
Safety Rituals & Proactive Culture: Champion proactive safety performance by implementing and monitoring Leading Safety Rituals (including systematic Plan vs. Actual tracking) and operationalizing regular Project Safety Reviews for capital works
Occupational Health, Wellness & Crisis Management
Occupational Health Center (OHC) Operations: Supervise the daily operations, clinical governance, and service level delivery of the on-site Occupational Health Center, ensuring strict adherence to medical confidentiality, occupational hygiene standards, and regulatory requirements
Workforce Well-Being & Engagement: Lead the implementation of comprehensive Health Promotion and well-being programs (including corporate All Well initiatives); organize high-impact employee engagement campaigns such as the One Hour Stop for Safety, Environmental Days, and targeted wellness interventions
Emergency Preparedness & Crisis Response: Formulate, maintain, and test site-specific Emergency Management and Crisis Response Plans addressing local industrial hazards, severe weather, and business continuity vulnerabilities. Provide rapid, expert incident command during major emergencies, critical injuries, or environmental releases, steering post-event recovery and forensic event reviews
Sustainability Roadmap & Environmental Stewardship
Multi-Year Environmental Strategy: Formulate and execute a Multi-Annual HSE & Sustainability Action Plan aligned with overarching Global Group commitments, ensuring environmental targets are embedded within baseline Hub operations
Workplace Experience (WX) Collaboration: Partner directly with WX and Facilities teams to lead sustainability reporting, energy conservation and energy sobriety initiatives, waste reduction/diversion programs, and circular recycling workflows
Resident Awareness & Environmental Engagement: Design and roll out comprehensive green communication frameworks to maximize campus resident participation in energy conservation, waste segregation, and carbon-reduction initiatives
Incident Investigation, Digital MIS & Analytics
Incident Governance & Root Cause Analysis: Direct incident reporting workflows, lead comprehensive investigations for near-misses, injuries, and operational deviations, and perform root-cause analysis (RCA) and CAPA lifecycle tracking via enterprise tools such as QualiPSO
HSE Enterprise Platforms Administration: Administer and maintain site operations on global and local digital platforms, including QualiPSO, SHERPA, and the HSE Index Portal
Data Intelligence & Digital MIS: Modernize HSE reporting by building and managing automated MIS dashboards and workflows utilizing Microsoft Power Apps and Power BI, providing transparent, real-time performance analytics

jobs.description:
Job Title: Assistant Manager | Access Management
Job Location: Bangalore, India
About Unilever:
Be part of the world’s most successful, purpose-led business. Work with brands that are well-loved around the world, that improve the lives of our consumers and the communities around us. We promote innovation, big and small, to make our business win and grow; and we believe in business as a force for good. Unleash your curiosity, challenge ideas and disrupt processes; use your energy to make this happen. Our brilliant business leaders and colleagues provide mentorship and inspiration, so you can be at your best. Every day, nine out of ten Indian households use our products to feel good, look good and get more out of life – giving us a unique opportunity to build a brighter future.
Every individual here can bring their purpose to life through their work. Join us and you’ll be surrounded by inspiring leaders and supportive peers. Among them, you’ll channel your purpose, bring fresh ideas to the table, and simply be you. As you work to make a real impact on the business and the world, we’ll work to help you become a better you.
PURPOSE OF THE ROLE
The Access Management product team delivers the privileged access controls that protect Unilever’s most critical technology platforms, identities and business services. The PAM capability enables secure, governed and auditable access for administrators, engineers, suppliers, service accounts and other privileged identities across on-premises, cloud and SaaS environments.
As the Privileged Access Management Product SME, you will be part of internal technical authority for PAM. You will oversee the design, engineering, integration, support and operational health of CyberArk, Beyond Trust and Cloud console capabilities, while shaping and leading the technical delivery of Unilever’s PAM modernization programme. The role requires strong hands-on expertise, strategic thinking and the ability to translate emerging security capabilities into scalable, resilient and user-centered services. Additionally, you will strive to continuously improve our services, ensuring they meet the evolving needs of our users and customers, and provide robust support to maintain secure, efficient and frictionless access.
WHAT WILL YOUR MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES BE
Serve as the internal technical authority for Privileged Access Management, including CyberArk, BeyondTrust and associated identity, directory, endpoint, cloud and security integrations.
evolve the PAM technical strategy, target architecture, standards and roadmap, aligned to Zero Trust, least privilege, identity-first security and Unilever technology strategy.
Lead the technical workstreams of the PAM modernization programme, including discovery, platform rationalization, migration planning, solution design, proof of concept, implementation and transition to operations.
Design secure, scalable and resilient solutions for credential vaulting, password rotation, privileged session management, remote privileged access, endpoint privilege management, secrets management and just-in-time access.
Define onboarding patterns for human, service, application, machine and cloud privileged identities, ensuring appropriate controls, approvals, ownership, monitoring and lifecycle governance.
Provide clear technical direction and oversight to strategic suppliers and delivery partners; assure designs, engineering practices, operational procedures and contracted outcomes against Unilever standards.
Act as the escalation point for complex PAM incidents and problems, leading advanced troubleshooting, root cause analysis, service restoration and permanent remediation across integrated platforms.
Improve 24x7 operational readiness through effective monitoring, alerting, capacity management, disaster recovery, resilience testing, patching, vulnerability management and service continuity controls.
Partner with IAM, Active Directory, Entra ID, cloud, endpoint, SOC, application, infrastructure and risk teams to embed PAM controls across hybrid and multi-cloud technology environments.
Establish measurable technical and service outcomes, including privileged account coverage, credential rotation compliance, session control adoption, onboarding throughput, platform health and reduction of standing privilege.
Support audits, control testing, risk assessments and remediation, ensuring evidence is accurate, repeatable and traceable and that suppliers remain accountable for agreed actions.
Monitor market and technology developments, evaluate new PAM and identity security capabilities, and recommend forward-looking improvements such as identity threat detection, password less administration, workload identity protection and policy-driven automation.
Coach engineers and operational teams, create reusable engineering patterns and documentation, and build sustainable internal capability for PAM design and support.
EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS
Necessary experience
5-7+ years of hands-on experience in PAM, IAM, cyber security engineering or a related technical role within a large, complex and regulated enterprise.
Demonstrable engineering and operational experience with CyberArk PAM and strong working knowledge of BeyondTrust capabilities; experience across both platforms is highly desirable.
Proven delivery of PAM transformation or modernisation initiatives, including current-state assessment, target-state design, migration, platform consolidation and adoption planning.
Experience designing and operating highly available PAM services across global, hybrid and multi-cloud environments, including disaster recovery and cyber recovery considerations.
Deep understanding of privileged account discovery, vaulting, rotation, Just In Time, Zero Standing Privilege, session isolation and recording, remote access, endpoint privilege management, secrets management and non-human identity controls.
Experience integrating PAM with Active Directory, Entra ID, GCP, MFA, ITSM, SIEM/SOC, cloud platforms, databases, network devices, applications.
Advanced troubleshooting capability across complex identity, network, authentication, certificate, API and platform dependencies, with experience providing L3/L4 engineering support.
Experience governing third-party service providers, assuring technical designs and procedures, managing escalations and driving measurable service improvement.
Strong knowledge of cyber security risk, audit and control frameworks, with the ability to convert requirements into practical engineering standards and evidence.
Excellent stakeholder communication and leadership skills, with the ability to influence architects, engineers, suppliers, control owners and senior decision-makers.
Qualifications and desirable certifications
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Cyber Security, Engineering or a comparable discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
PAM Product certifications such as Cyberark, Beyond Trust or equivalent practical accreditation is desirable.
Experience working within Agile, product-led and DevSecOps delivery models.
FORWARD-LOOKING TECHNICAL LEADERSHIP
Anticipate how privileged access must evolve for cloud-native platforms, machine identities, AI-enabled services and increasingly automated technology estates.
Challenge legacy operating models and standing privilege, using data and threat insight to priorities modernization and control uplift.
Balance strategic architecture with pragmatic delivery, creating transition plans that reduce risk while maintaining business continuity.
Build proof points through experimentation and pilots, then industrialize successful patterns through automation, standards and reusable onboarding journeys.
Promote secure-by-design and user-centred controls that improve both security outcomes and the administrator experience.
SKILLS
Innovation & Problem Solving
Automation & Integration
Cyber Security & Risk
Supplier Governance
Incident & Problem Solving
Stakeholder Communication
Learning Agility & Innovation
KEY BEHAVIOURS
Focus on What Counts: Prioritise the highest-risk privileged access challenges, set clear outcomes and deliver measurable security and service improvements.
Stay Three Steps Ahead: Anticipate technology and threat changes, explore emerging PAM capabilities and shape a modern, adaptable target state.
Deliver with Excellence: Maintain high engineering standards, take accountability for outcomes and continuously improve platform resilience, controls and customer.

jobs.title: Principal Data Systems Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Build the next generation of Oracle data protection software, helping fortune 500 enterprises protect and recover their business-critical Oracle databases. Work on software where data integrity, recoverability, cyber resilience, and performance at scale directly affect customers’ most important operations.
Join our growing engineering team in Bengaluru and collaborate with experienced engineers in India and the US. You will contribute to shared product priorities, deliver new features and projects, and help evolve an enterprise data protection platform. This role offers the opportunity to help shape a new team while building deep product expertise within an established global engineering organization.
The work spans Oracle database kernel development and systems programming, primarily in C and PL/SQL on Linux. You will tackle engineering problems involving buffers and caches, memory management, storage, file systems, I/O, networking, concurrency, and distributed systems. Strong algorithms, thoughtful design, and an understanding of how these components interact will be central to delivering correct, efficient, and maintainable software.
You will participate throughout the development lifecycle: understanding problems, exploring the codebase, identifying root causes, designing solutions, implementing changes, writing tests, and validating results. The work combines new development and enhancements with complex defect resolution, including issues encountered in customer environments. As your product knowledge grows, you will take increasing technical ownership of assigned features and components, contributing to design decisions, code reviews, ongoing maintenance, and knowledge sharing.
We value engineers who investigate problems systematically, use documentation and diagnostic tools resourcefully, communicate clearly, and help colleagues succeed. You will use modern engineering tools, including LLMs and AI coding agents, to accelerate code exploration, development, and testing while applying independent judgment and rigorous validation to the resulting designs and code.
We welcome experienced developers with strong C, Linux, system programming skills and practical knowledge of database internals, storage, distributed systems, or other demanding enterprise software. Prior Oracle Database, RMAN, PL/SQL, or backup and recovery product experience is an advantage. Strong systems fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to translate complex requirements into reliable production software are essential.
This position is based in Bengaluru, India.
• Design, implement, and maintain RMAN features and enhancements in C and PL/SQL on Linux, contributing to Oracle database kernel and systems software development.
• Translate requirements and technical problems into clear designs, manageable tasks, and deliverable milestones. Evaluate alternatives and document trade-offs involving correctness, performance, scalability, compatibility, and maintainability.
• Apply appropriate algorithms and data structures to build efficient, reliable software. Reason about memory use, concurrency, synchronization, and behavior under demanding workloads.
• Develop and improve assigned components involving buffers, caches, storage, file systems, I/O, networking, and distributed processing, with careful attention to data integrity and recovery behavior.
• Build product expertise through code exploration, technical documentation, collaboration, and delivery of fixes and enhancements. Progress toward ownership of assigned features and projects, including subsequent development, maintenance, and defect resolution.

jobs.title: Senior Construction Scheduler
jobs.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers
Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.
Your role at a glance
The Sr. Construction Scheduler is responsible for reviewing and analyzing General Contractors’ schedules and reporting on schedule health to the Project Team and other key stakeholders. This role involves working closely with NTT’s Construction Team and General Contractors to drive consistency, accountability, and adherence to established scheduling standards across all projects.
The Construction Scheduler will also support the analysis of schedule delays by reviewing, summarizing, and comparing General Contractors’ Time Impact Analyses (TIAs) against other available project data. This position plays an integral role in providing data-driven insights to enhance project predictability. Additionally, the Construction Scheduler will be responsible for collecting as-built data.
What we are looking for
KEY RESPONSIBLITIES
Lead baseline schedule development by partnering with NTT’s General Contractors to establish accurate, fully logic-driven project baselines.
Review General Contractors’ project schedules to identify potential risks, constraints, and sequencing issues, with a proactive focus on mitigation and recovery strategies.
Develop periodic schedule reports and proactively communicate schedule risks and performance trends to the Project stakeholders.
Ensure client-specific scheduling requirements are met, including compliance with contractual obligations, reporting standards, and project specific deliverables.
Develop schedule what-if scenarios and perform comparative schedule assessments to inform and drive data-based decision making.
Champion and support the implementation of scheduling best practices across GID, driving standardization of processes, templates, coding structures, and reporting methodologies to ensure consistency, data integrity, and alignment with portfolio-level controls and governance standards.
Develop meaningful scheduling key performance indicators (KPIs) that accurately reflect project progress at any given point in time, enabling clear visibility into performance against baseline.
Review Time Impact Analyses (TIAs) and provide structured feedback to the Construction Team and General Contractors.
Partner with project stakeholders to support planning efforts and maintain schedule control throughout the project lifecycle by developing and managing internal schedules that accurately reflect current progress across all phases.
Lead schedule progress meetings with the Construction Team and General Contractors to review status, validate updates, and address variances.
Perform any other related tasks as required.
KNOWLEDGE & ATTRIBUTES
Fully versed in Critical Path Method (CPM) scheduling requirements for construction projects, including development and maintenance of logic-driven schedules, critical path analysis, risk assessment, and adherence to contractual scheduling specifications.

jobs.title: Financial Planning & Analysis, Staff
jobs.description:
We Are:
At Synopsys, we drive the innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology is central to the Era of Pervasive Intelligence, from self-driving cars to learning machines. We lead in chip design, verification, and IP integration, empowering the creation of high-performance silicon chips and software content. Join us to transform the future through continuous technological innovation.
You Are:
You are a seasoned finance professional with a passion for transforming data into actionable insights. With over a decade of experience in Financial Planning & Analysis, you thrive in dynamic environments where complexity is the norm and innovation is encouraged. You possess a keen eye for detail and are adept at identifying cost optimization opportunities that support business objectives. As a trusted advisor, you foster strong relationships across cross-functional teams, building credibility and driving collaborative outcomes. Your analytical prowess is matched by your communication skills, enabling you to translate financial data into compelling narratives for leadership and business partners. You take initiative and are not afraid to challenge the status quo, constantly seeking ways to improve processes and deliver value. You are comfortable working across time zones and enjoy the challenge of supporting global-scale programs. Your expertise spans budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and KPIs, and you are proficient with advanced financial tools.
What You’ll Be Doing:
Managing budget versus actuals for business and finance expenditures, ensuring financial discipline across departments.
Reporting actual financial results, comparing them with plans and forecasts, and providing insightful commentary on variances.
Assisting in month-end closure activities and ensuring accurate, timely financial reporting in compliance with internal standards.
Alerting leadership to unforeseen expenses, risks, and opportunities through proactive financial monitoring and analysis.
Identifying cost reduction opportunities and making actionable recommendations to leadership for operational efficiency.
Developing long-term financial projections and building robust financial models to support strategic planning.
Maintaining key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess financial health and performance, and communicating results to stakeholders.
Performing budgeting, forecasting, operational metrics tracking, and identifying cost optimization opportunities for business units.
Analyzing financial data to support decision-making and reporting on performance for business partners and leadership.
Conducting variance analysis, identifying trends, and recommending improvements to business processes.
Collaborating with the accounting team to ensure compliance and accuracy in financial reporting.
Driving process improvements, including the creation of standard and ad-hoc reports and Excel dashboards.
Supporting ad-hoc business analysis and reporting requirements for various business units.
Ensuring high data accuracy and attention to detail in all financial analyses.
Designing and implementing reporting tools to enhance transparency and flexibility in financial analysis.
The Impact You Will Have:
Empowering leadership with reliable financial insights to make informed strategic decisions.
Enhancing operational efficiency through cost reduction and optimization initiatives.
Strengthening financial discipline and accountability across the organization.
Driving process improvements that streamline reporting and increase transparency.
Supporting business units with accurate and actionable financial analysis, fostering growth and profitability.
Promoting a culture of continuous improvement in financial planning and execution.
Facilitating compliance and accuracy in financial reporting, safeguarding Synopsys’ reputation and integrity.
Enabling Synopsys to respond proactively to risks and opportunities in a fast-evolving industry.
What You’ll Need:
CA (Chartered Accountant), ICWA (Management Accountant), US CPA, or MBA (Finance specialization).
5+ years’ experience in Financial Planning & Analysis, MIS, and analytics, preferably in a leading high-tech company.
Strong background in accounting, expense accruals, analysis, and capital expenditure analysis.
Advanced analytical and numeric skills; adept at handling complex data and translating it into actionable insights.
Working knowledge of Anaplan, SAP, and advanced skills in Excel, PowerPoint, and visualization tools; hands-on experience with Oracle is a plus.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for effective interaction with Corporate FP&A partners and functional teams.
Willingness to work in shifts to enable collaboration with global teams across different time zones.
Who You Are:
Collaborative team player who communicates effectively across functions and geographies.
Self-starter with a curious mindset and a drive for continuous learning and improvement.
Detail-oriented with a high standard for data accuracy and integrity.
Relationship builder who cultivates trust and credibility with business partners.
Adaptable and resilient in fast-paced, dynamic environments.
Proactive problem solver who takes initiative to deliver results.
The Team You’ll Be A Part Of:
You’ll join a high-performing finance team that partners closely with cross-functional business units and leadership. The team is focused on delivering strategic financial insights, driving operational excellence, and supporting Synopsys’ mission to lead in innovation and technology. Collaboration, transparency, and a commitment to continuous improvement are core values, and you’ll have opportunities to contribute to impactful projects while growing your expertise in a supportive, global environment.
Rewards and Benefits:
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings.
At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

Work with Engineering and QA teams to file bug reports, develop test plans, and improve software and hardware quality with each release cycle.
Facilitate hiring and onboarding by conducting technical screenings, training new hires on technical and soft skills, and ensuring readiness through process and tools training.

Provide rapid, high-quality support in high-pressure situations, traveling to customer sites to expedite critical issue resolution.
Engage in technical discussions with cross-functional teams to drive transparency, optimize security posture, and enhance cybersecurity resilience.
Leverage internal AI-powered diagnostic utilities, automated log analyzers, and machine learning tools to accelerate root-cause analysis, optimize multi-vendor troubleshooting workflows, and decrease time-to-resolution for complex network security events.

Required Qualifications
Minimum of 5 years of network security experience.
BS in computer science, information technology, computer architecture, electrical engineering, mathematics, or related experience or equivalent military experience required.
Expertise in TCP/IP, LAN/WAN technologies, routing protocols (e.g, BGP, OSPF, EIGRP), and branch/center architectures.
Extensive experience with troubleshooting Remote Access VPN solutions including IPSEC, PKI & SSL technologies.
Ability to independently debug complex networks with an advanced understanding of packet flow across multiple OSI layers.

Proficiency with network troubleshooting tools such as Wireshark and GNS3.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a proven track record of communicating technical concepts to diverse audiences, including C-level executives.
Willingness to work outside of normal business hours as business needs dictate.

Virtualization experience (AWS, Azure, VMWare, OpenStack).
Experience with Windows, MAC OS, and Linux (Debugging, Editing Registries, Plist, etc.).
Experience with Python or Shell scripting.
Multi-Vendor Exposure - Cisco Advanced Security Appliances, Palo Alto Next-Generation Firewalls, Prisma Access, Cisco Firepower, Checkpoint Firewalls, Cisco Switches, and Intrusion Detection/ Intrusion Prevention S

As a Senior Design Verification Engineer at Analog Devices, you will lead verification planning and execution for next-generation automotive connectivity SoCs based on E2B technology. Working independently with minimal supervision, you will develop advanced verification environments for complex SoCs incorporating embedded microprocessors, communication subsystems, firmware, security functions, and mixed-signal components.
You will collaborate closely with architecture, digital design, analog design, firmware, functional safety, and validation teams to ensure robust verification coverage and high-quality silicon. You will also contribute to verification methodology improvements, mentor junior engineers, and help resolve complex hardware, firmware, and system-level issues.
This career-level position provides the opportunity to contribute to technologies that enable reliable, high-performance communication within modern vehicles.
Key Responsibilities
Verification Strategy: Develop and implement comprehensive verification strategies and test plans for automotive connectivity SoCs and E2B-related functionality.
SoC Verification: Verify complex SoCs containing embedded processors, memories, interconnects, DMA controllers, interrupts, communication interfaces, security features, and mixed-signal subsystems.
UVM Environment Development: Architect, develop, and maintain scalable SystemVerilog/UVM verification environments, including agents, scoreboards, reference models, sequences, assertions, and functional coverage.
Processor and Firmware Verification: Develop firmware-driven verification scenarios for microprocessor-based SoCs, including processor initialization, interrupts, exceptions, memory accesses, peripheral control, and hardware-software interactions.
C DPI Development: Develop and integrate C/SystemVerilog DPI components, software models, and reference models into simulation environments.
E2B Protocol Verification: Verify E2B protocol functionality, including data transfers, control and configuration mechanisms, timing behavior, error handling, diagnostics, and recovery scenarios.
Coverage and Verification Closure: Define and track functional coverage, code coverage, assertion coverage, test status, and verification metrics through sign-off.
Debug and Issue Resolution: Analyze and resolve complex issues across RTL, UVM environments, embedded software, C models, and system-level use cases.
Functional Safety Verification: Support verification of safety mechanisms, fault injection campaigns, requirements traceability, and verification activities associated with ISO 26262-compliant automotive products.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with architecture, design, firmware, functional safety, validation, and applications teams on verification planning, issue resolution, and product readiness.
Post-Silicon Support: Contribute to FPGA prototyping, silicon bring-up, post-silicon validation, and investigation of system or customer issues.
Technical Mentorship: Provide technical guidance to junior verification engineers and contribute to design and verification reviews.
Methodology and Automation: Improve verification productivity through reusable components, automation, regression infrastructure, and verification best practices.

SystemVerilog and UVM: Expert-level knowledge of SystemVerilog and the Universal Verification Methodology, with experience developing reusable verification environments for complex digital designs.
SoC Verification: Strong experience verifying complex SoCs that include embedded microprocessors, memories, buses, peripherals, interrupts, and communication subsystems.
C DPI Development: Hands-on experience developing C/SystemVerilog DPI interfaces and integrating C models or reference models into verification environments.
Verification Planning: Proven ability to convert architecture, design, and product requirements into detailed verification plans, test scenarios, functional coverage, and sign-off criteria.
Coverage-Driven Verification: Strong experience with constrained-random verification, functional coverage, code coverage, and assertion-based verification.
Hardware-Software Integration: Experience developing firmware-driven tests and debugging interactions between embedded software and RTL.
Debugging Expertise: Strong analytical and debugging skills across SystemVerilog/UVM testbenches, RTL, embedded C code, and system-level environments.
Scripting and Automation: Proficiency in Python, TCL, Perl, shell scripting, or similar languages for regression management, result analysis, and workflow automation.
Communication and Collaboration: Ability to work effectively across architecture, design, firmware, functional safety, validation, and applications teams.
Technical Leadership: Ability to independently lead verification activities, conduct technical reviews, mentor less-experienced engineers, and influence verification methodology adoption.
Preferred Skills
Experience verifying SoCs incorporating RISC-V processors. Experience with ARM or other embedded processor architectures is also valuable.
Understanding of processor concepts such as privilege modes, exceptions, interrupts, memory protection, caches, debug infrastructure, and firmware boot sequences.
Experience with automotive communication technologies, in-vehicle networking, or E2B technology.
Experience verifying communication protocols, packet-based interfaces, control channels, diagnostics, and error-recovery mechanisms.
Knowledge of automotive functional safety development and ISO 26262 verification practices.
Experience with fault injection, safety-mechanism verification, requirements traceability, and functional safety evidence generation.
Experience with emulation, FPGA prototyping, virtual platforms, or pre-silicon firmware development.
Knowledge of formal verification, clock-domain crossing, reset-domain crossing, low-power verification, or gate-level simulation.
Experience working with analog behavioral models or mixed-signal verification environments.
Familiarity with automotive cybersecurity concepts and secure communication mechanisms.
Experience with continuous integration, regression automation, and verification dashboards.

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
Master’s degree preferred.
4–8 years of relevant digital or mixed-signal IC verification experience.
Experience verifying processor-based SoCs and delivering designs through verification closure.
Experience with automotive semiconductor products or communication SoCs is preferred.

Role and Responsibilities
Design & maintain UVM‑based verification environments for high‑speed serial IP blocks (e.g.,56G/112G/224G Gbps SERDES, PCIe Gen4/5, Ethernet MAC/PHY,) and security IP (AES/SHA engines, ECC, secure‑boot, root‑of‑trust).
Develop comprehensive test plans and coverage models that capture protocol corner cases, timing jitter, eye‑diagram constraints, and security threat scenarios.
Create reusable UVM components (agents, drivers, monitors, scoreboards, and protocol checkers) that can be shared across multiple serial and security projects.
Implement constrained‑random traffic generators with data‑pattern, error‑injection, and latency‑stress capabilities to validate link reliability and security robustness.
Integrate formal verification and assertion‑based checking (SVA) to capture protocol violations, key‑exchange errors, and timing violations early in the flow.
Run and maintain regression suites on industry‑standard simulators (VCS, Xcelium, Questa) and CI pipelines; monitor functional coverage, protocol coverage, and security‑feature coverage.
Collaborate closely with design, architecture, and security teams to refine specifications, resolve bugs, and drive design for testability (DfT) and low‑power considerations.
Mentor junior verification engineers, enforce coding standards, and contribute to the IPD verification methodology library.
Participate in design reviews, risk assessments, and compliance verification (e.g., PCI‑SIG, IEEE Ethernet, NIST crypto standards).
Required Skills & Experience
System Verilog & UVM, Formal Verification expertise – 5–6 years of hands‑on verification on complex IP, with strong understanding of class‑based verification, randomization, coverage, and SVA.
High‑speed serial protocol knowledge – Practical experience verifying PCIe, Ethernet SERDES, or similar high‑throughput interfaces.
Security IP verification – Familiarity with cryptographic engines, secure‑boot flows, authentication protocols, side‑channel analysis, and related test strategies.
Simulation & automation tools – Proficient with VCS, Xcelium, or Questa; scripting in Tcl/Python for test bench generation and regression management.
Coverage‑driven verification – Ability to define functional, protocol, and security coverage models and drive them to closure.
Debugging & root‑cause analysis – Strong waveform analysis, assertion debugging, and use of log‑extraction tools to isolate failures.
Version control & CI/CD – Experience with Git and Jenkins/GitLab CI for automated regression runs.
Digital design fundamentals – Understanding of clock‑domain crossing, reset strategies, and low‑power design considerations for high‑speed blocks.
Education – B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech in Electrical/Computer Engineering or equivalent practical experience.
Skills and Qualifications
Experience – 5 to 6 Years of experience

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description
Are you the kind of product leader who gets energy from turning a great product into a growth engine?
If you've built product-led experiences that actually moved the needle on revenue and retention and you want to do it at scale, in a role that sits at the heart of company strategy, this is your opportunity.
We're looking for a Senior Product Manager who will architect the experiences that bring customers in, help them succeed, and grow with us, making our product the primary driver of how we acquire and retain customers.
This role is based in Pune and requires you to work from office at least 3 days a week.
About the team
You'll join a forward-thinking, collaborative product organisation focused on delivering exceptional experiences for Customer and Employee Service teams. You'll be part of a small but high-impact group of PMs in Pune, working closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success across locations.
The opportunity
Our ambition is bold: build the most powerful self-serve growth experience in our category. That means turning our product into the primary driver of new and expansion revenue, designing experiences that make it effortless for customers to discover, adopt, and expand and connecting product signals with sales and customer success to maximise retention.
As the PM driving this, you'll set the vision, lead execution, and shape how we use AI to move faster and smarter.
What you'll do
Own the growth roadmap: Define the product strategy for your area, tying every initiative to clear revenue and retention targets with measurable hypotheses and expected outcomes.
Deliver a best-in-class self-serve experience: Design and optimise the full customer journey: sign-up, onboarding, activation, upsell, and expansion. Build in-product experiences that drive real conversion and growth.
Build the PM community in Pune: Establish shared standards for research, experimentation, and storytelling that raise the bar for the whole team.
Use AI responsibly: Identify and deliver high-value use cases for AI across onboarding, workflows, and recommendations.
What you bring
8+ years in B2B SaaS product management, with proven success driving growth motions that directly impacted revenue and retention.
Strong experience with workflow, customer service, or employee experience products (e.g. support, ticketing, CRM, or similar).
A track record of defining and tracking metrics across the full funnel from sign-up through to expansion and churn, and running A/B experiments.
Experience influencing beyond your immediate team, partnering effectively with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Engineering across time zones.
Excellent communication and storytelling skills, able to translate complex ideas into clear narratives for executives and cross-functional partners.
A clear point of view on responsible, value-driven AI usage.
Why this role matters
This isn't a supporting role, it's a core lever for how we acquire, grow, and retain customers in the next phase of our journey. If you want to build an industry-defining growth experience and shape how growth is built into the product experience in customer and employee service, this is for you.
Please note that Zendesk can only hire candidates who are physically located and plan to work from Karnataka or Maharashtra. Please refer to the location posted on the requisition for where this role is based.
Hybrid: In this role, our hybrid experience is designed at the team level to give you a rich onsite experience packed with connection, collaboration, learning, and celebration - while also giving you flexibility to work remotely for part of the week. This role must attend our local office for part of the week. The specific in-office schedule is to be determined by the hiring manager.
The intelligent heart of customer experience
Zendesk software was built to bring a sense of calm to the chaotic world of customer service. Today we power billions of conversations with brands you know and love.
Zendesk believes in offering our people a fulfilling and inclusive experience. Our hybrid way of working, enables us to purposefully come together in person, at one of our many Zendesk offices around the world, to connect, collaborate and learn whilst also giving our people the flexibility to work remotely for part of the week.

Lead architecture and roadmap

Job Description
Senior Demo Platform Architect – Contact Center and Customer Experience
Position Overview: We are seeking a seasoned Senior Demo Platform Engineer with deep expertise in contact center technologies and CX suites, preferably Zendesk, Amazon Connect, and AWS. This role will own the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of shared demo environments and reusable customer service use cases. The ideal candidate will combine hands-on technical expertise, strong operational ownership, and independent decision-making to ensure demo environments remain reliable, current, scalable, and ready to support both internal teams and occasional customer-facing engagements.
Core Daily Activities
Own and Optimize Demo Environments – Maintain reliable, scalable, secure, and high-quality shared demo environments leveraging Amazon Connect, AWS, and Zendesk.
Develop New Demo Use Cases – Design and build compelling, reusable demonstrations that showcase contact center, customer experience, AI, automation, analytics, and integration capabilities.
Support Custom Demo Requests – Partner with presales specialists and architects to develop opportunity-specific configurations, integrations, workflows, and demonstrations.
Maintain Product and Release Readiness – Track Zendesk, Amazon Connect, AWS, and related technology releases and incorporate relevant capabilities into the demo portfolio.
Drive Automation and Standardization – Develop reusable components, templates, deployment processes, and automation to improve the speed and consistency of demo delivery.
Ensure Security, Governance, and Best Practices – Maintain appropriate access controls, data standards, platform governance, cost management, and technical quality across demo environments.
Support Customer-Facing Activities – Occasionally participate in customer demonstrations, proof of concepts (PoCs), technical discussions, and presentations for prospects and clients.
Develop Technical Documentation and Demo Collateral – Create technical guides, setup instructions, troubleshooting documentation, architecture diagrams, demo scripts, and internal enablement materials.
Engage with Vendors and Partners – Work closely with AWS, Zendesk, and other partners to remain aligned with product capabilities, best practices, and technology advancements.
Key Responsibilities:
Demo Platform Ownership: Define and execute the technical vision for shared demo environments, proactively identifying improvements, resolving issues, and ensuring environments remain available and ready for use.
Demo Design and Development: Build compelling end-to-end contact center demonstrations leveraging Zendesk, Amazon Connect, and AWS services to showcase customer experience, agent productivity, AI, automation, and operational performance.
Integration Management: Design and maintain integrations between Zendesk, Amazon Connect, AWS, and other enterprise systems to support realistic workflows, consistent data, and reusable demo scenarios.
Custom Demo Support: Work with presales specialists and architects to understand opportunity requirements and deliver tailored demonstrations while identifying opportunities to create reusable assets for the wider team.
Technical Oversight: Establish and maintain high standards for demo architecture, configuration, testing, security, documentation, reliability, and overall presentation quality.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Engage with internal teams, business leaders, product specialists, engineering teams, customers, and external partners to gather requirements, propose solutions, communicate tradeoffs, and deliver effective demonstrations.
Innovation and Best Practices: Stay ahead of product releases, industry trends, and emerging technologies in contact center platforms, AI, and automation, applying them to continuously improve the demo portfolio.
Independent Execution: Establish priorities, manage multiple concurrent requests, make informed decisions, and deliver outcomes without requiring detailed day-to-day direction.
Governance: Establish and enforce governance frameworks for security, access control, data management, cost optimization, platform reliability, and lifecycle management of demo environments.
Qualifications:
Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or Business Administration - or equivalent experience.
Experience: Minimum of 8–10 years in solution engineering, platform engineering, solution architecture, software development, or a related technical field, with at least 5 years of experience in contact center technologies, including Amazon Connect and CRM/CX technologies, preferably Zendesk.
Technical Expertise: Strong proficiency in designing, implementing, and supporting scalable solutions using a CRM/CX platform, Amazon Connect, AWS Lambda, Amazon AI Agents (Bedrock), Amazon Lex, IAM, DynamoDB, S3, API Gateway, CloudWatch, and other AWS services. We will rank you higher if you have experience or exposure to Python and/or NodeJS.
Demo Development: Demonstrated experience creating technical demonstrations, reusable use cases, prototypes, proof of concepts, or reference implementations that translate technical capabilities into compelling business scenarios.
Platform Management: Experience maintaining shared technical environments, managing releases and configuration changes, troubleshooting complex issues, and proactively improving platform availability and reliability.
Leadership Skills: Demonstrated ability to operate with ownership, take initiative, work independently, influence cross-functional teams, and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced and globally distributed environment.
Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to document technical solutions, collaborate across time zones, and articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of investigating root causes, making sound decisions with incomplete information, and developing scalable solutions to complex challenges.
Preferred Qualifications:
Certifications: Zendesk certifications, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, or equivalent credentials in contact center platforms.
Industry Knowledge: Experience designing and demonstrating omnichannel contact center solutions, including voice, chat, messaging, AI-driven automation, agent assistance, Workforce Engagement Management, including workforce and quality management, and contact center reporting and analytics tools.
Customer Engagement: Experience delivering technical demonstrations, supporting customer discussions, and responding to detailed technical questions during customer or prospect engagements.
Agile Methodologies: Experience working within Agile and DevOps frameworks, including source control, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated testing, and repeatable deployment practices.

We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to be the technical leader for this team. In this role, you’ll define and drive the architecture, execution strategy, and long-term technical roadmap. You’ll lead the development of a feature-rich system that helps company admins onboard, adopt, and manage Zendesk products with ease, while also empowering internal teams to integrate their solutions efficiently.
If you’re passionate about building meaningful experiences, driving platform excellence, and creating extensible systems that serve both customers and internal teams, we’d love to have you on this journey.
Our ideal candidate is someone who takes the lead on anything they work on and is a self-starter with projects that has the initiative to drive a project from start to finish.
This role is based in Pune and requires you to work from office at least 3 days a week
What you’ll get to do each day:
Contribute to the code at the core of Zendesk’s support product - what you write will reach millions of people each day!
Break complex features into granular pieces of work, to facilitate incremental feedback cycles.
Take ownership of features and collaborate with the Tech Leaders to design and implement complete solutions.
Contribute to technical discussions and decision-making with other teams and partners across the global engineering organisation.
Prioritise and estimate work balancing feature delivery with the management of tech debt.
Participate in and lead activities such as pairing sessions and code reviews to facilitate continuous self-improvement for the whole team.
Work closely with our designers and product managers to help define the future of the product.
Triage customer issues in partnership with Product Managers.
Provide operational support for our services in Production.
Actively look for ways to improve the observability, performance, reliability and security of our services.
Show strategic forward-thinking and provide technical leadership to drive near-to-mid-term success (1-2 years).

9+ years of experience in full-stack software engineering, with expertise in building enterprise-scale SaaS or large web applications.
Strong proficiency in any of the programming languages - Java, Ruby on Rails, GoLang, Scala, Typescript, NodeJs or any other object oriented language.
9+ years of experience working with JavaScript and TypeScript, as well as frameworks like React and Redux.
Solid experience with MySQL or similar. A knack for writing efficient queries and optimizing performance in high-traffic environments.
Good to have - experience/knowledge of front end technologies
A track record of delivering large-scale, high quality, and resilient web systems.

jobs.description:
Job Description
Security Operations Engineer
Job Description
Zendesk is a global leader in AI-first customer service and employee service software, renowned for its powerful yet customer-friendly solutions. At Zendesk, we believe in building better customer relationships through our suite of products that are smart, flexible, and reliable.
We are looking for an experienced security professional to join our growing Cyber Security team. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong technical investigation skills with sound judgment, clear communication, and a genuine interest in improving how security operations work.
The Security Operations Engineer helps protect Zendesk, its products, and its customers by monitoring, investigating, and responding to security threats. The role combines hands-on security operations with threat hunting, incident response, cloud security, DLP investigations, and the continuous improvement of security tools, processes, and automation.
This is a hybrid role based in the Pune office.
Please note that Zendesk can only hire candidates who are physically located and plan to work from Karnataka or Maharashtra. Please refer to the location posted on the requisition for where this role is based.
Hybrid: In this role, our hybrid experience is designed at the team level to give you a rich onsite experience packed with connection, collaboration, learning, and celebration - while also giving you flexibility to work remotely for part of the week. This role must attend our local office for part of the week. The specific in-office schedule is to be determined by the hiring manager.
What you’ll be doing
Join Zendesk’s global team of cyber responders.
Serve as a primary incident responder addressing critical security alerts and incidents across enterprise infrastructure, product offerings, and client environments.
Leverage enterprise security platforms to perform threat analysis, examine security incidents, and execute daily operational response workflows.
Conduct proactive threat hunts to identify visibility gaps and support deeper investigations.
Analyze Data Loss Prevention alerts, assess data-exfiltration risks, and assist with complex forensic analysis.
Collaborate with audit and compliance partners to respond to regulatory inquiries.
Lead cross-functional tabletop simulations by partnering with key internal stakeholders.
Stay current on emerging threats and attacker tactics. Analyze tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) observed in security events across devices and end-user systems.
Lead or manage technical cybersecurity investigations, including triage, scoping, containment, and documentation.
Contribute to the development and operation of automation and orchestration tools that reduce manual effort and improve response consistency.
Leverage artificial intelligence responsibly to enhance security orchestration, accelerate investigation workflows, and assist with building AI capabilities.
Collaborate with Security Engineering partners to enhance operational monitoring, threat detection, and incident response mechanisms.
Collaborate with the Threat Intelligence team and broader security community to build relationships and share knowledge.
Partner with internal stakeholders and business partners to explain major security incidents and implement actionable risk mitigation strategies.
Demonstrate adaptability by taking on expanding responsibilities and working effectively in dynamic, rapidly evolving environments.
Join Zendesk’s global cyber security on-call rotation to support continuous response operations.
Provide regional coverage across APAC through scheduled operational shifts, currently spanning 6:00 a.m.–3:00 p.m. IST and 9:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m. IST, on a rotational basis.
What you bring to the role:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field
7+ years of experience in cybersecurity, SOC, incident response, or threat hunting
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret security metrics, user behavior, and event patterns.
A team-first and collaborative approach.
Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex investigations, incidents, cyber threats, and recommended actions clearly to business stakeholders.
A strong security and analytical mindset, with the ability to think strategically about evolving threats to a customer-service platform, including risks introduced by AI and automation.
Experience with Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), Security Orchestration, Automation and Response (SOAR), and other log-aggregation tools such as QRadar, Splunk, or ArcSight.
Experience investigating Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and User and Entity Behavior Analytics (UEBA) alerts, with a good understanding of network, proxy, firewall, cloud, Windows, and macOS logs.
Good understanding of cloud infrastructure and cloud security alerts.
Cybersecurity certifications such as CEH, CHFI, or AWS Certified Security Specialist,Microsoft Azure - SC-200, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer are a plus. Certifications such as GCIH, GPEN, GCFR, GREM, GCFA, CISSP, or CISM are an added advantage.
Hands-on experience building automated security workflows and AI-powered security capabilities is highly desirable.

jobs.description:
Job Description
Professional Services Resource Manager (P-10)
Zendesk helps companies build better relationships with their customers through exceptional products and teams. Our global Professional Services team delivers a range of services to onboard our customers quickly and easily and ensure they derive value on an ongoing basis.
The Resource Manager helps create successful customer engagement by ensuring the right people are assigned to the right projects at the right time. This role partners closely with delivery leaders, engagement managers, and internal teams to turn project demand into clear, accurate plans and resource assignments. It also helps modernise how we work by using AI and automation to simplify project creation, improve assignment speed, and reduce repetitive administration.
What you'll be doing:
Manage project demand: Monitor the services opportunity pipeline and upcoming work to anticipate project setup needs and resource demand.
Validate requirements: Partner with sales, delivery leaders, and project managers to confirm project scope, timing, roles, skills, and staffing requirements.
Create and maintain projects: Set up projects in the PSA platform, keeping project details, roles, forecasts, and resource plans accurate as scope or timing changes.
Coordinate resource assignments: Assign resources to project roles in partnership with delivery leads and project managers, balancing customer needs, skills, availability, and business priorities.
Improve assignment decisions: Use capacity and demand data to identify constraints, surface conflicts, and recommend resource changes or additional staffing.
Support capacity planning: Work with Senior Resource Managers to maintain visibility into resource capacity, demand forecasts, utilization, and staffing risks.
Advance AI-enabled workflows: Identify and implement opportunities to use AI and automation to simplify project creation and resource assignment—for example, preparing project records, matching skills to roles, surfacing staffing options, and flagging missing or inconsistent information.
Use AI tools thoughtfully: Apply tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, and Gemini to build or use skills, projects, and other workflows; select appropriate models and intelligence levels; and review AI-generated outputs for accuracy and sound judgment.
Connect systems and data: Help explore integrations and workflows across tools such as Salesforce, Certinia, Snowflake, Streamlit, and Gainsight, in partnership with technical teams as needed.
Test and refine solutions: Evaluate AI-enabled process improvements, measure their impact on speed and quality, and help incorporate successful changes into standard workflows.
Support utilization and time processes: Help ensure project plans, resource forecasts, and time-related information accurately reflect the work being delivered.
Build strong partnerships: Develop trusted working relationships with Professional Services delivery leaders and team members, communicating clearly and resolving competing priorities constructively.
Improve processes: Contribute to broader initiatives that make Professional Services operations more consistent, efficient, and scalable.

Experience: 2–4 years of resource management, project coordination, or project management experience, ideally at a technology company or consultancy.
PSA experience: Experience using a Professional Services Automation or resource management platform for project setup, staffing, and assignments. Certinia (formerly FinancialForce) experience is preferred; experience with comparable tools is also valuable. Certinia administration experience is a plus.

Process improvement: A track record of simplifying processes and helping teams adopt more efficient ways of working, including identifying opportunities for automation.
Communication: Clear, concise verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams.
Partnership and influence: Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build trust, negotiate priorities, and resolve conflicts.
Organisation and judgment: Strong attention to detail, sound problem-solving skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a changing environment.
Service orientation: A customer-focused, resourceful approach and a commitment to helping teams deliver successful engagements.

Technical fluency: General familiarity with JSON and Python, sufficient to understand how data and simple scripts can support workflow improvements. Experience with APIs, MCP (Model Context Protocol), or connecting AI tools with business systems and data.
Business and analytics tools: Experience with Excel and one or more of Salesforce (SFDC), Snowflake, Streamlit, or Gainsight.

Job Description
Managed Shared Services Consultant
Our Managed Services team supports customers with subscription services on an ongoing basis, helping them adopt, expand, optimize, and maintain their use of Zendesk products as their businesses grow and evolve. We function as an extension of their teams, consulting on design and configuration best practices, and offering the hands-on support they need to realize their vision.
As a Managed Services Consultant, you will be responsible for configuring Zendesk solutions and consulting on configuration best practices for our global portfolio of managed services customers. You will analyze current configurations to recommend optimizations, investigate configuration options to address customer requests, and implement configuration updates in production environments. You will collaborate with our global team of Managed Services Consultants to ensure customers realize ongoing value from their services subscription and view the Managed Services team as an extension of their own. You may be required to work directly with customers across various regions (USA/LATAM, EMEA, APAC).

jobs.description:
What success looks like in this role:
Job Title: Senior Service Management Transformation Specialist
Location: Bangalore
Who we are:
Unisys is a global information technology company that builds high-performance, security-centric solutions for the most digitally demanding businesses and governments on Earth. Unisys’ offerings include security software and services; digital transformation and workplace services; industry applications and services; and innovative software operating environments for high-intensity enterprise computing. Unisys builds better outcomes securely for its clients across the Government, Financial Services and Commercial markets. For more information, visit www.unisys.com.
Our Vision: Enhancing people’s lives through secure, reliable advanced technology.
Our Core Beliefs:
Curiosity: We embrace the unknown and continuous learning.
Creativity: We look past routine ways of doing things.
Client-Centricity: Our clients’ success is our success.
Integrity: We act ethically and honestly.
Role Purpose
Support and deliver Service Management transformation initiatives across client environments, improving how Incident, Major Incident, Problem, Change and related practices operate. The role combines strong Service Management knowledge with practical exposure to automation, AI, analytics, observability and modern engineering practices. The individual is expected to identify opportunities, work effectively with technical teams and independently own defined improvement initiatives from analysis through implementation.
Key Responsibilities
Service Management Improvement
· Assess existing Incident, Major Incident, Problem, Change and related operational practices.
· Identify process friction, unnecessary governance, repetitive work and opportunities for simplification.
· Own defined improvement initiatives from assessment through implementation and benefit tracking.
· Help shift Service Management measures from activity and volume toward stability, prevention, efficiency and business outcomes.
Problem Management and Service Stability
· Analyse incidents, recurring failures, work notes, monitoring events, changes and other operational data to identify problem candidates.
· Drive proactive Problem Management and recurring-incident prevention within assigned scope.
· Work with resolver and engineering teams to convert analysis into corrective and preventive actions.
· Measure avoided recurrence, reduced operational effort and improved service stability.
Change Management Modernisation
· Identify change activities suitable for standardisation, automation and simplified risk-based governance.
· Support integration between Change Management and CI/CD or engineering workflows.
· Help reduce unnecessary manual governance while maintaining appropriate risk, audit and compliance controls.
· Contribute to models where high-risk changes receive focused review and lower-risk changes follow proportionate controls.
AI, Automation and Analytics
· Use approved tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude, ServiceNow, Power BI and workflow or automation platforms where available.
· Identify repetitive Service Management activities suitable for automation.
· Build or support practical analytics, dashboards, workflows and AI-enabled use cases.
· Apply human oversight and appropriate guardrails when using AI or automation in operational processes.
Engineering and Observability Collaboration
· Work with Cloud, Infrastructure, Application, Platform and Engineering teams.
· Develop a practical understanding of monitoring, events, logs, metrics and traces.
· Connect technical operational information with Service Management records and processes.
· Identify existing engineering tools, scripts or automation that can be reused for Service Management improvement.
Continuous Improvement and Adoption
· Maintain an improvement backlog with defined owners, outcomes and progress.
· Document opportunities, implementation decisions, benefits and lessons learned.
· Share reusable methods and solutions across client accounts.
· Coach practitioners in adopting improved ways of working within assigned initiatives.
#LI-RB1
You will be successful in this role if you have:
Experience and Skills
Must Have
· Approximately 5-8 years of relevant IT Operations or Service Management experience.
· Practical experience in at least two areas such as Incident/Major Incident, Problem, Change, Configuration or Continual Improvement.
· Evidence of improving a process or service, not only operating an established process.
· Strong analytical, facilitation and problem-solving capability.
· Ability to work independently with technical resolver groups and multiple stakeholders.
· Curiosity, adaptability and willingness to learn unfamiliar tools or technologies.
Should Have
· Exposure to ServiceNow, Jira or comparable ITSM platforms.
· Exposure to Cloud, DevOps, CI/CD, monitoring or observability concepts.
· Experience with Power BI, Microsoft Copilot, Claude, Power Automate or equivalent technologies.
· Working understanding of ITIL practices and their practical application.
Good to Have
· SRE concepts and reliability practices.
· ServiceNow workflow or automation exposure.
· Cloud platform knowledge.
· Basic scripting, API or workflow-development experience.
Success Measures
· Defined transformation initiatives delivered with measurable operational or client value.
· Reduction in repetitive effort, avoidable incidents or process cycle time.
· Improved use of technical and Service Management data for decisions.
· Sustained adoption of improved practices by operational teams.
· Reusable improvements applied beyond a single activity or account where appropriate.

jobs.description:

Job Summary
We are seeking a Technical Service Desk Analyst L1 to provide first-level technical support to end users by handling IT incidents and service requests. This role involves troubleshooting hardware, software, network, and application-related issues while ensuring excellent customer service and adherence to service level agreements (SLAs).
Key Responsibilities
· Serve as the first point of contact for IT support requests via phone, email, chat, and ticketing systems.
· Log, categorize, prioritize, and track incidents and service requests.
· Provide first-level troubleshooting for desktop, laptop, mobile, printer, and application-related issues.
· Troubleshoot Windows operating systems, Microsoft 365 applications, Outlook, Teams, and basic networking issues.
· Reset passwords and manage user accounts through Active Directory or relevant identity management tools.
· Escalate unresolved incidents to appropriate Level 2/Level 3 support teams.
· Maintain accurate documentation of issues, resolutions, and support activities.
· Follow ITIL processes for Incident, Request, and Problem Management.
· Ensure timely resolution in accordance with defined SLAs.
· Assist users with remote access, VPN, hardware setup, and software installations.

Required Skills:
Knowledge of Windows 10/11 operating systems.
Basic understanding of Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
Knowledge of Active Directory and password management.
Understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN).
Experience with ticketing tools such as ServiceNow, Remedy, Jira, or similar.
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Customer-focused attitude.
Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's degree
Microsoft certifications are an added advantage.
Experience
