Customer Service Orientation
Problem Solving
Communication Skills
Incident Management
Team Collaboration
Attention to Detail
Time Management

jobs.title: Sr Recruiter
jobs.description:
The Company
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.
Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.
Job Summary:
This job develops and executes strategic recruiting plans to attract top talent. They partner with hiring managers to understand specific hiring needs and create job descriptions. Senior Recruiters source and screen candidates, conduct interviews, and assist in the selection and offer process. They also manage relationships with candidates and hiring managers, develop recruiting metrics, and may supervise junior recruiters. With extensive experience in recruiting, they utilize advanced sourcing tools and techniques to ensure the company hires the best talent
Job Description:
Essential Responsibilities:
Partner with hiring managers and business unit leader to understand hiring requirements, products and services while providing consultative expertise in recruitment.
Lead & develop recruiting strategies and manage the end-to-end hiring activities of assigned requisitions, delivering an efficient and effective recruiting partnership.
Oversees candidates in the talent pipeline through every life cycle stage and develop an outstanding candidate experience and recognition of downstream impact on other disciplines
Advises and influences leaders of assigned business units on Talent Acquisition strategy and how to identify and invest in talent pipeline
Conduct ongoing market research and analysis to develop innovative and effective sourcing strategies, providing market intelligence to the business as required.
Collaborates regularly with peers and/or internal partners
Minimum Qualifications:
3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.
Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:
What you need to know about the role-
This role is for Technical Recruiter to join the India Talent Acquisition team. Beyond day-to-day hiring, you'll play a key role in shaping and rolling out TA initiatives and projects including recruitment campaigns & marketing, diversity, inclusion, equity and belonging hiring, and our Global TA transformation.
Meet our team-
The TA team is based out of Bangalore in India.
The hiring TA team is responsible for achieving headcount needs for the Engineering & Products organization.Job Description:
Your way to impact-
You will own end-to-end hiring activities across some of our most critical business areas across the India region, partnering closely with Coordination, Onboarding, and Sourcing. Additionally, you'll engage closely with leaders on the site, the broader HR community, and the Global GTA team.
Your day to day-
Achieves staffing objectives by recruiting and evaluating job candidates; advising managers
Educating and guiding hiring managers on Talent Acquisition related policies, processes, and interview skills.
Developing innovative recruitment strategies and managing the end-to-end hiring activities, delivering an efficient and effective service to all involved in the hiring process.
Monitor and ensure 100% compliance with hiring process activities and resolve any discrepancies that may arise prior to the completion of the hiring process
Conduct ongoing market research and analysis to develop innovative and effective sourcing strategies, providing market intelligence to the business as required.
Use various sourcing platforms and techniques LinkedIn, Boolean strings, X-ray search, and other select sourcing tools to further build a robust pipeline of top-tier candidates
Assist in identifying, organizing, attending, and participating in sourcing channels, such as community outreach events, job fairs, Meetups, conferences, educational institutions, non-profit organizations, and social networking activities, on behalf of PayPal, in order to promote PayPal’s employer-brand
Conduct thorough pre-screen activities in line with PayPal and job requirements, and presents a shortlist and recommendations of the most suitable candidates for consideration for assigned requisitions.
Support the administration and coordination of the end-to-end hiring activities of assigned requisitions, ensuring an efficient and effective service is delivered to all involved in the hiring process.
Prepare, present, and negotiate job offers in accordance with PayPal compensation and benefits guidelines.
Manage and actively participate in Talent Acquisition related projects of varying complexity, importance, and priority.
Represent the Talent Acquisition team positively in relationships and communication with the Human Resource Business Partners, Centres of Expertise, business leaders, and other Global Talent Acquisition team members.
What do you need to bring-
5 + years experience with full life cycle talent acquisition in a fast-paced corporate environment.
Comfortable to multitask, project management, and presentation skills coupled with technical / business acumen
Ability to work independently in a dynamic environment of change, challenge, and multiple deadlines and priorities
Experience handling sensitive/confidential information
Networking, and relationship-building skills
High level of comfort with direct sourcing
Subsidiary:
PayPal
Travel Percent:
0
PayPal does not charge candidates any fees for courses, applications, resume reviews, interviews, background checks, or onboarding. When making an application directly, we will never ask you to share passwords, one-time passcodes (OTP), or verification codes. Any such request is a red flag and likely part of a scam. All communication regarding your application will come from official PayPal email domains. If you suspect fraudulent activity, please report it immediately. To learn more about how to identify and avoid recruitment fraud please visit https://careers.pypl.com/contact-us.
For the majority of employees, PayPal's balanced hybrid work model offers 3 days in the office for effective in-person collaboration and 2 days at your choice of either the PayPal office or your home workspace, ensuring that you equally have the benefits and conveniences of both locations.
Our Benefits:
At PayPal, we’re committed to building an equitable and inclusive global economy. And we can’t do this without our most important asset-you. That’s why we offer comprehensive, choice-based programs, to support all aspects of personal wellbeing—physical, emotional, and financial—delivering meaningful value where it matters most. We strive to create a flexible, balanced work culture with a holistic approach to benefits, including generous paid time off, healthcare coverage for you and your family, and resources to create financial security and support your mental health.

Job Summary:
PayPal Payments Private Limited (PPPL) is the India subsidiary of PayPal Holdings, Inc. and a regulated payments entity supervised by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI). As the entity-level Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), this role is accountable for ensuring cybersecurity, information technology (IT) and information & communication technology (ICT) risk, and operational resilience capabilities are effectively implemented, governed, and evidenced within the regulated entity, while leveraging PayPal’s global technology and cybersecurity services.
Job Description:
Essential Responsibilities:
Recognized as a security governance, risk, and compliance expert, independently addressing the most complex security risks and providing strategic direction on risk mitigation and governance practices across the security domain.
Define methods and procedures for new or special assignments, collaborating with cross-functional teams to drive security risk and governance initiatives that align with business needs and objectives.
Lead complex, high-impact security governance and risk management initiatives, leveraging a deep understanding of business trends and security challenges to develop innovative risk mitigation strategies and solutions.
Possess a keen awareness of the broader impact of decisions, with initiatives driving enterprise-wide improvements in risk management and security governance, enhancing overall security practices and operational efficiency.
Lead a security risk and governance team; set clear priorities and define actionable plans, ensuring alignment with organizational goals.
Guide team members through complex challenges, fostering their growth and development while maintaining a focus on high-impact results.
Minimum Qualifications:
8+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.
Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:
This Senior Manager serves as the entity-level Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) and First Line of Defense lead for information security, cyber resilience, and ICT risk management. The role provides local lead of technology services delivered by PayPal's global organisation, ensuring compliance with Reserve Bank of India (RBI) cybersecurity, ICT risk, operational resilience, data protection, and other applicable regulatory requirements.
The CISO is accountable for the local governance and assurance of enterprise security capabilities, ensuring they are effectively implemented, monitored, evidenced, and reported. Working closely with global engineering, infrastructure, cloud, security, SLOD & enterprise risk teams and business teams, the role requires strong technical expertise, sound risk judgement, regulatory interpretation, and excellent communication skills.
Information Security & Cyber Resilience
Serve as the entity-level CISO, leading local information security, cyber resilience, and ICT/IT risk management activities
Lead the implementation and continuous improvement of cyber and digital operational resilience capabilities across the regulated entity
Partner with global Infrastructure, Cloud, Cybersecurity, Site Reliability Engineering, Product, and Operations teams to strengthen the resilience of critical ICT services and business processes supporting the entity.
Ensure enterprise cybersecurity policies, standards, and control requirements are effectively implemented, monitored, and evidenced within the entity, and mapped to applicable RBI requirements.
Oversee operational resilience activities, including disaster recovery exercises, cyber simulations, failover testing, tabletop exercises, and resilience validation, and maintain evidence for regulatory and audit review.
Oversee adherence to payment data storage and localisation requirements applicable to the entity, coordinating with global teams on data residency, retention, and evidencing.
ICT Risk & Secure Technology Delivery
Act as the First Line ICT/IT Risk lead for major technology changes, cloud migrations, new product launches, and transformation initiatives affecting the regulated entity.
Lead ICT and cybersecurity risk assessments across infrastructure, applications, cloud services, third-party providers, and operational processes.
Ensure security, resilience, data protection, and regulatory requirements are embedded throughout technology delivery and operational processes.
Partner with engineering and product teams to drive practical, measurable, and risk-based remediation of identified control gaps, including time-bound closure of vulnerabilities identified through VA/PT.
Oversee cybersecurity and operational resilience risks associated with third-party technology providers and cloud services supporting the regulated entity, Incident Management & Regulatory Engagement
Lead the First Line coordination of cybersecurity incidents and ICT disruption events in partnership with global Cybersecurity and Technology teams.
Lead the entity’s coordination of cyber incidents and ICT disruption events, including assessment, escalation, root cause analysis, recovery, and remediation tracking.
Drive post-incident reviews and resilience improvements to strengthen operational readiness and reduce future risk.
Act as the primary local point of contact for the RBI, CERT-In, external auditors, and internal assurance on cybersecurity, ICT risk, operational resilience, and data protection matters, maintaining a current view of the entity’s regulatory obligations and compliance posture and ensuring control design and evidence remain adequate to demonstrate compliance.
Governance, Risk & Compliance
Monitor the effectiveness of cybersecurity and resilience controls, ensuring timely remediation of identified risks and control deficiencies.
Develop and report cybersecurity, operational resilience, and ICT risk metrics, Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), and management reporting to support informed decision-making, including inputs to the Board and IT Steering Committee.
Ensure the entity maintains compliance with applicable cybersecurity, ICT risk, operational resilience, data protection, and technology governance requirements under the RBI and other Indian regulatory frameworks, while aligning with PayPal’s global security standards.
Advise senior management on cyber risk, technology risk, regulatory developments, resilience readiness, and emerging threats, escalating material risks where appropriate.
Partner with global Cybersecurity, Technology, Risk, Compliance, and Legal teams to align enterprise security capabilities with local regulatory expectations and business priorities.
Experience
10-12 years of experience in information security, cybersecurity, ICT/IT risk, technology operations, or cyber resilience within financial services, payments, fintech, or other highly regulated technology environments.
Demonstrated experience leading cybersecurity, ICT risk, or operational resilience initiatives while partnering closely with engineering, infrastructure, cloud, and technology teams.
Experience operating within a First Line of Defense function or in a technology leadership role with accountability for security, resilience, or operational risk outcomes.
Strong understanding of modern technology environments, including cloud platforms, distributed infrastructure, enterprise applications, cybersecurity operations, and secure technology delivery.
Sufficient technical proficiency to provide credible oversight, assessment, and challenge across areas such as cyber and operational resilience, disaster recovery and resilience testing, incident management and response, ICT risk assessment, secure technology change, and vulnerability management.
Experience engaging with regulators, external auditors, and internal assurance functions within regulated financial services environments — engagement with the RBI, CERT-In, or other Indian authorities is highly desirable.
Working knowledge of the Indian regulatory landscape applicable to non-bank Payment System Operators / payment aggregators, including the RBI (Information Technology Governance, Risk, Controls and Assurance Practices) Directions, 2023; the RBI Master Direction on Cyber Resilience and Digital Payment Security Controls for non-bank PSOs, 2024; the RBI Guidelines on Regulation of Payment Aggregators and Payment Gateways; CERT-In Directions (2022); and the DPDP Act, 2023.

Job Summary:

You’ll partner with Security Architecture, engineering, product, and platform teams to translate AI security requirements into scalable controls, testing, and enforcement across PayPal’s products and business units. Through hands-on technical leadership and mentorship, you’ll turn emerging risks into durable capabilities and measurable risk reduction.
Job Description:
Essential Responsibilities:
Leverage specialized security expertise to identify and resolve complex security issues, recommending best practices and determining new approaches that have an impact on broader security operations, while aligning security strategies with business priorities
Partner across teams and key stakeholders to drive security initiatives, leading and solutioning complex projects and programs to strengthen overall security posture.
Apply advanced analytical skills and sound judgment to solve security challenges, considering diverse perspectives and innovative solutions. Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies, understanding their security implications to the company’s context.
Directly contribute to improvements within the security domain and occasionally beyond, ensuring decisions lead to meaningful enhancements in security practices.
Leverage relationships across teams, both within and outside of security, to influence initiatives and integrate feedback into security processes.
Minimum Qualifications:
5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.
Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:
Roles and Responsibilities:
Lead the development and execution of Product Security’s technical roadmap for AI security controls and assurance, partnering with Security Architecture to translate requirements into scalable engineering capabilities.
Design, implement, and operate controls for AI-assisted software development, including security review of AI-generated code, security context and constraints for coding agents, automated testing, and risk-based enforcement.
Conduct and lead security reviews of AI-enabled applications and their models, agents, retrieval systems, data flows, and external tool integrations.
Create controls for agent identity, least privilege, tool access, execution isolation, human approval, and interruption of unsafe behavior.
Design and help implement security controls for AI models, agents, toolsets, datasets, and pipelines.
Develop runtime monitoring, auditability, detection, containment, and incident-response requirements for AI systems, including visibility into agent actions, tool calls, and sensitive-data access.
Build and scale AI-driven capabilities for vulnerability discovery, validation, prioritization, and remediation across teams and engineering workflows.
Partner with AI platform and cloud engineering teams to integrate security across AI infrastructure, platforms, and workloads.
Help establish security criteria for evaluating, onboarding, integrating, and periodically reassessing third-party models, AI services, APIs, and developer tools.
Develop methods and metrics for evaluating AI security risk, control effectiveness, remediation performance, and adoption across teams.
Serve as a technical escalation point for complex AI security issues and lead architectural reviews following significant incidents or control failures.
Mentor security and engineering professionals, deliver targeted technical guidance, and help teams apply AI security controls across diverse technology stacks.
Minimum Qualifications
5+ years of experience in software engineering, application security, product security, or cybersecurity, including leadership of complex security initiatives spanning multiple teams or technology platforms.
Deep knowledge of application security vulnerabilities, secure software development practices, and technical controls used to identify, prevent, and remediate software risk.
Hands-on experience securing AI systems.
Strong software-engineering experience building and operating production security tooling, automation, platform services, or developer-facing capabilities.
Track record of partnering with developers to implement robust security controls.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence technical and senior stakeholder audiences.
Experience designing and operating security controls across cloud environments, CI/CD systems, and diverse application and infrastructure stacks.
Experience mentoring and developing engineers.
Preferred Qualifications
Hands-on familiarity with application security tools (SAST, DAST, SCA, WAF, Burp Suite).
Strong programming experience in at least one language such as Ruby, Java, Python, JavaScript, or Swift.
Knowledge of Kubernetes, Terraform, and version control systems such as Git.
Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud vendor (AWS, Azure, GCP).
Strong understanding of authentication and authorization protocols (OAuth 2.0, SAML).
What you need to know about the role
This is a hands-on individual contributor role with cross-organizational scope. You will help set technical direction, lead delivery, and mentor engineers while remaining directly involved in architecture reviews, control design, implementation, and technical problem-solving.
Meet our team
Our mission is to embed security into every phase of the product development lifecycle, recognizing that security promotes quality engineering. We strive to create a culture of security by empowering teams to take responsibility for securing their own code and environments. We do this by providing leaders and engineers with the visibility, tools, guidance, training, and support needed to create secure products and systems. We prevent, identify, and respond to critical vulnerabilities within our ecosystem, driving response to limit potential impact to the business.
Your way to impact
Your work will reduce the likelihood that AI-assisted development introduces exploitable vulnerabilities and that AI-enabled systems misuse sensitive data, tools, or business actions. You will also improve PayPal’s ability to detect, validate, and remediate software vulnerabilities at scale.
Your day-to-day
Your work will vary across hands-on engineering, technical leadership, and cross-functional program delivery. Typical activities may include:
Reviewing an AI architecture, threat model, or agent workflow and identifying material security risks.
Designing, prototyping, or integrating an AI security control into a product, shared platform, or engineering workflow.
Evaluating results from AI security scanners, adversarial tests, and runtime monitoring to determine required engineering action.
Partnering with developers and platform teams to resolve complex design or implementation issues.
Analyzing control coverage, effectiveness, adoption, and incident findings to determine program priorities.
Mentoring engineers and leading technical decisions that span multiple teams or organizational boundaries.

Job Description
Position Overview
We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Principal Observability & Event Management Engineer to champion enterprise-wide initiatives that improve monitoring effectiveness, reduce alert noise, and accelerate incident response.
In this dual-impact role, you will act as both a strategic leader and a hands-on technical expert. You will define the enterprise standards for multi-domain monitoring (infrastructure, cloud, application, network, batch, and mainframe) while actively designing and configuring our Event Management platforms—specifically Oracle Unified Assurance (Assure1) and IBM Netcool. The ideal candidate will leverage data insights, machine learning, and automation to transform massive "event storms" into high-fidelity, actionable signals.
Key Responsibilities
Strategic Leadership & Governance
Drive Enterprise Initiatives: Own and lead cross-functional, enterprise-wide initiatives focused on improving monitoring effectiveness, optimizing alert quality, and reducing incident volumes.
Define Standards: Establish corporate standards, approaches, and best practices for alert optimization across infrastructure, application, batch, network, and mainframe environments.
Culture & Mentorship: Mentor, guide, and evangelize a strong observability and optimization mindset across engineering and operations teams.
Continuous Improvement: Identify systemic gaps in monitoring design and lead long-term, architectural improvements to eliminate redundant or low-value alerts.
Platform Engineering & Administration
Infrastructure Design: Implement, maintain, and scale Oracle Assure1 / Unified Assurance servers and architectures for high-availability (HA) enterprise environments.
Event Correlation & Enrichment: Develop advanced Object-Server configurations, triggers, and correlation rules to distinguish isolated anomalies from critical root causes.
Multi-Vendor Integration: Integrate multi-vendor telemetry, logs, faults, and data from disparate monitoring domains into a single, unified Event Management UI.
Operations & Backend Support: Manage backend databases (e.g., MySQL, OpenSearch), maintain platform availability, and troubleshoot complex backend issues.
Automation, AIOps & Incident Response
Incident Automation: Write robust automation scripts and workflows to bridge monitoring tools with ITSM platforms (such as ServiceNow) to accelerate incident response times.
AIOps & Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Apply Machine Learning (ML) algorithms, topological discovery, and data-driven approaches to enhance event correlation, suppress noise, and automate self-healing or ticket generation.
Basic Requirements
Required Qualifications & Skills
Experience & Education
Total Experience: 5+ years of dedicated experience in enterprise Event Management, Fault Management, Service Level Management, or production environments.
Initiative Leadership: 3+ years of proven experience leading large-scale, cross-functional improvements in monitoring effectiveness, alert optimization, or incident reduction.
Technical Expertise
Platform Expertise: Hands-on, deep technical experience with Oracle Unified Assurance / Assure1 and/or IBM Netcool suites (OMNIbus, Netcool Impact, ITM).
OS & Scripting: Strong proficiency in Linux Administration (RHEL) and expert-level scripting skills (Python, Bash, Perl, or Shell) for building event parsers and API integrations.
Databases & APIs: Solid understanding of backend database management, SQL queries, REST APIs, and tool customization using rule files and OpenSearch.
Domain Knowledge: Strong exposure to multi-domain infrastructure (Cloud, Network, Telecommunications, Mainframe) paired with a solid understanding of ITIL Event Management principles.

What Unified Communications Means at Motorola Solutions
Motorola Solutions designs its UC ecosystem so that frontline workers, field technicians, office supervisors, and public safety personnel can collaborate seamlessly regardless of the device they carry or the network they connect to.
Key principles include:
Any Network, Any Device: Connecting traditional two-way radios (such as MOTOTRBO or APX P25) directly to smartphones, tablets, laptops, and dedicated broadband push-to-talk (PTT) handhelds.
Instant Push-to-Talk (PTT): Expanding high-reliability, sub-second PTT audio from dedicated radio talkgroups to cellular and Wi-Fi networks.
Integration of Voice, Video, and Data: Unifying voice talkgroups with streaming video (body cameras, fixed surveillance), multimedia messaging, GPS location tracking, and telemetry.
Core Products & Services in Motorola’s UC Portfolio
WAVE PTX (Broadband Push-to-Talk)
A subscription-based carrier-independent cloud service that turns smartphones, tablets, and PCs into push-to-talk communication devices.

Bridges MOTOTRBO/TETRA/P25 radio systems with cellular networks.
Critical Connect

Enables mutual aid and cross-agency collaboration by federating disparate communication systems (e.g., allowing police, fire, emergency medical services, and utility teams across different jurisdictions and radio frequencies to join shared talkgroups seamlessly).
Hybrid Smart Devices (e.g., MOTOTRBO Ion)
Ruggedized devices that combine the mission-critical audio and durability of a two-way radio with the multimedia and touchscreen capabilities of an Android smartphone.
Connects simultaneously to DMR radio frequencies, LTE, and Wi-Fi to keep workers connected both inside plants and out in the field.

We are seeking a customer-focused Support Engineer who is excited about supporting AI/ML/ SaaS functionality and platforms and passionate about helping customers solve complex problems. In this high-visibility, customer-facing role, you will manage a ticket queue of cases with varying complexity specifically for Adaptive Planning’s Financial and Workforce Planning products.
You will drive incident resolution, root-cause analysis (RCA), and performance optimization across both Workday Adaptive Planning’s enterprise web applications and autonomous AI agent workflows. Partnering closely with product and support analyst teams, you will help customers find timely workarounds and solutions while managing critical escalations within strict SLAs.
A key part of this role will also involve hands-on technical debugging and AI evaluation. You will analyze system metrics, debug cloud-hosted ML service pipelines, inspect LLM orchestration layers, review conversation logs, and dig into system traces to spot failure modes—translating those insights into prompt, data, and workflow improvements.
Location & Shift
Location: This position is based in the Workday Pune office. Candidates should be local to the Pune area or willing to relocate.
Hybrid Work: Candidates will be expected to work from the office at least 50% of the time.
Hours: Typical shift will be from 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM IST
On-Call: Participation in an on-call rotation is required to provide after-hours support when needed.
Key Responsibilities
Core Planning and Reporting Troubleshooting: Troubleshoot with customers on cases to resolve reported issues with their financial data, reporting, and/or financial integrations.
Enterprise SaaS & Functional Domain Expertise: Apply foundational knowledge of enterprise applications to validate AI responses and assist in troubleshooting functional processing errors.
Hands-On AI Evaluation: Review LLM outputs, conversation logs, and execution traces to identify edge cases, hallucinations, and routine failure modes. Perform structured data labeling and report findings to senior engineering staff.
Technical Troubleshooting & RCA: Assist in root-cause analysis for software defects and pipeline execution failures using monitoring tools like Kibana and Grafana, following established diagnostic runbooks.
Cloud & LLM Diagnostics: Inspect enterprise AI workflows hosted in public cloud environments (AWS, GCP), helping isolate breakdown points across model hosting services and API gateways.
Incident & Queue Management: Monitor and triage support queues, enforce SLAs, and process incoming tickets efficiently. Support high-severity incident responses and participate in weekend on-call rotations.
Customer Communication: Communicate clear technical updates, standard workarounds, and resolution steps to customer IT teams, working with senior support for high-stakes escalations.
Database & Code Diagnostics: Write standard SQL queries to validate backend data integrity, inspect REST/SOAP API payloads (JSON/XML), and execute existing Python or Bash scripts to run routine diagnostics.
Documentation & Team Collaboration: Maintain detailed investigation logs in Jira, ServiceNow, or Salesforce, help maintain team runbooks, and flag recurring issue trends to senior engineers and product teams.
About You
Basic Qualifications (Required)
Work Experience: Minimum 1 year of experience in technical support, platform operations, or application support for enterprise SaaS environments.
Technical & Diagnostic Skills:
Minimum 1 year of experience writing and executing intermediate SQL queries and running diagnostic scripts.
Minimum 1 year of experience inspecting API payloads (JSON or XML data structures) and utilizing basic Linux or Windows command-line tools.
Cloud & Monitoring Systems:
Minimum 1 year of hands-on experience navigating or monitoring services on public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
Minimum 1 year of experience utilizing observability tools (e.g., Grafana, Kibana, Datadog) to view logs or trace outputs.
AI & LLM Exposure: Minimum 1 year of experience inspecting, reading, or evaluating AI/LLM conversation logs, traces, or prompt outputs.
Triage & Operations:
Minimum 1 year of experience performing initial queue triage and basic troubleshooting using ticketing workflows.
Ability to manage multiple cases at once with some to no guidance around prioritization.
Willingness and ability to work scheduled weekend and holiday coverage rotations.
Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical work experience).
Experience following established runbooks to perform guided, autonomous technical troubleshooting.
History of drafting clear written technical documentation, post-incident updates, or resolution notes for customer-facing teams.
Strong active problem-solving skills and an adaptability to learn complex, multi-tiered enterprise systems.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, combined with the ability to communicate with users at all levels and varying technical ability.
Experience collaborating with internal development and/or QA teams, acting as a customer advocate.
Had previous experience or knowledge of finance and/or financial planning software applications or integrations
Have these technical skills:
ETL, tools (e.g., Pentaho) or Integration Implementation/Support
Jenkins & Git
Kubernetes and Docker
ELK or other log aggregation tool
JavaScript

The Security Solutions Data Science team develops AI and machine learning capabilities that help protect the global payments ecosystem from fraud and cyber threats. Supporting Mastercard’s fraud and risk product, the team builds and enhances models that analyze billions of transactions and enable real-time detection of fraudulent activity.
We are looking for a highly motivated Senior Data Scientist to help build the next generation of AI-powered fraud detection systems. This role offers an opportunity to work on challenging problems involving predictive modeling, AI agents, LLM-based solutions, real-time decisioning systems, and large-scale data engineering while contributing directly to Mastercard's mission of enabling secure and trusted commerce worldwide.
Role
As a Senior Data Scientist, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale AI solutions that enhance fraud detection and risk intelligence capabilities across Mastercard's Security Solutions portfolio.
This is not just a model development role; it is ideal for someone who enjoys working closely with complex data, exploring patterns, deeply understanding business and technical problems, experimenting through R&D, and translating practical solutions into scalable fraud and security capabilities.
Key responsibilities include:
Develop, deploy, and optimize machine learning models for fraud detection, risk scoring, anomaly detection, and related security applications.
Build scalable AI and ML pipelines supporting model training, validation, deployment, monitoring, and retraining.
Design and implement Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), reasoning and planning workflows, Chain-of-Thought-style prompting techniques, tool/function calling, LLM-based modular systems, and multi-agent orchestration.
Partner with AI Engineers and Data Scientists to productionize advanced models and translate research into scalable business solutions.
Work with large-scale transactional datasets using distributed computing technologies such as Spark and Databricks.
Implement MLOps best practices, including CI/CD, model governance, observability, experimentation frameworks, and performance monitoring.
Contribute to the design of reusable AI platforms, libraries, and engineering frameworks that accelerate AI development across teams.
Evaluate emerging AI technologies and identify opportunities to apply them to fraud prevention and security challenges.
Contribute to Mastercard's innovation efforts by publishing top-tier research papers, filing patents, and translating applied AI research into scalable fraud and security solutions.
Ensure solutions meet Mastercard standards for scalability, reliability, explainability, security, and responsible AI.
All About You
Strong programming skills in Python and experience building production-quality software.
Solid understanding of machine learning fundamentals, including supervised learning, ensemble methods, feature engineering, model evaluation, and experimentation.
Hands-on experience developing and deploying machine learning solutions in production environments.
Experience working with LLMs, prompt engineering, reasoning and planning frameworks, RAG architectures, vector databases, AI agents, and Generative AI application development.
Experience with distributed computing platforms such as Spark, Databricks, or similar big data technologies.
Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP and associated AI/ML services.
Understanding of MLOps principles, including model deployment, model monitoring, CI/CD, and ML lifecycle management.
Experience working with SQL and large-scale structured and unstructured datasets.
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities with a passion for solving complex real-world challenges.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams.
Strong learning agility, intellectual curiosity, and desire to stay current with advances in AI and machine learning.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience developing fraud detection, risk management, trust & safety, cybersecurity, or financial crime solutions.
Hands-on experience with Hadoop, Spark, Databricks, MLflow, Agentic AI frameworks, reasoning and planning frameworks, LangChain, or similar AI engineering technologies.
Experience building Agentic AI solutions and multi-agent systems.
Exposure to graph learning, anomaly detection, network intelligence, or real-time decisioning systems.
Publications, patents, open-source contributions, Kaggle achievements, or demonstrated research experience in AI/ML.
Corporate Security Responsibility
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Title and Summary
Senior Technical Program Manager
Overview
The Mastercard Authentication Program powers consumer authentication experiences across e-commerce and in-store payment ecosystems. As part of this mission, the engineering team ensures our authentication platforms remain highly available, performant, scalable, resilient, and operationally efficient while supporting rapid product innovation and growth.
We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to drive reliability-focused programs across our authentication products. This role sits at the intersection of Engineering, SRE, Product, Business Operations, and Platform teams and is responsible for leading strategic initiatives that improve platform health, operational maturity, release excellence, and customer experience. The ideal candidate combines deep technical program management expertise with strong understanding of cloud-scale distributed systems, operational excellence, resiliency engineering, performance management, capacity planning, and large-scale release coordination.
If you are passionate about building highly reliable systems that power billions of secure transactions globally, this role is for you.
Responsibilities:
• Facilitate and oversee team Agile ceremonies including backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and release planning.
• Coordinate resource planning and capacity allocation across the SRE and engineering team to balance operational commitments, incident response, technical debt reduction, and strategic initiatives.
• Drive backlog prioritization and dependency management across multiple Scrum teams to ensure delivery commitments are met.
• Own end-to-end release governance across the broader authentication program. Identify opportunities to improve release processes, planning accuracy, dependency management, and overall delivery efficiency across teams.
• Understand the needs of the engineers and teams who have to build, maintain, and operate the system.
• Identify dependencies, remove execution blockers, and ensure alignment across stakeholders.
• Drive strategic programs focused on improving platform availability, resiliency, reliability, and operational maturity.
• Partner with SRE and Engineering teams to identify reliability risks and develop mitigation strategies.
• Establish structured review mechanisms for reliability, resiliency, performance, scalability, and operational readiness.
• Champion engineering best practices including observability, automation, self-healing, disaster recovery, and operational excellence.
• Coordinate major releases, platform upgrades, migrations, and production rollouts involving multiple engineering teams.
• Manage release risks, dependencies, issue resolution, rollback planning, and stakeholder communication.
• Drive automation initiatives that improve reliability and reduce operational overhead.
• Influence technical and business stakeholders without direct authority.
• Foster a culture of continuous learning, accountability, and operational excellence.
Experience
• Strong understanding of distributed systems, cloud-native architectures, microservices, APIs, and modern platform engineering practices.
• Demonstrated experience breaking down problems, organizing work, planning sprints, and delivering technical programs in agile delivery models (scrum, Kanban, etc.)
• Experience driving capacity planning, performance engineering, disaster recovery, and operational readiness initiatives.
• Proven experience managing large cross-functional release programs across multiple teams.
• Enjoys diving deep to understand of the platforms capabilities and underlying technologies.
• Proven track record of data driven decision-making and applying continuous improvement methodologies across teams.
• Can debate the delivery strategy with business teams, architects, engineers, and designers
• Can communicate to executives, peers, and staff with impact, eloquence, and authenticity
• Demonstrated experience building relationships, partnering with and influencing dependent teams while commanding the respect of the individuals you work with across the organization
• Huge plus if you have expertise in Payments, IaaS, PaaS, serverless technology, CI/CD, SQL/NoSQL databases, microservices APIs, and distributed systems operations in a DevOps model
• 6+ years technical program delivery experience including time developing and testing software.
• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent experience).
Corporate Security Responsibility
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

jobs.title: AI Principal Architect
jobs.description:
Our Purpose
Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.
Title and Summary
AI Principal Architect
Mastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by delivering unparalleled data-driven intelligence and cutting-edge AI solutions. By harnessing proprietary data, frontier generative AI, and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, faster, and more impactful decisions. We transform complex, multi-modal data into agentic systems and generative applications that drive measurable business outcomes and sustained competitive advantage.
We're looking for a Principal Architect, Generative AI & ML Engineering, for the Operational Intelligence Program within B&MI. As a principal-level technical leader, you'll define the architecture vision and technical strategy for our agentic AI platform. On this platform, agents make extensive tool calls into enterprise services and APIs and must run securely, reliably, and at scale. You'll set the standards teams build on across tool calling, multi-agent orchestration, self-correcting agents, memory, retrieval, and LLMOps. You'll also make the key decisions on models, platforms, and trade-offs. Working closely with engineering, product, security, and business leaders, you'll shape the long-term direction of Gen AI across B&MI and mentor architects and senior engineers. You'll also stay hands-on with prototypes that de-risk big bets. The hardest problems in enterprise Gen AI are reliability, integration, security, and scale. If you've solved them as a backend or distributed systems architect and have started applying that experience to LLM systems, we'd love to hear from you.
Roles & Responsibilities
• Own the architecture and technical roadmap for the Operational Intelligence Gen AI platform, defining reference architectures and standards that teams across the program can reuse and scale.
• Architect the enterprise tool-calling layer, setting standards for how internal services, data platforms, and external APIs are exposed to agents as tools. This covers schemas, contracts, versioning, access control, and resilient execution (parallel and chained calls, retries, timeouts, idempotency, circuit breakers, and fallbacks).
• Set the architecture for multi-agent and skills-based agent systems (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen), including when to use agents versus deterministic workflows and how agents coordinate, delegate, and share context.
• Design self-correcting agent patterns: tool critics and verifiers that check tool selection, arguments, and results, plus reflection and plan-and-execute loops that catch errors before agents act or respond.
• Architect agent memory and state for long-running, multi-step sessions, including short- and long-term memory (e.g., Mem0, Zep, LangGraph memory), session persistence, and memory scoping and retention.
• Define retrieval architecture for grounded reasoning, including Self-RAG, Corrective RAG (CRAG), adaptive retrieval, and Graph-RAG, built on vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch) and knowledge graphs (e.g., Neo4j, AWS Neptune).
• Design the inference and orchestration layer for high throughput, covering async processing, streaming, caching, rate limiting, and model routing across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and open-source models.
• Establish the LLMOps architecture on Databricks (AWS), including MLflow, CI/CD for prompts and agents, and model lineage. Set platform-wide evaluation and observability standards: end-to-end tracing of tool calls, tool-selection accuracy, task success rates, cost, and latency.
• Build security and Responsible AI into the architecture, including guardrails, prompt-injection defenses, hallucination mitigation, data privacy, and audit trails that meet Mastercard's data ethics and regulatory standards.
• Own key architecture decisions and trade-offs, such as build versus buy, model and vendor selection, and cost versus latency versus accuracy, documented through architecture decision records. Assess emerging models, frameworks, and standards such as MCP for production readiness.
• Lead design reviews and partner with engineering, product, security, and data teams to align on architecture and raise the engineering bar across the program.
• Stay hands-on, building prototypes and reference implementations that de-risk decisions and give teams a working starting point.
All About You
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
• Significant experience architecting large-scale distributed systems in production, including microservices, event-driven systems, data platforms, and cloud-native infrastructure.
• Deep expertise in API design and systems integration, including contracts, security models, and reliability patterns for services consumed by many teams. You understand what changes when the consumer is an LLM.
• Hands-on experience designing and shipping LLM-powered systems in production, especially agents that use tool/function calling, memory, and retrieval, and a clear view of how they fail.
• Strong Python skills for hands-on prototyping (async programming, FastAPI or similar), plus SQL proficiency.
• Deep experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS preferred; Azure or GCP welcome), including its AI services such as Bedrock, SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, or Vertex AI.
• A solid grounding in security, privacy, and compliance for enterprise systems, ideally in financial services or another regulated industry.
• The ability to influence without authority, aligning engineering, product, and leadership around a technical direction and explaining trade-offs in business terms.
• Nice to have: hands-on experience with tool critics, Self-RAG, CRAG, reflection loops, memory frameworks such as Mem0 or Zep, MCP tool servers, or agent evaluation frameworks.
• Nice to have: exposure to fine-tuning (LoRA, PEFT, RLHF), multimodal models, or knowledge graphs.
• Coming from backend or distributed systems architecture? The hardest problems in enterprise Gen AI are reliability, integration, security, and scale, and you've solved them before. If you've started applying that experience to LLM systems, we want to hear from you, even if you haven't used every tool listed here.
Corporate Security Responsibility
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Job Details:
Job Description:
The Role and Impact:
As an IP Logic Design Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in developing high-quality intellectual property (IP) for Unified Intel Chassis designs. This position is at the forefront of Intel's innovation, ensuring that our products consistently deliver world-class performance, power efficiency, and reliability. Work closely with architects to define and design complex protocol bridges. Define and implement range-based access control for secured memory and register paths across HBW and LBW. Own privilege qualification and policy propagation across AXI-Lite, APB, IOSF-SB, and HBW request paths. Design and validate parity/ECC generation and checking for request, response, and data channels. Define fault behavior for unauthorized accesses and corrupt transactions, including silent block semantics, RAZWI-style handling, poison propagation, and timeout cleanup. Build or integrate logging, interrupt, and firmware-visible error harvesting flows for local and global RAS handling. Support error injection, diagnostics, and post-silicon debug hooks for both security and reliability validation. Define and implement telemetry capture for fabric load, latency, congestion, error context, and other operational health indicators. Own debug and trace data paths for wrapper-level and fabric-level observability, including data capture, transport, formatting, and handoff to downstream debug infrastructure. Design counters, sticky status, snapshots, and firmware-visible CSRs that make performance and failure analysis practical. Integrate trigger, monitor, and logging hooks needed for bring-up, stress triage, and post-silicon correlation. Work with architecture, validation, firmware, and post-silicon teams to ensure telemetry and debug signals are useful, stable, and diagnosable. Balance observability depth against area, timing, bandwidth, and survivability constraints. Support root-cause analysis of bandwidth loss, latency outliers, protocol stalls, and intermittent field or lab issues using hardware observability features.
Key Responsibilities:
Develop logic designs, register transfer level (RTL) coding, and simulations required for IP blocks, functional units, and subsystems.
Define architecture and microarchitecture features for the IP block being designed.
Apply strategies, tools, and methods to optimize RTL design for power, performance, area, and timing targets.
Strong knowledge of AXI, AXI-Lite, APB, parity/ECC schemes, and transaction error handling.

Experience with RAS concepts such as fault containment, poison, interrupt generation, logging, and recovery-oriented design.

jobs.title: CPU Physical Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Details:
Job Description:
Performs physical design implementation of CPU designs from RTL to GDS to create a design database that is ready for manufacturing. Conducts all aspects of the CPU physical design flow including synthesis, place and route, clock tree synthesis, floor planning, static timing analysis, power/clock distribution, reliability, and power and noise analysis. Conducts verification and signoff including formal equivalence verification, static timing analysis, reliability verification, static and dynamic power integrity, layout verification, electrical rule checking, and structural design checking. Analyzes results and makes recommendations to improve current and future CPU microarchitectures closely collaborating with logic, circuit, architecture, and design automation teams. Possesses CPUspecific expertise in various aspects of structural and physical design, including physical clock design, timing closure, coverage analysis, multiple power domain analysis, structured placement, routing, synthesis, and DFT. Works intimately with industry EDA vendors to build and enhance tool capabilities to design a highspeed, lowpower synthesizable CPU. Optimizes CPU design to improve product level parameters such as power, frequency, and area. Participates in the development and improvement of physical design methodologies and flow automation.
Qualifications:
As a CPU Physical Design Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in implementing high-performance, low-power CPU designs from RTL to GDSII. You will focus on detailed processes such as synthesis, placement, routing, timing analysis, and power optimization, enabling designs that meet stringent performance and efficiency targets. Your work will directly influence the success of Intel's next-generation CPUs and their manufacturing readiness, contributing to innovative advancements in computing technology.
You will join a dynamic team dedicated to designing Intel's latest high-performance CPUs using cutting-edge technologies. This group focuses on delivering innovative solutions that propel Intel's leadership in the semiconductor industry. Collaborating across multiple domains, the team drives groundbreaking designs that support Intel's mission of creating world-changing technologies to enrich the lives of every person on Earth.
Key Responsibilities
- Perform physical design implementation from RTL to GDSII, including synthesis, placement, routing, clock tree synthesis, and optimization.
- Conduct static timing analysis, power distribution analysis, and reliability verification to ensure design convergence and high manufacturability.
- Collaborate with logic, circuit, architecture, and automation teams to improve CPU microarchitectures and design methodologies.
- Work closely with industry-leading EDA vendors to enhance tool capabilities for high-speed, low-power CPU development.
- Optimize designs for power, frequency, and area, ensuring product-level parameter excellence.
- Participate in developing and improving physical design methodologies and flow automation for future projects.
Qualifications
- B. Tech or M. Tech degree in Electrical, Electronics with 10+ years of relevant experience.
- Technical expertise in synthesis, placement, clock tree synthesis (CTS), and routing tools, particularly using Synopsys and Cadence platforms.
- Proficiency in timing signoff, formal verification, and low-power design techniques.

- Experience with Verilog or VHDL for hardware description and design execution.
- Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, for collaborative problem-solving.
- Demonstrated ability to work effectively in dynamic environments across geographies.
- Knowledge of innovative feature feasibility studies and SD flow methodologies.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Responsible AI
jobs.description:
Job Details | Atlassian
Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Responsible AI
Engineering | Bengaluru, India | Remote, Remote
Apply for this job
Working at Atlassian
Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. This is a remote position. To help our teams work together effectively, this role requires you to be located in India.
We are seeking a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our team, dedicated to developing innovative solutions to make AI services responsible (Responsible AI).
You will join the Responsible AI (RAI) & AI Safety engineering team. We are responsible for building, operating, and advancing the centralized AI safety, content moderation, and guardrail platforms powering Atlassian Intelligence and Rovo.
Our systems run inline and asynchronously across high-throughput production workloads, detecting and mitigating jailbreaks, prompt injection, harmful content, bias, and policy violations while preserving latency and user experience. We partner closely with Product Engineering, Central AI Platform, AI Gateway, Legal, and Trust teams to deliver safety systems that scale globally.
We have teams in the USA, Australia, New Zealand, and this will be our expansion to India. This team is responsible for building solutions and operating mature platforms to improve the entire company's security and trust & safety posture.If you are passionate about improving security, trust & safety, and combating abuse, this role presents a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact!
At Atlassian, a Machine Learning Engineer (MLE) is responsible for building, training, evaluating, and deploying machine learning models into production systems at scale. The role sits at the intersection of software engineering and data science, requiring production-grade code to turn research prototypes into real-world systems like search ranking, recommendations, and GenAI platforms.
What You’ll Do
Design & Productionize Safety Models: Architect, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML/LLM-based guardrail and moderation models (text, multi-modal, and code) to safeguard user inputs and model outputs across Atlassian products.
Build Robust Evaluation & Benchmarking: Design offline and online evaluation frameworks, adversarial test suites (red-teaming), and LLM-as-a-judge pipelines to measure precision, recall, false-positive rates, and robustness against model drift.
Optimize for Real-Time Serving: Work at the intersection of model accuracy and low latency (P50/P99 targets) to deliver cost-effective, high-throughput safety filtering integrated with our central AI Gateway and inference layers.
Combat Emerging Threats: Research and build defenses against adversarial prompts, jailbreaks, data leakage, hallucinations, and unauthorized tool-calling behaviors in agentic systems.
Drive Global Compliance & Governance: Support technical readiness for enterprise standards and emerging AI regulations (e.g., EU AI Act, ISO 42001 / AIMS, FedRAMP) through verifiable safety controls, audit logging, and watermarking capabilities.
Collaborate & Mentor: Partner with engineering managers, staff engineers, data scientists, and product managers to steer technical strategy; provide code/design reviews and mentor junior engineers across the team.
At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
Your background
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related quantitative field, with 7+ years of industry experience building and deploying machine learning systems in production.
Deep hands-on experience with modern NLP and LLM techniques, transformer architectures, prompt engineering, fine-tuning (e.g., PEFT/LoRA), and model alignment.
Proficiency in Python (and familiarity with Kotlin, Java, or Go) with a track record of writing clean, testable, and performant production-grade code.
Proven experience constructing rigorous evaluation pipelines, benchmarking datasets, and managing precision/recall trade-offs for high-consequence classification or safety systems.
Expertise at telling stories with data and familiarity with at least one visualization tool (e.g. Tableau, R-Shiny, Microstrategy, SAP Business Objects, Looker, etc.)
Experience deploying and scaling ML services in cloud environments (AWS / GCP) using containerized platforms (Kubernetes/Docker) and distributed data processing frameworks (Spark, SQL).
Strong analytical problem-solving skills, ability to navigate ambiguity, and clear communication skills to articulate ML trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
An agile development mindset focused on constant iteration, solving problems from first principles, and navigating ambiguity.
It's great, but not required, if you have
Experience specifically in Trust & Safety, Content Moderation, or AI Red-Teaming / Adversarial Robustness.
Hands-on experience optimizing inference engines (e.g., Triton Inference Server, vLLM, TensorRT-LLM) or model quantization techniques for low-latency serving.
Familiarity with AI governance frameworks, content provenance/watermarking, or regulatory compliance standards (e.g., EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001).
Experience with large-scale streaming pipelines (e.g., Kafka, Kinesis) or graph-based entity systems.

Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits.

jobs.description:

We partner with the world's most innovative AI companies and open-source communities to address their most challenging technical problems. ​
What you will be doing:
In this role, you will develop innovative solutions that advance AI infrastructure capabilities, advise infrastructure experts on the demands of ML workloads, help practitioners diagnose and solve full-stack AI and ML system problems, and work on a team with direct responsibility for the success of internal and external customers’ AI and ML initiatives, including LLM performance evaluation and supporting new hardware in open-source frameworks. You will:
Build and deploy custom AI solutions on NeoCloud platforms and NVIDIA Cloud Partners (NCPs), including distributed training, inference optimization, and MLOps pipelines,
Act as a primary technical contact for internal and external customers and partners, guiding joint engagements, ensuring the success of initiatives on DGX Cloud, and solving complex problems in production,
Work closely with the teams building the infrastructure software and accelerated frameworks that support today’s most compelling AI applications,
Profile and tune large-scale training and inference workloads on NCP platforms, leading efforts to reduce latency, cost, and operational risk, and
Develop open-source tools and reference architectures to make it easier to build and manage machine learning and AI workloads, pipelines, and systems at scale.

Solid scripting and programming skills in languages like bash and Python and solid systems programming skills in a language like C++, Go, or Rust.

Experience contributing to and working in open-source communities.

Direct experience drawing on deep systems knowledge to diagnose and fix performance or correctness problems that span multiple layers of the application stack, like hardware, networking, accelerator, hypervisor or OS, compilers or runtimes, application code, and libraries.

Finance Costing COE Data & Integration Lead
Description -
HP is launching a Costing Transformation Program to simplify, standardize and modernize costing across the company. The program will establish a consistent enterprise framework and governance, enabling faster insights, greater pricing agility and better business decisions.
Our ambition is to create a unified, globally harmonized Fully Burdened Cost ecosystem that connects costing with pricing, supply chain and financial processes. The future-state model will provide greater end-to-end visibility, agility and control, while maintaining the financial integrity and compliance required to support HP’s future growth.
At the center of the transformation, HP is establishing a Finance-led Costing Center of Excellence (CoE) responsible for enterprise costing standards, methodologies, process design, governance and business alignment. The CoE will partner closely with Personal Systems, Print, Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, Digital, Pricing and other business and functional teams.
We are looking for individuals with a strong costing and/or Supply Chain cost-accounting background who are excited about the opportunity to challenge the status quo and shape how costing should work at HP in the future. This is not a lift-and-shift of today’s processes into new technology. CoE team members will help simplify existing complexity, challenge legacy practices, harmonize processes and methodologies, and translate deep costing expertise into scalable solutions.
As an early member of the Costing CoE, you will not simply join an established organization. You will help build it, shape its operating model and influence one of HP’s key Finance transformations from the ground up.
Required qualifications and experience
· Strong product-costing and cost-accounting background, with a solid understanding of how product costs are developed, maintained, analyzed and used in business decisions.
· Experience with standard cost, material cost, bill-of-material cost structures, cost rollups, burden and overhead rates, allocation methodologies, purchase-price impacts, manufacturing costs and cost variances.
· Strong understanding of end-to-end costing dependencies across Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, Product Management, Engineering, Pricing and Digital.
· Ability to assess current-state processes, identify unnecessary complexity and design simplified, standardized future-state solutions.
· Hands-on problem-solving capability, including the ability to independently analyze data and processes, develop recommendations, document future-state requirements and drive implementation.
· Experience working across functions and geographies, with strong communication and influencing skills.
· Ability to challenge established practices constructively and distinguish genuine business-model requirements from legacy process preferences.
· Strong analytical skills and ability to work with large, complex product and costing data sets.
· Experience supporting process transformation, ERP implementation, systems modernization or enterprise operating-model change.
· Strong understanding of financial controls, data traceability, reconciliation and auditability.
Preferred profile
· Deep Personal Systems costing experience is strongly preferred, including knowledge of PS product structures, SKU and AV complexity, bills of material, commodity cost movements, product lifecycle events and hardware-costing processes.
· Supply Chain cost-accounting experience is strongly preferred, particularly experience connecting operational cost drivers with financial costing and accounting outcomes.
· Experience in hardware, technology, manufacturing or similarly complex product environments.

Description -
Job Summary
HP’s Controls & Compliance Hub provides a unique opportunity to get a broad view of HP businesses and processes in a relatively short period of time. The team is tasked with assessing how HP management is managing the inherent risk in our large, diverse and rapidly changing company....a huge challenge!
This Expert role will be engaged to enhance, monitor, and provide ongoing assurance over the company’s business processes and controls. This position is critical for managements assessment of internal controls over financial reporting.
Responsibilities include but are not limited to the following:
Develops and oversees first and second line of defense for key mega processes.
Responsible for overseeing the design and implementation of control gaps and looks for ways to ensure the end-to-end suite of controls appropriately manages the key risks with robust processes while balancing efficiency
Drives ongoing evaluation of the control environment to review the efficiency and effectiveness of controls and ongoing improvements
Provides guidance on compliance matters and identifies hidden risks or non-conformity issues
Reviews the work of global control owners to identify compliance issues and provides advice, training and assistance with developing remediation plans
Partners with management, the internal audit function and external auditor as an independent team to facilitate successful control testing outcomes
Keeps abreast of regulatory developments within the company as well as evolving best practices in compliance and controls space
Drives adherence to regulations in all aspects and levels of business
Stays abreast of cross-functional/cross-organizational programs. Brings strategic insights in dealing with complex strategic issues.
Prepares reports for executive management and various stakeholders, as needed
Ensures timely and effective delivery of programs under scope

Content master in the field with a complete systematic knowledge of audit standards and accounting principles

The role ensures data integrity and compliance by performing data cleansing and data validations. The role performs root-cause analysis and recommends or executes corrective actions by implementing auto detect, auto dragonize and auto correct when data from related system problems occur. • Designs and establishes secure and performant data architectures, enhancements, updates, and programming changes for portions and subsystems of data pipelines, repositories or models for structured/unstructured data.

• Collaborates and communicates with project team regarding project progress and issue resolution.
• Analyzes data inaccuracies, identifies opportunities and supports the development of automated solutions to enhance overall quality of the enterprise data.
• Identifies problematic areas and conducts research to determine the best course of action to correct the data; identifies, analyzes and interprets trends and patterns in complex datasets.
• Works cross-functionally with different departments to assess, define, and develop report deliverables.
• Represents the software data engineering team for all phases of larger and more-complex development projects.
