jobs.title: Planning Process System Expert
jobs.description:
Planning Process System Expert
Description -
Job Description for Planning Process System Expert and IBP Consultant
Business Environment
HP creates new possibilities for technology to have a meaningful impact on people, businesses, governments and society. The world’s largest technology company and ranked 10 on the Fortune 500 list for 2012, HP brings together a portfolio that spans printing, personal computing, software, services and IT infrastructure to serve more than 1 billion customers in over 170 countries on six continents. HP invents, engineers, and delivers technology solutions that drive business value, create social value, and improve the lives of our clients.
About the Engagement
The Print Planning Excellence (PPE) team is responsible for managing and executing production planning systems, data, and processes supporting global and regional Print and Personal Systems businesses within HP. The team focuses on ensuring that demand and supply plans are complete, reliable, accurate, and available on time to support effective business planning and execution.
The Planning Process System Expert and IBP Consultant would work closely with business planning teams, IT, and cross-functional stakeholders to support the execution of demand and supply planning processes. The consultant would monitor daily and weekly planning activities, analyse planning data, identify process and system issues, and coordinate with relevant teams to drive timely resolution.
The role would also support master data accuracy, planning metrics and reporting, business-user queries, and planning cycle readiness. The consultant would act as a key connection point between the planning community and IT, supporting issue resolution, process improvements, testing, and implementation of planning system enhancements.
The objective of the role is to ensure stable and timely planning execution, high-quality planning data, effective issue resolution, and continuous improvement of planning processes.
Planning Process System Expert and IBP Consultant
Execute → Monitor → Analyse → Resolve → Support
Key Roles & Responsibilities
ü Support and manage end-to-end Demand and Supply Planning activities across Print, S&G, and Personal Systems businesses.
ü Execute daily, weekly, and periodic planning processes, ensuring planning activities are completed accurately and on time.
ü Analyse planning data and reports to identify demand, supply, forecast, and planning-system issues and highlight potential business impacts.
ü Monitor key supply chain and planning KPIs, including forecast accuracy, demand-supply alignment, and other operational planning indicators.
ü Identify planning gaps and operational risks, perform initial root-cause analysis, escalate critical issues, and coordinate actions toward resolution.
ü Partner closely with Business SMEs, IT, and cross-functional teams to troubleshoot planning issues and ensure demand and supply alignment.
ü Communicate planning issues, business impact, corrective actions, and resolutions to relevant stakeholders and support/lead regular SME discussions.
ü Identify opportunities for process improvement, standardization, automation, and cost reduction across demand and supply planning processes.
ü Participate in cross-functional projects and planning transformation initiatives, including business requirements, testing, validation, and implementation activities.
ü Support the implementation, stabilization, and continuous improvement of planning tools and systems, while maintaining process documentation, controls, and planning best practices.
Planning Process System Expert and IBP Consultant – Skills Required
ü Demand & Supply Planning Fundamentals
Good understanding of demand planning, supply planning, forecasting, inventory, and demand-supply balancing.
ü Planning Systems Knowledge
Working knowledge of SAP IBP, SAP HANA, ARIBA, Enterprises Business Wearhouse or similar supply-chain planning systems.
ü Data Analysis
Strong analytical skills with the ability to review planning data, identify exceptions, trends, gaps, and potential issues.
ü Planning KPI & Performance Monitoring
Understanding of planning metrics such as forecast accuracy, demand-supply match, inventory, backlog, and service-level indicators.
ü Problem Solving & Root-Cause Analysis
Ability to investigate day-to-day process, data, and system issues and support root-cause identification and resolution.
ü Excel & Reporting Skills
Strong knowledge of Microsoft Excel; exposure to Power BI or other reporting/analytics tools is preferred.
ü Master Data & Data Quality
Basic understanding of master-data dependencies and the importance of data quality within planning processes.
ü Stakeholder Collaboration
Ability to coordinate effectively with planners, Business SMEs, IT/support teams, and other cross-functional stakeholders.
ü Communication Skills
Ability to clearly communicate planning issues, business impact, risks, corrective actions, and resolution status.
ü Testing & Implementation Support
Ability to support requirements gathering, UAT, validation, implementation, go-live, and stabilization activities.
Education & Experience
Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, master’s in supply chain, or a related discipline. BTech, BE, MCA, or equivalent qualification preferred.
1–3 years of overall experience, preferably with exposure to Supply Chain, Demand Planning, Supply Planning, or Planning Operations.
Working knowledge or hands-on exposure to SAP APO and/or SAP IBP modules.
Basic understanding of end-to-end Demand and Supply Planning processes.
Exposure to SAP S/4HANA, SAP Ariba, or related supply-chain applications is an added advantage.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word for analysis, reporting, and business presentations.
Knowledge of SQL, MS Access, Excel Macros/VBA, Power BI, or other data/automation technologies is an added advantage.
Willingness and flexibility to work across different time zones based on business requirements.
Soft Skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work effectively with Business, IT, and cross-functional teams.
Strong attention to detail, particularly when working with planning and master data.
Ability to learn new processes, systems, and technologies quickly.
Good time management and prioritization skills.
Proactive approach toward issue identification and resolution.
Strong teamwork and collaboration skills.
Customer and business-oriented mindset.
Willingness to take ownership and accountability for assigned activities.

Description -
About the role
HP Applied AI helps the enterprise use AI safely and at scale while improving performance, experience and cost. As an AI Technical Program Manager, you will be the primary Applied AI partner for one or more value streams, flexing across priorities as business demand evolves.
You will connect business leaders, Global Process Owners, product and platform teams, delivery managers, engineering, machine learning, data, operations and controls. You will translate business problems into buildable requirements, steer execution, challenge legacy ways of working and ensure solutions reach production with measurable outcomes.
What you will do
· Own end-to-end program outcomes. Lead AI and automation initiatives from intake and feasibility through planning, execution, testing, release, adoption, operational handover and benefits realization.
· Plan and drive delivery. Maintain integrated plans, milestones, capacity, estimates, budgets and release schedules using agile or hybrid approaches. Manage critical paths, dependencies, scope changes and recovery actions.
· Lead sprint and backlog readiness. Facilitate prioritization, backlog refinement, sprint planning, estimation, reviews and retrospectives. Remove impediments and ensure requirements are ready for engineering.
· Translate business needs into buildable requirements. Map current and future processes; define epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, nonfunctional requirements, data needs, exceptions, integrations and controls.

· Manage risk and governance. Maintain an actionable RAID log, stakeholder map, RACI, decision records and governance cadence. Escalate early, communicate trade-offs and secure accountable decisions.
· Guide AI and enterprise technology delivery. Lead the lifecycle from use-case definition and data readiness through AI evaluation, deployment and monitoring. Work with engineers on LLMs, agents, RPA, APIs, cloud services, environments, pipelines and the SDLC.
· Safeguard quality and production readiness. Align engineering, QA and business teams on test coverage, environments, data, entry and exit criteria, sign-offs and traceability. Coordinate functional, integration, regression, UAT, AI evaluation, performance and security testing as applicable.
· Ensure controls and operational readiness. Maintain required SOX/ITGC change evidence, release approvals, cutover and rollback plans, support readiness and explicit acceptance of residual risks.
· Drive adoption and realized value. Coordinate communications, training and support handover. Track adoption and benefits against agreed baselines, identify outcome gaps and drive corrective action.
· Identify opportunities to Improve the process, not only the technology. Perform root-cause analysis and operational data verification and validation to remove waste, reduce rework, reduce manual handoffs and control weaknesses before or alongside automation. Identify opportunities for process standardization, align with business process SMEs and execute process improvements.

jobs.description:
Database Engineering SME, Global Database Administration
Description -
The Database Engineer SME provides advanced technical expertise for enterprise database architecture, engineering, modernization, security, resiliency, and operational support. This role requires significant hands-on experience with Oracle database technologies, complemented by experience with other relational, cloud-based, and emerging database technologies. The ideal candidate brings a broad understanding of enterprise data platforms and can apply that knowledge across a diverse and evolving database landscape.
The position serves as a technical lead and database subject-matter expert supporting application, infrastructure, cybersecurity, compliance, operations, and project teams. The Database Architect applies advanced technical knowledge and independent judgment to solve complex problems, develop and improve database standards and practices, support cross-functional initiatives, and provide technical guidance and mentoring to other database professionals.
Key Responsibilities
Define and maintain enterprise Oracle database architecture, engineering standards, and best practices across on-premises, virtualized, hybrid, and cloud environments.
Design secure, highly available, scalable, performant, and recoverable database solutions using Data Guard, Data Guard Broker, and RMAN.
Lead database upgrades, migrations, patching, modernization, cloud adoption, infrastructure transformation, and technical-debt reduction initiatives.
Establish standards for HA/DR, backup and recovery, performance, monitoring, observability, security, patching, and lifecycle management.
Support SOX, ITGC, cybersecurity, privileged access, encryption, auditing, governance, and compliance requirements.
Provide expert technical leadership for major incidents, complex troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, performance issues, and database recovery.
Drive automation of provisioning, monitoring, patching, maintenance, compliance reporting, backup validation, and lifecycle activities.
Evaluate emerging database, cloud, automation, and observability technologies and recommend appropriate solutions.
Maintain architecture standards, technical procedures, operational documentation, and technology roadmaps.
Mentor database engineers and represent GDBA in architecture reviews, modernization programs, audits, and vendor engagements.
Follow ITIL-aligned Change, Incident, Problem, and Configuration Management processes for production database services.
Plan and execute database changes through formal Change Management, including risk/impact assessment, implementation plans, validation, rollback procedures, and post-change reviews.
Maintain accurate database and infrastructure Configuration Items (CIs) in the CMDB, including ownership, relationships, lifecycle status, and configuration information.
Ensure database incidents, problems, changes, and configuration records comply with organizational ITSM, SOX, ITGC, security, and audit requirements.

You will serve as a conversational AI product leader across Go to Market, Operations, Product, and Corporate functions. Depending on the initiative, you may advise business leaders, partner with product and engineering teams, or directly lead product strategy and delivery for conversational experiences and the platform capabilities that power them.
The conversational AI market is changing quickly — from single-turn chatbots to multi-agent, tool-using assistants. An important part of this role is evaluating new conversational AI technologies, identifying which capabilities are relevant to Equinix, and translating them into practical product and platform investment decisions.
Responsibilities
Conversational AI, Cloud, and Data Architecture
Bring strong working knowledge of conversational AI, dialogue systems, agent orchestration, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise data architecture to product and platform decisions

Translate technical choices, constraints, and risks into clear business implications that leaders can understand and act on
Help ensure conversational AI products are designed for enterprise scale, security, reliability, multi-channel support (chat, voice, embedded assistants), and reuse across business functions
Conversation Design, Model Strategy, and Deployment

Help teams determine when a smaller model may provide better latency, cost, or control for real-time conversational interactions than a larger model
Partner with AI and machine learning engineering teams on deployment approaches for conversational agents across cloud, private infrastructure, and low-latency environments
Evaluate emerging approaches such as multi-agent coordination, model routing, tool/function calling, memory and context management, and hybrid model deployment for conversational systems
Use conversation quality metrics, containment and escalation rates, model performance data, evaluation results, user feedback, and business outcomes to guide product priorities
Platform Reliability and Responsible AI
Define product requirements for conversational AI system reliability, availability, latency, performance, monitoring, usage limits, and incident response
Partner with engineering teams to improve visibility into conversational agent behavior, model performance, cost, conversation logs, and production issues
Establish requirements that support traceability, explainability, auditability, fairness, privacy, and regulatory compliance across conversational interactions
Work with Legal, Security, Privacy, and AI Governance teams to incorporate company policies and responsible AI requirements into conversational products and platforms, including data handling within chat, voice, and memory features
Partner with Design to create clear conversational UX that explains how AI is being used, manages user expectations, and provides appropriate review, control, hand-off to a human, and approval within the conversation itself
Product Decisions and Risk Management
Lead decisions involving tradeoffs among business value, delivery speed, technical complexity, cost, performance, and risk for conversational AI features
Establish clear and repeatable methods for evaluating major conversational AI product and architecture decisions
Help teams identify risks early — including hallucination, unintended actions, and improper data exposure in conversational contexts — and determine the appropriate level of governance and human oversight
Balance the need to deliver conversational value quickly with the requirements of security, reliability, and responsible AI
Executive and Cross Functional Leadership
Build alignment across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Legal, Information Security, Data, Design, and business functions on the conversational AI roadmap
Influence decisions through expertise, clear reasoning, and strong working relationships rather than direct authority
Explain complex technical topics in clear language that is relevant to both technical and business audiences
Work with senior leaders to connect conversational AI investments to business priorities, customer value, productivity, and operational outcomes
Develop trusted relationships so that teams engage early when evaluating important conversational AI opportunities or decisions

Master's degree or doctorate in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, Physics, or a related field
Experience working with models and platforms from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or the open source community, including agent frameworks and orchestration tooling
Experience with machine learning operations, model evaluation, AI monitoring, or conversational AI observability tools
Experience defining service requirements for conversational AI systems, including availability, latency, performance, monitoring, usage limits, and operational support
Knowledge of responsible AI practices, including explainability, model documentation, evaluation, audit processes, governance, and policy implementation for conversational systems
Experience working with research, engineering, or innovation teams to bring conversational AI capabilities into production
Experience designing conversational AI user experiences that support transparency, consent, user review, and appropriate human control (e.g., escalation to a live agent)
Experience in data centers, cloud infrastructure, telecommunications, or enterprise technology
Experience building AI assistants, chatbots, voice agents, or AI-enabled conversational workflows at enterprise scale
Experience with business software, enterprise platforms, or products designed for developers

You will lead the engineering pods that build the orchestration layer, the persona consoles, and the agents themselves, and carry the roadmap from first MVP to organization-wide scale. Share patterns, standards, and playbooks so other teams can adopt what your team proves

The delivery engine is in daily use by live delivery teams, with measurable cycle-time and quality gains that survive finance scrutiny
You have built a team people want to join, with a hiring record and retention that show it
Executives trust your roadmap because what you commit to ships, and what ships gets measured

jobs.description:
Who are we?
Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.
A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.

Job Summary
We are looking for a Staff Engineer to join the Reliability Engineering team that operates a bare-metal Kubernetes platform across multiple metro locations. The platform's architecture is defined and the build is underway you will provision and operate it day to day: bringing up nodes and clusters, running upgrades, keeping the fleet consistent through GitOps, and owning your shift of the on-call rotation.
This is a deliberately broad role. We are not looking for someone who works one layer and hands everything below it across a boundary. You will work alongside the teams that own the physical hardware, the underlay network, and the data plane software, and you need working knowledge of all three enough to isolate where a problem lives before escalating it.
You will join the Digital Interconnection Engineering organization. The team owns the full application stack for interconnection and the Kubernetes platform for the software-defined data plane across multiple metros. We operate with an automation-first, GitOps-driven culture and a strong commitment to operational rigor, documented runbooks, and blameless postmortems.
Responsibilities
OS Provisioning & Bare-Metal Infrastructure
Provision bare-metal servers across multiple metros using the team's PXE/iPXE imaging and cloud-init pipeline, and harden the OS prior to cluster bootstrap
Extend and maintain that provisioning automation as new hardware, metros and OS versions are introduced, keeping node bring-up free of manual per-node steps
Work with the teams that own the hardware on BIOS/firmware baselines, NIC configuration and disk layout standards, and use BMC/IPMI and platform sensors to isolate hardware faults before handing them over
Kubernetes Cluster Operations
Bring up and operate Kubernetes clusters following the team's established control-plane topology, including etcd members, kube-apiserver HA behind the L4 load balancer or VIP, and defined failure-domain placement
Provision worker nodes, configure CNI, and run end-to-end cluster validation before workloads are onboarded
Perform routine cluster operations: node drains and replacements, certificate rotation, capacity checks, and remediation of cluster-level alerts
GitOps & Fleet Configuration
Make cluster and fleet configuration changes through GitOps, keeping clusters consistent, auditable and drift-free
Perform cluster registration, RBAC and policy changes in the management plane, respecting the isolation between production and nonproduction planes
Extend the deployment pipeline for the software-defined data plane adding validation coverage and test cases working from the pipeline design and gates owned by the senior engineers on the team
Upgrades & Patching
Execute rolling OS and Kubernetes upgrades across the fleet from tested runbooks, with no unplanned downtime, and improve those runbooks as you find gaps
Take etcd snapshots ahead of significant changes, and run scheduled restore drills to prove the recovery path works
Apply the platform's patching cadence across the fleet, tracking CVEs affecting the OS, Kubernetes and cluster components
Observability & On-Call
Own your shift of a follow-the-sun on-call rotation, and act as first responder for control-plane, node, and cluster-level incidents
Build and tune dashboards and alerts for the systems you operate, and reduce alert noise where it is costing the rotation time
Write up incidents you respond to, contribute to blameless postmortems, and turn recurring toil into automation
Author and maintain runbooks for the components you operate
What Success Looks Like First 9-12 Months
Provisioning and bringing up nodes and clusters independently, without per-node manual steps
Running OS and Kubernetes upgrades on cadence from runbooks, and improving those runbooks where they fall short
Owning your on-call shift unassisted, as first responder for cluster and node-level incidents
Restore drills run on schedule, with the recovery path demonstrated rather than assumed
Measurable reduction in toil or alert noise in the areas you operate
Runbooks and dashboards in place for the components you own
Qualifications
Required
Linux on bare metal: Solid hands-on Linux/Ubuntu administration and provisioning; familiarity with PXE/iPXE imaging or equivalent, cloudinit, and OS hardening
Hardware working knowledge: Comfortable with BMC/IPMI consoles, SMART data and platform sensors; able to identify a failing disk, NIC, DIMM or power supply and follow a vendor replacement process
Kubernetes: Production experience operating clusters ideally RKE2 or kubeadm on bare metal including etcd basics, node lifecycle, CNI configuration and cluster-level troubleshooting
Infrastructure as code: Day-to-day use of Ansible, Terraform, ArgoCD, Fleet or similar; comfortable making infrastructure changes through a pipeline rather than by hand
Networking: Working knowledge of VLANs, BGP, bonded NICs and SR-IOV enough to read a configuration, interpret what you see, and isolate whether a problem is above or below the network layer
Upgrades: Experience executing OS and Kubernetes upgrades in production against an established runbook
On-call: Experience in an on-call operations role, responding to production incidents and writing them up afterward
Automation mindset: A reflex to automate repeated manual work, and to leave the runbook better than you found it
Preferred
Experience with Rancher, Rancher Prime or a comparable multi-cluster management plane
Familiarity with DPDK-based data planes such as 6WIND VSR, or with SR-IOV NIC tuning
Exposure to SDN or private-connectivity platforms (Equinix Fabric, VyOS, or equivalent)
Familiarity with LLM provider APIs and AI/agent gateway proxying patterns, since inference traffic from multiple providers transits this platform
Experience operating infrastructure across geographically distributed sites

Job Summary
The Interconnection Sales Specialist (ICS) is an architecture-led seller who grows interconnection revenue across Equinix's full portfolio, physical and virtual, in new and existing accounts.
An ICS sells architectures, not transactions. They work with customers to design how their networks, clouds, partners and AI workloads connect, then land that design on Platform Equinix as a repeatable pattern. Each landed architecture is a design win: a durable position in the account that further connections and workloads route through.
The ICS partners with Account Executives (across all teams), Solution Architects, Sales Engineers, and Technical Account Managers to create pull-through for the whole team, not to compete with it for credit.
What you'll sell
The ICS sells every Equinix interconnection service, combined into the architecture the customer needs rather than one product at a time. Typical architectures the ICS designs and lands include:
WAN core and network modernization on Fabric and Network Edge
Hybrid multicloud connectivity using Fabric Cloud Router and cloud on-ramps
Distributed AI hubs and high-capacity GPU and data-movement interconnect
AI inference and application delivery at the edge
Private connectivity to SaaS, AI platforms and ecosystem partners
Digital supply chain and partner ecosystems built on cross connects, peering and Metro Connect
Responsibilities
Architecture-led selling and design wins
Lead design conversations with customer network, cloud and infrastructure architects to understand business drivers, technical requirements and pain points
Map customer needs to proven interconnection architectures, combining physical and virtual services into a single design
Partner with Solution Architects on presales feasibility and solution design, and produce blueprints another team can run
Register the architecture scope early, and drive it from customer commitment to the first production circuit and a published blueprint
Build value cases and value metrics that show the business impact of the architecture to technical and executive buyers
Account and territory planning
Run joint account planning with Account Executives and Sales Engineers for assigned accounts, segments or verticals
Analyze the installed base and interconnection footprint to find accounts ready for a new architecture, and prioritize them for short- and long-term pursuit
Drive interconnection growth in existing accounts and help open new logos, including magnet customers that pull through partners and ecosystems
Contribute to quarterly business reviews to find and develop new interconnection opportunities
Partnership with the account team
Act as the interconnection expert for the account team, from pursuit strategy through close
Bring in the right resources for each deal: Solution Architects, Technical Account Managers, product, customer success, alliances and channel partners
Co-sell with cloud, technology and channel partners where partner-led plays create the strongest path to a design win
Hand off landed architectures cleanly so that follow-on connections are booked by whoever is best placed, whether AE, partner or portal
Expertise and enablement
Be the field expert on the full interconnection portfolio, industry trends and competitive landscape
Help AEs identify interconnection fit, use cases, buyer personas, common objections and competitors
Contribute to playbooks, reference architectures and customer case studies so winning patterns repeat across the region
Keep current on networking, multi-cloud, AI infrastructure and digital transformation trends
Pipeline, forecasting and cadence
Build and manage a pipeline of architecture opportunities against monthly, quarterly and annual objectives
Provide timely, accurate forecasts and opportunity status through the team's operating cadence
Follow the Equinix selling methodology and keep CRM records current, including registered design scopes
Work with marketing, partner and business development on campaigns that generate interconnection pipeline
Commercials and negotiation
Support the AE on quoting, pricing, negotiation and closing of interconnection deals
Shape commercial structures that support the full build-out of the architecture over time
Work with deal desk and legal on interconnection terms as needed

Knowledge and experience
Required
5+ years selling network, cloud, data center or infrastructure-as-a-service solutions to enterprise or service provider customers, in a technical sales, or specialist role
Architecture depth in enterprise networking, interconnection and hybrid multicloud: WAN, routing, peering, cloud connectivity and network virtualization
Ability to design a solution with customer architects and write it up as a blueprint others can deliver
Executive presence and credibility with both technical buyers and business decision makers
Track record of working with account teams and partners, and meeting or exceeding sales objectives
Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience
Preferred
Experience with AI and GPU-cluster networking, data movement or large-scale cloud architecture (especially for Strategic and hyperscale accounts)
Hands-on background as a network or solutions architect, or with a cloud provider, carrier or network service provider
Industry certifications such as CCNP, JNCIP or cloud networking specialty certifications from AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud
Experience in one of Equinix's vertical segments: Financial Services, Enterprise, Strategic, Telco & Media or Public Sector

jobs.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
The Distinguished Member of Technical Staff (DMTS) for ITP (Innovation, Technology and Products) AI is one of the company's important distinguished technical leadership positions, accountable for turning ITP's AI priorities into production-grade solutions that accelerate technology development, silicon design, product development, and engineering execution across ITP. This role is central to Micron's mission to make AI foundational to how ITP innovates and develops technology and products, amplifying its people and unlocking durable competitive advantage through solutions that are deployed, adopted, and delivering value.
Position Summary
The ITP AI DMTS is a hands-on technical architect and execution leader in Artificial Intelligence. This individual will work closely with subject matter experts (SMEs) across ITP to understand engineering workflows and pain points, translate those needs into practical AI architectures, and work alongside implementation teams seeing through to production deployment. The role directly advances ITP's goal to redesign engineering from specification to qualification, enabling more design IDs, faster execution, and first-pass qualification with best-in-class quality.
The DMTS will be accountable alongside implementation teams for delivery of outcomes, partnering directly with internal customers to ensure solutions are adopted and deliver measurable business impact, including ITP's broader goal of significantly faster time-to-market. Success in this role will be measured primarily by the number of AI systems successfully rolled out into production and the business value they deliver. The individual will drive disciplined execution against quarterly objectives while bringing applied innovation to every solution, ensuring Micron continues to lead in how AI is used across engineering.
Key Responsibilities
Architecture and Execution
Partner with SMEs across ITP to understand engineering workflows, data, and constraints, and translate them into scalable, implementable AI architectures.
Define technical designs, solution blueprints, and implementation plans that move AI use cases from concept to production.
Lead hands-on technical execution, including architecture reviews, build decisions, integration, and deployment readiness.
Establish reusable architecture patterns, platforms, and standards that accelerate delivery across ITP.
Translate the ITP AI roadmap into concrete quarterly deliverables with clear milestones, owners, and success criteria.
Identify and manage technical risks, dependencies, and trade-offs to keep programs on schedule.
Customer Partnership and Production Delivery
Own delivery of AI outcomes end to end, from requirements through production rollout and adoption.
Work closely with internal customers across technology development, silicon design, product engineering, and manufacturing to prioritize the use cases with the highest business impact.
Drive the rollout of production AI systems, ensuring quality, reliability, scalability, security, and supportability.
Partner with cross-functional engineering and IT teams to integrate AI solutions into existing tools, data, and workflows.
Track and report adoption, performance, and business impact of deployed solutions, including improvements in velocity, quality, and cost.
Continuously improve deployed systems based on customer feedback and operational data.
Applied Innovation
Drive innovation that becomes deployable capability, applying advances in GenAI, agentic AI, machine learning, scientific AI, and semiconductor-focused AI to real ITP problems.
Rapidly prototype and evaluate new approaches, scaling those that prove value into production.
Bring emerging AI technologies and industry practices into ITP where they can measurably improve engineering outcomes.
Technical Leadership and Influence
Drive disciplined execution against objectives set each quarter, translating the ITP AI roadmap into measurable, quarter-over-quarter results.
Serve as a trusted technical advisor to ITP leaders on AI architecture, delivery priorities, and investment trade-offs.
Lead cross-functional teams through complex technical challenges requiring exceptional expertise and creativity.
Mentor senior technical staff, principal engineers, architects, and engineers
Build and strengthen Micron's AI technical community and talent pipeline.
How Success Is Measured
Number of AI systems rolled out into production across ITP.
Customer adoption and sustained usage of deployed solutions.
Measurable business impact, including faster time-to-market, improved quality, and engineering productivity gains.
Delivery against quarterly objectives and committed milestones.
Innovation output, including new IP and novel solutions that reach deployment.
Minimum Qualifications
MS or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computer Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or related field.
15+ years of experience in advanced AI research, AI platform development, machine learning, semiconductor or related technical domains.
Demonstrated record of technical innovation translated into production systems with measurable business impact.
Deep expertise in multiple AI disciplines, such as Generative AI, agentic AI, machine learning, deep learning, LLMs, AI infrastructure, scientific AI, reinforcement learning, and AI safety and governance.
Significant experience architecting, building, and deploying large-scale AI or software systems into production.
Exceptional communication and executive influencing skills.
Proven ability to drive technical outcomes across organizational boundaries without direct authority.
Preferred Qualifications
Expertise in AI with a good record of publications, patents, open-source contributions, or industry recognition.
Experience applying AI within semiconductor technology, EDA, manufacturing, product development, scientific computing, or high-performance computing environments.
Demonstrated success creating and scaling enterprise AI platforms and capabilities.
Experience leading AI transformation efforts within global organizations.
History of mentoring senior technical talent and developing future technical leaders.
Distinguished engineer experience, or equivalent technical leadership accomplishments.

Job Description
Role and Responsibilities
Own the development and physical implementation of critical analog, mixed‑signal, and custom digital blocks, including block‑level and full‑chip layout ownership.
Lead layout implementation using AI‑assisted and automated workflows, applying copilot‑based assistants, agentic AI flows, and rule‑aware automation to accelerate placement, routing and optimization.
Perform and automate layout verification activities, including DRC, LVS, Antenna, Yield, ESD, TOTEM, EM/IR and quality checks.
Drive on‑time delivery of blocks and partition‑level layouts with predictable quality and risk prediction/mitigation plans.
Develop and deploy AI‑enabled methodologies for Semi-automated floorplanning, parasitic estimation, layout consistency checks and best‑practice enforcement, repetitive layout task elimination via SKILL, Python, TCL or agent‑based flows.
Demonstrate technical leadership in planning, area and cycle‑time estimation, delegation and execution.
Guide and mentor engineers in Analog layout fundamentals, Automation‑first approach, Design‑for‑quality and design‑for‑yield practices
Collaborate closely with Design, CAD, Verification, Reliability, and Program Management teams, clearly communicating technical risks, schedule impacts and any optimization opportunities.
Drive continuous improvement by identifying manual bottlenecks and converting them into scalable automated flows.
Job Requirements
8+ years of experience in analog/custom layout design in advanced CMOS technology nodes.
Strong expertise in Cadence Virtuoso (VLE/VXL) and Calibre DRC/LVS, with hands‑on ownership of verification closure.
Proven experience in layout of critical analog blocks, including but not limited to Temperature sensors, PLLs, ADCs, DACs, LDOs, bandgaps, reference generators, Charge pumps, etc
Hands‑on experience with memory layouts, including DRAM, SRAM, CAM, OTP and understanding of array‑to‑periphery integration.
Deep understanding of analog layout fundamentals, including Matching and symmetry, EM, latch‑up, coupling, crosstalk, IR‑drop, shielding, guard‑ring strategies, parasitic effects.
Strong ability to interpret design intent and constraints and translate them into high‑quality, manufacturable layouts.
Proven expertise in defining, developing, and scaling AI‑driven automation and AI‑assisted methodologies for complex layout workflows.
Demonstrated problem‑solving skills in physical verification, debug, and layout optimization dedicated to improving yield.

B.Tech in Electronics, Electronics & Communication, or VLSI Engineering

About NCR Atleos:

Passionate about technology and see the world a little differently than your peers. Everywhere you look, there’s possibility and opportunity. You don’t see problems—you see boundaries to push and challenges to solve. Why? Because you believe software engineering changes how people live.

jobs.description:
About NCR Atleos
NCR Atleos, headquartered in Atlanta, is a leader in expanding financial access. Our dedicated 20,000 employees optimize the branch, improve operational efficiency and maximize self-service availability for financial institutions and retailers across the globe.
Title: Application Security Compliance Lead
Location: Gurgaon or Hyderabad, India
About NCR Atleos
NCR Atleos Corporation (NYSE: NATL) is a global technology company that enables financial access and commerce through assisted and self-service solutions and comprehensive support services. NCR Atleos serves financial and public-sector organizations in more than 100 countries and is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, USA.
The opportunity
As an Application Security Compliance Lead, you will help ensure that NCR Atleos software products and development practices meet applicable security, privacy and regulatory requirements. Working within our global Application Security team, you will turn complex requirements into practical guidance, prepare teams for assessments, and help demonstrate that security and privacy are embedded throughout the software lifecycle.
A major focus is organization-level PCI Software Security Framework (SSF) activities: support product teams to achieve and retain PCI Secure Software Standard listings and maintain validation of our Secure Software Lifecycle practices. This role suits someone who combines compliance expertise with software development and application security knowledge.
What you will do
Govern the Secure SDLC. Maintain and improve practices aligned with the PCI Secure SLC Standard.
Enable PCI SSF validation. Guide teams through external assessment, self-assessment, annual attestation and periodic revalidation activities.
Interpret requirements. Translate security, privacy, legal and industry requirements into clear, proportionate guidance.
Assess readiness and close gaps. Coordinate reviews, evidence, gap analysis, remediation and resolution of findings.
Engage and influence. Partner with engineering, Legal, risk, compliance and security teams, QSAs and the PCI SSC.
Build capability. Create training and reusable guidance; monitor developments and communicate material changes.
Drive continual improvement. Use industry changes, stakeholder feedback, internal audits, assessment outcomes, recurring findings, and incidents to strengthen controls and processes.
What you will bring
Essential experience and capabilities
Typically, 7+ years of relevant experience in application security, software security assurance, secure software development, technology risk, privacy, compliance, or audit.
Practical experience developing, operating, governing or assessing a Secure SDLC.
Experience interpreting security or compliance requirements and supporting assessments, evidence collection, gap analysis and remediation.
Working knowledge of threat modelling, vulnerability management, security testing, and risk-based decision-making.
Technical understanding of cloud services, source-code management, and CI/CD practices sufficient to engage credibly with engineering teams.
Ability to convert complex requirements into pragmatic guidance and make evidence-based recommendations.
Strong stakeholder management, communication, analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to influence without direct authority.
Ability to work independently and effectively within a globally distributed team.
Comfortable using AI assistants, such as Copilot, responsibly in day-to-day work to improve personal productivity, quality, and speed of delivery.
A bachelor’s degree in a STEM discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience and qualifications.
Desirable experience and capabilities
Direct experience of PCI SSF validation or a comparable software security assurance framework.
Knowledge of payment-card security, GDPR requirements, NIST CSF and OWASP standards and guidance.
Experience delivering application security or compliance-related training.
Knowledge of security and governance for AI-enabled software development and products.
A relevant certification, such as CISSP, CSSLP, CIPP, CIPT or CIPM.
How you will succeed
Teams receive clear, timely, and actionable compliance guidance.
PCI SSF validation activities are well planned, appropriately evidenced, and progressed effectively.
Compliance gaps and findings are clearly owned, prioritized, tracked, and resolved.
Secure SDLC requirements remain practical, current, and consistently understood.
Assessment and incident lessons lead to sustainable improvements and strong stakeholder relationships.
Evidence we value
In your application, we would particularly welcome examples of how you have interpreted a security standard, prepared a product or organization for assessment, resolved a significant compliance gap, or influenced an engineering team to adopt a more effective security practice.

Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) aims at "transforming the way Roche operates.'' As a global organization of over 3,500 colleagues, we enable Roche to operate in a competitive and ever-changing business environment. We provide our partners with end-to-end business services and solutions, enabling them to focus on patient-centric activities. Embracing an OneRoche mindset, we leverage our global network located in Budapest (Hungary), Riga (Latvia), Chennai & Hyderabad (India), San José (Costa Rica), Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia), and our other sites to remain customer-centric 24/7 and co-create solutions together.
The PD Regulatory Innovation and Sustainment Chapter is accountable for creating and maintaining a framework for building, maturing, and sustaining PDR business capabilities. This includes fostering innovation, ensuring operational readiness, and implementing continuous improvement across our regulatory processes, systems, and tools. Chapter members lead by designing and deploying innovative, compliant solutions that optimize regulatory workflows while maintaining the highest standards of integrity and data quality. We operate with enterprise thinking in a highly transformative regulated environment—assessing end-to-end processes, anticipating regulatory landscape changes, and unlocking company-wide benefits through strategic partnerships across PD, affiliates, Pharma, and the Roche group. Success in this chapter requires strategic thinking, systems thinking, data and content management expertise, an enterprise mindset, and the ability to drive continuous improvement and change leadership in a matrix environment.
Your Opportunity
As a Regulatory AI & Automation Specialist within PD Regulatory Innovation and Sustainment Chapter at RSS Hyderabad, you will drive the hands-on digital execution of regulatory operations. In this role, you will design, build, and deploy AI-driven tools, document intelligence engines, and automated workflows that accelerate regulatory document processing, submission dossier management, and compliance tracking across global health authorities
Key Responsibilities:
Collaborate with regulatory stakeholders to evaluate incoming AI/automation requests, assess technical feasibility, and help prioritize high-value use cases for regulatory document workflows.
Build and deploy scalable AI, machine learning, and automation solutions—integrating RPA, Low-Code/No-Code platforms, Python, NLP, and cloud-native services like AWS—specifically tailored to optimize global regulatory workflows and document management.
Perform operational process mining and opportunity mapping by partnering directly with SMEs from PDR Innovation & Sustainment chapter and global regulatory SMEs to identify high-impact AI and automation opportunities.
Support IT team by providing business directions for ongoing technical & preventive maintenance, performance monitoring, and troubleshooting for all deployed automation scripts, machine learning models, and AI assets operating in production.
Maintain comprehensive technical artifacts (including solution architecture, source code repositories, and testing frameworks) and conduct hands-on internal training to empower business teams and drive adoption across global regulatory functions.
Drive cross-functional Agile and DevOps execution in a matrixed environment, collaborating with PDR Innovation & Sustainment chapter leads, regulatory teams, IT, and RSS peers through sprint planning, rapid PoC prototyping, iterative testing, and continuous feedback loops.
Monitor operational performance metrics and deliver clear project updates, technical insights, and continuous improvement recommendations to functional leadership and regulatory stakeholders.
Partner with global regulatory teams to showcase the practical applications of AI, NLP, and automation, translating technical features into clear business benefits like compliance risk reduction, improved document processing throughput, and operational efficiency.
Who You Are
You are a hands-on technical builder with 4–6 years of experience in software engineering, data analytics, or AI/automation development and exposure of working in pharmaceutical R&D regulatory affairs or clinical development departments. You possess strong analytical problem-solving skills and thrive in an agile setting where you take ownership of technical execution, turning complex operational processes into automated, production-ready AI tools.
Qualifications & Technical Skillset:
Education & Experience: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology, Statistics, or a related quantitative field, with 4–6 years of hands-on experience building and deploying software, automation, or AI/ML solutions
Education & Experience: Direct experience in pharmaceutical R&D regulatory affairs or clinical development.
Advanced GenAI: Experience exposure to prompt evaluation frameworks, or multi-agent orchestration.
Core Programming & Data Engineering: Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL for data extraction, manipulation, pipeline creation, and writing modular, production-ready code.
Document AI & Text Processing: Practical experience with Natural Language Processing (NLP), Optical Character Recognition (OCR like Tesseract, AWS Textract, or Azure AI Document Intelligence), and unstructured document parsing (PDFs, XML, JSON, Word).
AI & LLM Integration: Hands-on experience developing application logic around modern LLM frameworks (e.g., Lang Chain, Llama Index, OpenAI/AWS Bedrock APIs) and building Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines for document querying.
Software Engineering & APIs: Solid experience with REST APIs, Git version control, unit testing, and basic CI/CD practices.
Workflow & Process Automation: Experience automating workflows using Python orchestration, low-code automation tools (e.g., Power Automate, UiPath), or enterprise schedulers.
Exposure to Deployment & Cloud: Basic exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) and containerization (Docker) for deploying scripts and API services.
Strong to have:
Prompt Architecture & Validation: Ability to design complex, multi-step prompts; validate outputs against business logic; and refine solutions iteratively.
Regulatory Domain Knowledge: Foundational knowledge of ICH guidelines FDA/EMA submission processes, regulatory document formats (eCTD, GxP guidelines, CT documentation), emerging AI/ML regulatory guidance.

The Director, Record to Report Controllership, will provide end-to-end leadership for the Record-to-Report accounting and controllership activities. This is a critical leadership role within the Accounting COE and will play a key part in building, transitioning, stabilizing, and scaling controllership activities including transition from other regions. The Director will partner closely with WBD Controllership, FP&A, Tax, Treasury, Global Business Services (GBS), and other global and regional stakeholders to deliver high-quality financial outcomes at scale.

This role will manage ~ 5 Senior Manager level accounting positions in Hyderabad and will oversee a broader team of ~50 accounting positions, supporting the controllership function. Your normal hours of work are 3:00 p.m IST. to 11:00 p.m IST. Monday to Friday. Your Role Accountabilities…
Controllership, Close and Reporting Leadership

• Ensure strong balance sheet governance, account reconciliation quality, variance analysis, management reporting, and timely issue resolution.
• Review and analyze financial results against expectations and provide meaningful insights to controllership and business stakeholders.

• Continuously identify, design, and implement process improvements and standardizations across areas of responsibility to enhance efficiency and effectiveness. This includes special projects and serving as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) as needed.
Governance, Controls and Audit Readiness
• Maintain a strong internal control environment and ensure compliance with SOX requirements.
• Partner with internal and external auditors to support audit planning, walkthroughs, testing, information requests, and timely closure of audit matters.
• Drive discipline around documentation, evidence retention, review controls, issue tracking, and remediation.
• Proactively identify financial reporting, compliance, and control risks and ensure appropriate escalation and resolution.

• Understand the business model and operating drivers to provide informed controllership advice and support decision-making.

• Identify opportunities to improve close efficiency, reporting quality, control effectiveness, and team productivity.
• Support system implementations, ERP-related changes, integrations, reorganizations, and other finance transformation initiatives.
• Lead process improvement initiatives in partnership with controllership, technology, GBS, and transformation teams.
People Leadership and Talent Development
• Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Senior Managers and accounting professionals.
• Set clear goals, performance expectations, priorities, and accountability standards.
• Build strong succession depth and develop controllership capability within the Hyderabad COE.
• Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, integrity, continuous improvement, and high-quality execution.
• Assess workload, resource requirements, and capacity needs, and recommend changes as required.
Qualifications & Experience…
Required

● High attention to detail, strong ownership mindset, and commitment to quality and compliance.
● Able to work effectively across various time zones.
Desired

• Experience with remote transition.

• Experience leading finance transformation, automation, process standardization, or system implementation initiatives.
• MBA or master’s degree in accounting, finance, or business preferred.
Leadership Attributes

Define and promote best practices for FreeWheel and Marketplace integrations, configurations, troubleshooting, and operational processes.
Work directly with FreeWheel and external vendors on technical investigations, product capabilities, new integrations, and resolution of complex issues.
Lead technical investigation and root-cause analysis of FreeWheel Marketplace issues, including integration failures, deal delivery issues, discrepancies, configuration problems, and ad-serving behaviour.

Own and support end-to-end FreeWheel Marketplace connectivity with SSPs, DSPs, DSP-side demand, exchanges, and other programmatic partners.
Act as the internal subject-matter expert for FreeWheel Ad Server and FreeWheel Marketplace, with a deep understanding of how the platforms support publisher monetization and programmatic workflows.

Ad Tech Integration & Connectivity
Own and support end-to-end integrations and connectivity between the ad server, DSPs, SSPs, exchanges, and other programmatic partners.
Manage and support API, oRTB, VAST, and other technical integrations, ensuring robust data and ad-request/response flows across platforms.
Lead technical assessment, testing, validation, and launch of new ad-tech integrations and partner connections.
Ensure integrations are configured correctly and aligned with business, technical, and operational requirements.
Technical Troubleshooting & Support
Act as the senior technical point of contact for complex ad-serving, programmatic, integration, and delivery issues.
Troubleshoot issues across the end-to-end ad-tech stack, identifying root causes and driving resolution with internal teams and external partners.
Support the wider Programmatic team with technical investigations, debugging, and resolution of platform or integration issues.
Use tools such as Charles Proxy, Wireshark, browser developer tools, logs, XML/VAST inspection, and platform diagnostics to investigate issues.
Analyze discrepancies, ad-request/response flows, delivery failures, VAST errors, oRTB issues, and other technical problems.
Stakeholder & Partner Management
Work closely with Ad Sales partners to understand requirements, resolve technical issues, and ensure programmatic solutions support commercial objectives.
Lead technical discussions with SSPs, DSPs, ad-tech vendors, and other external partners.
Act as a trusted technical advisor to internal stakeholders, translating complex technical issues into clear business implications and actions.
Partner with Product, Engineering, Trafficking, Operations, and other teams to resolve issues and deliver new capabilities.

Develop and maintain technical documentation, integration guides, troubleshooting playbooks, and operational standards.
Identify recurring issues and opportunities to improve reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency.
Share knowledge with the wider team and provide technical guidance and coaching on ad-tech integrations and troubleshooting.
Stay current with developments in programmatic advertising, ad-server capabilities, oRTB standards, and emerging ad-tech solutions.
Performance Monitoring & Continuous Improvement

You will play a key role in modernizing the user experience of a mature product ecosystem, bringing contemporary design thinking to our suite of enterprise solutions. This role is highly collaborative; you will act as an embedded partner to Product Managers, Engineers, and Researchers to translate ambiguous briefs into clear, defensible designs. Your work will have a direct impact on users at some of the largest organizations in the world, making high-stakes systems feel intuitive and impactful.

Education: Master’s degree in Computer Science Engineering, Human Factors Engineering, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Interaction Design (IxD), Industrial Design, Cognitive Science, Graphic Design or related field.

Simplify Complexity: Strong systems thinking and ability to design across complex, end-to-end experiences and translate advanced enterprise/technical workflows into accessible, intuitive solutions.
Collaborate Actively: Act as an embedded partner to Product Managers and Engineering; convert vague requirements into actionable, high-impact design strategies.
Design Systems: Identify gaps, build patterns, and enforce component standards to accelerate velocity across the product ecosystem.
Work AI-Native: Integrate AI tools (e.g., Figma AI, Claude, Cursor) into your daily process to accelerate validation and design cycles.
Champion Quality: Advocate for research-backed decisions, accessibility (WCAG), and data-informed iteration.

A culture of innovation with an AI-first approach to product development.

Broadcom's identity and access products help mitigate cyberattacks by enforcing granular security policies that stop unauthorized access to sensitive resources across the world's most complex infrastructures. As a Senior UX Designer on this team, you'll:
Design products at the heart of global enterprise operations, felt by users at some of the largest organizations in the world.

Lead first-silicon bring-up, characterization, debug, and validation of advanced 3D NAND products. Establish whether silicon meets design intent and datasheet requirements, correlate simulation with measurements, and resolve issues that could affect product qualification, reliability, yield, or SSD/system integration.
This role provides a unique opportunity to develop end-to-end expertise across advanced NAND products, spanning circuit design concepts, mixed-signal simulations, first-silicon bring-up, silicon debug, product qualification, and manufacturing readiness. Engineers gain broad exposure to analog, mixed-signal, digital, firmware, memory-array, and system-level behavior while working closely with design, verification, firmware, product, and system teams.
RESPONSIBILITIES
• Own validation strategies, coverage, and test plans for assigned NAND circuits and functions; define expected behavior, operating corners, and pass/fail criteria from product specifications and design intent. Be able to perform micro probing to validate and char internal signals at Wafer level and hands on experience with ATEs.
• Lead first-silicon bring-up, characterization, debug, and simulation-to-silicon correlation across voltage, temperature, process, timing, and workload conditions.
• Characterize and debug NAND subsystems including reference and bias generation circuits, bandgap references, oscillators, voltage regulators, charge pumps, sensing and page-buffer paths, high-voltage program/erase circuitry, memory-core drivers, control and timing logic, interface circuitry, trim and calibration functions, and firmware-controlled mixed-signal features.
• Investigate silicon failures with Design, Verification, Firmware, Test, Reliability, Product Engineering, and SSD/System teams. Form evidence-based hypotheses, design targeted experiments, identify root causes, and drive issues to verified closure through hardware, firmware, test-flow, trim, or workaround solutions.
• Convert silicon observations into engineering insight and product decisions by explaining deviations from expected behavior, assessing risk, recommending next actions, reviewing validation evidence, mentoring engineers, and improving reusable validation and debug methodologies.
Proven ability to leverage AI‑assisted (vibe) coding techniques to improve efficiency or automate design and analysis methodologies
Leverage AI tools to automate the tools and workflow Applying Artificial Intelligence in workflows to improve build efficiency
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
• BS, MS, or PhD in Electrical, Electronics Engineering, or a related field, with experience appropriate to the approved Senior Staff/Principal level.
• Strong analog and mixed-signal fundamentals with substantial experience in at least one of the following:
Mixed-signal verification
Analog/Mixed-Signal IC design
Post-silicon validation and characterization
Memory validation
• Experience with mixed-signal simulation environments, including full-chip, block-level, pre-layout, or post-layout simulations.
• Familiarity with Verilog/System-Verilog-based simulation and debug environments.
• Ability to derive tests from specifications, assess coverage, debug complex circuit behavior, and explain differences between expected and observed results.
• Experience with validation, characterization, data analysis, scripting, or automation using tools such as Python.
• Strong technical communication, problem-solving, and cross-functional leadership skills.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• NAND Flash, SSD, DRAM, or other memory technology experience, including program/read/erase operations, sensing architectures, bias generation, charge pumps, timing/control circuits, reliability characterization, or system-level integration.
• Experience with System-Verilog, Verilog-AMS, real-number modeling, SPICE, assertions, functional coverage, or simulation-to-silicon correlation methodologies.

EHR/EMR and clinical RWD: structured vs. unstructured content, clinical depth (stage, biomarkers, labs, performance status, laterality), health-system coverage bias, ambulatory vs. inpatient capture, and the NPI/provider-identifier limitations of EHR sources

Specialty pharmacy, hub, and distribution data; buy-and-bill dynamics
Lab, diagnostic, and biomarker/genomic testing data

Therapeutic Area Exposure: Demonstrated exposure to either of Oncology (solid tumor and/or heme; biomarker testing, staging, lines of therapy, pathways), Ophthalmology (Imaging and registry data such as IRIS/Verana), or CVRM (cardiovascular, metabolic and obesity, lab-value-driven segmentation such as HbA1c/LDL/eGFR, high-volume PCP targeting). jobs.title: Senior Business Operations Manager (Intuit India Strategy & Operations)
jobs.description:
Intuit is the global financial technology platform powering prosperity for over 100 million customers worldwide through products like TurboTax, Credit Karma, QuickBooks, and Mailchimp. We believe everyone deserves the opportunity to prosper, and we use breakthrough technology to solve our customers' most important financial problems.
As part of our mission-driven culture, the Intuit India site plays a vital role in our global strategy. Because every site is unique, we've built the Intuit India Strategy & Operations (IIOS), our dedicated Strategy and Operations team. IIOS drives the India site strategy, fosters leadership collaboration, and integrates our local initiatives into Intuit's global goals to create a world-class employee experience.
In this role, you will be a strategic partner to executive leaders, acting as the 'connective tissue' that turns site strategy into tangible outcomes. You will operate like an entrepreneur: owning a portfolio of programs end to end, building the data and tools that make them measurable, and bringing our communities together. The portfolio spans program management of Partner Engineering, data, dashboards and insights for the site, and communities and events across the India site.
Responsibilities
Program-manage Partner Engineering
Partner Engineering is how Intuit India works with its external engineering partners. Partner engineers from supplier firms sit inside our India engineering orgs, working alongside Intuit employees on product delivery. As these teams scale, the program makes sure partner engineers are an integrated, high-performing part of how India builds.
Own Partner Engineering end to end: define priorities, build the program framework and governance model, and lead workstreams to deliver clear outcomes.
Owning the shared data view of partner engineering, including AI adoption, spend, and delivery so leaders and suppliers work from the same facts.
Run the operating rhythm with engineering leaders and suppliers to monitor performance, inspire teams, and instill accountability.
Uncover risks and dependencies early, escalate blockers, and determine the optimal path to green.
Build Data, Dashboards, and Insights
Design and maintain dashboards and data models that track the health of site programs, partner engineering, communities, and events.
Run error-free analysis and turn it into clear, data-backed recommendations and narratives for India site leadership and global executives.
Build lightweight internal tools, automations, and apps (including with AI coding assistants) to remove manual effort and scale the team's impact.
Program Manager & Drive Communities and Events
Support and grow Intuit India's communities: tech communities, people communities, and employee resource groups (ERGs).
Plan and deliver medium and large site events, from concept and budget to execution and impact measurement.
Partner with Communications, Site Engagement, and Workplace teams to deliver a consistent employee experience.
Solve Strategic Problems and Lead Change
Frame strategic questions, run experiments or pilots, and identify solutions independently.
Ramp up quickly in new domains and apply learnings to shape organizational strategy, enhance our operating systems, and improve efficiency.
Establish credibility and trust across teams to lead change with velocity. Communicate a compelling, data-backed case for change and coach stakeholders to action.
Identify and drive continuous improvement, including by experimenting with AI, and share what works to raise quality and velocity across the team.
Qualifications
We are looking for a collaborative, data-driven operator who builds rapport and trust throughout the organization.
Professional experience: 5-8 years in high-impact roles such as strategy/business operations or program management in a tech company, or in an implementation-focused management consulting firm.
Connect strategy to execution: Ability to link business strategy, operating model, and performance drivers to project and program priorities, and to make data-informed recommendations on decisions and tradeoffs.
Execute with rigor: Track record of building high-quality plans with clear milestones and success measures that adapt to change, driving an operating rhythm, and communicating progress with clarity using data.
Solve business problems: Exceptional structured problem-solving and business acumen. Frames strategic questions, runs analysis end to end, and conveys recommendations in well-structured arguments.
Analytics and tools: Strong command of spreadsheets (Excel, Google Sheets) and a visualization tool such as Tableau or Power BI. Working knowledge of Python (Pandas, NumPy) or SQL for data manipulation and analysis.
Technical fluency and builder mindset: A software engineering or related technical background is strongly preferred. You have a fair understanding of technology and engineering teams, and you build apps, automations, or prototypes, including with AI coding assistants ('vibe coding').
Lead change: 'Extreme ownership' in driving change, with the ability to read stakeholder dynamics, influence at all levels, and build relationships with senior leaders in a global, matrixed organization.
Strategic communication: Proven ability to turn complex, ambiguous topics into compelling narratives and data stories for senior executives.
Community and event experience: Experience running programs, communities, or medium and large events, and the flexibility to move between deep analysis and hands-on execution.
Entrepreneurial mindset: Self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment, adapts easily to change, and works well both independently and as part of a team.
Education: A strong academic record is required. An MBA or equivalent degree from a nationally recognized institution is a plus.
Note: This is an Individual Contributor role.

jobs.description:
We are building a culture of innovators, risk-takers, and imaginative thinkers. To become AI-native, we look for 'builders' who use AI and emerging technologies to solve customer problems quickly and well.
Join the Data Reliability team as a Senior Staff Software Engineer. Our mission is to make Intuit's business-critical data trusted, observable, and AI-ready. We build the platforms that measure and enforce Data quality, Detect Data and Data Pipeline failures early, and turn them into actionable alerts & incidents. Our work includes:
Data Quality Monitoring : Profiling the Data and automate schema based Data Quality checks, execute and calculate Data Quality score, Maturity Score Calculation, and Data Parity validation between each hop of the data lifecycle for critical business use cases covering Lake Tables, Kafka Topics and Data Pipeline health.
Data Observability and Alert 2 Incident (A2I): a self-serve detect-and-act capability. Owners onboard Tier 1 assets through a UI or an agentic experience, choose pipeline and data quality signals and thresholds, tune them during an observation period, and get paged through automated incidents before downstream users feel the impact. 1500+ Data assets are managed and monitored under this capability.
Data Observability Dashboard the Intuit-wide command center that gives leaders a single view of Data health. It covers clean-data standards, availability, A2I incident effectiveness, cost and consumption, and the verified or potential business impact of unhealthy data.
As a Senior Staff Software Engineer, you will be a technical leader and domain expert across multiple teams, responsible for multiple capabilities of a composite platform. You will apply master-level software engineering to design, build, and run backend systems that process high-volume data and operational signals reliably. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports. You will typically drive work across multiple scrum teams (15 to 20+ engineers), influence technology and product direction, tactically strong to deal with conflicts and drive alignments to unblock technical direction of the platform capabilities and balance short-term delivery with long-term business impact.
Responsibilities
Technical Leadership and Execution
Spend 70–85% of your time hands-on across the full software lifecycle: design, build, test, deploy, and operate.
Architect and build scalable, secure, highly available backend services and APIs that power data quality evaluation, signal detection, incident creation, and impact analysis.
Drive the next phase of A2I: Lead the evolution of the Data Observability platform. This includes simplifying the overall Platform and coming up with end to end system for intelligently connecting the issues in one hop of the data lifecycle to consolidate the Incident creation and avoid noise across the entire data lifecycle causing churn for all data producers and consumers across the chain.
Data Observability Dashboard: Create a technical vision for the health observability essentials (logs, traces and metrics) and how to use those to create insightful actionable KPIs for Data Producers and consumers to increase the confidence on the Data Quality and Reliability.
Build reliable data and event pipelines (Spark, Databricks, Kafka) that feed health, availability, cost, and incident metrics into Data 360 and other leadership views.
Define the technical strategy, design specifications, and estimates for large, cross-capability initiatives, and manage conflicts and alignments to see them through to delivery.
Diagnose and resolve complex, cross-system production issues. Lead RCA and drive durable fixes that raise the platform's own reliability and cut noise and false positives.

Act as the domain authority on Data quality, Observability, and Incident management. Set standards for signal design, SLO and threshold models, alerting hygiene, and detection metrics such as MTTD, MTTR, and false-positive rate.
Design for the five pillars: Operational excellence, Security, Reliability, Performance efficiency, and Cost optimization.
Integrate with enterprise systems such as the data catalog and lineage, pipeline platforms, incident management, and paging tools.
Find opportunities to apply AI in the product, such as anomaly detection, smart threshold recommendation, automated triage, and RCA. Ship AI integrations to production and measure their impact.
Mentorship and Cross-Functional Collaboration
Raise the technical bar through design reviews, tech talks, and mentoring. Coach and assess engineers, and support calibrations and talent development.
Partner with product managers, TPMs, designers, data stewards, and platform teams across data, pipeline, and ITSM organizations to align roadmaps and unblock delivery.
Explain complex architectures and trade-offs clearly to engineers, business partners, and senior leaders, and drive decisions.
Work effectively with global teams across time zones
Define principles for the Capability offerings (Incident Management, Platform boundaries etc) to increase the efficiency of the platform operations
Qualifications
12+ Years of Software Engineering experience delivering enterprise class, high scale backend systems including significant experience in Multi Tenant Data Platforms and Observability.
Expert in Java and Spring/Spring Boot for building microservices and APIs.
Experience in Observability Stack Prometheus/Mimir, Splunk, ELK / Grafana
Experience with Big data and streaming technologies: Spark (batch and streaming), Databricks, and Kafka is a plus.
Deep experience and expertise with Data observability concepts: monitoring and alerting design, Golden signals, SLOs/SLAs and thresholds, anomaly detection, incident management, and paging workflows.
Strong knowledge of Data quality and Data reliability: DQ checks, data Parity, Data reconciliation at scale and Data lineage.
Expertise in Data Mesh concepts, Data warehousing and handling large data volumes.
Experience building and operating services in the cloud (AWS preferred) using containers and Kubernetes.
Solid foundation in algorithms, design patterns, and distributed systems design, including scalability, fault tolerance, and idempotency.
Experience with test automation (TDD, unit, integration, functional, and performance testing) and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience using or integrating AI/LLM technologies, including AI-assisted development tools, and evaluating their performance in production.
Proven ability to lead complex, multi-team technical initiatives and influence without authority.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence engineers, product partners, and executives.
Strategic mindset. Uses data to shape technology and product decisions. Comfortable entering new areas, understanding them quickly, and driving immediate impact.
