jobs.description:
Meet the Moment with Alteryx
We're living through a once-in-a-generation shift in how work gets done. Data, automation, and AI are quickly becoming the center of every business decision - and Alteryx is leading the transformation.
You'll be working on the challenges that sit at the heart of modern business. No matter your role, the work you do will help organizations move faster, see more clearly, and tackle questions that used to feel impossible.
If you're ready to meet the moment with innovation, curiosity, and excellence, there's a place for you here.
Are you someone who enjoys solving problems, building relationships, and helping customers get the most out of technology? Join Alteryx as a Customer Success Manager and help customers turn data into meaningful business results. You’ll work closely with customers to understand their needs, guide them in using our analytics solutions, and help them achieve their goals. If you have strong communication skills, a curious mindset, and experience in customer support, technical support, sales, or a similar customer-facing role, this could be a great opportunity to grow your career in data and technology. If you don’t meet all the criteria but think you could excel in this role, please put an application in, above all else we are looking for ambitious, intelligent people with a curious mindset who are eager to learn.
Responsibilities:
Help People Solve Problems – Establish a trusted advisor relationship with our users and help them use Alteryx one to solve some of the biggest problems business and IT professionals are facing in the age of Data & AI.
Become An Alteryx Expert – Immerse yourself in the solutions Alteryx offers and become a guru on how to apply these solutions in the field
Driving Advocacy - Build deep relationships with our customers with the goal of turning each of them into a champion
Building Solutions That Work – Conduct technical working sessions to jointly architect solutions leveraging the Alteryx Designer with prospective and existing users within your accounts
Supporting Account Activity– Familiarise yourself with all the metrics we use and partner with the account team to provide those insights and recommendations – focusing on adoption, retention and new business.
Run a Book of Business – Work closely with in-market CSMs to jointly execute on a portfolio of diverse accounts
Enabling and Training Users – Conduct enablement sessions to a range of users, from people using it for the first time to established Alteryx professionals. You will provide hands-on training of the entire Alteryx product suite and turn that into outcomes for the customer and Alteryx.
Qualifications:
Experience in a customer-facing role, such as customer support, technical support, customer success, sales, or implementation.
Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to lead engaging conversations and understand customer needs.

jobs.title: Sr. FinOps Cloud Engineer
jobs.description:
Meet the Moment with Alteryx
We're living through a once-in-a-generation shift in how work gets done. Data, automation, and AI are quickly becoming the center of every business decision - and Alteryx is leading the transformation.
You'll be working on the challenges that sit at the heart of modern business. No matter your role, the work you do will help organizations move faster, see more clearly, and tackle questions that used to feel impossible.
If you're ready to meet the moment with innovation, curiosity, and excellence, there's a place for you here.
We are looking for problem solvers, innovators, and analytical thinkers who challenge the status quo. If you are an experienced technologist passionate about the intersection of cloud architecture, big data, machine learning workloads, and financial accountability, this role is for you.
As a Senior FinOps Engineer, you will serve as the technical backbone and subject matter expert for cloud financial operations across our global engineering organization. This role bridges deep cloud infrastructure mechanics with data engineering, algorithm design, and business economics. You will architect automated reporting pipelines, develop unit-cost metrics, govern procurement and operational policies, introduce FinOps practices for AI workloads, and partner closely with engineering squads, platform teams, and finance leaders to foster a culture of cost-aware engineering.
Key Responsibilities
1. Cloud Cost Visibility, Data Analytics & Anomaly Detection
Manage, curate, and normalize end-to-end cloud cost and usage datasets, ensuring high data fidelity, consistency, and standardized governance across multi-cloud environments.
Define, build, and maintain automated cost, usage, and efficiency dashboards using Apache Superset, supported by SQL and data extraction pipelines.
Design and deploy automated anomaly detection algorithms, statistical models, and alerting mechanisms to detect spending spikes, runaway workloads, and unexpected cost regressions in near real time.
Benchmark, track, and report on cloud consumption, forecast variance, unit economics, and realized savings to engineering teams and leadership.
Implement and refine tagging governance, business cost-allocation models, and unit economics metrics, such as cost per customer, cost per query, or cost per pipeline run.
2. Architecture, Automation & Spend Optimization
Own and optimize cloud financial management platforms for reporting, cost optimization, and performance measurement. Our environment includes Cloudability, PointFive, ProsperOps, and Larridin; experience with comparable platforms is welcome.
Design, build, and maintain automation workflows and scripts to identify and reclaim idle, underutilized, or orphaned resources, including compute instances, unattached volumes/IPs, outdated snapshots, and development/test environments.
Lead enterprise-wide commitment strategies across AWS, Azure, and GCP, managing portfolio coverage, risk, and utilization for Reserved Instances, Savings Plans, and applicable provider-specific commitments.
Partner with software, platform, and SRE teams to analyze utilization telemetry, implement rightsizing recommendations, and optimize compute and storage resources.
3. FinOps for AI & Emerging Technologies
Introduce and establish FinOps frameworks tailored to AI, ML training pipelines, and LLM inference workloads.
Establish Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) and Return on Investment (ROI) models for AI infrastructure, including GPU clusters, vector databases, model hosting endpoints, and third-party AI APIs.
Collaborate with AI/ML engineering teams to evaluate model inference performance against operational costs, improving token efficiency and hardware utilization.
4. Governance, Procurement & Cross-Functional Alignment
Establish and enforce cloud cost and operational policies across accounts, subscriptions, regions, and resource configurations.
Participate in architectural design and cloud capacity planning for new projects, services, and major infrastructure changes.
Oversee third-party cloud marketplace software procurement, ensuring spending aligns with enterprise budgets and cloud discount commitments.
Review production release schedules from a cost-impact perspective, incorporating pre-production load-testing analysis and cost guardrails.
Partner with Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) and engineering leaders to track monthly variance, improve forecasting models, and translate technical decisions into business impact.
Collaborate with engineering, platform, and finance teams across India and the United States. Lead knowledge-sharing sessions, develop technical documentation, and promote FinOps best practices across engineering teams.
Qualifications:
Required Experience:
5+ years of hands-on experience in cloud engineering, DevOps, SRE, or cloud financial management, with strong expertise in AWS and/or Google Cloud and familiarity with Azure.
Proven experience applying FinOps principles (Inform, Optimize, Operate) in a modern cloud-native enterprise environment.
Advanced SQL skills and experience building automated data workflows, metrics engines, and dashboards using BI tools such as Apache Superset.
Experience creating or configuring automated alerting rules, statistical anomaly detection, or threshold-based algorithms for infrastructure telemetry.
Direct experience managing cloud commitment portfolios, including Savings Plans and Reserved Instances, and optimizing effective savings rates.
Strong scripting or coding skills in Python, Bash, or Go to build automated resource reclamation, API integrations, and policy enforcement tools.
Strong communication skills and demonstrated ability to contribute to architectural planning, implement governance policies, and explain trade-offs between cost, performance, reliability, and delivery speed.
Preferred Qualifications:
FinOps Certified Practitioner or FinOps Certified Professional certification.
Cloud Architect or SysOps certifications (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Experience implementing FinOps practices for AI/ML workloads and GPU compute environments, including TCO/ROI analysis for LLMs and distributed training.
Experience with cloud marketplace procurement workflows and private offer agreements.
Experience with container cost allocation across Kubernetes, EKS, GKE, or AKS using tools such as Kubecost or OpenCost.
Working knowledge of the FinOps Open Cost and Usage Specification (FOCUS), including its schema and taxonomy standards.
What Success Looks Like
Within 3 Months
Complete an assessment of existing multi-cloud accounts, commitment coverage portfolios, and FinOps tooling.
Establish baseline dashboards for core services, identify idle-resource optimization opportunities, and improve commitment coverage.
Participate in cloud architectural reviews and establish partnerships with AI/ML and platform engineering teams.
Within 6–12 Months
Deploy automated anomaly detection and idle-resource cleanup solutions into production workflows.
Establish FinOps practices for AI workloads, providing TCO and ROI visibility into AI infrastructure and model inference.
Formalize cloud marketplace procurement governance and cost reviews within operational release processes.
Standardize multi-cloud cost allocation models and deliver trusted unit-cost KPIs across product lines.
Long Term
Build a proactive engineering culture where financial efficiency is incorporated into architecture and infrastructure decisions.
Maintain scalable, automated cloud cost management and optimization capabilities that evolve with business and technology needs.
Why This Role Matters
As Alteryx continues to scale its platform and invest in AI capabilities, managing cloud infrastructure efficiently is essential to sustainable growth.
In this role, you will go beyond monitoring cloud costs to build automation, improve financial visibility, influence architectural decisions, and establish meaningful metrics that connect engineering investments with business value.
Your work will directly contribute to making our cloud infrastructure more efficient, scalable, and financially sustainable.

Support day-to-day administration for assigned benefits programs, including eligibility, enrollment, benefits onboarding, billing, reporting, audits, quality assurance, documentation, and issue resolution, with a particular focus on India.

Maintain accurate documentation, process guides, trackers, and communications; support the transition of administrative processes and recommend ways to simplify, standardize, or automate them, including responsible use of artificial intelligence tools. Experience using a human resources information system (HRIS), benefits administration platform, or similar operational tools, with attention to detail in data entry, testing, reconciliation, and quality assurance. Workday experience is preferred.

Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain benefits topics in accessible language and collaborate across functions.
Ability to manage assigned work, meet deadlines, communicate when blocked, and distinguish urgent work from work that can be sequenced.
A collaborative, learning-oriented approach, willingness to apply feedback, and curiosity about using artificial intelligence tools responsibly to improve benefits work and team processes.

Who We Are and Where We're Going
Assurance at Salesforce is being rebuilt as an engineering discipline.
Legacy GRC runs on spreadsheets, screenshots, and an annual scramble to prove that controls worked months ago. We're replacing that model with one that is continuous, automated, and built into how Salesforce ships. Controls are code. Evidence comes from pipelines, not people chasing tickets. We work to improve the state of controls, drive decisions with risk, govern with code, and make compliance a streamlined business process.
Our strategy:
Risk-informed, control managed. We monitor, validate, and improve the security controls that stand against threats and failures. This proves trust while delivering risk operations, compliance artifacts, and outputs, and it opens access to new markets through the product we build and the behavior we change.
Visibility and invention. We give Salesforce a clear, current view of its security posture. We equip the Assurance team with a new way of protecting Salesforce, through the invention we create together. We also invest in the people who work here, with room to grow, take on new challenges, and drive excellence.
Always in front. We turn gaps into signals, alerts, and escalations. When a control fails, it flows into a workflow built to help stakeholders meet their trust obligations. Nothing waits for the next audit to surface.
We're hiring people who want to build this future. You'll have real ownership, a real roadmap, and the chance to define what modern assurance looks like for the industry.
What you’ll do …
Risk Operations provides a centralized approach to identifying, prioritizing, and managing cybersecurity risks, driving accountability, faster decision-making, and measurable risk reduction. The team partners across security, engineering, and business functions to streamline risk management processes, improve visibility into risk exposure, and ensure timely escalation and resolution.
We're looking for an Information Security Associate who is excited to help build and support a growing Risk Operations function. In this role, you'll be at the center of day-to-day security issue and exception management activities, helping ensure risk cases are accurately documented, efficiently processed, and consistently tracked through resolution. You'll work closely with experienced risk and security professionals while contributing to the development of workflows, processes, and reporting that will help shape how Risk Operations operates at scale.
This is a great opportunity for an early-career security professional who enjoys solving problems, bringing organization to complex processes, and making a meaningful impact in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
Rapid Decision Management: We work in a business. Predictability and rapid decisions are the core outcomes you’ll bring to the job. Support rapid risk decision-making by coordinating timely reviews, approvals, and escalations, ensuring decision-makers have the information needed to assess risks and take action.
Support day-to-day security risk operations by managing the intake, triage, and tracking of security issues and exceptions to accelerate risk-based decisions and timely resolution.
Coordinate issue and exception management activities, including reviewing submissions for completeness, following up with stakeholders, tracking remediation commitments, monitoring exception expiration dates, and supporting timely case resolution.
Maintain accurate and complete risk records in case management platforms, ensuring consistent documentation, appropriate case status, and reliable data for operational reporting.
Partner with security, engineering, and compliance teams to gather information, clarify case requirements, resolve operational blockers, and accelerate risk-based decision-making by ensuring stakeholders have the information, context, and visibility needed to take timely action.
Support timely risk decisions and escalations by monitoring case progress, identifying stalled requests or decision gaps, and coordinating follow-ups to ensure issues and exceptions move efficiently through established governance and approval workflows.
Assist with operational reporting and metrics, including tracking case volumes, aging, remediation progress, exception renewals, and other key performance indicators to provide visibility into risk operations activities.
Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and automate repetitive tasks, helping streamline case handling, improve data quality, and enhance the overall stakeholder experience.
Contribute to broader Risk Operations initiatives by supporting ad hoc requests, process improvements, and emerging operational needs as the team establishes and matures its capabilities.
What you bring ...
You have +2 years of experience in information security or security operations, or a related field.
You have a foundational understanding of information security concepts, including security findings, risk remediation, policy exceptions, and risk acceptance.
You have sufficient technical ability to serve as one of many eyes as we assess the certainty of our compensating controls and exposures.
You are highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple cases, deadlines, and follow-up activities while maintaining accurate records.
You bring strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to review information for completeness, identify inconsistencies, and recognize when issues require additional attention or escalation.
You have strong written and verbal communication skills and enjoy collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders to gather information, clarify requirements, and drive timely follow-through.
You are comfortable learning new tools, navigating workflow or ticketing systems, and working with spreadsheets and data to support operational activities.
You are adaptable, proactive, and comfortable working in an evolving environment where processes and responsibilities are still being established.
You have a continuous improvement mindset and are eager to learn, contribute ideas, and help build scalable and efficient security risk management practices.
How We Work
Engineering-first culture. We use version control, code review, CI/CD, and backlogs. Assurance work ships like software.
Automate first. If it's done manually twice, it's a candidate for a build.
Signals, not surprises. Gaps become alerts and workflows, and control failures resolve through defined escalation paths.
Embedded partners. We work alongside T&P teams and solve problems with them, not at them.
Outcomes over activity. We measure risk reduced, effort saved, and audit friction removed.
Room to grow. Learn the engineering side if you come from GRC, or the risk side if you come from engineering. We support both paths.

Direct experience using and critically reviewing code and artifacts generated by large language model (LLM) coding assistants and agentic tools. Must be able to effectively guide AI tools to achieve desired outcomes.

jobs.description:
The Company
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.
Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.
Job Summary:
Meet our team
The Payments Risk Engineering team is responsible for fraud detection and risk management at PayPal. We design, build, and support the services that are called on every money movement transaction between PayPal and its users and partners. Our solutions scale across millions of interactions, integrate with other APIs in real time, and deliver high availability and configurability to the business. We stay current with advances in technology and science and tie them back to business needs.
What you need to know about the role-
We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to strengthen the risk prevention and mitigation systems that protect PayPal and its customers from fraud. Our team owns fraud detection, and risk management services across PayPal globally. These services are called on every interaction between users, partners, and PayPal. We also apply advances in AI, machine learning, and data science to real business problems.
Job Description:
Essential Responsibilities:
Delivers complete solutions spanning all phases of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) (design, implementation, testing, delivery and operations), based on definitions from more senior roles.
Advises immediate management on project-level issues
Guides junior engineers
Operates with little day-to-day supervision, making technical decisions based on knowledge of internal conventions and industry best practices
Applies knowledge of technical best practices in making decisions
Minimum Qualifications:
3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.
Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:
Your way to impact
• Protect customers and PayPal by building real-time risk systems that scale across millions of transactions.
• Keep payments seamless for good users while stopping fraud, with services that are highly available, reliable, and configurable.
• Shape the technical direction of the team by challenging the status quo, bringing fresh ideas, and championing clean, scalable engineering practices.
• Reduce technical debt and raise the quality bar for software and the team.
Your day to day
• Design, develop, and test features and services for our risk applications.
• Work with product managers in an agile setting to deliver high-quality solutions on time.
• Partner with developers, product, design, and analytics teams to explore new ideas and opportunities.
• Work with operations teams to keep services highly available and reliable.
• Take part in code reviews to maintain code quality.
• Contribute to our automated test suite to enable fast, reliable continuous integration.
• Communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders.
• Be proactive: anticipate issues and handle them before they escalate.
What do you need to bring-
• Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related technical discipline with 4-6 years of experience.
• Strong applied experience: you’ve built, broken, and rebuilt software, and you know how to ship real-world products.
• Proficiency in back-end development with Java EE technologies (Java, application servers, servlet containers, JMS, JPA).
• Strong object-oriented programming skills and the ability to turn requirements into scalable designs.
• Experience designing and building REST APIs and web services or microservices in a commercial setting.
• Experience with design patterns, MVC, and frameworks such as Spring.

jobs.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.
About the Role:
Directly sells enterprise security software solutions across the breadth of the company’s products and drives incremental revenue with new customers, primarily through flexible and scalable licensing models. This field sales role has primary accountability for the planning, prospecting, qualification, and closing of revenue on new business accounts. Additionally, this role develops the post close relationship within newly won accounts during the first twelve months by partnering with internal stakeholders who are accountable for onboarding, accelerated adoption, expansion, and drawdown of flexible licensing models. Incumbents effectively collaborate with other teams, including Account Managers, Customer Success, Sales Engineering, Professional Services, Marketing, Channel / Alliances sales teams, Finance and Customer Support, as well as external parties such as Alliance and Channel Partners.
This role is open to candidates based in Delhi NCR.
What You’ll Do:
Prospects, identifies, qualifies, and closes new customer revenue within assigned accounts by building relationships with key decision makers, typically using flexible and scalable licensing models (e.g. Falcon Flex).
Develops and executes a comprehensive business plan for each account, including identifying core customer requirements and mapping the benefits of CrowdStrike’s solutions to customer business requirements.
Coordinates with internal stakeholders during customer onboarding, accelerated adoption of products, expansion, and eventual transition of accounts after the first twelve months to expansion/renewal focused Account Managers.
Timely documentation within CRM / Marketing software of customer contact and activity data is required of the role (e.g. names, titles, contact information, opportunity value, product information, sales stages, probability, business pain, firm-future commitments, etc.).
Accountable for accurate forecasting, regular quarterly revenue delivery, and the implementation of agreed account and business plans.
Promotes CrowdStrike’s products, maximizes brand recognition and mindshare at all levels, and publicizes success stories.
Provides customer feedback to internal stakeholders for product, systems, and process improvements.
Work is primarily performed in the field away from home office or company office location in order to accomplish the duties of the position.
At this level, incumbents will have expert-level knowledge of selling the company’s products and services.
Assigned accounts are larger and of the most complex nature, where assigned quota is typically higher than lesser-scoped portfolio sales role levels. (Size of quota may be relative to complexity and nature of account set.)
Incumbents routinely sell-to and interact with executive-level customer decision makers, to include up to CXO levels and are typically assigned to Enterprise accounts segmentation or commensurately complex accounts.
What You’ll Need:
Holds expert-level experience and uses professional concepts and company objectives to resolve complex issues in creative and effective ways.
Deep industry knowledge and understanding of a customer’s decision-making process, goals, strategies, and business objectives.
Expert-level presentation, customer service, financial/business acumen, and negotiation skills at all levels of customer engagement.
Complete, “big-picture” understanding of the business and technical contexts of key account opportunities.
Driven, self-starter who exudes leadership on account set and compels others to get on board.
Fully adept at consultative effectiveness and establishing trust with internal and external customers.
Fully functional knowledge of sales methodologies, techniques, and the sales lifecycle of security software solutions, software business value concepts, and the company's products.
BA/BS or equivalent educational background is preferred.
Minimum 12+ years of relevant professional experience.
Bonus Points:
Experience working for a SaaS security company

jobs.title: Sr. Associate Purchasing Analyst
jobs.description:
Your work days are brighter here.
We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.
About the Team
At Workday, we help the world’s largest organizations adapt to what’s next by bringing finance, HR, and planning into a single enterprise cloud. We work hard, and we’re serious about what we do. But we like to have fun too! We put people first, celebrate diversity, drive innovation, and do good in the communities where we live and work.
The Procurement Operations team manages supplier onboarding and supplier data maintenance, contract routing and administration, purchase requisitions (REQs), purchase orders (POs), purchasing documents, invoice reconciliation, program management, and quarterly audits. The team also helps drive projects related to automation and efficiencies and partners with Workday on Workday (WoW) and Product teams to enhance, test, and adopt Workday functionality on an ongoing basis.
You will be part of the Purchasing / Procurement Operations team, reporting to the Associate Manager, Procurement Operations, and working closely with Finance, Accounts Payable, suppliers, and business stakeholders across Workday.
About the Role
As a Sr. Associate Purchasing Analyst, you will support day-to-day operations within the Source-to-Pay (S2P) workstream, with a primary focus on supplier onboarding, supplier data management, and contract routing. You will work closely with senior analysts, your manager, and cross-functional stakeholders to onboard suppliers, maintain and update supplier records, coordinate contract reviews and approval workflows, track signatures, and monitor renewal dates.
You will leverage your working knowledge of Source-to-Pay processes and familiarity with procurement and financial systems to deliver accurate, timely, and customer-focused support. You will follow established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), maintain strong attention to detail, and contribute to process improvements.
A successful candidate will demonstrate accountability, a willingness to learn, openness to feedback, and flexibility as the role evolves.
Responsibilities
Support supplier onboarding, maintenance, and data updates in alignment with Procurement Operations policies and controls.
Support contract routing by coordinating stakeholder reviews, tracking approvals and signatures, monitoring renewal dates, and maintaining accurate contract records and documentation.
Apply working knowledge of the end-to-end Source-to-Pay process and follow established SOPs to maintain quality, consistency, and compliance with applicable policies and SOX controls, escalating exceptions as needed.
Build collaborative relationships with internal stakeholders and suppliers, respond to routine queries, and support the preparation of training materials on procurement processes and tools as your expertise grows.
Use Workday Procurement and Financial systems and reports to monitor work queues, track turnaround times, and highlight recurring issues or potential enhancements.
Contribute to process-improvement efforts and recurring daily, monthly, and quarterly activities in support of team goals and Workday’s Core Values.
As a secondary responsibility, review purchase requisitions for accuracy, completeness, and appropriate coding; coordinate approvals and support purchase order processing under guidance from senior team members.
As part of this purchasing support, partner with Accounts Payable and senior analysts to help resolve straightforward invoice and receiving discrepancies, escalating complex issues as needed.
About You
Basic Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Supply Chain, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
3+ years of experience as a Procurement Buyer, Purchasing Analyst, Supplier Master Data Analyst, or in Procurement Operations, including hands-on experience onboarding suppliers and maintaining supplier master data in enterprise systems.
Other Qualifications
Working knowledge of supplier onboarding, supplier master data management, and Source-to-Pay processes, plus familiarity with procurement, financial, and contract management systems. Workday experience is a plus.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills with a customer-service mindset, and the ability to collaborate across global teams in a fast-paced environment.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple tasks accurately.
Solid analytical and problem-solving skills, with accountability for completing assigned work.
Willingness to learn new systems and contribute to process improvements. Proficiency with Microsoft Office (especially Excel) and comfort with data and reports are expected. Experience with contract approval workflows, e-signatures, purchase requisitions, or purchase orders is a plus.
Our Approach to Flexible Work
With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in-office each week, we simply spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.

jobs.title: Principal SSD Applications Engineer
jobs.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
The Principal SSD Applications Engineer is Micron's customer-facing SSD technical leader, driving complex issue resolution, technical enablement, and the successful qualification, deployment, production ramp, sustaining support, and adoption of SSD products and solutions.
Responsibilities
Lead complex customer issue investigations, including issue replication, Level 1 debugging, root cause analysis, and failure analysis, and manage issues from escalation through resolution using Jira or an equivalent issue-tracking system.
Drive customer issue prioritization, turnaround-time tracking, technical reviews, and escalation management while coordinating engineering, validation, quality, product management, field organizations, and ecosystem partners.
Support customer qualification, platform integration, deployment, production ramp, sustaining activities, Level 1 performance testing, workload characterization, performance analysis, interoperability testing, validation, and technical troubleshooting for assigned SSD products and solutions.
Communicate product capabilities, limitations, technical requirements, qualification criteria, deployment considerations, and technical findings through clear, accurate, actionable, and customer-appropriate communications.
Own firmware release management, including release planning, deployment readiness, firmware change-list development, release documentation, approval coordination, customer communications, and technical input for customer-specific firmware requirements.
Develop and maintain customer-facing technical documentation, including standard and custom datasheets, application notes, errata, firmware release communications, troubleshooting guides, and related technical collateral, and review Product Change Requests (PCRs) for impacts on documentation and customer deliverables.
Deliver technical training, mentoring, and knowledge-sharing for Field Application Engineers (FAEs), Customer Quality Engineers (CQEs), Technical Customer Managers (TCMs), and support organizations, and align technical execution with qualification schedules, customer priorities, identified risks, and business commitments.
Provide technical ownership and support for SSD management and diagnostic tools, including MSECLI, SuperDM, and Storage Executive, and coordinate tool-related issue resolution and enablement needs.
Drive Design-for-Debug initiatives, incorporate customer and field feedback into Market Requirements Documents (MRDs), product readiness activities, and roadmap planning, and analyze recurring issues to improve product quality, reliability, usability, support readiness, and customer experience.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline, with 13 or more years of relevant experience in SSD technologies, storage systems, firmware engineering, hardware engineering, applications engineering, product engineering, validation engineering, technical support, or a related technical field.
Deep expertise in SSD architecture, NAND Flash technologies, storage controllers, firmware interactions, enterprise or data center storage systems, and storage technologies and protocols, including NVMe, PCIe, SATA, and SAS.
Proven experience leading customer escalations, issue replication, debugging, root cause analysis, failure analysis, and complex technical problem resolution.
Experience supporting product qualification, deployment, production ramp, sustaining activities, and post-deployment customer support, including firmware release management, technical documentation, and customer or field enablement.
Experience coordinating cross-functional technical investigations and managing issues through resolution using Jira or an equivalent issue-tracking system.
Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical findings into clear, accurate, actionable, and audience-appropriate communications.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, prioritization, and data-driven decision-making skills, with excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, collaboration, and stakeholder management capabilities.
Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership, influence decisions, and lead strategic initiatives across global and matrixed organizations. Equivalent combinations of education, training, certifications, and experience may be considered in accordance with company policy and applicable requirements.
Preferred Qualifications
Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.

jobs.title: Engagement Lead - Data Science
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
The Position
Engagement Lead - Data Scientist
Roche India – Roche Services & Solutions
Hyderabad
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
That’s what makes us Roche.
Roche has established the Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) as part of Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) India to drive analytics and technology-driven solutions by partnering with Roche affiliates across the globe. RSS is a global division operating in an agile organizational setup without extensive hierarchical structure, where all our employees lead from every seat, and inspirational leadership, and an entrepreneurial customer-centric mindset are our core values.
Your Opportunity
As Engagement Lead, you will lead two data science sub-streams supporting commercial teams: Predictive AI & Optimization and Causal AI & Experimentation. You will own the technical direction and delivery of both. You will work directly with product owners to turn business questions into predictive, causal and optimization solutions, and you will grow a team of about 7 data scientists.
This is a hands-on leadership role. You will review models and code, unblock the team quickly, and be accountable for the quality and business impact of everything the two sub-streams deliver.
Key Responsibilities:
Lead, mentor and develop Senior Data Scientists and Data Scientists across both sub-streams. Build technical depth, modular coding standards and agile delivery habits
Lead the design, calibration and validation of Bayesian and frequentist Marketing Mix Models (MMM). Models should account for adstock, saturation, seasonality and hierarchical or geo-level effects
Oversee multi-touch attribution (MTA) and brand performance analytics. Translate the results into practical recommendations on channel mix and spend
Design and govern experiments, including A/B tests, quasi-experimental designs (e.g., difference-in-differences, synthetic control) and econometric analysis, to measure the true impact of commercial initiatives
Oversee the design and delivery of predictive models for commercial use cases. This includes classification on highly imbalanced data, anomaly detection, segmentation and time-series forecasting
Turn predictions into decisions through optimization: budget and resource allocation, response curves, ROI/mROI analysis and scenario-planning simulations
Rapid Prototyping & Business Value: Quickly design and build proofs of concept, prototypes and business case studies, including GenAI- and agent-based solutions where they add value, to show tangible impact
Set the methodological standards for each sub-stream. Decide which approaches are suitable for a given problem, and explain why others are not
Stay close to the work: review model designs, validation results and critical code, and resolve technical blockers quickly
Present findings and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, so that complex model results lead to confident decisions
Work with global cross-functional teams in an agile environment, including demos, reviews and retrospectives to keep improving deliverables
Ensure reproducibility, documentation and peer review across all models delivered
Who You Are
You are an accomplished data science leader with deep expertise in both predictive modelling and causal inference. You know when a problem needs a prediction, when it needs a causal estimate, and when it needs an optimization layer on top. You lead by example, stay close to the code, and can explain complex model outputs, from an MMM posterior to a SHAP plot, in clear business terms that product owners can act on.
Education & Certification:
Educational Background: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, Computer Science, Business Analytics or another quantitative field.
Certifications: Recognized professional certifications in Data Science, Machine Learning, Cloud AI Platforms or Advanced Analytics are an advantage.
Qualifications & Technical Skillset:
10+ years of experience in Data Science/Analytics, including at least 3 years leading data science teams and mentoring data scientists. You should have a proven track record of measurable business impact through predictive modelling and causal inference or experimentation, ideally in commercial or marketing analytics.
Strong hands-on expertise in predictive modelling, including classification on skewed data with imbalance handling (e.g., SMOTE, class weighting), ensemble and tree-based models (LightGBM, XGBoost, CatBoost), linear models, anomaly detection, unsupervised methods (clustering, segmentation) and time-series forecasting (e.g., ARIMA, Prophet).
Rigorous model validation and explainability, including SHAP and precision-recall and calibration methods for imbalanced problems.
Deep expertise in causal inference and experimentation, including experimental design, A/B testing, quasi-experimental methods and econometrics.
Hands-on experience building Marketing Mix Models and multi-touch attribution models (regression-based, time-decay, Markov-chain and Shapley-value methods), using frameworks such as Google Meridian, PyMC-Marketing, Meta Robyn, LightweightMMM, Orbit, PyMC or Stan. This includes model diagnostics (convergence, priors, posterior predictive checks) and turning outputs into budget optimization, response curves and scenario simulations.
Expert proficiency in Python and SQL, with strong experience in Spark (distributed computing), Airflow, Git, AWS, and Tableau or an equivalent tool for visualization and storytelling.
Exposure to and recent experience with GenAI tools and LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek) and coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot, plus experience of building AI agents using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen or CrewAI.
Note: This job description is intended as a general guideline for the responsibilities and qualifications required for this position. It is not an exhaustive list, and responsibilities may evolve and change based on business needs.

jobs.description:
Job Title:
Sr Staff Engineer - Subsystem Interoperability & AI-Driven Verification
Location- Bangalore
We Are
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
You Are
You are a verification engineer who thinks in systems, across IP blocks. You understand where interoperability problems show up: architectural boundaries, configurations, initialization sequences, protocol interactions, firmware dependencies, clock and reset domains, implementation constraints, and assumptions made between independently developed IP. Deep hands-on verification skill sits alongside the judgment to shape methodology and influence interface and testbench decisions with partner teams. You are equally comfortable building a subsystem verification environment, reviewing SystemVerilog/UVM code, analyzing coverage, debugging a difficult Controller-PHY interaction in Verdi, writing Python automation, and explaining the technical tradeoff to architects and partner teams. You turn interoperability failures into subsystem fixes that prevent the same class of issue in later configurations. The hardest cross-IP investigations are the work you want, because a clear root cause becomes a test, a check, or a design change that protects customers. At Synopsys, you will verify subsystem interoperability across high-speed interface IPs, and you will apply GenAI, LLMs, and agentic workflows so qualification is continuous and backed by evidence.
What You'll Be Doing
Drive subsystem interoperability verification across Controller, PHY, firmware, VIP, verification environments, and customer configurations for one or more high-speed interface IP families
Design and build the verification content and flows for a scalable Interop Verification Platform: continuous integration, verification, and qualification across IP releases, covering the configuration space of Controller × PHY × Firmware × VIP × Protocol Mode × Customer Configuration, and using risk and coverage to decide what must be qualified
Develop reusable verification architectures, methodologies, and reference environments for functional verification, protocol compliance, error and stress scenarios, coverage, assertions, CDC/RDC, and system initialization
Own the hardest cross-IP investigations and drive fixes across RTL, PHY, firmware, VIP, testbench, and implementation boundaries when interoperability issues appear
Work with Controller and PHY architects and R&D teams early in the lifecycle on interfaces, observability, design-for-verification, and subsystem behavior
Apply GenAI, LLMs, RAG, and agentic workflows to the verification work this team owns, from specification and verification intent through environment, tests, regression, debug, qualification, and what the team learns from each failure
Build AI-assisted flows for environment and test generation, regression selection, log and failure clustering, coverage-gap analysis, protocol and waveform debug, root-cause recommendations, engineering knowledge retrieval, and qualification evidence
The Impact You Will Have
Make interoperability a continuous part of development for the subsystems you own, so bring-up and qualification start earlier and finish with evidence
Verify a growing set of IP configurations so Controller-PHY combinations are exercised before they reach a customer environment
Turn field and integration issues into permanent tests and shared debug knowledge, so the same failure does not return and the team keeps the lesson
Contribute reusable interoperability methods across the protocols you work on, including UCIe, PCIe/CXL, Ethernet, DDR/HBM, USB, and AMBA/CHI
Apply an AI-assisted verification flow so debug skill and methodology extend across more products and configurations
Produce compatibility matrices and qualification evidence that show when a specific Controller-PHY combination is ready for customers, and shorten integration time
Mentor other engineers and raise the quality of environments, reviews, and debug on the team
What You'll Need
5-15+ years of ASIC, IP, or SoC verification experience, with ownership of complex verification work and a record of influencing design and verification decisions with partner teams. Senior Staff candidates also show broader scope: reusable architectures or methodologies adopted beyond a single project, and technical leadership of interoperability work across configurations or teams
Deep expertise in SystemVerilog, UVM, assertions, functional and code coverage, verification closure, and complex debug, including building and reviewing sophisticated verification environments
Experience creating reusable verification environments for IP, subsystem, or SoC designs that other engineers could pick up and extend
Strong expertise in one or more high-speed protocols such as UCIe, PCIe/CXL, Ethernet, DDR/HBM, USB, or AMBA/CHI, including protocol interactions, initialization sequences, and interoperability issues
Hands-on use of industry simulation and debug tools, VIP, and coverage infrastructure, specifically VCS and Verdi or an equivalent toolchain
Automation skill in Python, Tcl, or a similar language, with examples of scripts or tools that made verification faster or more reliable
Experience with CDC/RDC, formal verification, emulation or prototyping, CI/CD, or distributed regression infrastructure is an advantage, as is experience or a demonstrated interest in GenAI, LLMs, RAG, agentic workflows, and AI-assisted verification
Who You Are
You can join a Controller-PHY integration that is failing in a customer configuration, debug the waveforms in Verdi, find the root cause across firmware, RTL, and protocol assumptions, and define the fix that prevents the same issue in later configurations
You align partner teams through technical credibility, clear communication, and a record of closing hard problems
You mentor other engineers by teaching them how to structure a verification environment and how to reason about a subsystem failure
You move between hands-on work and technical planning: reviewing a UVM testbench, proposing the verification approach for the next release, and walking architects through a risk in the interface or the initialization sequence
You treat AI and LLMs as practical tools for scaling verification, and you are ready to apply GenAI from specification through qualification on the work this team owns
You raise concerns when an interface creates interoperability risk or a qualification plan has no evidence behind it, because the subsystem has to work in the customer's configuration
The Team You'll Be Part Of
You will work in the IP R&D organization at Synopsys with Controller and PHY architects, verification engineers, firmware engineers, and VIP developers across high-speed interface IP families. Your work sits where these teams meet: you own interoperability verification and help define the checks, environments, and evidence that show a subsystem works as a subsystem. You will collaborate with engineers in Bangalore and at other R&D sites. The role is hands-on and technical. Customer-ready Controller-PHY combinations depend on the quality of this work.
Rewards and Benefits
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.
At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

jobs.title: Staff Technical Program Manager — Multi-Entity Account Scale & Access Lifecycle
jobs.description:
Intuit's Identity organization is seeking a Staff Technical Program Manager to focus on how our platform scales for large and complex customers. Our Identity Platform is the primary gateway for millions of customers across TurboTax, QuickBooks, Credit Karma, and Mailchimp — a durable strategic lever that ensures personalized experiences are delivered with world-class security and compliance.
This role sits at the center of one of Intuit's largest growth bets: serving customers whose organizations look nothing like a single-owner small business. Accounting firms managing hundreds of clients. Multi-entity businesses running dozens of legal entities across currencies and locations. Mid-market companies with real hierarchies, real headcount, and real governance requirements. The users you build for are the people your customers employ — the staff, contractors, and accountants they invite into their own Intuit account — and the platform they administer today was designed for a much smaller shape of customer.
You will own two initiatives end to end. Scale is the work of taking our account model from hundreds of entities to thousands, delivering bulk and group-level administration, and standing up an API-first surface so customers and partners can manage identity programmatically rather than one user at a time. Access automation is the work of making the joiner/mover/leaver lifecycle automatic — permissions applied correctly the moment someone is added, revoked the moment they leave, with the audit trail to prove it — collapsing onboarding that takes weeks and eliminating access that outlives the person who held it.
We need an AI Native, results-oriented and empathetic technical leader who can navigate complex system architectures, establish order in ambiguity, and drive technical excellence in a fast-paced, matrixed environment. This role is based in Bengaluru India and partners daily with the engineering and product teams driving both initiatives.
Responsibilities
Drive Technical Excellence: Own and drive two critical identity programs — multi-entity account scale and automated access lifecycle — from scope definition through launch and adoption. Navigate complex microservice architectures, multi-tenant account and permission models, and intricate system dependencies to deliver capabilities that are secure, performant, and reliable at scale.
Own the Scale Initiative: Drive the work of taking our account model from hundreds of entities to thousands — hierarchies, groups, bulk administration, and an API-first surface so customers and partners can manage identity programmatically rather than one user at a time. Dive deep into the technical subject matter and re-emerge with an end-to-end blueprint the delivery teams can execute against.
Own the Access Automation Initiative: Drive the joiner/mover/leaver lifecycle to automatic — permissions applied correctly the moment someone is added, revoked the moment they leave, with the audit trail to prove it. Partner with engineering on the provisioning architecture and with product on the administrative experience that sits on top of it.
Connect Strategy to Execution: Synthesize business strategy, customer signals, and delivery realities to prioritize across both initiatives and keep teams focused on the highest-impact outcomes. Lead the tradeoff discussions, recommend the execution path, and ensure follow-through with stakeholders.
Execute with Rigor: Partner across teams to define program outcomes, build the end-to-end delivery plan, and establish the governance model for both initiatives. Develop and drive the operating rhythm — planning, reviews, cutline sessions, and decision forums — that sets direction and instills accountability.
Own Risks and Dependencies: Both initiatives carry committed dependencies from product teams across Intuit. Uncover risks and dependencies before they materialize, proactively escalate blockers, determine the optimal path to green, and hold partner teams to dated commitments.
Identity Architecture Partnership: Work with Identity Architects and engineering leaders to ensure account hierarchy, provisioning, and access patterns scale consistently across the Intuit ecosystem, and that both initiatives compose cleanly with the authorization and governance work running alongside them.
Lead Change Through Migration and Adoption: Own the path from the current account model to the new one — not just the capability, but how existing customers get there without disruption. Identify the impact of key changes, develop the change plan, and exhibit extreme ownership driving from plan to sustained adoption, tracking that customers actually move rather than that the feature shipped.
Enable Scale and Velocity: Build the frameworks, tooling, and instrumentation that make identity program delivery repeatable — and apply AI agent tools to accelerate program analysis, delivery, and stakeholder communication, evaluating AI-generated program artifacts with the same rigor applied to human-generated output.
Qualifications
Experience: 8+ years in technical program management within platform organizations or high-scale software development environments, including demonstrated ownership of programs spanning multiple engineering organizations.
Education: BA/BS in Computer Science, Information Systems, or an equivalent technical degree.
Identity Platform Depth: Direct experience delivering customer identity and access management (CIAM) capabilities — authentication, authorization, account and organization modeling, or user provisioning and administration — in a product-facing platform serving external customers at scale.
Access Model Fluency: Working knowledge of role- and attribute-based access control (RBAC/ABAC/PBAC), permission and entitlement models, delegated administration, and the failure modes that come with them — over-permissioning, role sprawl, and orphaned access.
Multi-Tenant Hierarchy Modeling: Experience with systems that represent a customer's own organizational structure — parent/child entities, groups, delegated admins, cross-organization access — and the design tradeoffs between flexibility and comprehensibility at scale.
Technical Domain Expertise: Strong grasp of SDLC methodologies, microservices architecture, and platform design, with the systems thinking to form an end-to-end blueprint in an unfamiliar problem area and the credibility to be treated as a thought partner by technical stakeholders. Fluency with API-first delivery, including developer-facing surfaces and programmatic administration.
Scale Judgment: Demonstrated experience taking a platform capability from a small-customer design point to a large-customer design point, including the migration path for customers already on the old model.
AI-Native Delivery: Demonstrated use of AI agents and tools in your own program work to accelerate analysis, structure delivery, and sharpen stakeholder communication — with firsthand judgment about where AI accelerates delivery and where it introduces risk.
Leadership Style: Proven ability to lead through influence rather than authority, at a scope where you define the program rather than inherit it. Credibility as a boundaryless change leader who drives from plan to sustained adoption. You are a self-starter who values 'Leadership as a Coach' and supports the growth of those around you.
Communication: Excellent articulate and warm communication skills, with strong written fluency. You can compress a complex program into a page an executive can act on, and simplify technical problems into actionable insight for engineers and leaders alike.
Problem Solving: Demonstrated ability to establish order in ambiguous situations and use rapid experimentation to learn fast and pivot when necessary.
Analytical Skills: Strong data-driven mindset with the ability to track and report on program health, delivery velocity, and customer impact metrics.
Preferred: Experience with identity standards and protocols (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, ReBAC/ABAC engines such as OPA); B2B or B2B2C SaaS serving mid-market or larger customers; experience delivering through partner, reseller, or professional-services channels.
Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

jobs.description:

IT

Mid-Senior level
Job Description:
At Cloudera, we empower people to transform complex data into clear and actionable insights. With as much data under management as the hyperscalers, we're the preferred data partner for the top companies in almost every industry. Powered by the relentless innovation of the open source community, Cloudera advances digital transformation for the world’s largest enterprises.
Cloudera IT team is seeking a talented, motivated, and passionate Infrastructure Automation Engineer (DevOps) to join the Infrastructure Engineering team within our Technical Operations organization. In this role, you will build and maintain the automation, tooling, and self-service capabilities that enable software engineering teams to consume and integrate with our private cloud environment quickly, safely, and consistently.
You will play a hands-on part in Cloudera IT’s Enterprise-as-Code (EaC) evolution—applying our EaC standard, developed in collaboration with the EaC Platform Architect, to bring infrastructure, network, configuration, and policy under version control. Working closely with our Sr Infrastructure Automation Engineer alongside our Sr Infrastructure Solutions Engineer, Sr Platform Operations Engineers, and Sr Systems Engineers, you will support Enterprise Cloud Services Operations, Networking, and Service Desk teams by turning recurring manual processes into automated workflows—making the right way the easy way while growing your DevOps skills on an experienced team.
As an Infrastructure Automation Engineer you will:
Build, test, and maintain automation and tooling (scripts, CLIs, Terraform modules, Ansible roles, pipelines, and self-service workflows) that enable software engineering teams to provision and integrate with our private cloud environment.
Bring creativity and curiosity to everyday automation work by proposing new approaches, building prototypes, and iterating on tools based on user feedback.
Implement infrastructure and configuration as code aligned with IT’s Enterprise-as-Code (EaC) and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) standards—following conventions for repository structure, module design, code review, testing, versioning, and promotion across environments, including bringing manually managed resources under code.
Contribute to improving the EaC standard by sharing gaps, friction points, and improvement ideas from day-to-day implementation with the Sr Infrastructure Automation Engineer and the EaC Platform Architect.
Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and platform services using GitHub Enterprise and GitHub Actions, aligned with the EaC standard and incorporating automated linting, testing, security scanning, and policy checks.
Support the Enterprise Cloud Services Operations team by codifying private and public cloud resources and automating operational runbooks.
Support the Networking team with network automation and source-of-truth initiatives (e.g., NetBox/Nautobot, Ansible, Terraform), such as DNS/IPAM and firewall configuration as code.
Support the Service Desk team by automating repetitive requests and connecting self-service catalog items and ticket workflows (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira Service Management) to backend automation.
Apply policy-as-code, secrets management, and security controls (e.g., OPA, HashiCorp Vault) so that automation is secure and compliant by default.
Help software engineering teams onboard to the private cloud by troubleshooting automation and pipeline issues and answering technical questions.
Monitor automation and pipelines, investigate failures and configuration drift, implement fixes, and contribute metrics, logging, and alerting for the tools you build.
Create and maintain clear documentation, runbooks, templates, and examples for your tools.
Participate in a shared on-call rotation to support mission-critical IT services, with clear documentation and runbooks provided.
Grow your skills by collaborating with the Sr Infrastructure Automation Engineer and other senior engineers through code reviews, design reviews, and pairing.
We’re excited about you if you have:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or 4+ years of equivalent experience, including 2+ years of hands-on work in DevOps, platform engineering, infrastructure automation, or systems engineering.
Hands-on Infrastructure-as-Code experience with Terraform/OpenTofu and Ansible, including writing or extending modules and roles.
Proficiency in Python and shell scripting, with comfort working with REST APIs and JSON/YAML.
Demonstrated curiosity and creativity in solving problems with automation, supported by examples of tools, scripts, or workflows you have built to eliminate manual work.
Experience with Git workflows (branching, pull requests, code review) and CI/CD tools (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins).
Working knowledge of private cloud platforms (e.g., OpenStack, VMware vSphere/VCF) and/or public cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP).
Familiarity with containers (Docker) and basic Kubernetes concepts.
Solid Linux systems administration skills (e.g., Red Hat, Rocky, Ubuntu).
Strong networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, firewalls, load balancing).
A security-aware mindset covering secrets management, service accounts, and least-privilege practices.
Good communication skills and a customer-focused approach to supporting internal engineering and operations teams.
Comfort working within shared engineering standards, with a willingness to contribute improvements through collaboration and code review.
You may also have:
Relevant certifications such as HashiCorp Terraform Associate, Red Hat (RHCSA/RHCE), Kubernetes (CKAD), or an associate-level public cloud certification (AWS, Azure, GCP).

Location: Noida
Company: Paytm
About Paytm

Paytm is a pioneer of digital payments in India, serving over 450 million consumers and 45 million merchants across payments, financial services, and commerce. Over the years, Paytm has built deep in-house capabilities across technology, data, and operations to operate at scale with high reliability.
Paytm is building a full stack AI platform focussed on Inference and Agents, enabling large enterprises to deploy AI driven automation across sales, service, operations, and analytics.

Role Overview

Paytm is looking to hire a Client Onboarding Director to own implementation delivery and client onboarding governance for Paytm’s AI Inference and Agentic AI products across enterprise clients.
This is a managerial role that will lead Client Onboarding Managers and ensure that enterprise deployments move smoothly from sales closure to go live and early adoption.
The role sits at the intersection of client teams, product, engineering, business, and sales, and is responsible for converting signed enterprise deals into successful, timely, and scalable deployments.
The candidate will own delivery planning, integration governance, risk management, stakeholder communication, and post go live stabilization across enterprise AI agent deployments.
The role requires strong program management, technical understanding, client handling, and ability to drive execution across multiple internal and external teams.

Key Responsibilities

Delivery Ownership and Implementation Governance
Own end to end delivery governance for enterprise AI agent deployments from sales handoff to go live and stabilization.
Lead the implementation planning process across scope, timelines, milestones, dependencies, risks, and success metrics.
Ensure every enterprise deployment has a clear project plan, ownership structure, escalation path, and delivery cadence.
Track deployment progress across multiple clients and ensure timely resolution of blockers.
Drive consistency in delivery quality, client communication, and implementation standards across the onboarding team.
Client Onboarding and Integration Management
Oversee client onboarding across product configuration, data source integration, CRM integration, communication channel setup, user training, and adoption readiness.
Work with Client Onboarding Managers to understand client systems, databases, architecture, workflows, and integration requirements.
Coordinate with product and engineering teams to ensure technical dependencies are resolved on time.
Review integration plans, data readiness, testing plans, and go live checklists for enterprise deployments.
Ensure smooth handoff from pre sales and sales teams into delivery, with clear scope and success criteria.
Client Stakeholder Management

Manage senior client stakeholders across business, product, technology, data, marketing, and operations teams.
Conduct steering committee reviews, project status updates, and escalation discussions with client teams.

Identify delivery risks early across scope, integrations, timelines, data readiness, client dependencies, and product gaps.
Build mitigation plans and escalation mechanisms to avoid deployment delays.
Run root cause analysis for delivery delays, failed integrations, adoption gaps, or client escalations.
Work with product, engineering, pre sales, and business teams to resolve critical issues.
Maintain clear documentation of risks, decisions, open items, dependencies, and closure actions.
Process, Playbooks, and Scalability
Build standard onboarding playbooks, project templates, go live checklists, training material, and implementation SOPs.
Define delivery metrics such as time to onboard, milestone adherence, integration success rate, client readiness, go live success, and early adoption.
Create dashboards and review cadences to track implementation health across enterprise clients.
Improve onboarding processes continuously through post implementation reviews and client feedback.
Build scalable delivery systems that reduce dependency on individuals and improve implementation quality at scale.
Team Leadership and Cross Functional Collaboration
Lead and mentor Client Onboarding Managers across enterprise delivery workstreams.
Set clear goals, delivery standards, review mechanisms, and quality expectations for the onboarding team.
Work closely with Enterprise GTM, Pre Sales, Product, Engineering, Security, Legal, Finance, and Support teams.
Ensure clean handoffs across pre sales, sales, onboarding, support, and account management.
Build team capability in client communication, technical understanding, project management, and issue resolution.

Ideal Candidate Profile

8 to 10 years of experience in implementation delivery, customer onboarding, program management, customer success, solutions delivery, or enterprise technology roles.
Experience leading implementation or onboarding teams for SaaS, fintech, CRM, marketing technology, AI, automation, cloud, data platforms, or enterprise software products.
Strong understanding of APIs, system integrations, data flows, enterprise architecture, CRM systems, and deployment lifecycle.
Proven ability to manage enterprise client stakeholders and drive multi stakeholder implementation programs.
Strong program management skills with ability to manage multiple deployments, timelines, dependencies, and escalations.
Experience building delivery playbooks, SOPs, dashboards, review cadences, and implementation governance systems.
Strong communication and problem solving skills with ability to work across client, product, engineering, sales, and business teams.
High ownership mindset with comfort operating in fast moving and ambiguous environments.
Interest in AI agents, LLMs, automation, analytics, and enterprise digital transformation.

Strong implementation delivery and program management skills for enterprise technology products.
Good understanding of APIs, data integrations, CRM systems, databases, cloud platforms, and enterprise workflows.
Ability to build project plans, dependency trackers, risk logs, go live checklists, SOPs, and executive status updates.

Strong team leadership skills with ability to manage Client Onboarding Managers and drive delivery discipline.
Strong analytical and problem solving skills with ability to identify root causes and drive corrective actions.
Comfort with tools such as Google Sheets, Slides, project management tools, documentation platforms, CRM tools, and AI enabled productivity tools.
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Computer Science, or a related field. MBA or technical postgraduate degree is a plus.

The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Direct Tax, GST, tax accounting, ERP systems, and financial reporting, along with the ability to support strategic finance initiatives.

Tax payments
Reconciliations
Statutory reporting

Current Tax

GST
Other statutory levies
Review tax-related ledger balances and reconciliations.
Support preparation and review of financial statements from a taxation perspective.
Ensure tax provisions comply with applicable Accounting Standards, IND AS, and regulatory requirements.

Drive automation of tax compliance, reconciliations, and reporting processes.
Collaborate with ERP and Technology teams to enhance tax configurations and system capabilities.
Ensure tax-related master data and ERP configurations remain compliant with applicable regulations.
Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy, and compliance across tax processes.
