Support month-end and year-end financial closing activities.
Participate in finance transformation, ERP implementation, automation, and process improvement initiatives.
Assist in preparation of MIS reports, management dashboards, and board or regulatory submissions.
Partner with Accounting, Treasury, Business, and Compliance teams on finance-related initiatives and projects.
Provide support on accounting, treasury, regulatory reporting, and other finance functions as required.

5. Audit & Regulatory Compliance
Support Internal Audit, Statutory Audit, Tax Audit, and regulatory inspections.
Ensure timely closure of tax and audit observations.
Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails for all tax-related transactions and compliance activities.
Ensure adherence to applicable tax laws, accounting standards, and internal governance policies.

Ensure zero material tax compliance defaults or regulatory penalties.
Deliver timely and accurate Direct Tax, GST, and TDS/TCS compliance.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Zonal Collection Manager

About the Team:
The Collections team is responsible for managing overdue accounts, driving recovery performance, monitoring collection agencies and in-house teams, and ensuring compliance with applicable regulatory guidelines and the Code of Conduct. The team focuses on achieving collection targets, improving recovery efficiency, and minimizing credit losses across assigned territories.

About the Role:
The Zonal Collection Manager will be responsible for driving collection performance across the assigned zone, managing regional and branch-level collection teams, and ensuring the achievement of business and recovery targets. The role requires strong leadership, strategic planning, stakeholder management, and expertise in managing collection agencies and field operations while maintaining regulatory compliance.

Key Responsibilities:
Drive and achieve zonal collection targets across assigned products, branches, and delinquency buckets.
Develop and implement effective collection strategies to improve recovery rates, reduce roll-forwards, and control delinquencies.
Lead, manage, and monitor regional collection managers, branch teams, field executives, and collection agencies.
Review collection performance through regular MIS, productivity reports, and portfolio analysis, and take corrective actions wherever required.
Monitor collection agency performance, ensure optimal resource utilization, and drive accountability for assigned targets.
Ensure strict adherence to applicable RBI guidelines, regulatory requirements, internal policies, and the Code of Conduct.
Identify and control fraudulent practices, operational risks, and process gaps across collection operations.
Work closely with business, credit, risk, legal, and operations teams to resolve collection challenges and improve recovery outcomes.
Manage escalations related to overdue accounts, customer grievances, and field collection activities.
Ensure effective allocation of collection resources across branches and territories based on portfolio size, delinquency levels, and business requirements.
Drive employee productivity, performance reviews, capability building, and continuous improvement across the zonal team.
Prepare and present periodic collection performance updates, recovery forecasts, and action plans to senior management.

Skills and Competencies:
Strong expertise in collections, recovery management, and delinquency control.
Excellent leadership and team management skills, with the ability to manage large, geographically distributed teams.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with proficiency in collection MIS and performance tracking.
Excellent negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Strong understanding of collection processes, agency management, and applicable regulatory guidelines.
Ability to drive results, manage escalations, and deliver targets in a high-performance environment.
Strong planning, execution, and decision-making capabilities.
Proficiency in MS Excel, reporting tools, and collection management systems.
A proactive approach to process improvement, operational efficiency, and risk mitigation.

Education and Experience:
Education: Graduate in any discipline. Postgraduate qualifications will be an added advantage.

Experience: 10+ years of relevant experience in collections and recovery management, preferably in banking, NBFCs, fintech, or financial services.
Prior experience in managing zonal or multi-location collection operations, large teams, and collection agencies is preferred.

Compensation:
Compensation will be commensurate with the candidate’s experience, expertise, and suitability for the role.

About the Team:

About the Role:
We’re looking for a high-agency, execution-focused Growth Manager to drive scalable and sustainable growth for Paytm Postpaid. This is a hands-on role focused on owning and running growth campaigns for the postpaid onboarding funnel, understanding user intent and psychology, and designing and executing end-to-end digital campaigns to improve funnel conversion.
You will own campaign execution end-to-end, while staying close to key business questions such as:
•⁠  ⁠Where is the funnel leaking?
•⁠  ⁠Which stages are users getting stuck at?
•⁠  ⁠What could be the users' motivation to take this product, and what could be the deterrents that are dragging down the funnel
•⁠  ⁠Which user journeys or product flows are broken or inefficient?
If you enjoy owning campaigns end-to-end, working at the intersection of marketing, product, and user behavior, and care about solving real-world problems for India’s consumers, we’d love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities:
•⁠  ⁠Own end-to-end planning and execution of growth campaigns across channels (in- app, push, SMS, email) to drive Postpaid conversion
•⁠  ⁠Continuously track funnel health, campaign effectiveness, and market trends to propose new strategic bets.
•⁠  ⁠Identify opportunities to increase visibility (impressions), CTR, conversion, and engagement using experiments, segmentation, and campaign innovation.
•⁠  ⁠Run and evaluate growth experiments (A/B tests, control groups) to find what works and scale it through campaigns.
•⁠  ⁠Partner with Product and Business teams to improve in-app journeys, address drop-offs, and reduce friction in loan application flow.
•⁠  ⁠Use AI to fast-track ops, improve efficiency, and unlock growth.

Requirements:
•⁠  ⁠4 to 6 years of experience in a growth, campaign management, or product marketing role, preferably in fintech, e-commerce, or consumer tech.
•⁠  ⁠Working understanding of user funnels, segmentation, and basic attribution, enough to use data to inform campaign decisions.
•⁠  ⁠Hands-on experience with analytics tools like SQL, Looker, or Amplitude, and engagement tools like CleverTap or MoEngage.
•⁠  ⁠Ability to generate and test hypotheses using data, and translate insights into product or marketing actions.
•⁠  ⁠Comfortable working cross-functionally with design, content, product, analytics, and business teams.
•⁠  ⁠Excellent problem-solving skills, structured thinking, and a bias toward
experimentation and measurement.

5. Familiarity with regulatory requirements and compliance standards (e.g., RBI, SEBI).
6. Excellent communication, interpersonal, analytical and leadership skills.
7. Knowledge of emerging technologies, their impact on data protection and ability to handle sensitive information discreetly.

5. Paytm offers you a career — not just a job — to become a next-gen tech leader.

7+ years of experience in product support, customer success, account management or consulting for large, complex ERP, HCM, Financial, CRM or cloud computing system (SaaS preferred)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
The Position
Job description
We are looking for a highly skilled, deeply hands-on Full-Stack Software Engineer who will cover frontend UI, backend architecture, cloud deployment, and DevOps engineering all under one hat. Since our team already includes dedicated AI Engineers and Data Engineers, your primary mission is to be the foundational software engineering anchor: building the robust, scalable, and secure user interfaces, infrastructure, integrations, and server-side logic that allows our AI solutions to thrive in a production environment.
Description of the area
At Roche Digital Technology, we are advancing the boundaries of Applied AI. As part of our strategic initiatives, we are enabling high-value AI solutions spanning advanced agentic frameworks, Generative AI applications, and classical Machine Learning. The Applied AI Engineering Team is tasked with building these innovative AI applications end-to-end to solve complex business challenges in healthcare.
In the 2026 tech landscape, the lines between traditional disciplines have blurred. We operate in small agile teams (e.g., ~9 members) powered by advanced coding agents (like Claude Code) to develop and ship solutions faster than ever before (through agentic SDLC).
Job Responsibilities
Frontend Architecture & Generative UI: Develop highly scalable, reusable UI components using expert-level TypeScript and modern frameworks (React/Next.js or Angular 16+). Shift from static layouts to flexible, dynamic interfaces that gracefully handle unpredictable data and real-time LLM streams.
Core Backend Engineering & API Design: Design and build highly scalable, reusable backend services and APIs (using Python) that serve as the backbone for multi-agent workflows and GenAI applications. Build, host, and secure Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and standard APIs to standardize data exchange.
Cloud Architecture & DevOps Excellence: Design, implement, and manage secure and scalable cloud infrastructure (primarily AWS) tailored for diverse AI workloads. Apply Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) practices using Terraform. Build, maintain, and optimize fully automated CI/CD pipelines and manage application containerization (Docker).
Agentic SDLC & Engineering Excellence: Leverage AI coding assistants and autonomous agents (e.g., Claude Code, Ona) daily to accelerate full-stack development cycles. Conduct rigorous code reviews for both human-written and AI-generated code.
Qualifications / Education / Experience
Experience: 7+ years of strong software engineering experience with a demonstrable focus on backend development, cloud infrastructure, advanced frontend architecture, and DevOps.
AI Integration Experience: Proven experience building backends for complex solutions and AI / LLM-powered applications, managing streaming responses, and translating non-deterministic AI outputs into safe, functional user interfaces.
Agentic Workflow: Proven experience leveraging AI coding agents within an agentic SDLC to accelerate feature delivery.
Hold a B.Sc., B.Eng., M.Sc., M.Eng., PhD, or equivalent in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
Be a passionate builder, staying continuously up-to-date with the latest developments in cloud computing, backend architectures, frontend paradigms, and AI integrations.
Be team-oriented, proactive, and collaborative, thriving in a fast-paced environment where roles are fluid and multidisciplinary.
Have a deep sense of accountability, capable of diagnosing complex system-level issues across the entire stack, and able to step into a Tech Lead role when necessary.
Skills
Must-have:
Software Engineering Best Practices: Robust automated testing (TDD) to verify both code written by AI agents and dynamic UI components generated at runtime.
Frontend & User Interface: Deep expertise in TypeScript and a major framework (React/Next.js or Angular 16+). Strong capability in complex state management and handling real-time data flow.
Backend Programming: Advanced, production-grade proficiency in Python. Excellent enterprise API design and microservices architecture skills.
Cloud & DevOps: Deep expertise in AWS (IAM, Lambda, S3, ECS, etc.), Docker, CI/CD tools (e.g., GitHub Actions), and Terraform.
APIs and integrations: Building API-driven applications and integrating different enterprise systems into one solution.
Should-have:
Data & AI Tooling: Experience integrating with modern databases (Snowflake, OpenSearch). Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP), graph databases, and Generative UI libraries.
aSDLC: leveraging Agentic AI in the Software Development Lifecycle
Building scalable, secure, resilient, and highly available systems.
Could-have:
Regulatory Compliance: Proven experience in working within highly regulated industries.
Additional Qualifications
Security Mindset: Strong understanding of enterprise security risks, IAM, and safe data handling along with a strong understanding of responsible AI deployment.
Communication: Be an excellent problem solver, detail-oriented, and a great communicator, able to present complex technical matters clearly to diverse audiences. Be able to communicate in English at the level of C1+.
Be deeply interested in developments in AI, staying up-to-date with the latest developments in agentic SDLC, cloud computing, and software development practices.
Be able to communicate in English at the level of: C1+.
Working Hours: Located in Hyderabad, India, with working hours structured to capture the 'golden hours' of overlap with Central European Time (typically running through the IST evening).

jobs.title: AI Business Analyst – Applied & Agentic AI Systems
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
The Position
About the Role
At Roche Digital Technology (RDT), we are advancing the boundaries of Applied AI. As part of our strategic initiatives, we enable high-value AI solutions (with a strong focus on Generative AI and agentic systems) through fit-for-purpose platforms, services, and applications. The Applied AI Engineering Team is tasked with building innovative AI applications, GenAI agents, and agentic foundations.
In the 2026 tech landscape, the lines between traditional disciplines have blurred. We operate in small agile teams (typically ~9 members) powered by advanced coding agents (like Claude Code) to develop and ship solutions faster than ever before (Agentic SDLC).
To support our rapid-turnaround, high-velocity engineering teams, we are seeking a highly skilled, deeply experienced IT Business Analyst. Operating in a highly regulated pharmaceutical and clinical environment (GxP), you will serve as the strategic interface between complex business priorities, regulatory compliance frameworks, and cutting-edge engineering realities. You are not a traditional analyst who merely documents requests; you are a passionate, technically literate individual contributor equipped with advanced AI skills (including prompt engineering & modern agentic workflows) and the business acumen to collaborate closely with product leaders. Furthermore, you possess strong Product Owner (PO) skills and are fully prepared to confidently act as a Proxy PO for the squad if necessary—managing the product backlog, defining sprint goals, and steering delivery timelines to align with Roche’s strategic objectives.
Core Tech Stack & Scope
This role requires a deep understanding of three core domains: AI systems, the life sciences and pharmaceutical business context, and the complexities of operating within a highly regulated environment.
The IT Business Analyst serves as the strategic bridge between complex business requirements and cutting-edge technical execution. You will take ownership of the end-to-end requirements lifecycle for AI initiatives, ensuring that all architectural designs and engineering deliverables are scalable, high-performing, and strictly compliant with global regulatory standards. By aligning technical roadmaps with strategic priorities, you will drive the delivery of robust AI solutions that provide measurable business value and maintain the highest levels of data integrity and quality assurance.
Key Responsibilities
Agile Requirements & Product Owner Support (60% Focus):
Manage the full AI project lifecycle from opportunity identification through deployment and value realization.
Translate business goals into prioritized product backlogs, Epics, and User Stories with clear acceptance criteria.
Define MVP/MMR strategies to iteratively deliver business value while managing project risks.
Act as a Proxy PO when necessary, making critical decisions on prioritization and sprint goals.
LLM Prompt Engineering & Solution Prototyping:
Design and optimize LLM prompts to ensure accurate, secure, and relevant model outputs.
Prototype agentic workflows and evaluate model responses using Python scripting and SQL data exploration.
Develop specifications for dynamic Generative UI components and RAG pipeline context mappings.
Requirements Engineering & Business Process Analysis:
Lead requirements workshops and JAD sessions to elicit business and functional specifications.
Author standard-compliant artifacts including URS, FRS, and "as-is/to-be" process maps.
Conduct gap analyses and re-engineering assessments to optimize and automate manual workflows.
GxP Compliance, Computerized System Validation (CSV) & Software Assurance (CSA):
Guide compliance-by-design strategies for AI deployments following GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, and Annex 11.
Guide risk-based CSA/CSV activities, authoring risk assessments (FMEA), trace matrices, and validation reports.
Enforce strict data integrity controls (ALCOA+) and system classifications to preserve validated states.
AI Governance, Risk Management & Observability Specifications:
Ensure governance guardrails, escalation triggers, and observability requirements for agentic AI systems are applied.
Assess AI-specific risks (drift, leakage, tool misuse) and formulate TCO/ROI business cases.
Change Control, ITSM & Configuration Management:
Manage formal Change Requests (RFC) and present impact analyses to CAB/ECAB boards.
Maintain system configuration documentation and audit-readiness for internal and regulatory inspections.
Audit Readiness & Operational Support:
Act as IT SME during audits, presenting validation evidence and requirements engineering practices.
Author SOPs, manuals, and training materials to support business readiness and operational transitions.
Practical Skills Required
Experience:
8+ years of IT Business Analysis experience supporting enterprise-scale software solutions, system integrations, and business processes.
5+ years of experience in highly regulated environments, with a strong preference for the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical devices, or clinical healthcare sectors.
3+ years of proven experience in Agile/Scrum product delivery, with demonstrated success managing product backlogs, writing detailed User Stories, and supporting agile ceremonies.
Hands-on AI/LLM Project Experience: Experience working directly on Generative AI or machine learning projects, supporting data preparation, prompt development, or AI application testing.
Proven track record of delivering computerized system validation or software assurance under industry-standard quality guidelines and electronic records regulations.
Demonstrated experience working with cross-functional, globally distributed engineering squads (including developers, architects, QA, and validation teams).
Agentic Workflow / aSDLC Experience: Proven experience leveraging AI productivity tools and writing/coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, ChatGPT, Codex, GitHub Copilot) daily to accelerate elicitation, business process mapping, and requirements generation within an agentic software development lifecycle.
Skills
Must-have:
Advanced Requirements Lifecycle Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in elicitation, specification, modeling, verification, and traceability.
LLM Prompt Engineering & AI Prototyping: Proficient in designing, evaluating, and refining prompts for large language models. Ability to construct robust system prompts and templates that control model outputs and behavior.
Technical & Data Literacy (Analysis & Logical Assessment): Advanced ability to analyze complex data structures, logically assess AI model outputs, and trace data lineage. Strong technical aptitude to interpret technical specifications and evaluate system behaviors, with a focus on data-driven decision-making rather than hands-on coding or scripting.
Regulatory & Quality Expertise: Deep theoretical and practical knowledge of industry-standard regulatory and quality protocols, software validation and quality assurance standards, and global guidelines for electronic records and digital signatures.
Process Modeling & Visualization: Advanced skills in process mapping, business workflow design, and data flow diagramming using tools like Microsoft Visio, Lucidchart, or BPMN engines.
Business Case & Financial Analysis: Experience conducting financial analyses, cost-benefit modeling, and calculating the total cost of ownership for enterprise platforms.
Stakeholder Management & Facilitation: Outstanding active listening, communication, and negotiation skills, with the ability to build consensus across conflicting viewpoints, push back on unrealistic business requests, and translate between "business speak" and "tech speak."
Should-have
Agile Product Ownership Capability: Strong product thinking and backlog management capabilities using JIRA and Confluence. Ability to confidently step in as a Proxy PO when necessary to define MVPs, prioritize backlogs, and drive sprint goals.
AI/ML and Agentic Architecture Familiarity: Broad understanding of LLM architectures, RAG/GraphRAG concepts, multi-agent frameworks, and vector/graph databases to effectively analyze requirements for advanced AI projects.
IT Service Management (ITSM): Solid understanding of ITIL-based change management, incident management, and CMDB architectures.
Testing and QA Partnership: Experience partnering with QA to review test plans, coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and verify test coverage using Requirements Traceability Matrices.
Agentic SDLC: Strong drive to apply agentic Software Development Lifecycle practices and tools.
Could-have:
Professional Certifications: International Institute of Business Analysis (IIBA) credentials such as CBAP (Certified Business Analysis Professional) or CCBA; Project Management Institute (PMI-PBA) or Scrum Alliance (CSPO/PO) certifications.
Multicloud Awareness: Basic familiarity with cloud service models (AWS/Azure) and cloud-native application deployments.
Capabilities:
Problem-Solving Skills: Dissect complex, ambiguous, and abstract business challenges into manageable, structured, and verifiable functional requirements.
Ownership & Decisiveness: High-ownership mindset with the confidence to make tough priority decisions, remove development roadblocks, and step in to lead product direction as a Proxy PO when necessary.
Consulting & Trust: Ability to serve as a strategic, trusted advisor to senior business stakeholders, QA leads, and engineering teams, translating seamlessly between clinical business speak and technical developer speak.
Ethics & Empathy: Deep commitment to patient safety, product quality, data security, and ethical AI deployment, backed by a strong user-centric design approach.
Qualifications
The successful candidate should:
Have a strong understanding of both AI applications and traditional software development life cycle (SDLC) methodologies.
Be passionate about AI, staying up-to-date with emerging digital trends, software architectures, prompt engineering, and validation practices.
Be team-oriented, proactive, and collaborative, with a proven ability to thrive in a high-velocity, fluid, and multidisciplinary agile environment where roles are fluid.
Be detail-oriented, highly organized, and an exceptional problem-solver who takes initiative in identifying and solving problems.
Be willing to learn and expand their skill set in an environment where roles are fluid and multidisciplinary.
Be able to communicate in English at the level of: C1+.
Located in Hyderabad, India, with working hours structured to capture the "golden hours" of overlap with Central European Time (typically running through the IST evening).

Innovative Environment: Collaborate with a highly advanced, autonomous squad pioneering agentic AI and GenAI systems in healthcare.
Growth Opportunities: Bridge the gap between innovative technologies and critical, life-saving regulatory standards, expanding your skills into Product Ownership and Prompt Engineering.

About this Role
BlackRock Global Markets function is focused on advancing investment processes and platform architecture across these areas, and on ensuring we engage with other market participants in a collaborative, strategic way. The Liquidity & Financing (L&F) pillar combines Securities Lending, Securities
Financing, and Cash Management, with a mandate to deliver liquidity, lending, and financing performance for clients and investment teams while ensuring financial resource capacity. Within L&F, the Innovation, Data & Analytics team is building a Securities Lending Business Enablement Center to enhance business processes through task execution and automation, with an initial focus on client-facing, data analytics, and reporting deliverables. We will do this by leveraging existing citizen-developer tools and the full Aladdin toolkit.
Your Role and Impact
We are seeking a highly motivated, quantitatively minded software engineer to join the Securities Lending Business Enablement Centre as an Associate.
In this role, you will independently plan and deliver technology solutions that improve business processes, increase productivity, and support our scale and automation efforts. You will apply strong software engineering practices across the full development lifecycle, contribute to shared design and development standards, and collaborate closely with partners across Securities Lending and the broader Innovation, Data & Analytics function.
This role sits at the intersection of data engineering, business automation and applied solutions. You will design and build scalable, data-driven solutions, automate workflows, and own the reporting and visualization layer,
turning data from multiple sources into actionable insights through Power BI, Streamlit, and other reporting tools. Although predominantly a Python role, experience across multiple technologies is a plus, as we focus on the best
tool for the job. Hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools is expected, and experience building or experimenting with Generative AI solutions, LLMs, or agent-based frameworks will be a strong advantage.

Design and develop data-driven automated solutions using Python to improve efficiency and scalability

standards that support consistent, high-quality delivery across the team

Strong proficiency in Python for data processing, automation, and application development

Strong experience with data analysis libraries such as Pandas, NumPy

Experience using AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., GitHub & Microsoft Copilot) in development workflows
Excellent interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills

Personal attributes
Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with attention to detail

Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts into business value
Our benefits
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
Our hybrid work model
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. The Company
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.
Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

jobs.description:
About this role
Your team
Join our growing ServiceNow Centre of Excellence and Innovation (CoEI), where people, process and technology come together to deliver scalable solutions across the enterprise. Partnering with global business stakeholders, Enterprise Architects and technology teams, you will help evolve the ServiceNow platform, strengthen engineering practices and enable digital transformation.
Your role and impact
As a senior member of the ServiceNow engineering team, you will combine hands-on development expertise with solution design and technical leadership. You will translate complex business requirements into secure, scalable and maintainable solutions while guiding developers and contributing to the strategic evolution of the platform.
You will play an important role in platform modernization, automation, integration strategy, technical-debt reduction and the adoption of emerging ServiceNow artificial intelligence (AI) capabilities.
Your responsibilities
In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:
Design and deliver secure, scalable and maintainable ServiceNow solutions, translating complex business requirements into effective technical designs aligned with platform standards.
Lead hands-on ServiceNow development across JavaScript, Flow Designer, Service Catalog, integrations, Representational State Transfer (REST) APIs, IntegrationHub, OAuth, MID Server and security controls.
Perform solution design and code reviews and troubleshoot complex platform and production issues, driving quality, performance, security, upgradeability and sustainable root-cause resolution.
Support platform upgrades, releases, testing and deployments while driving modernization, automation and reduction of legacy customizations and technical debt.
Provide technical leadership and mentoring to developers while promoting strong engineering practices.
Partner with architects, product owners and technology teams to deliver strategic platform solutions.
Contribute to the adoption of Now Assist, AI Agents, Artificial Intelligence for IT Operations (AIOps) and other emerging ServiceNow capabilities.
Your experience
6–10 years of technology experience, including 4–7+ years of hands-on ServiceNow development experience.
Strong ServiceNow development expertise, including JavaScript, Flow Designer, Service Catalog, integrations and REST APIs, with a strong understanding of architecture, security, Access Control Lists (ACLs) and enterprise development standards.
Experience designing and delivering complex enterprise ServiceNow solutions, including technical design, code reviews, troubleshooting, upgrades and release management.
Good understanding of Information Technology Service Management (ITSM), Configuration Management Database (CMDB), Common Service Data Model (CSDM) and Information Technology Operations Management (ITOM) capabilities.
Demonstrated ability to independently own technical delivery and provide guidance to other developers.
Strong communication and collaboration skills across technical and business stakeholders.
Experience with IntegrationHub, Discovery, Service Mapping, AIOps, Automated Test Framework (ATF), MID Server, Scoped Applications, Now Assist and ServiceNow AI capabilities is desirable. ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA), Certified Application Developer (CAD), Certified Implementation Specialist – ITSM (CIS-ITSM), or additional ServiceNow certifications are advantageous.
Our benefits
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
Our hybrid work model
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
Guidance on AI use for candidates
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
About BlackRock
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.

Job Title: Global Subject Matter Expert - GTMC ESM
Hiring Manager: GTMC Performance Optimization Lead
Location: Hyderabad
Job type: Full time
About Sanofi
We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.
Our ambition: deliver best-in-class enterprise services enabling Sanofi to chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives. Sanofi has been building the foundations of enterprise services over the past few years. With the creation of the global business unit Business Operations two years ago, we have elevated our commitment to innovation and excellence.
About the Job
The Global Subject Matter Expert - GTMC ESM is the operational backbone of the GTMC ESM function — translating the GTMC ESM Owner’s governance standards and service direction into consistent operational execution across platform governance support, Universal Request Management, knowledge base stewardship, and change adoption facilitation. Across GTMC’s 4 core Pillars (I&A: Insights & Analytics, CXC: Customer Experience Capabilities, CFC: Customer Facing Capabilities, TRM: Trade & Revenue Management), this role covers platform governance & operations — managing configuration activities, maintaining data quality, and ensuring system administration standards — alongside direct L1 service support through timely Universal Request handling and SLA-compliant resolution via the ServiceNow platform.
This role strengthens the GTMC ESM ecosystem through Knowledge Base stewardship, change adoption facilitation, and ongoing platform governance support, complemented by direct Universal Request Management — contributing to the overall service quality, knowledge accessibility, and operational effectiveness of the ESM function across GTMC.
This role is fully hands-on by design: the role holder is expected to personally contribute to operational work alongside the team during peak demand periods, emergencies, and coverage needs.
Note: The scope of activities listed in this job description is not exhaustive. Responsibilities may evolve over time as the GTMC ESM program matures, as Sanofi's strategy evolves, and as new priorities emerge across the organization.
Main Responsibilities
ESM Platform Operations & Governance
Serve as the first-line ESM operational specialist and subject matter reference across all GTMC pillars, applying and upholding the governance standards defined by ESM leadership
Support the ESM demand governance process: capture, triage, and document GTMC enhancement requests and operational needs before escalation to ESM leadership for review and prioritization to BO Service Excellence
Serve as the GTMC-side operational liaison with BO Service Excellence: translating GTMC-specific platform needs, business requirements, and priority inputs into structured governance inputs and actionable requests
Monitor operational ESM KPIs (SLA adherence, open queue health, backlog, compliance metrics); identify anomalies and escalate structured improvement recommendations to ESM leadership
Maintain configuration documentation, change records, and data dictionaries in permanent audit readiness, ensuring full governance traceability across all ESM platform activities
Execute and coordinate UAT and hypercare phases for system updates, patches, and new module deployments — validating business requirements and ensuring readiness for GTMC-wide adoption
Monitor and maintain data quality across all ESM GTMC modules; identify, flag, and drive corrective actions in partnership with BO Service Excellence to ensure data integrity and consistency across all modules
Execute ESM configuration management activities across GTMC modules (assignment groups, dropdown values, workflow updates, service catalogue entries, metadata) within the enterprise governance standards defined by ESM leadership
Universal Request Management & Supervision (L1 Support)
Own, Screen, triage, and resolve Universal Requests (URs) submitted via ServiceNow "Get Help" within agreed SLAs
Deliver first-contact resolution wherever possible; escalate to L2/L3 stakeholders with full documentation when expertise or authority is required
Maintain and enforce documentation standards for all support activities, resolution steps, and approved workarounds in ServiceNow — ensuring consistency, audit-readiness, and knowledge reuse across the team
Monitor open queues proactively to prevent SLA breaches
Analyze recurring patterns and systemic issues across the support queue, developing structured improvement recommendations and owning their escalation to the ESM governance team for root-cause resolution
Apply appropriate handling protocols for requests touching GxP relevant or validated processes
Own the L1 support quality framework: upholding handling protocols, SLA performance standards, and resolution guidelines — and coaching team members to operate consistently within them
Knowledge Base (KB) Article Supervisor
Identify Knowledge Base content gaps from frontline case experience and propose new articles or updates
Guide and partner with Topic Owners to produce clear, standardized, and consistently high-quality GTMC KB articles — setting the content standards and review criteria the function operates within
Own and report on self-service deflection metrics, translating ticket volume and resolution data into actionable insights that inform knowledge management improvement priorities
Flag outdated or inaccurate articles with a structured improvement recommendation to the relevant Topic Owners
Document emerging user pain points and FAQs to inform GTMC knowledge management roadmap
Support the continuous improvement of the GTMC ESM knowledge management approach — identifying structural gaps, flagging content investment priorities, and contributing to KB evolution in line with user needs and platform changes
Change Agent
Facilitate the onboarding of Topic Owners to the ESM platform through structured training sessions, awareness communications, and readiness validation
Own and continuously improve onboarding documentation, FAQ content, and user guides — ensuring materials remain accurate, accessible, and aligned with current platform capabilities
Flag adoption blockers and user feedback to the relevant ESM team members
Support MCO/Country onboarding execution activities: preparing operational governance documentation, tracking readiness milestones, and coordinating stakeholder communications in alignment with the onboarding framework defined by ESM leadership
Report on and analyse onboarding performance and adoption outcomes, identifying friction points and driving corrective actions to accelerate time-to-productivity for newly onboarded populations
About You
Technical Skills
6+ years in service management, operations, or IT service delivery — including demonstrated experience managing ESM/ITSM platform administration activities, owning support quality standards, and driving service performance in a cross-functional, global environment; hands-on experience with ServiceNow or equivalent ITSM platform
Solid command of ESM service domains, support request flows, platform configuration activities, service catalogue structures, and data quality practices — with the ability to translate operational knowledge into improved user experience, governance compliance, and measurable service performance
Demonstrated experience documenting configuration changes, maintaining governance records, and supporting UAT and hypercare activities for system updates and new module deployments — ensuring changes are traceable, validated, and communicated to relevant stakeholders
Strong written communication skills — able to document clearly for both technical and non-technical audiences
Strong data literacy: proven ability to analyze ticket volumes, SLA performance trends, and deflection metrics — and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations for senior stakeholders
Soft Skills
Service-minded: takes genuine ownership of user issues through to resolution
Rigorous and detail-oriented: applies structured governance standards to configuration, documentation, and data management activities without losing sight of the user experience
Curious and improvement-oriented: naturally turns recurring issues into better knowledge content
Clear and empathetic communicator across cultures and functions
Organized and reliable under volume — manages multiple open tickets without losing quality
Key Competencies
User Empathy - places the end-user experience at the center of every interaction
Platform Operations Execution — manages ESM platform configuration, data quality, and system administration with rigor, ensuring reliable operations within governance standards
Quality & Accuracy - zero-defect mindset on case records and knowledge contributions
Proactive Knowledge Sharing - surfaces insights and content gaps without waiting to be asked
Process Discipline - follows procedures rigorously while flagging when they need improvement
Service Excellence Leadership — drives continuous improvement of Universal Request Management quality and knowledge base operations, within the standards defined by ESM leadership
Cross-functional Collaboration — builds effective working relationships with Topic Owners, BO Service Excellence, and GBU contacts to drive shared service quality and governance outcomes
Data-Driven Continuous Improvement — leverages operational metrics and data indicators to identify risks, escalate issues, and drive continuous improvement across ESM services
Why choose us?
Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team
Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally
Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.
Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender-neutral parental leave
Make your work count by supporting a company that brings life-changing treatments to millions — and is committed to doing right by patients, communities, and the planet
Drive Progress from within by helping simplify, scale, and modernize how a global biopharma business delivers smarter, faster, and more sustainably
Support teams across science, medicine, and operations by building better systems, shaping bold strategies, and enabling innovation at speed
Pursue Progress. Discover Extraordinary.
Progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. You can be one of those people. Chasing change, embracing new ideas and exploring all the opportunities we have to offer. Let’s pursue progress. And let’s discover Extraordinary together.

jobs.description:
Job Title: S2P Digital Process Specialist
Location: Hyderabad
About the job:
At Sanofi we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. We are dedicated to making a positive impact on the lives of the patients and families we serve, and we accomplish our goals through world-class research and with the compassion and commitment of our employees.
As we continue to transform the practice of medicine, the next chapter of Sanofi’s Play to Win strategy will require a focus on delivering transformation and simplification of our core processes, optimizing resource allocation and deployment to fuel business growth and investment in science.
To facilitate this transformation, a new Business Operations Business Unit is being established, bringing together existing business service activities, and driving further expansion of centralized services at scale into a global unit, with a focus on driving simplification, efficiency, and productivity.
This new Business Unit will enable the delivery of best-in-class business support capabilities across the organization, incorporating and engaging disparate teams from across areas such as R&D, M&S, the Corporate Functions and GBUs into new global Service Delivery Towers with initial services spanning Commercial, Finance, Procurement and People & Culture.
Reporting to the S2P Operational Strategy and Excellence Lead Hyderabad, the S2P Digital Process Specialist plays a critical role in supporting the development, execution, and transformation of Sanofi’s Source to Pay strategy. This role will directly involve ensuring the success of all S2P Initiatives involving Hyderabad S2P Global Service Delivery. This role also involves the development, governance S2P process in BPO and Hyderabad service delivery, supporting process standardization, optimization, and improvement initiatives across the organization's global operations. A significant part of this role will also involve BPO governance to make sure highest efficiency, CPIs, KPIs around S2P are met. In terms of collaboration and partnership, this role involves working closely with regional and local teams and BPO to meet Sanofi agreed S2P CPI/ KPI and in the process identify, develop, and implement best practices that further enhance efficiency, quality, and consistency of processes across S2P and integration with the rest of processes in S2P.
Main Responsibilities:
Process:
Provide input to GPL on improvement in S2P.
Promote standardized and harmonized ways of working in BPO with alignment to Core Model.
Support the implementation of Core Model deployment in regions and monitor Core Model gaps.
Review and propose changes to Core Model design documents to enhance continuous improvement, compliance, efficiency, and user experience.
Recommend change requests and exceptions to the Core Model for approval/rejection.
Contribute to updating desktop procedures and processing documentation.
Technology / Solution:
Support launches and use of digital solutions and new process technologies (e.g., Coupa Module, Concur, SAP, Agentic AI).
Work closely with Global Process Lead to improve core model process and feedback improvement.
Identify market trends, benchmarks, and best-in-class solutions to improve operational processes.
Provide options to improve solution usage, user experience, and automation as part of continuous improvement.
Strong proficiency in Advanced Excel, VBA/Macros, Basic SQL, and Python to support data analysis, reporting, and process improvements.
Ability to design and implement automation solutions that reduce manual effort, improve accuracy, and enhance operational efficiency.
Experience in Data Analytics and dashboard development, translating business requirements into actionable insights and technology-driven solutions.
Continuous Improvement Management:
Assist in executing core model improvement initiatives.
Contribute to project timelines, risks, issues, and escalations.
Ensure appropriate documentation is maintained and the continuous improvement process is followed.
Inform stakeholders about process changes and benefits.
Act with a mindset of continuous improvement and innovation within the organization.
Support S2P quality initiatives.
Stakeholder Management & Governance:
BPO management ensuring service delivery, core model and compliance.
Handling escalation from business and provide guidance to BPO in the process.
Resolve BPO challenge and provide insight to neighbouring partners to avoid similar challenges.
Involve stakeholders for project governance / incident / request / process resolution.
Provide process expertise to stakeholders either ad-hoc or during stakeholder meetings.
Ensure stakeholders are informed of the outcomes whenever required.
Ensure Internal control and compliance requirements are embedded in process designs.
Performance Reporting:
Working with GPL and contribute to the KPI/DQI/metrics definition and propose improvements if required.
Support implementation of KPIs in respective regions.
Monitor and review BPO reporting performance.
About you:
Required
Bachelor’s or similar degree in business, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
Proven experience (5+ year) in Source-to-Pay or Procure-to-Pay process ownership role.
Demonstrated experience in process optimization, standardization, and change management.
Additional certifications in process improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma) are an advantage.
Strong understanding of S2P processes at scale in a global context.
Strong leadership and interpersonal skills.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Strategic thinker with the ability to translate strategy into actionable plans.
Effective communicator with the ability to influence driving adoption of standardized S2P processes.
Fluent in English (spoken and written).
Ability to travel when required approximately 10% of the time.
Preferred
Experience in implementing source-to-pay technology solutions (e.g., e-procurement, spend analytics).
International experience working with diverse cultures and global teams.
Experience in working and managing BPO towards meeting KPI and process improvement.
Why choose us?
Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.
Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.
Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.
Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender-neutral parental leave.
Be part of an international collaborative team
Work for several sites and varied departments
Be involved in crucial statistical activities for the company like in the regulatory dossiers
Pursue Progress, discover Extraordinary.
Better is out there. Better medications, better outcomes, better science. But progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. So, let’s be those people.

From prevention to treatment, Sanofi transforms scientific innovation into healthcare solutions, in human vaccines, rare diseases, multiple sclerosis, oncology, immunology, infectious diseases, diabetes and cardiovascular solutions.

jobs.description:
Job title: Senior Scientific Writer – Health Economics and Value Assessment (HEVA)
Hiring Manager: Head/Group Lead/Team Lead HEVA
Location: Hyderabad
% of travel expected: Travel required as per business need
Job type: Permanent and Full time
About the job
Our Team:
Sanofi Global Hub (SGH) is an internal Sanofi resource organization based in India and is setup to centralize processes and activities to support Specialty Care, Vaccines, General Medicines, CHC, CMO, and R&D, Data & Digital functions. SGH strives to be a strategic and functional partner for tactical deliveries to Medical, HEVA, and Commercial organizations in Sanofi, Globally.
Main responsibilities:
The overall purpose and main responsibilities are listed below:
Create HEVA communications deliverables (including manuscripts, posters, abstracts, slide decks) aligned with HEVA strategy and global HEVA communication plan across relevant business units and product teams. Manage core HEVA communication processes, templates, and products across the portfolio in accordance with the scientific and value messages aligned with Core Value Dossier, the US AMCP Dossier, and HEVA contributions as appropriate to other submissions. Ensure Core Value Decks for key products are established and maintained, making available a regularly updated synthesis of critical HEVA evidence on the value of products. Maintain accountability for adherence to the publication standard operating procedure (SOP) and other compliance expectations relevant to HEVA communication processes. Seek opportunities to innovate HEVA value communications to increase the relevance and impact of HEVA evidence and inform optimal access and reimbursement decisions. Develop and maintain therapeutic area expertise. Coach junior HEVA writers and develop and review content created by them. Manage end to end process through iEnvision (previously, Datavision/Matrix). Collaborate effectively with stakeholders: HEVA, RWE, and Scientific communication global and/or local teams.
People: (1) Maintain effective relationships with the end stakeholders within the allocated GBU and product – with an end objective to develop education and communication content as per requirement for HEVA communications; (2) Interact effectively with healthcare professionals on publication content; and (3) Constantly assist other writers (junior) in developing knowledge and sharing learning
Performance: (1) Create HEVA communications deliverables (including manuscripts, posters, abstracts, and slide decks) aligned with HEVA strategy and global HEVA communication plan across relevant business units and product teams as per agreed timelines and quality; and (2) Provide strategic support with individuals and institutions, which may serve as resources for publications purpose, etc
Process: (1) Develop complex publications material; (2) Act as an expert in the field of medical communication for the assigned therapeutic area; (3) Assist the assigned scientific communication team in conducting comprehensive publication-needs analysis; (4) Manage core HEVA communication processes, templates, and products across the portfolio in accordance with the scientific and value messages aligned with Core Value Dossier, the US AMCP Dossier, and HEVA contributions as appropriate to other submissions; (5) Ensure Core Value Decks for key products are established and maintained, making available a regularly updated synthesis of critical HEVA evidence on the value of products; (6) Maintain accountability for adherence to the publication SOP and other compliance expectations relevant to HEVA communication processes; (7) Maintain accountability for adherence to the publication SOP and other compliance expectations relevant to HEVA communication processes; (8) Implement relevant element of publication plan and associated activities for the year identified for the region; (9) Work with selected vendors within the region to deliver the required deliverables as per defined process; and (10) Design an overall plan of action based on end-user feedback and improve course content and delivery
Stakeholder: (1) Work closely with HEVA global and local teams, RWE global and local teams and scientific communication teams in regions/areas to identify publications needs and assist in developing assigned deliverables; and (2) Liaise with HEVA global and local teams to prepare relevant and customized deliverables
About you
Experience: >4 years of experience in content creation for the pharmaceutical/healthcare industry, or academia
Soft skills: Stakeholder management; communication skills; and ability to work independently and within a team environment
Technical skills: Relevant training/experience in health economics, public health, epidemiology, or other relevant health-related scientific discipline (including but not limited to therapeutic area/domain knowledge exposure; knowledge of Good Publication Practice; publication submission; and/or project management)
Education: Advanced degree in life sciences/pharmacy/similar discipline or medical degree
Languages: Excellent knowledge of English language (spoken and written)

jobs.title: Senior Global Subject Matter Expert - GTMC ESM
jobs.description:
Job Title: Senior Global Subject Matter Expert - GTMC ESM
Hiring Manager: GTMC Performance Optimization Lead
Location: Hyderabad
Job type: Full time
About Sanofi
We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.
Our ambition: deliver best-in-class enterprise services enabling Sanofi to chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives. Sanofi has been building the foundations of enterprise services over the past few years. With the creation of the global business unit Business Operations two years ago, we have elevated our commitment to innovation and excellence.
About the Job
The Senior Global Subject Matter Expert - GTMC ESM is the primary senior subject matter expert and operational governance lead for the ESM capability across GTMC — translating the GTMC ESM Owner’s strategic direction into operational governance excellence, service delivery standards, and continuous capability improvement at global scale. This role carries senior-level accountability across all ESM dimensions — governance architecture, platform strategy, service excellence delivery standards, knowledge management, and change management & organizational adoption — acting as the recognized subject matter authority bridging Global Business Units (GBUs), GTMC leadership, and the Business Operations (BO) Service Excellence organization.
Spanning from enterprise governance policy to frontline service quality standards, this role, in close alignment with the GTMC ESM Owner, shapes the operational and governance direction of the ESM capability across GTMC's 4 core Pillars (I&A: Insights & Analytics, CXC: Customer Experience Capabilities, CFC: Customer Facing Capabilities, TRM: Trade & Revenue Management), defining how the platform is governed, how services are delivered, how knowledge is managed, and how organizational change and adoption are driven across GTMC. Working across organizational boundaries and in close partnership with the GTMC ESM Owner, this role contributes to building ESM capability and fosters a culture of excellence — ensuring the ESM platform evolves as a strategic, enterprise-grade asset that enables GTMC to deliver scalable, measurable, and future-ready service to its stakeholders.
This role carries a direct hands-on operational commitment: beyond strategic and governance responsibilities, the role holder is expected to personally contribute to operational execution alongside the team during peak demand periods, emergencies, and coverage needs.
Note: The scope of activities listed in this job description is not exhaustive. Responsibilities may evolve over time as the GTMC ESM program matures, as Sanofi's strategy evolves, and as new priorities emerge across the organization.
About Sanofi
We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.
Main Responsibilities
ESM GTMC Subject Matter Expertise & Governance
Serve as the primary senior subject matter expert and operational lead for all ESM matters across GTMC — spanning platform governance, service excellence delivery standards, and knowledge management — setting the accountability framework and operating standards that all pillars operate within
Own and continuously evolve the ESM demand governance policy and operating model: establishing intake criteria, validation standards, and structured escalation protocols to BO Service Excellence, with full traceability and strategic oversight
Maintain and enforce the ESM core model and governance policy across all GTMC pillars and geographies — upholding standards and driving compliance — ensuring full alignment with GPO/GPL frameworks at all times
Provide expert guidance on ESM scope, service management processes, and best practices to cross-functional teams
Support ESM governance forums, Capability Reviews, and QBRs at GTMC Leadership Team level — preparing strategic inputs, platform performance insights, and capability roadmap recommendations for GTMC and BO Leadership
Anticipate platform risks, escalate proactively, and develop mitigation plans with Service Excellence and IT governance
Contribute to shaping the GTMC ESM 1-3 year strategic capability roadmap — bringing platform evolution priorities, capability development milestones, and investment recommendations in alignment with Sanofi’s strategy
Support GTMC ESM representation at senior governance bodies and stakeholder forums, contributing deep subject matter expertise on platform direction and service management standards
Drive capability development and excellence standards across the ESM function — coaching practitioners, sharing subject matter expertise, and fostering a culture of ownership and continuous improvement
Data Administration & Business System Ownership
Maintain the governance framework and standards for all ESM configuration management activities (assignment groups, dropdown values, workflow updates, metadata, etc.), delegating execution to the team while maintaining strategic oversight and quality accountability
Own and maintain the data governance standards across all ESM GTMC modules; ensure alignment principles for master data management and hold organizational accountability for data quality outcomes
Lead Specifications Writing, Development, UAT & Hypercare phases (along with BO Service Excellence Team) for system updates, patches, and new module deployments — applying structured monitoring according to pharma/GxP requirements
Establish and govern the configuration documentation framework, change records, and data dictionaries — ensuring permanent audit readiness and full governance traceability across all ESM activities
Monitor data quality KPIs; initiate corrective actions when thresholds are breached
Govern strategic vendor and system integrator (SI) partnerships for all ESM platform activities — defining contractual standards, SLA governance frameworks, and senior-level vendor relationships to optimize platform value and delivery quality
Service Excellence & Knowledge Management Strategy
Translate strategic ESM governance intent into concrete service experience outcomes: ensuring platform decisions, data standards, and governance policies are consistently reflected in how support is delivered, cases are documented, and knowledge is produced at team level
Define and own the enterprise change adoption and onboarding strategy for Topic Owners and GTMC end users — establishing readiness standards, communication frameworks, and adoption measurement criteria aligned with pillar-level rollout plans
Own and monitor enterprise-level service quality and knowledge performance KPIs — including first-contact resolution rate, SLA adherence, self-service deflection, user satisfaction, and KB coverage — setting organizational targets and driving corrective actions when thresholds are breached
Define and own the Knowledge Base governance framework: content standards, quality review criteria, article approval workflows, and self-service deflection targets — ensuring the GTMC Knowledge Base evolves as a high-quality, continuously improving asset aligned with user needs
Own the L1 support quality framework: defining resolution protocols, SLA performance standards, case documentation requirements, and escalation criteria — setting the service delivery standard that governs how all GTMC support requests are handled across pillars
Change Agent
Lead MCO / Country onboarding to the GTMC ESM platform, ensuring full alignment with the core model from day one
Own and continuously evolve the global ESM onboarding governance framework: playbooks, readiness standards, activation criteria, and post-go-live governance protocols — ensuring all onboarding waves meet the established standards
Align BO Service Excellence and regional leads to resolve onboarding blockers and enforce core model standards — escalating decisions requiring senior validation at the appropriate organizational level
Drive stakeholder communication and training strategy for each onboarding wave
Contribute to leadership visibility on ESM adoption Progress — preparing adoption dashboards, escalation briefs, and risk summaries for timely decision-making at the appropriate organizational level
Embed change management practices into ESM governance routines and post-implementation reviews
Drive and continuously evolve the ESM adoption and change management strategy across all GTMC pillars and geographies, translating strategic objectives into scalable activation programs and building organizational readiness for sustained ESM maturity
Drive ESM Services process map definition and optimization across GTMC pillars, in partnership with pillar leads and BO Service Excellence — shaping the process architecture that governs how services are designed, delivered, and continuously improved
About You
Technical Skills
10+ years in leadership roles spanning enterprise technology strategy, service management transformation, and business operations at global scale, including a proven track record of leading ESM/ITSM programs in complex, multi-pillar organizations
Recognized authority in enterprise service management strategy, governance architecture, service excellence design, and knowledge management leadership — with a deep understanding of how ESM functions as a strategic enabler in large, global organizations
Proven track record governing ESM/ITSM platforms at scale (ServiceNow or equivalent), including platform strategy oversight, service quality governance, knowledge management frameworks, vendor governance, and executive-level performance reporting
Demonstrated ability to define enterprise KPI frameworks spanning governance, service quality, and knowledge management — translate organizational data into senior leadership strategic insights, and lead large-scale system transformation programs from strategy through sustained adoption
Experienced senior leader in Agile and scaled delivery methodologies, with a track record of steering enterprise technology programs and governing cross-functional delivery at pace across global organizations
Soft Skills
Exceptional executive communication and organizational influence at senior leadership level, with a demonstrated ability to shape enterprise decisions across complex, matrixed global environments
Structured analytical thinker with high attention to detail and strong problem-solving ability
Track record of securing senior leadership endorsement for strategic programs through compelling business cases, ROI articulation, and risk framing at the enterprise level
Highly autonomous senior leader — defines direction, resolves organizational ambiguity, and makes high-impact decisions with minimal oversight in complex, fast-moving global environments
Proven people leader with a track record of building and developing high-performing teams, creating organizational capability, and fostering a culture of ownership, excellence, and continuous improvement
Key Competencies
Enterprise Governance Architecture — architects and enforces ESM governance policies and standards that define how GTMC operates its service management capability
Platform Strategy & Evolution — contributes to shaping ESM platform strategy and drives investment priorities and capability evolution across all GTMC pillars
Executive Strategic Influence — informs and shapes strategic decisions at GTMC Leadership Team level through data-driven insights and senior stakeholder engagement
Continuous Improvement at Scale — architects systemic improvement programs, embedding a culture of excellence and innovation across the ESM function
Service Excellence Strategy — defines GTMC's service delivery framework, bridging governance intent with frontline quality and user experience outcomes
Knowledge Management Leadership — owns the GTMC knowledge management strategy, ensuring the Knowledge Base evolves as a high-quality self-service asset aligned with user needs
Customer Focus - designs governance that serves the end-user experience, not just compliance
Cross-Enterprise Leadership — drives alignment and shared outcomes across GBUs, GTMC, BO Service Excellence, and broader Sanofi stakeholders
Organizational Influence — builds ESM capability through coaching and expertise-sharing, fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement
Why choose us?
Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team
Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally
Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact
Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender-neutral parental leave
Make your work count by supporting a company that brings life-changing treatments to millions — and is committed to doing right by patients, communities, and the planet
Drive progress from within by helping simplify, scale, and modernize how a global biopharma business delivers smarter, faster, and more sustainably
Support teams across science, medicine, and operations by building better systems, shaping bold strategies, and enabling innovation at speed
Pursue Progress. Discover Extraordinary.
Progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. You can be one of those people. Chasing change, embracing new ideas and exploring all the opportunities we have to offer. Let’s pursue progress. And let’s discover Extraordinary together.

Sanofi’s Digital organization’s mission is to transform Sanofi into a data-first and AI first organization by empowering everyone with good data. Through custom developed AI products built on world class data foundations and platforms, the team builds value and a unique competitive advantage that scales across our markets, R&D and manufacturing sites. The team is located in major hubs in Paris, Lyon, Barcelona, Cambridge, Bridgewater and most recently, Toronto, with the aim of opening a new office in Hyderabad. Join a dynamic, fast paced and talented team, with world class mentorship, using AI to chase the miracle of science

jobs.description:
Overview
Role Summary
Our Solutions Engineering Physical IP team comprises some of the industry’s leading experts in deep submicron circuit design. This position is a wonderful opportunity for you to work with our custom standard cell design engineering team on innovative technologies. Your work will have a significant lasting impact as the designs will be used in Solutions Engineering products servicing the infrastructure, client, automotive, and IoT market segments.
In this role, you will be responsible for the layout development of Arm custom standard cells in the latest, sub-3nm process technology nodes. The ideal candidate will be an expert in standard cell layout, physical verification, and automation techniques. You will work in close collaboration with the circuit design team to provide optimally tuned layout, and validate them through QA flows that use a variety of tools. This role is crucial in delivering high-performance, area-optimized, and DRC-clean logic libraries for next-generation SoCs and custom digital IPs.
Key Responsibilities
Layout design of logic standard cells (inverters, muxes, flops cells, complex logic gates) optimized for performance, area, and power.
Work with automation and QA teams to support library validation flows.
Collaborate with circuit designers to understand schematics and translate them into clean, compact layouts.
Drive design rule clean (DRC) and layout vs. schematic (LVS) closure using industry-standard verification tools (e.g., Calibre ).
Perform layout debugging and root-cause analysis for DRC, LVS, and other physical sign-off issues.
Handle cell abutment, cell profiling, and cell integration constraints for logic libraries.
Address layout-dependent effects (LDE) and double patterning/EUV compliance in advanced nodes.
Review and debug standard cell physical views (LEF, GDS, abstract views) for integration into digital flows.
Automate layout QA, regression checks, and PDK-driven layout verifications using scripts (e.g., SKILL, Python).
Participate in library quality audits and delivery cycles including signoff package creation and documentation.
Required Skills and Experience
3+ years of custom layout experience in logic standard cell development.
Proven track record of working at 5nm, 3nm, or 2nm nodes with FinFET/GAA-based technologies.
Proficiency in Cadence Virtuoso.
Deep understanding of advanced DRC rules, LVS methodologies, and multi-patterning constraints.
Solid experience in cell layout optimization for PPA (Power, Performance, Area).
Strong grip on pin accessibility, cell architecture trade-offs, and physical synthesis-aware design.
Automate layout-related tasks and workflows using scripting languages like Python, PERL, SKILL, and TCL.
Maintain accurate documentation of layout designs, changes, and verification results.
Working knowledge of version control, configuration management, and flow automation
Make effective use of AI tools and automation to improve productivity, accelerate learning, and enhance the quality of technical solutions
Strong documentation and communication skills to interface with cross-functional teams (PDK, design, QA).
Stay updated on best practices for standard cell layout, design rules, and advanced node requirements.

Exposure to physical design implementation flow

Hard-working and excellent time management skills with an ability to multi-task
An upbeat demeanor to working on exciting projects on the cutting edge of technology
