Optimize device placement, diffusion sharing, routing and pin accessibility to achieve compact and robust layouts.

Consider reliability requirements such as current density, electromigration and routing robustness during implementation.
Perform layout quality checks and participate in peer reviews.
Review straightforward layout work produced by other engineers where required.
Work with circuit designers to identify practical solutions to layout-related implementation challenges.
Manage assigned workload, communicate progress and identify potential technical or schedule risks.
Support development of less-experienced engineers through knowledge sharing and occasional on-the-job guidance.
Contribute to continuous improvement of layout practices and team workflows.

CMOS transistor-level circuit layout
Schematic interpretation
Stick-diagram development
Transistor placement and diffusion optimization
DRC and LVS
Physical-verification debugging
Design Rule Manual interpretation
Parasitic resistance and capacitance
Basic EM/current-density considerations
Layout-dependent effects
PPA-aware physical implementation
Semiconductor manufacturing/process fundamentals

Complete straightforward layout assignments with minimal or no supervision.
Take ownership of assigned layouts from initial implementation through physical-verification closure.
Make sound engineering decisions using established methodology and previous experience.
Independently troubleshoot common layout and verification problems.
Recognize when a problem requires specialist or senior-level input.
Balance layout quality, area, performance and schedule requirements.
Communicate technical information clearly within the engineering team.
Work effectively with circuit designers and related engineering teams.
Provide constructive peer-review feedback.
Consistently deliver accurate, high-quality work within agreed schedules.
Use AI tools as a normal engineering productivity aid while retaining ownership of technical decisions, verification and final deliverables.
Education / Experience :
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, VLSI, Microelectronics, Semiconductor Engineering or equivalent practical experience. Professional experience in custom IC, standard-cell, memory, analog or related transistor-level layout design is preferred.

Responsibilities:
As a creative design engineer with a strong understanding of subsystems and SoC architectures, you will be part of a team responsible for developing advanced subsystems and SoCs.
You will work closely with the architecture team to understand system requirements and drive the development of microarchitecture specifications for one or more SoC infrastructure areas such as clocking, reset, debug, power management, interconnect and interrupts.
You will take technical ownership of RTL development and integration for assigned subsystems or SoC infrastructure components, driving design quality and timely delivery.
Your key responsibilities will include preparing RTL designs for hardware emulation and FPGA prototyping, fixing bugs, running various design checks, supporting emulation compilation, bring-up, and debugging.
You will work closely with verification and emulation teams to review test plans and drive resolution of complex design, connectivity, configuration and emulation bring-up issues.
You will also contribute to developing and enhancing the design methodologies used by the team.
You will support other members of the team as needed to enable the successful completion of project activities.
You will balance other opportunities such as working with Project Management on activities, plans, and schedules.

Experience developing microarchitecture and design specifications for SoC infrastructure, with strong technical knowledge in one or more areas such as clocking, reset, debug, power management, interconnect and interrupts

Strong understanding of current design techniques used in complex SoC development

Strong written, verbal, presentation and cross-functional collaboration skills
Experience with Perl, Python or other scripting languages

Experience developing subsystems for Interconnect, DDR/LPDDR, HBM, UCIe

jobs.title: Senior Staff Engineer Software
jobs.description:
Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
Who We Are
In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
Job Summary
Job Summary
We are seeking a Senior Staff Software Engineer to own medium-sized features in our connectors framework from design through production. You will work independently on diverse problems, finding simple solutions that ensure the framework remains highly maintainable. In this role, you will write comprehensive feature designs, refactor modules with a strong grasp of overall architecture, and mentor junior engineers. Your impact will directly shape how accurately and reliably identity data reaches our product.
Key Responsibilities
Own and take medium-sized framework features from design to production, including checkpointing and rate limiting.
Write functional and design specifications for features, advocating for your design decisions during reviews.
Break down ambiguous or complex requirements into simple, well-scoped pieces to ensure continuous progress.
Refactor and rewrite framework modules and services, optimizing for performance, deployment, and debugging.
Build features that handle deletions, partial failures, and retries to protect data accuracy and identity inventory.
Debug complex framework issues and customer escalations, collaborating with senior engineers and product managers.
Develop AI-assisted workflows and rigorously evaluate AI-generated code to prevent security gaps and logic defects.
Implement secure engineering practices by correctly handling customer credentials, tokens, and tenant isolation.
Mentor junior engineers on code quality, testing methodologies, and comprehensive documentation.
Deliver on project commitments and timelines by making sensible and effective engineering trade-offs.
Qualifications

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Time & Attendance
jobs.description:
Overview
Small businesses drive the global economy. In the US, SMBs employ 60% of the labor force and create 80% of new jobs. However, the stakes are high, as 1 in 2 businesses will fail to survive within their first five years. In an environment where time is money, precise time tracking for payroll, invoicing, and project management is the critical lever for maintaining profitability and growing the business.
Within QuickBooks, our Workforce platform fuels productivity for growing teams — from time tracking and scheduling to project management and field operations. With 30M+ employees in the QuickBooks ecosystem and 18M paid through Workforce Solutions, we are building the essential tools that empower frontline teams and help businesses turn time into money.
Opportunity
We are seeking a Staff Product Manager to lead the verticalization of QuickBooks Time. You’ll make our time tracking platform the system of record for hours, labor cost, and payroll in the industries where labor is the highest cost, starting with construction and field services. Time is the source of hours for the entire QuickBooks ecosystem. Customers use the hours their teams track to run payroll, bill for their work, and understand whether each job is making money, and the mid-market businesses we serve need all three to work together without spreadsheets or re-entry.
This is a high-ownership role. You will own three connected areas end to end: time to payroll, so approved hours, overtime, and pay items flow into QuickBooks Payroll accurately and automagically; job costing, so every hour tracked produces labor cost estimates against projects and budgets before payroll runs and accurate actuals after it; and worker time tracking across Workforce Web, Workforce Kiosk, and the Workforce mobile app, where millions of workers track their time. You will build on Time 2.0, our rebuilt time platform that now lives inside QuickBooks Online, and extend it so that serving a new industry is mostly configuration rather than new code.
We need a scrappy, customer-obsessed product leader who leads through influence. Someone who navigates dependencies across Payroll, Projects, Mid-Market, and Payments, earns the trust and confidence of our customers and accountants, and ships experiences that delight both the worker clocking in on a job site and the admin who approves time and runs payroll.
Responsibilities
Responsibilities
Vertical Strategy. Own the multi-year roadmap for verticalizing QuickBooks Time, starting with construction and field services. Translate how each industry runs its labor (jobs, cost codes, phases, and certified payroll on a construction site; jobs, visits, and dispatch in field services) into shared platform concepts and configurable experiences, so that each new vertical is mostly configuration rather than new code. Decide what we build, what we configure, and where partner integrations fill the gap.
Time to Payroll. Own the flow of hours from clock-in to paycheck. Make approved time, overtime and break policies, and pay items land in QuickBooks Payroll accurately and automatically, with no exports, syncs, or re-entry, and make approvals fast and trustworthy for a mid-market company with hundreds of employees.
Job Costing: Estimates and Actuals. Deliver real-time labor costing that owners, project managers, and accountants trust. Partner with Projects, Payroll, and Accounting so that time is the single source of hours for payroll, invoicing, and profitability reporting.
Worker Time Tracking. Own how workers track time across Workforce Web, Workforce Kiosk, and the Workforce mobile app, where millions of workers already track their hours. Deliver one consistent, reliable experience for clocking in and out, breaks, schedules, geofencing, and job and task selection that holds up on a job site with poor connectivity and for crews whose first language is not English, and complete the migration of workers off legacy TSheets surfaces onto the new platform.
Commercial Impact. Own the metrics for your area: Time adoption within Workforce Premium and Elite offerings, attached in mid-market and industry editions. Plus worker engagement across web, kiosk, and mobile. Use data and customer evidence to prioritize, measure what ships, and make Time and real-time job costing a central part of how QuickBooks is sold to construction and field services customers, a market where competitors generate $150M+ ARR.
Operational Velocity. Run the end-to-end product lifecycle for your area: write crisp requirements, pressure-test designs, manage edge cases, and drive alignment across engineering, design, data, go-to-market, and customer success teams in the US and India. You lead through influence rather than authority, and you are fluent in AI-native tools like Claude and Cursor, using them to move faster from insight to shipped product.
Customer Empathy. Be the voice of the business owner, the payroll admin, and the frontline worker. Spend time with customers on their job sites and with the accountants who recommend HCM products to their clients, and make sure every feature removes a real pain point in how they bid, schedule, track, pay, and get paid.
Qualifications
Qualifications
A Product Leader. 8+ years of product management craft, including ownership of a complex, multi-team product area as a senior individual contributor. You have a proven track record of building and scaling customer-facing products in HCM, workforce management, construction or field service software, or fintech.
Strategic & Influential. You possess strong executive presence, translating market and customer insight into a strategy and roadmap that align senior stakeholders and technical teams. You make bold bets and bring partner teams along without direct authority.
Domain Depth. You understand how labor-intensive businesses run: how hours become payroll, how time, cost rates, and pay types become job costs, and how estimates compare to actuals. Experience with payroll, time and attendance, job costing, or construction and field service workflows is a strong advantage.
A Proven Growth Driver. You have a track record of spearheading complex initiatives that deliver measurable business growth. You understand the levers of adoption, attach, ARPC, and retention, and you use them to prioritize and to drive P&L growth.
An Ambitious Problem Solver. You proactively anticipate customer and stakeholder needs, thrive in ambiguity and turn complex, messy friction into clear roadmaps. You are scrappy and effective at managing a portfolio of bets across the lifecycle, from 0-1 innovations to products at scale. You know when to push forward and when to pivot based on evidence and stakeholder feedback.
Customer Obsessed & Analytical. You possess deep empathy for small and mid-market business operations and frontline workforce challenges. You combine this heart with rigorous analytical aptitude, storytelling with data to prioritize investments.
Technical Fluency. You demonstrate strong product judgment and comfort engaging across technical topics to build reliable web, mobile, and kiosk products on a shared platform, including APIs, data models, and integrations with payroll and accounting systems. Experience with agentic AI, payment systems, or HCM platforms is an advantage.
Education. BA or BS degree is required, and an MBA or advanced degree is preferred.

Job Description:
At Cloudera, we empower people to transform complex data into clear and actionable insights. With as much data under management as the hyperscalers, we're the preferred data partner for the top companies in almost every industry. Powered by the relentless innovation of the open source community, Cloudera advances digital transformation for the world’s largest enterprises.
About Octopai
Octopai is a fast-growing Data Intelligence company (Acquired by Cloudera) that empowers enterprises to understand, trust, and optimize their data. Our platform provides automated data lineage, cataloging, and discovery to accelerate analytics, improve governance, and drive business impact.
As we expand our platform capabilities and evolve our next-generation APIs and metadata modeling foundation, we are looking for an experienced Tech Lead to guide the architecture and development of Octopai’s core modeling and API layer.
Role Overview
As a Senior Staff Software Engineer (Modeling, APIs), you will combine hands-on engineering with deep technical leadership, owning the design and evolution of Octopai’s metadata modeling, domain structures, and API infrastructure.
You will drive architectural decisions around how Octopai represents data assets, lineage relationships, governance concepts, and integrations — and how these are exposed through scalable, enterprise-ready APIs.
This role requires strong backend and distributed systems expertise, plus the ability to lead engineers in building robust foundations that power both our SaaS platform and enterprise deployments.
As a Senior Staff Software Engineer you will:
Lead the backend engineering team in designing, developing, and delivering Octopai’s modeling and API infrastructure.
Own the architecture of Octopai’s metadata model, including representation of data assets, transformations, lineage, governance, and operational metadata.
Define technical direction and best practices for API versioning, extensibility, and enterprise-grade integrations.
Collaborate closely with Product and leadership to translate platform requirements into scalable modeling and API solutions.
Provide mentorship and day-to-day technical guidance, fostering strong practices such as TDD, CI/CD, peer reviews, and clean architecture.
Ensure API security, performance, and reliability across hybrid (SaaS + on-premise) deployments.
Drive development of SDKs, documentation standards, and partner-facing integration frameworks.
Partner with infrastructure and DevOps teams to ensure APIs are deployable, observable, and maintainable in complex enterprise environments.
Represent the Modeling & APIs domain in cross-team architectural forums, influencing platform evolution and roadmap priorities.
We are excited if you have:
12+ years of backend engineering experience, with at least 2+ years in a leadership role.
Proven experience leading the design and development of API-first platforms, domain modeling systems, or core backend infrastructure.
Strong programming expertise in C# (.NET), Java and familiarity with modern backend design patterns.
Hands-on experience designing RESTful APIs, distributed services, and scalable backend architectures.
Strong understanding of data modeling concepts, including metadata systems, graph-based relationships, or domain-driven design.
Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, ArangoDB, or similar), and messaging/streaming systems (Kafka, Redis, etc.).
Familiarity with API lifecycle management: versioning, backward compatibility, governance, and developer experience.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to mentor engineers, influence stakeholders, and align teams on platform strategy.\
You may also have:
Experience in data lineage, metadata management, or data intelligence platforms.
Background in graph databases and modeling complex relationships across enterprise systems.
Familiarity with OpenAPI standards, API gateways, and partner integration ecosystems.
Knowledge of search systems (ElasticSearch/Solr, full-text search) and modeling-driven discovery.
Contributions to open-source projects or experience scaling backend architecture in high-growth companies.

BA/BS degree and 4-6 years’ relevant experience OR equivalent combination of education and experience

Strong SQL skills, including data extraction, transformation, and manipulation.
Solid understanding of data modeling concepts and experience with database management systems.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a keen attention to detail.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

Proven track record of delivering high-quality, accurate, and actionable insights from data analysis.

jobs.title: Accountant
jobs.description:
Your work days are brighter here.
We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.
About the Team
The Workday Corporate Accounting team drives accuracy and transparency across day-to-day accounting activities to ensure consistent financial reporting while driving operational efficiency through system optimization and process automation. As a multifaceted group of professionals, we actively support strategic growth projects, including accounting for new entities. We foster continuous learning and cross-training to broaden domain knowledge and keep team motivation high. Above all, we value a strong work culture, we work hard, have fun, and prioritize a healthy work-life balance
About the Role
The Corporate Accounting team is looking for a highly motivated Accountant to join a collaborative and growing team. You will report to the Manager, Corporate Accounting (Shared Services). You're a self-starter who is curious and brings excellent attention to detail to everything you do. In this role, you will take on a mix of operational activities, monthly close procedures, and process improvement work that keeps our accounting engine running smoothly.
Responsibilities:
Bank Reconciliation & Cash Management: Perform daily and monthly reconciliations of all corporate bank accounts against GL ledgers; post FX journals, bank fees, and interest income while driving daily clearing of open line items by coordinating with AP, AR, and payroll teams.
Prepayment Accounting: Research purchase orders and vendor contracts to verify invoice terms, classify prepayment transactions, and maintain accurate monthly amortization schedules.
Accrual & Month-End Close Management: Calculate, verify, and post monthly journal entries for various expense accruals, perform other close activities in accordance with the close schedule to ensure full accounting compliance.
Balance sheet reconciliation: Prepare and review monthly balance sheet reconciliations, post recurring and month-end journal entries, research and resolve reconciling variances in a timely manner, investigate and support internal and external audit requests. Support internal and external audit requests by preparing supporting schedules, balance sheet roll-forwards, and transaction documentation. Perform flux/variance analysis on key GL accounts.
Audit, Compliance & SOX Testing: Participate directly in SOX controls testing, internal audits, and external audits by preparing supporting schedules, transaction documentation, and responding to requests in a timely and appropriate manner
Process Improvement & Project Representation: Drive continuous process improvements across cash, prepaid and expense accounting and reduce close cycle times.
Conduct ad hoc financial analyses and actively contribute to management-led strategic projects and initiatives.
About You
Basic Qualifications
Master’s degree in accounting, Finance, or a related field with a strong focus on accounting.
5+ years of progressive accounting experience, ideally managing accounting operations within a fast-growing company.
Other Qualifications
Industry background: Background in public accounting, software, or the SaaS industry is highly preferred.
Technical accounting expertise: In-depth knowledge of U.S. GAAP and standard accounting principles, with strong expertise in account analysis and balance sheet reconciliations.
Systems and analytical skills: Hands-on experience with an enterprise-grade ERP system and advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel. Proven analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a strong focus on financial controlling and process improvements.
Communication and collaboration: Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, with experience working effectively across global, cross-functional teams and internal business units. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, so you can present financial information clearly.
Work approach and adaptability: Ability to manage tight deadlines and prioritize tasks while staying highly organized, detailed, and accurate. A collaborative team player who is eager to learn, adapt, and take on new challenges in a dynamic environment.
Our Approach to Flexible Work
With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in-office each week, we simply spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.

Any employee who retaliates against a candidate or employee for doing so may be subject to disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment, to the fullest extent allowable under applicable law.
If you require a reasonable accommodation, you may email accommodations@workday.com, as far in advance as possible.
Are you being referred to one of our roles? If so, ask your connection at Workday about our Employee Referral process!
At Workday, we value our candidates’ privacy and data security. Workday will never ask candidates to apply to jobs through websites that are not Workday Careers.
Please be aware of sites that may ask for you to input your data in connection with a job posting that appears to be from Workday but is not.
In addition, Workday will never ask candidates to pay a recruiting fee, or pay for consulting or coaching services, in order to apply for a job at Workday.

jobs.title: Engineer III - Cloud
jobs.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.
About the Role:
We're hiring a Software Engineer to design, develop, and maintain SOAR connectors that integrate third-party security platforms with Falcon Fusion, and build/maintain platform services that provide core orchestration and workflow capabilities to all users of CrowdStrike's flagship Falcon Platform.
Falcon Fusion – a core 'tier one' offering in our Flagship Platform, Falcon – is used by customers to automate breach remediations within their environments. It also serves as the runtime for apps built by our Foundry Module and is 'dogfooded' internally to automate workflows and accelerate development. Processing anywhere from 500M to 10B+ events per day, it is utilized by essentially every customer of the Falcon Platform.
This role is for an experienced backend microservices developer adept with cloud engineering principles. Your passion and meticulous attention to performance, reliability, and scalability will be key ingredients to your success at CrowdStrike.
What You'll Do:
Build production-grade SOAR connectors that integrate security platforms (SIEM, EDR, ticketing, IAM) with Falcon Fusion at scale, and contribute to core platform services powering connector execution, authentication, and orchestration.
You'll own connectors end-to-end—from API research through deployment and production support—while improving underlying platform capabilities (auth systems, testing frameworks, deployment pipelines).
Research, evaluate, and integrate new security platforms and APIs to expand our connector portfolio.
Develop both connectors and platform services working with complex authentication mechanisms (OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, API keys).
Build and maintain automated testing frameworks and CI/CD pipelines to ensure connector quality and reliability across multi-region deployments.
Troubleshoot and resolve production issues with existing connectors and platform services, taking operational ownership across our fleet of Falcon environments.
Write technical documentation including integration guides, API specifications, and troubleshooting runbooks.
What You'll Need:
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent work experience.
6+ years of experience designing, implementing, and maintaining software systems across all phases of the development lifecycle, preferably in a SaaS model.
Fluency in at least one programming language, preferably Python or Go.
Proven expertise in building distributed systems, microservices, and REST APIs.
Experience developing applications using SQL and NoSQL databases.
Hands-on experience in large-scale system architecture, high scalability, availability, and optimization.
Demonstrated track record of operational excellence when operating services that span many components across several geographical regions
Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.
Strong communication skills with a track record of working collaboratively across stakeholders.
Bonus Points:
Experience with commercial cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
Contributions to open-source communities.
Hands-on Golang experience.
Prior experience with (cybersecurity) platforms or integrations.

Paid parental and adoption leaves

jobs.description:
Job Details | Atlassian
Principal Data Engineer
Analytics & Data Science | Bengaluru, India | Remote, Remote
Apply for this job
Working at Atlassian
Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
Atlassian is looking for a Principal Data Engineer to join our Data Engineering Team and play a tech lead & architect role to build world-class data solutions and applications that power crucial business decisions throughout the organization. We are looking for an open-minded, structured thinker who is passionate about building systems at scale. You will enable a world-class engineering practice, drive the approach with which we use data, develop backend systems and data models to serve the needs of insights and play an active role in building Atlassian's data-driven culture.
Own the technical evolution of the data engineering capabilities and be responsible for ensuring solutions are being delivered incrementally, meeting outcomes, and promptly escalating risks and issues
Establish a deep understanding of how things work in data engineering, use this to direct and coordinate the technical aspects of work across data engineering, and systematically improve productivity across the teams.
Maintain a high bar for operational data quality and proactively address performance, scale, complexity and security considerations.
Drive complex decisions that can impact the work in data engineering. Set the technical direction and balance customer and business needs with long-term maintainability & scale.
Understand and define the problem space, and architect solutions. Coordinate a team of engineers towards implementing them, unblocking them along the way if necessary.
Lead a team of data engineers through mentoring and coaching, work closely with the engineering manager, and provide consistent feedback to help them manage and grow the team
Work with close counterparts in other departments as part of a multi-functional team, and build this culture in your team.
Qualifications
At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
On Your First Day, We'll Expect
You have 12+ years of experience in a Data Engineer role as an individual contributor.
You have at least 2 years of experience as a tech lead for a Data Engineering team.
You are an engineer with a track record of driving and delivering large (multi-person or multi-team) and complex efforts.
You are a great communicator and maintain many of the essential cross-team and cross-functional relationships necessary for the team's success.
Experience with building streaming pipelines with a micro-services architecture for low-latency analytics.
Experience working with varied forms of data infrastructure, including relational databases (e.g. SQL), Spark, and column stores (e.g. Redshift)

Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
What’s Encouraged Daily:
Contribute to the development of new HBM products by assisting with the overall design, and layout.
· Interpret product specifications and design circuits to meet the required functionality.
· Design, implementation, and improvement of Complex Analog Mixed Circuits such as CMOS Amplifiers, Comparators, Bandgap references, V2I converters, LDOs, charge pumps, Oscillators, DLL, IO circuits (DDR/LPDDR), Delays, Process and temperature sensors in advanced semiconductor process nodes for advanced High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) products
· Integration of modules with Power delivery network and propose design solution for optimum performance
· Deep understanding of Array and its peripheral circuits.
· Driving innovation into the future Memory generations within a dynamic work environment
· Validate & optimize design for reliability (Device stress, Aging effect)
· EM/IR simulation, optimize layout to achieve best circuit performance
· Custom digital circuit design & validation
· Parasitic modeling and assisting in design validation, reticle experiments and required tape-out revisions
· Overseeing and managing the layout process including floor-planning, placement, and routing
· Performing verification processes with modeling and simulation using industry standard simulators
· Contributing to cross group communication to work towards standardization and group success
· Working with Marketing, Probe, Assembly, Test, Process Integration, and Product Engineering groups to ensure accurate manufacturability of product
· Proactively solicit guidance from Standards, CAD, modeling, and verification groups to improve the design quality
· Participate in new circuit conception and design as needed
· Perform circuit simulations using standard industry simulators such as FINESIM, HSPICE, and VERILOG
· Responsible for reliability and degradation verification.
· Assist in design validation, reticle experiments, and required tape-out revisions
· Contributes expert technical knowledge to advance innovative technical solutions
· Provides advice and counsel to senior management on significant technical issues
AI Usage
Also, strong AI proficiency, a solid understanding of agentic AI models, and effective use of tools such as Claude are expected to significantly improve engineering efficiency, enhance PPA (Power, Performance, Area) optimization, and accelerate overall delivery timelines.

jobs.title: Communications & People Engagement Lead
jobs.description:
Communications & People Engagement Lead
Description -
The Communications & People Engagement Lead is a strategic partner responsible for shaping organizational culture, driving employee engagement, strengthening leadership communications, and enabling successful change adoption across the Global Customer Care Centers (CCC) organization.
This role serves as the connective tissue between leadership, employees, and business priorities assuring that communication is not merely informational, but transformational. The individual will design and execute integrated communication, engagement, culture, recognition, and change management strategies that foster connection, transparency, inclusion, and organizational effectiveness across a globally distributed workforce.
The role requires a highly creative, customer-centric, and influential communications professional capable of translating business priorities into meaningful employee experiences that build trust, drive alignment, accelerate adoption of change, and strengthen employee commitment to organizational goals.
Working closely with Customer Care Center leadership, Operations, Quality, Training, HR, Communications, and other business stakeholders, the Communications & People Engagement Lead will help build a connected, resilient, engaged, and future-ready workforce while elevating employee experience across all care center locations.
Key Responsibilities
1. Strategic Communications
Organizational Communications Strategy
Develop and execute integrated communications strategies aligned to CCC business priorities, transformation initiatives, and organizational objectives.
Serve as the primary communications advisor to CCC leadership, shaping messaging that drives clarity, engagement, and alignment.
Build annual communication roadmaps and engagement calendars supporting strategic priorities.
Ensure consistent, timely, and effective communication across global teams, sites, and functions.
Establish communication standards, governance, and best practices across the organization.
Executive & Leadership Communications
Develop executive-level messaging, presentations, speeches, town halls, leadership updates, and employee communications.
Support leadership engagement sessions, all-employee meetings, fireside chats, podcasts, and interactive forums.
Partner with leaders to strengthen visibility, accessibility, and connection with employees.
Coach leaders on communication effectiveness, storytelling, and employee engagement approaches.
Communication Content Management
Own and manage end-to-end communication channels and content strategies.
Create and distribute:
Newsletters
Leadership updates
Internal campaigns
Employee stories
Organizational announcements
Transformation communications
Recognition communications
Ensuring content reflects organizational values, culture, and customer-focused priorities.
2. Storytelling, Branding & Employee Advocacy
Strategic Storytelling
Develop compelling narratives that connect employees to purpose, customers, business outcomes, and organizational strategy.
Translate complex business concepts into engaging, relatable, and actionable content.
Create storytelling frameworks that highlight innovation, customer impact, quality, transformation, and employee success.
Employee & Customer Impact Stories
Identify and amplify stories showcasing employee contributions, customer outcomes, operational excellence, and business impact.
Partner with leaders and teams to celebrate achievements and successes across geographies.
Build internal advocacy programs that increase employee pride and organizational connection.
Creative Content Development
Lead innovative communication approaches leveraging:
Visual storytelling
Infographics
Video communications
Digital campaigns
Podcasts
Interactive experiences
Executive narratives
Employee spotlights
Social and collaboration platforms
3. Employee Engagement & Culture
Employee Experience Strategy
Design and implement programs that strengthen employee engagement, belonging, motivation, and connection.
Partner with HR and leadership teams to improve employee experience across the employee lifecycle.
Develop initiatives that align employee sentiment with organizational goals and values.
Recognition & Appreciation Programs
Lead enterprise recognition strategies that celebrate performance, innovation, customer obsession, teamwork, and cultural excellence.
Establish scalable global recognition programs and engagement events.
Drive employee appreciation initiatives that reinforce desired organizational behaviors.
Inclusion, Belonging & Community
Champion an inclusive culture where all employees feel valued, respected, and empowered.
Build engagement initiatives that foster collaboration across countries, cultures, functions, and teams.
Partner with employee resource groups and community networks to create meaningful employee experiences.
Employee Listening Programs
Design and manage employee listening strategies including:
Pulse surveys
Focus groups
Listening sessions
Engagement assessments
Sentiment analysis
Translate employee feedback into actionable recommendations.
Ensure leadership accountability through continuous feedback loops and action planning.
4. Change Management & Organizational Adoption
Management of Change (MoC)
Lead communication and engagement workstreams supporting organizational transformation programs.
Develop comprehensive change communication strategies and adoption plans.
Ensure employees understand the rationale, benefits, risks, and impacts of transformation initiatives.
Change Communications
Create and implement communication plans covering:
Business rationale for change
Strategic objectives
Employee impacts
New ways of working
Adoption expectations
Success outcomes
Ongoing progress updates
Change Champion Network
Build and manage global networks of change champions.
Enable champions with training, messaging, communication assets, and engagement tools.
Drive local advocacy and adoption across regions and teams.
Adoption & Readiness Management
Measure awareness, readiness, engagement, and adoption of key initiatives.
Identify resistance points and engagement risks.
Develop mitigation strategies and targeted interventions.
Track organizational readiness and communication effectiveness.
5. Leadership Engagement & Organizational Effectiveness
Leadership Partnership
Act as a trusted advisor to senior leaders on employee engagement, communications, culture, and change initiatives.
Provide insights and recommendations that improve organizational effectiveness and employee connection.
Employee Engagement Events
Lead planning and execution of:
Global All Employee Meetings
Leadership forums
Town halls
Engagement weeks
Recognition ceremonies
Cultural celebrations
Volunteer and community activities
Learning and development events
Global Collaboration
Foster collaboration across sites, partners, suppliers, and functional organizations.
Encourage sharing of best practices, knowledge, and organizational success stories.
6. Employee Relations & Interpersonal Effectiveness
Employee Advocacy
Champion employee concerns, perspectives, and ideas.
Promote transparent communication and trust across the organization.
Active Listening & Empathy
Create environments where employees feel heard, respected, and supported.
Strengthen leadership understanding of employee needs and experiences.
Conflict Resolution & Engagement Support
Facilitate constructive dialogue and partnership across teams.
Support resolution of communication, engagement, and adoption challenges.
Promote collaboration and positive working relationships.
Success Measures
Performance will be measured through:
Communication Excellence
Employee awareness and understanding of organizational priorities.
Communication reach, engagement, and effectiveness.
Leadership communication satisfaction metrics.
Quality and timeliness of communication delivery.
Employee Engagement
Improvements in engagement and sentiment indicators.
Participation in engagement programs and activities.
Recognition program adoption and impact.
Employee advocacy and connection measures.
Change Adoption
Change readiness and adoption of metrics.
Effectiveness of change communication programs.
Champion network participation and influence.
Achievement of transformation communication objectives.
Culture & Leadership Impact
Improved employee trust and leadership connectivity.
Stronger culture of transparency, inclusion, and recognition.
Increased alignment to organizational vision and goals.
Enhanced employee experience outcomes.
Qualifications & Experience
Education
Bachelor’s degree in communications, Public Relations, Marketing, Human Resources, Organizational Development, Business Administration, Journalism, or related discipline.
Master's degree preferred.
Experience
8–12+ years of experience in Communications, Employee Engagement, Internal Communications, Organizational Development, Change Management, Human Resources, or related fields.
Experience supporting global and matrixed organizations.
Proven track record managing enterprise communication and engagement programs.
Experience supporting organizational transformation and change adoption initiatives.
Critical Skills & Competencies
Professional Skills
Executive and organizational communications
Internal communications strategy
Employee engagement and experience
Change management
Strategic storytelling
Event management
Stakeholder management
Program and project management
Communication analytics and insights
Content creation and digital communications
Leadership Competencies
Influencing without authority
Strategic thinking
Business acumen
Customer obsession
Relationship building
Emotional intelligence
Collaboration and partnership
Creativity and innovation
Resilience and adaptability
Inclusive leadership
Role Impact Statement
The Communications & People Engagement Lead transforms communication into a strategic business capability—connecting people to purpose, enabling organizational change, strengthening culture, elevating employee experience, and building a highly engaged, resilient, customer-obsessed workforce across the Global Customer Care Centers organization.

jobs.title: Digital Design Apprenticeship (Standard Cell Library Characterization)
jobs.description:
We Are:
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
Apprenticeship Experience:
At Synopsys, Apprentices dive into real-world projects, gaining hands-on experience while collaborating with our passionate teams worldwide—and having fun in the process! You'll have the freedom to share your ideas, unleash your creativity, and explore your interests. This is your opportunity to bring your solutions to life and work with cutting-edge technology that shapes not only the future of innovation but also your own career path. Join us and start shaping your future today!
What You'll Be Doing:
Run transistor-level simulations on digital standard cells using PrimeSim or FineSim to extract timing, power, and leakage data across PVT corners.

Solid knowledge of digital logic design including combinational and sequential circuits, timing concepts like setup, hold, recovery, and removal.
Familiarity with at least one circuit simulator such as PrimeSim or FineSim, and the ability to read and debug transistor-level schematics.

The Company
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.
Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

As an iOS Software Engineer, you will build and maintain the PayPal POS app that small businesses use every day to take payments, run checkout and manage their shop. Zettle SMB Direct is the part of PayPal that builds the native point-of-sale experience for small and medium-sized businesses: the PayPal POS app (formerly Zettle Go) and the Zettle Terminal. Build and ship features in Swift using modern concurrency; UIKit and SwiftUI as the product requires.
Integrate with backend services over REST and GraphQL; handle auth and session flows.
Work with Bluetooth reader connectivity (Core Bluetooth) and Apple payment frameworks under guidance.

Pair with Sweden engineers and write documentation and runbooks for areas you take over.

Experience with unit and UI testing and CI/CD pipelines for mobile apps.
Understanding of secure handling of sensitive data on device.
Interest in payments; experience with in-app payments, Bluetooth peripherals or NFC is a plus.

Curiosity about payments and a sense of care for the merchants and customers who depend on the product.

This is an exciting opportunity for you to join Mastercard and contribute to improving the response time for new applications that support the Mastercard Settings program. We are looking for an experienced engineer that is passionate about performance with a constant focus on improving system quality.

• Design, configure, and execute performance tests and drive resolution of failures
• Create performance measurements such as requests per second, P95 and P99 response latency, query performance, concurrency, and system utilization
• Dig into Java code, databases, middleware, and vendor software to identify performance bottlenecks and resolve them
• Improve the performance environment with your own code, automation, and external tools
• Apply technical ability to coach and develop junior engineers
• Deliver department and external presentations sharing results with stakeholders
All About You
• Strong software engineering experience writing applications using Java Spring Boot framework
• Strong experience debugging performance issues with APM tools (i.e. Dynatrace, Splunk, Jprofiler, and JMH)
• Strong experience optimizing DB queries in PostgreSQL and Oracle
• Strong experience writing jMeter scripts and running in load generation tools (i.e. BlazeMeter)
• Experience with Payments industry (i.e. ISO 8583 messaging, 4-party model, and payment applications)
• Systematic problem-solving approach, coupled with strong communication skills and a sense of ownership and drive

• Self-motivated demonstrating strong organizational and listening skills; and very detail oriented with the ability to carry out assigned tasks with minimal supervision

Corporate Security Responsibility
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

jobs.title: Senior Staff Engineer, Bare Metal Kubernetes Platform
jobs.description:
Who are we?
Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.
A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.

Job Summary
We are looking for a Senior Staff Engineer to join the Reliability Engineering team that operates a bare-metal Kubernetes platform across multiple metro locations. The platform's architecture is defined and the build is underway, you will help deploy, operate and continuously improve it, from OS provisioning on racked servers through a multi-cluster fleet managed from a central management plane, with a software-defined data plane deployed via GitOps.
This is a deliberately broad role. We are not looking for someone who owns a layer and hands everything below it across a boundary. You will work alongside the teams that own the physical hardware, the underlay network, and the data plane software, and you need enough fluency in all three to reason about a fault before escalating it. Where you find the design falls short in practice, we expect you to say so and to shape how it evolves.
You will join the Digital Interconnection Engineering organization. The team owns the full application stack for interconnection and the Kubernetes platform for the software-defined data plane across multiple metros. We operate with an automation-first, GitOps-driven culture and a strong commitment to operational rigor, documented runbooks, and blameless postmortems.
Responsibilities
OS Provisioning & Bare-Metal Infrastructure
Own OS installation (Debian/Ubuntu) across bare-metal servers in multiple metros using PXE/iPXE imaging and cloud-init, and harden the OS prior to cluster bootstrap
Build and maintain a repeatable, zero-touch provisioning pipeline so every metro is deployed consistently without manual per-node intervention
Partner with the teams that own the hardware on BIOS/firmware baselines, high-speed NIC configuration and disk layout standards (separate NVMe for etcd, SSD for OS) and be able to diagnose faults at that layer, not just report them
Kubernetes Control Plane & Worker Nodes
Deploy and operate Kubernetes clusters across all metros with quorum-based control-plane fault tolerance and correct failure-domain placement across racks, PDUs, or availability zones
Maintain the Layer 4 load balancer or keepalived VIP fronting all kube-apiserver instances, so no client depends on a single node
Manage worker node provisioning, CNI configuration, and end-to-end cluster validation before workloads are onboarded
CI/CD & Data Plane Deployment
Build and own the CI/CD pipeline that deploys the software-defined data plane, including automated throughput and latency validation gates that must pass before promotion to production. The data plane software itself is configured and troubleshot by the team that owns it, your ownership is the pipeline and the gates
Own data-plane observability: monitoring, alerting thresholds, and operational runbooks
Network
Operate on top of a multi-metro underlay and partner with network and security teams on VLANs, BGP peering, NIC bonding, private connectivity, firewall rules and segmentation
Validate connectivity end to end across environments, and troubleshoot far enough into the network layer to isolate a problem before handing it over
OS & Kubernetes Upgrades
Plan and execute rolling OS and Kubernetes upgrades across the fleet with zero unplanned downtime; maintain tested upgrade runbooks and validated etcd snapshot/restore procedures before every major change
Own the etcd snapshot schedule, retention policy, and offsite storage; verify restore runbooks before each site goes live
Apply the platform's patching cadence across the fleet, tracking CVEs affecting the OS, Kubernetes and cluster components
Management Plane
Administer the centralized management plane across all clusters, including RBAC, cluster registration and policy enforcement, and keep production and non-production management planes strictly isolated to prevent blast-radius cascades from configuration changes
Drive GitOps-based fleet configuration management to keep clusters consistent, auditable, and drift-free
On-Call & Incident Management
Own your shift of a follow-the-sun on-call rotation, and lead incident response for control-plane, data-plane, and network events
Drive blameless postmortems and systematically eliminate recurring failure modes through automation, better runbooks, and sharper alerting
Contribute to the shared incident-command process, and maintain the runbooks for the systems you operate
What Success Looks Like, First 9-12 Months
Provisioning is fully automated and repeatable, new nodes and metros brought up with no manual per-node steps
Deployment pipeline in production, with throughput and latency gates enforced before promotion
Management plane administered across all clusters; production and non-production planes isolated; GitOps driving cluster configuration
OS and Kubernetes upgrades executed on cadence across the fleet with documented, tested runbooks
etcd snapshot and restore tested and signed off before each site goes live
Observability and alerting in place for the systems you operate, including the data plane
Recurring failure modes measurably reduced through automation and runbook improvements
Qualifications
Required
OS & bare metal: Deep hands-on Linux/Ubuntu provisioning at scale, PXE/iPXE imaging, cloud-init, BIOS/firmware management, OS hardening
Hardware fluency: Comfortable with BMC/IPMI, SMART data and platform sensors; able to diagnose disk, memory, NIC and power faults and work with vendors through warranty replacement
Kubernetes: Strong experience deploying and operating RKE2 or kubeadm clusters on bare metal, etcd operations, kube-apiserver HA, CNI (Multus/SR-IOV), multi-cluster fleet management
Rancher or equivalent management plane: Production experience managing multiple clusters through Rancher Prime, Rancher, or comparable fleet tooling
CI/CD for infrastructure: GitOps or pipeline-driven infrastructure deployment, Ansible, Terraform, ArgoCD, or Fleet
Networking: Hands-on with VLANs, BGP, bonded NICs, SR-IOV and private connectivity, with enough depth to troubleshoot across the boundary rather than only consume it
Upgrades: Demonstrated zero-downtime rolling upgrades of both OS and Kubernetes across a multi-node fleet
Operational rigor: Experience running platforms where availability is measured in minutes of downtime per year, and where an unreviewed change is the most likely cause of an outage
On-call: Comfortable owning an on-call shift and leading infrastructure incident response
Automation mindset: Everything-as-code, repeatable and auditable; strong bias toward automation over manual operations
Preferred
Familiarity with 6WIND VSR or other DPDK-based data planes, enough to build and validate a deployment and performance-testing pipeline around one
SR-IOV NIC tuning and data-plane performance validation
SDN or private-connectivity platforms (Equinix Fabric, VyOS, or equivalent)
Familiarity with LLM provider APIs and AI/agent gateway proxying patterns, since inference traffic from multiple providers transits this platform
Experience operating infrastructure across geographically distributed sites

Drive data-based continuous improvement opportunities across Micron's manufacturing network.

jobs.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
In the Technology Development — Advanced Modeling & AI Solutions (AMAIS) organization, you will be part of a multidisciplinary team developing next-generation Digital Twins, predictive modeling solutions, and AI-driven technologies that accelerate advanced memory development and manufacturing excellence. You will create predictive digital representations of semiconductor processes, materials, structures, equipment, and products across DRAM, NAND, and advanced packaging technologies including HBM. Leveraging physics-based modeling, computational methods, machine learning, GenAI, large language models (LLMs), and agentic AI frameworks, you will enable technology co-optimization, design-space exploration, process optimization, yield improvement, and accelerated technology learning. Working at the intersection of engineering fundamentals, manufacturing data, and digital engineering, you will develop scalable predictive and prescriptive solutions that connect process, structure, performance, yield, reliability, and cost. This role offers the opportunity to influence critical technology decisions, drive fab-technology co-optimization, and advance Micron's leadership in data-driven semiconductor memory innovation.
Qualifications:
Independence – be comfortable executing activities and needs
Experience in algorithm development, numerical methods, and scientific computing
Solid experience with Plasma, FPM, HAR etching, and MC modeling
Experience with Wet Processes, Chemical Etching and Strip, Material selectivity, Chemistry evaluation, etc.
Strong background in thermodynamics, physics, and chemistry
Experience with computational materials science methodologies
Familiar with machine learning and deep learning concepts and applications
Experience with regression, neural networks, and frameworks
Familiar with process and multi-physics modeling, and implementation
Experience with common modeling software, previous software development and Linux experience
Experience with Bash, Python, FORTRAN, or C++
Experience with OpenFOAM, ANSYS Fluent, COMSOL, HPEM
Strong debug and problem-solving skills
Experience writing reports and conference papers
Excellent written and verbal communication
Ability to work in a team environment and experience with remote collaboration tools
Responsibilities
Develop and deploy Digital Twins and predictive models spanning process, wafer, die, package, and manufacturing domains to enable technology and fab co-optimization.
Develop structural and Multiphysics models to evaluate process-structure-performance interactions, including stress, deformation, cracking, voiding, and reliability risks.
Build physics-informed composite AI models that accelerate technology development, yield improvement, reliability assessment, and design-space exploration.
Apply advanced computational methods, machine learning, and sparse-data modeling techniques to create robust predictive and prescriptive solutions for complex semiconductor challenges.

Drive material characterization workflows and validation
Perform failure and reliability analysis including fatigue life and crack propagation

jobs.description:

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
Key Responsibilities:
Develop, integrate, and optimize custom test circuit architectures for NAND flash memory designs, including transistor-level digital, analog, mixed-signal, monitoring, control, and memory-array interface circuits.
Interpret product specifications and test requirements; define circuit functionality, interfaces, operating limits, controllability, observability, and validation criteria.
Create, review, and optimize schematics, device sizing, bias structures, sensing and monitoring paths, multiplexers relevant to test circuits.
Analyze circuit testability and robustness to ensure compliance with quality, coverage, manufacturability, power, area, and reliability requirements.
Validate custom test circuits using XA simulations, Verilog simulations, and mixed-signal validation environments.

Evaluate circuit risks including leakage, contention, floating nodes, device overstress, power sequencing, current density, EM/IR, and long-duration stress conditions.
Create and debug test sequences and test modes required to control, observe, characterize, and validate custom test circuits at wafer and package levels.
Work with Product Engineering during first-silicon bring-up, debug and characterization, failure isolation, simulation-to-silicon correlation, and ramp to high-volume production.
Use laboratory measurements and silicon data to identify root cause and recommend circuit, test-mode, characterization, or screening improvements.
Apply a Design + AI approach as a core responsibility by using AI-assisted and agentic engineering workflows to accelerate circuit review, simulation triage, waveform analysis, root-cause investigation, automation, documentation, and knowledge retrieval while maintaining engineering rigor and sign-off discipline.

We Are

You Are
You have spent years deep in the timing closure trenches, and you know that the difference between a chip that tapes out on schedule and one that slips six months often comes down to someone who understands both the tool and the real design problem underneath. You have seen PrimeTime from every angle: competitive evals where you had to prove superiority in two days, tape-out firefights at 2 AM, and those strategic conversations where a VP needs to understand why their timing methodology needs to change.
You do not just run the tool. You understand setup and hold violations in the context of process corners, you can debug a crosstalk issue that is hiding in a specific mode, and you know when a timing problem is actually a synthesis problem or an extraction artifact. When a customer's design team is stuck, you can look at their reports, ask three targeted questions, and find the path forward.
You are equally comfortable sitting with an engineer walking through TCL debug and presenting to a director explaining why their current flow is leaving performance on the table. You have learned that the best technical win is the one where the customer feels like they discovered it with you, not that you sold them something. At Synopsys, you will work with the teams building the most advanced chips in the world, and what you help them solve actually matters.
What You'll Be Doing

Build deep technical credibility with customer design teams and management, becoming the trusted advisor they turn to when timing issues threaten project milestones

You do not treat STA as a checkbox activity. You understand the architecture well enough to know when a timing path is telling you something important about the design, and when it is noise from a poorly written constraint. You have closed timing on DDR, LPDDR, HBM, or similarly unforgiving designs where setup and hold windows are measured in picoseconds and there is no room for handwaving.
Scripting is not a nice-to-have for you. It is how you work. You automate the repetitive parts so you can focus on the hard calls, the ECOs that actually fix the problem without creating three new ones, the corner case that everyone else missed. You have worked with PrimeTime long enough to know its quirks, and you have probably written your own flow scripts to make it behave.
At Synopsys, you will work on the IP and SoC designs that power the next generation of memory and compute architectures. The problems are real, the schedules are tight, and the team expects you to bring both rigor and judgment.
What You'll Be Doing
Close timing at chip level for high-performance IP designs including DDR, LPDDR, HBM, and SoC blocks across multiple process corners and operating modes
Analyze timing reports from PrimeTime, identify critical paths, and work with design and physical implementation teams to resolve violations without compromising power or area targets
Implement and validate engineering change orders (ECOs) using PTECO and DMSA to fix functional bugs and timing issues while maintaining design integrity
Develop and maintain automation scripts in Python, Perl, Tcl, and shell to streamline STA flows, constraint generation, and reporting across the RTL-to-GDSII process
Handle asynchronous timing analysis, clock domain crossings, and complex timing constraints for multi-mode, multi-corner designs
Collaborate with global cross-functional teams including RTL design, physical design, and verification to ensure timing closure aligns with overall project goals
Review and refine timing constraints to ensure accuracy and completeness, catching issues early before they propagate downstream
The Impact You Will Have
Your timing closure work directly determines whether high-performance memory IP and SoC designs meet their performance targets and tape out on schedule
The automation frameworks you build will improve efficiency and reduce manual effort across the entire backend design flow for your team and adjacent projects
Your ability to diagnose and resolve timing issues quickly will prevent costly respins and keep critical customer programs on track
The ECOs you implement will fix real bugs in production designs, ensuring that Synopsys IP meets the quality standards our customers depend on
Your collaboration with global teams will ensure that timing considerations are integrated early in the design process, reducing downstream surprises
The constraints and methodologies you develop will become reusable assets for future high-performance designs across the organization
Your technical judgment will help the team make the right tradeoffs between timing, power, and area when all three cannot be fully optimized
What You'll Need
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent technical discipline
5+ years of hands-on experience in static timing analysis with a focus on chip-level timing closure for complex ASIC designs
Deep working knowledge of PrimeTime, including PTECO and DMSA, and the ability to navigate large timing databases and reports efficiently
Strong scripting skills in Tcl and Python, with demonstrated ability to build automation for STA flows, constraint management, and reporting
Proven experience handling asynchronous timing analysis, multiple corner timing closure, and complex constraint scenarios in high-performance designs
Exposure to DDR, LPDDR, HBM, or other high-speed memory IP is highly valuable
Hands-on experience in physical design or related backend domains is a strong plus
Who You Are
You can look at a timing report with thousands of paths and quickly identify the five that actually matter, separating real problems from constraint artifacts
You push back when a constraint does not make sense or when an ECO proposal will fix one corner and break two others, and you do it with data, not opinion

You write scripts that other engineers can actually use, with clear logic, reasonable defaults, and enough documentation that someone can pick it up six months later

jobs.title: Senior Manager- AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Voyager (94001), India, Bangalore, Karnātaka
Senior Manager- AI Engineer
At Capital One India, we are creating responsible and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real-time, personalized customer experiences. Our investments in technology infrastructure and world-class talent — along with our deep experience in machine learning — position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to continuing to build world-class applied science and engineering teams to deliver our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build.
Team Description:
The Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX) team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. We work hand-in-hand with our partners across the company to advance the state of the art in science and AI engineering, and we build and deploy proprietary solutions that are central to our business and deliver value to millions of customers. Our AI models and platforms empower teams across Capital One to enhance their products with the transformative power of AI, in responsible and scalable ways for the highest leverage impact.
What You’ll Do:
Partner with a cross-functional team of engineers, research scientists, technical program managers, and product managers to deliver AI-powered products that change how our associates work and how our customers interact with Capital One
Oversee the design, development, testing, deployment, and support AI software components including foundation model training, large language model inference, similarity search, guardrails, model evaluation, experimentation, governance, and observability, etc.
Make high judgment build-vs-buy decisions across a broad stack of Open Source and SaaS AI technologies such as AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, VectorDBs, PyTorch, and more
Invent and introduce state-of-the-art foundation model optimization techniques to improve the performance — scalability, cost, latency, throughput — of large scale production AI systems
Contribute to the technical vision and the long term roadmap of foundational AI systems at Capital One
Attract and retain top talent in the AI industry and nurture personal and professional development for your team. Foster a culture of learning and staying abreast of the state-of-the-art in AI
Translate enterprise AI goals into actionable team roadmaps with measurable outcomes and regular readouts
Operationalize Responsible AI: establish review gates, documentation/evaluation requirements, and rollout/rollback standards for all production AI systems
Create strong collaboration interfaces with Research, Data, and Platform teams to accelerate model lifecycle
The Ideal Candidate:
You love to build systems, take pride in the quality of your work, and also share our passion to do the right thing. You want to work on problems that will help change banking for good
Passion for staying abreast of the latest research, and an ability to intuitively understand scientific publications and judiciously apply novel techniques in production
You get fulfillment from empowering others to achieve their potential and you actively drive professional development through mentoring and coaching. You are hands-on when necessary and lead by example
You adapt quickly and thrive on bringing clarity to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and digging deep to uncover the root of problems and can articulate your findings concisely with clarity. You have the courage to share new ideas even when they are unproven
You are deeply Technical. You possess a strong foundation in engineering and mathematics, and your expertise in hardware, software, and AI enables you to see and exploit optimization opportunities that others miss
You are a resilient trailblazer who can forge new paths to achieve business goals when the route is unknown
Basic Qualifications:
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering
At least 6 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies
At least 1 year of people leadership experience
Preferred Qualifications:
3+ years of experience managing and leading an engineering team
6+ years of experience deploying scalable and responsible AI solutions on cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, or equivalent private cloud)
6+ years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies (e.g. LLM Inference, Similarity Search and VectorDBs, Guardrails, Memory) using Python, C++, C#, Java, CUDA, or Golang
3+ years of experience in building agentic AI systems and agentic workflows
Passion for staying abreast of the latest AI research and AI systems, and judiciously apply novel techniques in production
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex AI concepts to peers
3+ years of experience leading technical strategy for a multi-disciplinary AI team, balancing research exploration with production delivery
Familiarity with MLOps, AI observability (evaluation pipelines, drift monitoring, model/version governance) to ensure reliability and compliance
Track record mentoring engineers/scientists to productize prototypes and meet production SLOs
3+ years of experience right-sizing models, instance counts, and hardware types given requirements (e.g., context length, token inputs, token outputs)
