jobs.title: Software Engineer - AI
jobs.description:
To be successful as a Java Developer, you should have experience with:
This is a hands-on Software Engineer role responsible for designing, developing and testing features across UI, mobile and API-based applications.
The role will work with developers, product colleagues and other engineering teams to understand requirements, design maintainable solutions, review code, investigate defects and support reliable software releases.
A typical day may include Java coding, developing Spring Boot services and REST APIs, reviewing designs and code, creating and executing automated tests, analysing failures, supporting CI/CD execution and contributing to engineering and release-readiness discussions.
The role is not directly customer-facing, but it supports the performance, reliability, security and usability of customer-facing digital services.
Working across varied applications, technologies and delivery teams; building secure, maintainable and testable software; diagnosing complex application, API and environment-related failures; applying multithreading and asynchronous programming safely; implementing effective observability; learning new tools quickly; and balancing hands-on technical delivery with stakeholder communication, risk management and release deadlines.
The role offers opportunities to modernise Java services, strengthen API and engineering standards, improve automated test coverage and CI/CD quality gates, enhance observability and performance, and apply AI-assisted engineering practices.
The successful colleague will use Claude or an equivalent enterprise-approved AI tool to support tasks such as solution design, code generation and review, test design and automation, failure analysis, documentation and productivity improvement, while following Barclays security, privacy and responsible-AI controls.
Mandatory skills include:
Strong hands-on Core Java engineering skills, with a sound understanding of object-oriented programming principles, collections, exception handling and modern Java development practices.
Practical experience with Spring and Spring Boot, including inversion of control, dependency injection, transactions, Spring Data JPA and Spring MVC.

jobs.title: Functional Safety Engineer- Tools & AI
jobs.description:
JOB OVERVIEW
About Arm
Arm Limited is the company behind the world's most widely used compute architecture. Headquartered
in Cambridge, UK, Arm designs the CPU architecture and processor IP that our partners build into
hundreds of billions of chips – from smartphones and IoT devices to vehicles, robots and data centres.
As compute moves into the physical world, Arm technology is at the heart of the automotive and
Physical AI systems where safety and security are non-negotiable.
About the team
The Arm CE Quality and Compliance team is responsible for how Arm products meet Functional Safety
(ISO 26262, IEC 61508), Automotive Cybersecurity (ISO/SAE 21434) and Quality requirements. We
work alongside Arm's CPU, SoC, software and ML engineering teams and with our automotive and
robotics partners, from early development through external assessment and certification. Our products
– including Arm processors, compute subsystems and software self-test libraries – are relied on by the
world's leading automotive and industrial companies.
Job Description
Arm is looking for a Functional Safety Engineer with a focus on tooling, automation and AI to join the
Arm CE Quality and Compliance team.
In this role you will support Functional Safety, Automotive Cybersecurity and Quality activities, working
closely with engineering and assurance teams to explore and implement process-improvement and
automation solutions. These will include data analytics and the use of AI to support – not replace –
human judgement on safety and security.
Youwill implement and maintain practical, scalable compliance solutions for ISO 26262, IEC 61508 and
ISO/SAE 21434.
RESPONSIBILITIES
• Identify and evaluate opportunities to improve productivity through automation, data analytics and AI.
• Design and implement AI-powered assistants and autonomous or semi-autonomous agents that
support engineering activities.
• Develop automated solutions for work-product quality checks, maturity assessments, consistency
reviews and engineering-process monitoring.
• Integrate automation solutions with existing engineering tools, databases and enterprise systems.
• Develop data-analytics solutions and dashboards to monitor engineering performance, quality and
process effectiveness.
• Establish appropriate validation, monitoring and human oversight for AI-supported engineering
decisions, ensuring compliance with the requirements of ISO 26262, IEC 61508, ISO/SAE 21434,
ISO/PAS8800 (Safety and AI) or similar standards.
• Collaborate with engineering teams, process owners and IT to translate business needs into scalable
technical solutions.
• Measure and continuously improve the effectiveness, reliability and adoption of the solutions you
deliver.
REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE
• Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Engineering or a related
technical discipline.
• Strong software development experience, including building automation solutions.
• Practical experience developing AI/LLM-based applications, assistants or agentic workflows.
• Knowledge of LLM integration, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), API
integration and evaluation of AI output.
• Experience with data analytics, data processing and visualisation.
• Understanding of modern software engineering practice, including version control, automated testing
and deployment.
• Ability to work across technical and organisational boundaries in complex engineering environments.
• Strong communication, stakeholder-management and problem-solving skills.
NICE-TO-HAVE SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE
• Practical knowledge of ISO 26262, ISO/SAE 21434, Automotive SPICE, IEC 61508 or similar
standards.
• Familiarity with ISO/PAS8800 (Road vehicles – Safety and artificial intelligence) and emerging
guidance on the use of AI in safety-related engineering.
• Experience in a safety-critical or regulated engineering environment.
• Experience with requirements/ALM tools (e.g. Jira, Polarion, DOORS) and their APIs.
IN RETURN
In this role you will support Functional Safety, Automotive Cybersecurity and Quality activities, working
closely with engineering and assurance teams to explore and implement process-improvement and
automation solutions. These will include data analytics and the use of AI to support – not replace –
human judgement on safety and security.
Youwill implement and maintain practical, scalable compliance solutions for ISO 26262, IEC 61508 and
ISO/SAE 21434.

Experience with Perl, Python or other scripting language

jobs.title: Senior Layout Engineer
jobs.description:
Overview
Role Summary
Our Solutions Engineering Physical IP team comprises some of the industry’s leading experts in deep submicron circuit design. This position is a wonderful opportunity for you to work with our custom standard cell design engineering team on innovative technologies. Your work will have a significant lasting impact as the designs will be used in Solutions Engineering products servicing the infrastructure, client, automotive, and IoT market segments.
In this role, you will be responsible for the layout development of Arm custom standard cells in the latest, sub-3nm process technology nodes. The ideal candidate will be an expert in standard cell layout, physical verification, and automation techniques. You will work in close collaboration with the circuit design team to provide optimally tuned layout, and validate them through QA flows that use a variety of tools. This role is crucial in delivering high-performance, area-optimized, and DRC-clean logic libraries for next-generation SoCs and custom digital IPs.
Key Responsibilities
Layout design of logic standard cells (inverters, muxes, flops cells, complex logic gates) optimized for performance, area, and power.
Work with automation and QA teams to support library validation flows.
Collaborate with circuit designers to understand schematics and translate them into clean, compact layouts.
Drive design rule clean (DRC) and layout vs. schematic (LVS) closure using industry-standard verification tools (e.g., Calibre ).
Perform layout debugging and root-cause analysis for DRC, LVS, and other physical sign-off issues.
Handle cell abutment, cell profiling, and cell integration constraints for logic libraries.
Address layout-dependent effects (LDE) and double patterning/EUV compliance in advanced nodes.
Review and debug standard cell physical views (LEF, GDS, abstract views) for integration into digital flows.
Automate layout QA, regression checks, and PDK-driven layout verifications using scripts (e.g., SKILL, Python).
Participate in library quality audits and delivery cycles including signoff package creation and documentation.
Required Skills and Experience
3+ years of custom layout experience in logic standard cell development.
Proven track record of working at 5nm, 3nm, or 2nm nodes with FinFET/GAA-based technologies.
Proficiency in Cadence Virtuoso.
Deep understanding of advanced DRC rules, LVS methodologies, and multi-patterning constraints.
Solid experience in cell layout optimization for PPA (Power, Performance, Area).
Strong grip on pin accessibility, cell architecture trade-offs, and physical synthesis-aware design.
Automate layout-related tasks and workflows using scripting languages like Python, PERL, SKILL, and TCL.
Maintain accurate documentation of layout designs, changes, and verification results.
Working knowledge of version control, configuration management, and flow automation
Make effective use of AI tools and automation to improve productivity, accelerate learning, and enhance the quality of technical solutions
Strong documentation and communication skills to interface with cross-functional teams (PDK, design, QA).
Stay updated on best practices for standard cell layout, design rules, and advanced node requirements.
“Nice To Have” Skills and Experience :
Exposure to physical design implementation flow

jobs.description:
What success looks like in this role:
Job Title: Senior Service Management Transformation Specialist
Location: Bangalore
Who we are:
Unisys is a global information technology company that builds high-performance, security-centric solutions for the most digitally demanding businesses and governments on Earth. Unisys’ offerings include security software and services; digital transformation and workplace services; industry applications and services; and innovative software operating environments for high-intensity enterprise computing. Unisys builds better outcomes securely for its clients across the Government, Financial Services and Commercial markets. For more information, visit www.unisys.com.
Our Vision: Enhancing people’s lives through secure, reliable advanced technology.
Our Core Beliefs:
Curiosity: We embrace the unknown and continuous learning.
Creativity: We look past routine ways of doing things.
Client-Centricity: Our clients’ success is our success.
Integrity: We act ethically and honestly.
Role Purpose
Support and deliver Service Management transformation initiatives across client environments, improving how Incident, Major Incident, Problem, Change and related practices operate. The role combines strong Service Management knowledge with practical exposure to automation, AI, analytics, observability and modern engineering practices. The individual is expected to identify opportunities, work effectively with technical teams and independently own defined improvement initiatives from analysis through implementation.
Key Responsibilities
Service Management Improvement
· Assess existing Incident, Major Incident, Problem, Change and related operational practices.
· Identify process friction, unnecessary governance, repetitive work and opportunities for simplification.
· Own defined improvement initiatives from assessment through implementation and benefit tracking.
· Help shift Service Management measures from activity and volume toward stability, prevention, efficiency and business outcomes.
Problem Management and Service Stability
· Analyse incidents, recurring failures, work notes, monitoring events, changes and other operational data to identify problem candidates.
· Drive proactive Problem Management and recurring-incident prevention within assigned scope.
· Work with resolver and engineering teams to convert analysis into corrective and preventive actions.
· Measure avoided recurrence, reduced operational effort and improved service stability.
Change Management Modernisation
· Identify change activities suitable for standardisation, automation and simplified risk-based governance.
· Support integration between Change Management and CI/CD or engineering workflows.
· Help reduce unnecessary manual governance while maintaining appropriate risk, audit and compliance controls.
· Contribute to models where high-risk changes receive focused review and lower-risk changes follow proportionate controls.
AI, Automation and Analytics
· Use approved tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude, ServiceNow, Power BI and workflow or automation platforms where available.
· Identify repetitive Service Management activities suitable for automation.
· Build or support practical analytics, dashboards, workflows and AI-enabled use cases.
· Apply human oversight and appropriate guardrails when using AI or automation in operational processes.
Engineering and Observability Collaboration
· Work with Cloud, Infrastructure, Application, Platform and Engineering teams.
· Develop a practical understanding of monitoring, events, logs, metrics and traces.
· Connect technical operational information with Service Management records and processes.
· Identify existing engineering tools, scripts or automation that can be reused for Service Management improvement.
Continuous Improvement and Adoption
· Maintain an improvement backlog with defined owners, outcomes and progress.
· Document opportunities, implementation decisions, benefits and lessons learned.
· Share reusable methods and solutions across client accounts.
· Coach practitioners in adopting improved ways of working within assigned initiatives.
#LI-RB1
You will be successful in this role if you have:
Experience and Skills
Must Have
· Approximately 5-8 years of relevant IT Operations or Service Management experience.
· Practical experience in at least two areas such as Incident/Major Incident, Problem, Change, Configuration or Continual Improvement.
· Evidence of improving a process or service, not only operating an established process.
· Strong analytical, facilitation and problem-solving capability.
· Ability to work independently with technical resolver groups and multiple stakeholders.
· Curiosity, adaptability and willingness to learn unfamiliar tools or technologies.
Should Have
· Exposure to ServiceNow, Jira or comparable ITSM platforms.
· Exposure to Cloud, DevOps, CI/CD, monitoring or observability concepts.
· Experience with Power BI, Microsoft Copilot, Claude, Power Automate or equivalent technologies.
· Working understanding of ITIL practices and their practical application.
Good to Have
· SRE concepts and reliability practices.
· ServiceNow workflow or automation exposure.
· Cloud platform knowledge.
· Basic scripting, API or workflow-development experience.
Success Measures
· Defined transformation initiatives delivered with measurable operational or client value.
· Reduction in repetitive effort, avoidable incidents or process cycle time.
· Improved use of technical and Service Management data for decisions.
· Sustained adoption of improved practices by operational teams.
· Reusable improvements applied beyond a single activity or account where appropriate.
Role Boundaries
This is not a traditional process-administration or reporting role. Deep software engineering expertise is not mandatory, but the individual must be able to work with engineers, understand operational concepts and convert opportunities into practical Service Management improvements.

Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. About the Role:
This is a Cloud/Backend development position in the Falcon Exposure Management team. The Exposure Management team focuses on continuous assessment of security configurations and vulnerability landscapes across cloud and hybrid environments in near real time. This involves understanding security misconfigurations, compliance frameworks, vulnerability data sources, and how adversaries may exploit these weaknesses to compromise enterprise environments. This person will be required to build solutions for configuration and vulnerability data sources, gather and normalize assessment data, analyze security posture gaps, assess risk criticality, and automate remediation workflows. They will also be responsible for troubleshooting issues with current assessment data and making platform enhancements.
What You'll Do:
Engineering efforts from rapid prototypes to developing large-scale application services for configuration assessment and vulnerability management content
Work with security researchers and vulnerability analysts to troubleshoot time-sensitive production issues related to configuration drift and vulnerability detection
Extensive use of Golang or Java, AWS/GCP cloud services, and relational and distributed databases
Ensure security, accuracy, and efficacy of configuration assessment data and vulnerability intelligence
Backend engineering systems and process automation for configuration compliance and vulnerability management workflows
Build vulnerability and configuration tracking capabilities by conducting analysis on asset configurations, vulnerability data, and compliance benchmarks to provide reviewed content to the platform team for product efficacy
Interact and integrate with platform teams and product teams
Constantly re-engineering to improve architecture, risk scoring models, user experience, performance and stability
What You'll Need:
Solid work experience in Golang or Java development
Strong database skills with relational databases and distributed databases like Cassandra, Redis & ElasticSearch
Exposure to AWS/GCP cloud services and cloud security assessment tools
Experience delivering high quality & tested code
Understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals, vulnerability management, and security configuration assessment
Knowledge of security configuration frameworks (CIS Benchmarks, NIST CSF, SOC 2, etc.)
Ability to communicate effectively at all levels of an organization
Team collaboration skills and ability to work in a global, distributed team

Our Purpose
Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.
Title and Summary
Manager, Product Marketing, Merchant Cloud - Global Acceptance and Merchant Solutions
The Mastercard Merchant Cloud marketing team is part of Mastercard’s Global Acceptance + Merchant Solutions team, whose mission is to make commerce simpler for merchants, to enable their growth.
Merchant Cloud is Mastercard's unified, open acceptance platform that simplifies how merchants and merchant service providers access payment and commerce services globally. Through a single integration, customers can configure modular gateway, fraud, authentication, tokenization, optimization and data services - alongside select partner solutions.
The Merchant Cloud Product Marketing Manager sits at the intersection of product, sales, and the wider marketing team. By working in close collaboration with Global Product teams, they will translate product documentation and technical capabilities into compelling value propositions that resonate with numerous customer segments.
By developing clear, comprehensive and compelling material that acts as the foundation for wider marketing activities and sales conversations, this role plays a pivotal role in maximising the distribution and usage of our services across our customer and partner base, as well as strengthening Merchant Cloud’s position as a leading merchant payments solutions provider, as part of the Mastercard brand.
Role
• Execution of plans to drive Merchant Cloud strategic priorities, developing strong foundation for long term success.
• Work closely with the Merchant Cloud product teams to craft and recommend product value propositions that are customer-led, crisp and competitively positioned.
• Lead the delivery of foundational product marketing across the portfolio, with a focus on developing a single source of truth across key product marketing assets.
• Leverage product documentation from product managers for all new and existing capabilities to ensure product marketing assets are maintained and always up to date with our latest capabilities, services, use cases and more.
• Gather market and competitive intelligence and apply these insights into compelling product value propositions.
• Recommend and co-identify key product, segmentation, and positioning opportunities by leveraging data and insights.
• Work closely with the rest of the marketing team to develop launch strategies for new products.
All about you
• At least seven years’ marketing experience, particularly in B2B product marketing for complex technology solutions.
• Demonstrated ability to develop and execute plans against strategic priorities using data, insights and other tools to continuously optimize the approach.
• Strong track record and achievements in developing and delivering strong fundamental product marketing.
• Proven success on guiding sales enablement and marketing efforts for B2B audiences by translating technical product information into compelling commercial sales and marketing assets.
• Demonstrated ability to successfully integrate marketing assets across channels and platforms, using metrics and measurement tools track success and impact.
Corporate Security Responsibility
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

jobs.title: Sr Manager, Procurement Platform Excellence
jobs.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
The Global Procurement team is an integral engine to Micron’s growth, delivering best-in-class total cost and supply chain resiliency through innovative predictive capabilities, risk analysis, and a focus on sustainability and diversity. Our business goals are directly tied to the value we place on our team members, our greatest asset. We invest in our people through a skills-based learning and development model to create clear career pathways for growth. Join us and discover why Micron’s Global Procurement team is the preferred destination to ignite your talent.
As Senior Manager, Platform Excellence within Global Procurement’s Center of Excellence Digital Transformation & AI organization, you drive the Source-to-Pay (S2P) platform strategy and roadmap and lead end-to-end management of the S2P platform landscape. This is a collaborative role: you shape one coherent S2P platform direction together with your peer Senior Managers for S/4HANA Transformation, AI Transformation, Data & Process Automation, and Data Excellence & Governance. Your portfolio spans sourcing, contract lifecycle management, procure-to-pay, supplier and catalog enablement, and the analytics and reporting platforms used by the data analytics team, and you lead a team based in Hyderabad, India.
This is not a SAP or ERP configuration role. The SAP S/4HANA and Ariba transformation is driven by a separate team; you partner closely with them so the S2P platform landscape integrates cleanly with the ERP core and enterprise systems, and every platform decision reinforces one coherent, standardized S2P experience. Similarly, new AI transformation products that are still at an early, incubation stage sit with the AI Transformation team — your accountability is the established S2P platform portfolio and how it is run, integrated, and adopted.
You set direction and priorities and own value realization measured in real business terms — productivity, adoption, cycle time, and decision quality. You bring strong product and user-centered discipline to how the portfolio is run: grounding decisions in user personas, journeys, and end-to-end processes, and owning supplier-supported and third-party products end-to-end, including escalation, supplier performance (reviews, SLAs, demos), licensing, renewals, and end-of-life transitions.
This is a people-leadership role. A core part of your mandate is to move platform operations from reactive, ticket-driven support to a proactive, agent-embedded model, and to embed product and user-centered discipline across the portfolio. You develop a team of platform and product professionals and partner closely with AI Transformation, Data & Process Automation, Data Excellence & Governance, IT, Enterprise Architecture, Security, and Compliance. GP-centric platform products are owned here end-to-end; enterprise-wide systems and IT infrastructure remain with IT — the role does not perform software development or manage infrastructure.
▍ Key Responsibilities
A core expectation is to run Global Procurement’s Source-to-Pay platforms as products — end-to-end, value-driven, well-integrated, and adopted — while moving platform operations toward a proactive, agent-embedded model.
Platform Strategy & Value Optimization
Own the end-to-end S2P platform portfolio strategy and roadmap — including the analytics and reporting platforms — framing business problems into clear product strategies that maximize outcomes over outputs.
Prioritize opportunities and make build-versus-buy-versus-partner trade-offs, sequencing platform investment against S2P Reimagined and ERP transformation milestones.
Track value through real business indicators — productivity, adoption, cycle time, and decision quality — and engage stakeholders on investment decisions and supplier and technology trends.
End-to-End Platform Leadership & Lifecycle
Lead and be accountable for the S2P platform portfolio across its full lifecycle — sourcing, contract lifecycle management, procure-to-pay, supplier and catalog enablement, and analytics platforms — setting clear direction and adapting priorities as needs evolve.
Own supplier-supported and third-party products for GP-centric solutions, including escalation, supplier performance management (reviews, SLAs, demos), licensing, renewals, and end-of-life transitions.
Apply product-management fundamentals — budgeting, cost-versus-value trade-offs, and lifecycle planning — to keep platforms fit-for-purpose as scale and complexity grow, while keeping GP-centric solutions PM-owned and enterprise-wide systems with IT.
Platform Operations, Integration & Health
Own platform stability, configuration, release, environment and test, and incident and problem management across the S2P landscape.
Ensure the S2P platforms integrate cleanly with the SAP S/4HANA and Ariba ERP core and enterprise systems, so data, controls, and processes flow reliably end-to-end.
Establish platform health KPIs, service levels, and monitoring, and shift from reactive support to proactive, increasingly self-healing platforms — with agents handling detection, triage, routing, and routine configuration and testing.
Analytics Platforms, Adoption & Product Performance
Product-manage the analytics and reporting platforms used by the data analytics team — ensuring the tooling is reliable, well-integrated, and fit-for-purpose, while analytics outputs and insights remain owned by the data analytics team.
Instrument platforms to measure usage, adoption, and value, and use those signals to refine roadmaps and features.
Define what “good adoption” means beyond usage — decision confidence, reduced rework, and behavior change.
User-Centered Solution Design
Ground solutions in user personas, journeys, and end-to-end process understanding, balancing usability, feasibility, business value, and enterprise constraints.
Challenge low-value features and over-customization; advocate scalable, standard-driven design and consistent interaction patterns across S2P tools and AI-enabled capabilities.
Anticipate adoption risks and continuously improve solutions based on user behavior and usage signals.
Stakeholder Engagement, Enablement & Change
Engage stakeholders, build trust, and bring people along through change; translate needs into clear action plans and resolve issues through influence and partnership.
Own the platform enablement and support model — training, documentation, self-service, and a responsive support experience across regions.
Embed change management into the product journey and drive adoption through clear, simple, actionable communication.
Innovation & Agent-Embedded Ways of Working
Reimagine platform operations and enablement with agents embedded — platform support copilot, configuration and testing agents, integration-monitoring agents, and enablement copilot.
Sponsor rapid experiments, validate impact, and turn the best into reusable building blocks for broader adoption across Source-to-Pay.
Team Leadership & Enterprise Partnership
Lead, coach, and develop a Hyderabad-based team; build depth, ownership, and succession, and coach the team for a product-led, agent-embedded operating model.
Partner across DTAI pillars, IT, Enterprise Architecture, Security, Compliance, and functional Global Procurement teams, and represent the platform agenda in program reviews and executive readouts.
Serve as the primary escalation point for platform stability, integration, and adoption risks, translating complex dynamics into clear decisions and tradeoffs for senior stakeholders.
▍ Leadership Expectations
This leader is expected to embody Micron’s core values and set the tone for the team:
People
Care for each other — build an inclusive, high-trust team; develop talent, grow capability, and plan succession within the team.
Innovation
Shape the future — run platforms as products and champion agent-embedded ways of working; experiment, learn fast, and scale what works.
Tenacity
Nothing shakes our resolve — own platform stability, integration, and adoption outcomes end-to-end through complex, cross-system challenges.
Collaboration
Aligned to win — break silos across DTAI, IT, Enterprise Architecture, Security, and the business; win as one team across time zones.
Customer Focus
Partner and win together — treat procurement stakeholders and end-users as customers; design for their journeys and deliver adopted, high-value platforms.
Speed
Act with purpose and set the pace — make timely, well-reasoned decisions and move prioritized platform work from pilot to scale without losing rigor.
▍ Leadership Competencies
Product & value judgment: Frame problems into value-driven strategy, prioritize outcomes over outputs, and make build-versus-buy-versus-partner calls with clarity.
User-centered & adoption mindset: Design for real user journeys and adoption, not just delivery, and define value beyond usage.
Talent & coaching: Develop, coach, and grow a multi-region team; build bench strength and succession within the function.
Cross-cultural leadership: Work effectively across U.S. and Asia cultures and time zones, partnering with globally distributed stakeholders and peers.
Influence & partnership: Lead through influence across IT, Enterprise Architecture, Security, and business stakeholders without direct authority.
Executive communication: Translate complex platform, integration, and product topics into crisp, decision-ready narratives for senior leaders.
Change leadership: Drive adoption of new platforms and agent-embedded ways of working through enablement and change management.
Outcome ownership: Set direction, prioritize ruthlessly, and hold the function accountable for measurable stability, adoption, and value.
▍ Minimum Requirements
Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, or a related field.
Experience — depth: 13+ years in enterprise platform, digital product, or Source-to-Pay application management, including 5+ years leading platform or digital product delivery and operations and 3+ years leading teams.
Experience — scale: At least 5 years in a large, multi-region enterprise (5,000+ employees), including environments running on SAP (ECC and/or S/4HANA).
Experience — domain: Deep, hands-on ownership of a Source-to-Pay platform landscape (several of sourcing, contract lifecycle management, procure-to-pay, supplier and catalog enablement, and procurement analytics platforms), with close working knowledge of how these integrate with an SAP S/4HANA and Ariba ERP core.
Product management: Proven end-to-end product ownership — vision, roadmap, prioritization, and value realization — with a track record of driving outcomes over outputs.
Supplier / third-party product management: Managing supplier-supported products, including escalation, SLAs, performance reviews, licensing, renewals, and end-of-life transitions.
Analytics & adoption: Working knowledge of analytics and business intelligence (Power BI or Tableau) and of instrumenting products to measure adoption and value.
Integration: Proven experience integrating SaaS platforms with an ERP core — APIs, middleware, connectors, and cross-system data and controls.
AI / agentic ways of working: Experience defining requirements for, or embedding, AI agents into platform operations, support, configuration, testing, or enablement.
Cross-functional leadership: Proven ability to lead through influence across IT, Enterprise Architecture, Security, and business stakeholders without direct authority on enterprise-scale, multi-region initiatives.
Ways of working: Able to collaborate across U.S. and Asia time zones, including regular overlap with U.S.-based stakeholders and partners.
▍ Preferred Requirements
Product management certification (Pragmatic Institute, SAFe Product Owner / Product Manager, or equivalent).
Hands-on experience with Source-to-Pay or procurement platforms (SAP Ariba, Coupa, Ivalua, GEP, Icertis, or Ironclad) and procurement analytics platforms.
Experience reimagining platform operations and enablement with AI or agents embedded.
Service management (ITIL) and Agile or DevOps ways of working for enterprise applications.
Depth in Source-to-Pay and Procure-to-Pay processes and the broader procurement platform landscape.

jobs.title: Director, Systems Software Engineering
jobs.description:
Oracle is seeking an engineering director to build and lead a new Systems Firmware team in Bengaluru. You will hire the founding engineers, establish the team’s technical direction and culture, and take responsibility for outcomes that directly affect the reliability and serviceability of our server fleet.
The team’s initial mission is to resolve BMC and BIOS firmware issues in production. Working closely with US engineering teams, infrastructure operations, hardware teams, and external partners, you will lead complex investigations, drive lasting fixes, and improve the diagnostics, testing, and release practices that prevent problems from recurring. The team will participate in on-call rotations during India daytime hours, complementing US coverage through coordinated response and clear technical handoffs.
You will start with four senior engineers and provide close technical leadership while building the practices and partnerships needed for the team to succeed. You will set priorities, develop your engineers, and balance immediate fleet needs with longer-term improvements in firmware quality, security, and operational efficiency.
You will also shape the team’s roadmap and future capability. As additional hiring is approved, our intent is to expand its responsibilities into firmware development and delivery for new server and GPU platforms. This includes working with original design manufacturers and joint design manufacturers (ODM/JDMs), particularly Taiwan-based partners, on platform requirements, firmware integration, bring-up, validation, and production readiness.
This role calls for a leader with deep systems firmware expertise, sound operational judgment, and a record of building strong engineering teams. You should be comfortable guiding difficult technical investigations, holding partners accountable for delivery, and translating lessons from production into better engineering decisions.
Key Responsibilities
Build and lead the Bangalore Systems Firmware team. Recruit, develop, and retain exceptional engineers working on BMC firmware and BIOS. Establish clear ownership, coach technical leaders, and create an inclusive culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.
Own firmware operational support during India daytime hours. Establish sustainable on-call rotations and effective handoffs with US teams to provide continuity of support for Oracle’s server and GPU fleet.
Lead resolution of complex firmware issues. Guide incident triage, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions across firmware, hardware, and software boundaries. Prioritize work by customer impact and ensure timely resolution and clear stakeholder communication.
Turn fleet experience into better products. Partner with engineering, operations, and vendors to address recurring defects, improve diagnostics and recovery, and translate customer and operational needs into firmware enhancements.
Establish engineering and operational standards. Define and evolve runbooks, escalation processes, maintenance procedures, and firmware validation and deployment practices that improve fleet availability, health, security, and reliability.
Drive disciplined execution. Set priorities and manage interdependent initiatives across teams, balancing urgent fleet issues with long-term improvements. Establish measurable outcomes, manage dependencies, and adjust plans as business needs and resources evolve.
Champion firmware quality and security. Partner with security and engineering stakeholders to establish secure development practices, clear acceptance criteria, and appropriate testing and release controls.
Develop strong global partnerships. Align priorities and ownership across US and India engineering teams, fleet operations, hardware engineering, and external partners. Build productive relationships with ODM/JDM vendors, including Taiwan-based partners.
Expand the team’s product development capabilities as it grows. Build the expertise and processes needed to contribute to firmware architecture, platform bring-up, integration, validation, and production readiness for new server and GPU products.
Drive continuous improvement. Evaluate emerging firmware technologies, identify team skill gaps, and invest in automation, knowledge sharing, and engineering practices that improve execution and reduce recurring operational work.
Required Qualifications
Demonstrated success leading systems firmware engineering teams, with experience hiring, coaching, managing performance, and developing senior technical talent.
Deep technical expertise in server firmware, with substantial experience in BMC firmware and/or BIOS/UEFI and the ability to lead engineering decisions across both domains.
Experience supporting production server environments and leading the investigation and resolution of complex issues spanning firmware, hardware, operating systems, and platform management.
Strong technical judgment, including the ability to guide architecture and design reviews, evaluate competing solutions, and connect immediate corrective actions to long-term reliability improvements.
Experience establishing operational support practices, including on-call rotations, incident escalation, root-cause analysis, runbooks, and coordination across geographically distributed teams.
A record of delivering complex engineering initiatives through clear priorities, resource planning, dependency management, and effective cross-functional execution.
Experience applying secure development practices, firmware validation, release management, and controlled deployment processes.
Strong communication and partnership skills, with the ability to explain technical issues, manage escalations, and align engineering teams, business stakeholders, and external vendors.
A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience building a new engineering team or expanding an existing team from operational support into firmware development and product delivery.
Experience working directly with ODM/JDM partners on server firmware development, platform bring-up, qualification, and production issue resolution; collaboration with Taiwan-based vendors is particularly relevant.
Experience with GPU or accelerated computing platforms and the firmware requirements of large-scale cloud infrastructure.
Familiarity with OpenBMC or other BMC firmware stacks, BIOS/UEFI implementations, and server management interfaces and standards such as Redfish and IPMI.
Experience improving fleet reliability through firmware telemetry, automated testing, diagnostic tooling, and safe update and recovery mechanisms.

The role ensures that technology decisions across SAP S/4HANA, SAP PaPM, data platforms, integration technologies, analytics and downstream solutions operate as one coherent enterprise architecture rather than a collection of locally optimized solutions.
The architect protects architectural coherence, enterprise standards, reuse, scalability and long-term technology sustainability, while providing architecture assurance from solution design through implementation, deployment and transition to run.
The role works in close partnership with the Costing Business Solution Architect, Enterprise Architecture, Digital teams, solution/platform architects, technology owners and implementation partners.
Key Responsibilities
1. Enterprise Costing Technology Architecture
Own and maintain the E2E target technology architecture and technology roadmap for Costing.
Translate the approved business solution blueprint and required business capabilities into the target technology architecture.
Define how applications, platforms, data, integrations and downstream systems work together as one enterprise costing technology ecosystem.
Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture principles, security requirements and technology standards.
Lead architecture reviews and technology design decisions that materially affect the E2E Costing architecture.
2. Application & Platform Architecture
Own the target application/system architecture across the Costing technology landscape.
Determine how approved Costing capabilities should be enabled across SAP S/4HANA, SAP PaPM, analytics, data platforms, integration platforms and supporting/downstream applications.
Drive architectural reuse and rationalization, avoiding unnecessary duplication or technology fragmentation.
Evaluate technology options based on architectural fit, scalability, maintainability, reuse and enterprise sustainability.
Assess emerging technologies, including AI and automation, where they can enable the approved Costing business solution.
3. Data & Integration Architecture
Own the architecture for costing data movement, storage, integration and consumption.
Define E2E integration architecture, interface patterns and technology dependencies across ERP, Supply Chain, Product, Finance, data platforms and downstream systems.
Ensure architectural support for required data quality, traceability, reconciliation and auditability.
Partner with business/data owners to ensure the technology architecture supports defined business information requirements and semantics.
4. Architecture Governance & Design Assurance
Establish and apply architecture principles, standards, patterns and technology guardrails for Costing.
Ensure solution designs comply with the approved enterprise technology architecture.
Lead/challenge decisions that alter the Costing technology architecture, integration model, platform strategy or technical standards.
Manage architectural risks, technical debt and architecture exceptions.
Provide architecture assurance throughout detailed design, build, testing, deployment and transition to run.
5. Cross-Technology Coherence
Prevent individual technology decisions across SAP, PaPM, data, integration, reporting and downstream systems from creating fragmented architecture.
Identify cross-system dependencies and architectural impacts early in solution design.
Ensure individual solution/platform designs collectively deliver the approved E2E business solution.
Work with Enterprise Architecture and relevant technology owners to resolve cross-domain architecture decisions.
6. Transformation & Vendor Architecture Leadership
Provide E2E technology architecture leadership throughout the Costing Transformation.
Challenge implementation partner and vendor designs against the approved business solution, enterprise architecture and long-term technology strategy.
Evaluate alternative solution options and innovations proposed by partners based on technical feasibility, architectural fit, enterprise reuse, scalability and sustainability.
Ensure the company retains long-term architectural ownership rather than allowing architecture to become vendor defined.
Maintain technical continuity from architecture → detailed solution design → build → deployment → run.

Description -

Business Environment
HP creates new possibilities for technology to have a meaningful impact on people, businesses, governments and society. The world’s largest technology company and ranked 10 on the Fortune 500 list for 2012, HP brings together a portfolio that spans printing, personal computing, software, services and IT infrastructure to serve more than 1 billion customers in over 170 countries on six continents. HP invents, engineers, and delivers technology solutions that drive business value, create social value, and improve the lives of our clients.
About the Engagement
The Print Planning Excellence (PPE) team is responsible for managing and advancing production planning systems, data, and processes supporting global and regional Print and Personal Systems businesses within HP. The team focuses on delivering robust, scalable, and reliable planning capabilities that enable effective demand and supply planning across the organization.
The Planning Business System Expert and IBP Principal Consultant would provide deep functional and solution expertise across demand and supply planning processes. The role would independently lead the resolution of complex and business-critical planning issues, perform advanced root-cause analysis, define solution approaches, and develop sustainable solutions rather than relying only on predefined procedures.
The expert would work closely with business, IT, project teams, and planning stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into effective planning solutions. The role would lead or contribute to solution design, development, testing, implementation, and stabilization of critical planning projects and system capabilities, while ensuring alignment with established architecture, technical standards, and industry best practices.
The role would also drive planning process improvements, identify opportunities for automation and standardization, strengthen planning KPIs and controls, and provide subject-matter expertise for strategic and digital transformation initiatives.
The objective of the role is to solve complex planning challenges, design scalable solutions, drive critical implementations, and continuously enhance the organization's end-to-end planning capabilities.

Diagnose → Design → Solve → Implement → Transform

jobs.title: R&D Engineering, Sr Engineer
jobs.description:
Alternate Job Titles
Memory Design Engineer
Embedded Memory Circuit Designer
SRAM Design Engineer
CMOS Circuit Design Engineer
Memory IP Development Engineer
We Are
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
You Are
You are someone who has spent the last couple of years getting your hands dirty with embedded memory design and you are ready to go deeper. You have worked with SRAM, ROM, or Register Files enough to know that the details matter, that a small circuit decision ripples through characterization, layout, and eventually into silicon. You are not looking for surface-level work. You want to understand why a bitcell behaves the way it does, how reliability analysis connects to real-world performance, and what makes one memory architecture better than another.
You learn by doing and by asking the right questions. When something does not make sense in simulation results, you dig in. When a senior engineer explains a tradeoff, you follow the logic and remember it for next time. You are comfortable working in Cadence tools, writing scripts when repetitive tasks slow you down, and collaborating across teams that speak different technical languages. You are organized enough to juggle multiple design tasks and curious enough to want to know how your piece fits into the bigger chip. At Synopsys, you will work on memory IP that goes into real products, alongside engineers who will help you grow.
What You'll Be Doing
Design and simulate embedded memory circuits including SRAM, ROM, and Register Files using Cadence Virtuoso and related tools
Support layout activities by working with layout engineers to ensure design intent translates cleanly into physical implementation
Run bitcell characterization and basic reliability analysis to validate performance across process, voltage, and temperature corners
Debug circuit-level issues by analyzing simulation results, identifying root causes, and proposing fixes with guidance from senior engineers
Collaborate with CAD, verification, and frontend teams to align on design requirements, timing constraints, and integration needs
Write and maintain technical documentation including design notes, simulation reports, and analysis summaries
Use scripting in C-Shell, Perl, or Python to automate repetitive tasks and improve design flow efficiency
The Impact You Will Have
Deliver memory IP blocks that meet performance, power, and area targets for high-volume semiconductor products
Reduce design iteration cycles by catching issues early through thorough simulation and analysis
Improve design quality and reliability by contributing to characterization and validation efforts
Enable faster time-to-market for Synopsys customers by supporting robust and well-documented memory solutions
Build reusable design methodologies and scripts that make future projects more efficient
Strengthen cross-functional collaboration by clearly communicating design decisions and technical tradeoffs
Grow into a more senior role by mastering the fundamentals of memory circuit design in a production environment
What You'll Need
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field
1 to 3 years of hands-on experience in CMOS circuit design, specifically with embedded memory such as SRAM, ROM, or Register Files
Working knowledge of memory architectures, bitcell design, and circuit fundamentals including read/write operations and sense amplifier behavior
Experience using Cadence Virtuoso or similar tools for schematic capture, simulation, and layout interaction
Exposure to scripting languages like C-Shell, Perl, or Python is a plus and will help you automate workflows and analyze data more effectively
Who You Are
You can look at a simulation waveform and spot when something is off, even if you do not immediately know why
You ask questions when requirements are unclear instead of guessing and moving forward
You can work on multiple design tasks in parallel without losing track of deadlines or deliverables
You communicate clearly in English, whether you are writing a design note or explaining a circuit issue to a colleague from another team
You are comfortable learning new tools and methodologies on the job, and you do not wait for someone to tell you every step
You take ownership of your work, even when you are contributing to a larger design effort led by senior engineers
The Team You'll Be Part Of
Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process.
Rewards and Benefits
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.
At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

jobs.title: Staff Application Engineer – ECO Timing
jobs.description:
We Are
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
You Are
You have spent years deep in the trenches of timing signoff and design closure, and you know the difference between a chip that tapes out on schedule and one that misses by three months because someone ignored a critical timing path in the second pass. You are the engineer who gets called when a customer's design is stuck at 95% timing closure and no one can figure out why. You do not just run tools, you understand what the tools are actually doing under the hood, and you know when to trust the results and when to dig deeper.
Working across P&R, STA, and ECO flows is second nature to you. You have debugged parasitic extraction issues at 3nm, optimized PPA targets on real silicon projects, and written enough TCL and Perl scripts to automate workflows that used to take days. You are comfortable sitting with a customer's design team in Hyderabad one day and presenting technical tradeoffs to their management the next, translating between 'this violates setup by 200ps' and 'this impacts your product schedule by two weeks.'
You do not wait for perfect data. You work with what you have, ask the right questions, and move. At Synopsys, you will work with customers who are pushing the limits of semiconductor design, and what you enable will directly affect whether their chips work.
What You'll Be Doing
Work directly with customers and partners to diagnose and resolve complex timing, extraction, and design closure issues on live silicon projects using Synopsys STA, ECO, and P&R tools
Collaborate with R&D teams to shape product roadmaps, validate new features, and translate real-world customer pain points into actionable technical specifications
Deploy best practices for timing signoff, parasitic annotation, and physical design methodologies to help customers hit aggressive PPA targets on advanced nodes

jobs.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.
Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.
If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!
ㅤ
The Senior Associate, Record to Report (RTR) for Controllership will support end-to-end RTR accounting and controllership activities for assigned Warner Bros. Discovery entities and business areas. This role will be based in Hyderabad and will report directly to the Manager RTR. The role is responsible for accurate and timely month-end, quarter-end and annual close activities, journal entries, account reconciliations, variance analysis, financial reporting support, SOX documentation, audit support, and compliance with US GAAP and company accounting policies.
The role will support transition, stabilization and scaling of RTR activities into the Hyderabad Accounting COE, while contributing to process standardization, simplification, automation and continuous improvement.
The role requires a strong controllership mindset, sound technical accounting knowledge, analytical capability and ownership. The Senior Associate is expected to independently execute assigned activities, perform detailed analysis and quality checks on assigned work, identify and resolve issues, support process knowledge sharing, and escalate material accounting, reporting or control matters to the Manager RTR in a timely manner.
Your normal hours of work are 3:00 p.m. IST to 11:00 p.m. IST, Monday to Friday. However, due to business needs, you may be required to work outside these hours and on holidays for the proper performance of your role, subject to applicable laws and company policy.
Your Role Accountabilities…
Controllership, Close and Reporting
· Perform and support RTR accounting and controllership activities for the assigned scope, ensuring completeness, accuracy and timely delivery.
· Prepare and post month-end journal entries including accruals, prepaids, amortizations, reclasses and other standard or ad-hoc entries.
· Prepare balance sheet reconciliations, investigate reconciling items and aging, and support timely resolution of open items.
· Perform monthly and quarterly balance sheet and income statement variance analysis and provide clear explanations to controllership stakeholders.
· Support intercompany reconciliations, investigate out-of-balance items and coordinate timely resolution with WBD counterparts.
· Ensure all assigned close activities are completed in accordance with the close calendar, accounting policies and reporting requirements.
· Assess accounting implications of routine transactions, apply sound judgment within established policies, and escalate complex matters to the Manager RTR.
· Prepare and support financial reporting schedules, management reporting requirements and other close deliverables as assigned.
Governance, Controls and Audit Readiness
· Ensure accounting and reconciliation supporting documentation meets SOX standards and internal control requirements.
· Execute assigned key controls, retain appropriate evidence and promptly escalate control exceptions or financial reporting risks.
· Support internal and external audits, statutory requirements, walkthroughs, testing and information requests, and help drive timely closure of open items.
Transition and Operating Model Buildout
· Support transition, knowledge transfer, stabilization and documentation of RTR activities moving into the Hyderabad Accounting COE.
· Help establish and maintain process documentation, SOPs, ownership matrices, close checklists, KPIs and escalation protocols.
· Participate in training, shadowing, reverse-shadowing, testing and readiness activities to support successful transitions and business continuity.
Transformation, Process Excellence and Systems
· Identify and implement opportunities for process standardization, simplification, automation and continuous improvement across RTR activities.
· Support SAP/ERP changes, BlackLine improvements, integrations, reorganizations, UAT and other finance transformation initiatives.
· Use advanced Excel, Power BI and other available tools to improve analysis, controls, reporting quality and team productivity.
Team Collaboration, Knowledge Sharing and Support
· Provide process guidance, knowledge sharing and training support to team members and new joiners without direct people-management responsibility.
· Support the Manager RTR in close coordination, issue tracking, backup coverage, prioritization and timely escalation of delivery risks.
· Maintain up-to-date process knowledge and contribute to a collaborative, accountable and quality-focused team culture.
· Perform other duties, special projects and ad-hoc activities requested by the Manager RTR or relevant stakeholders.
Qualifications & Experience…
Required
· MBA, B.Com, CA Inter, CMA Inter, M.Com or equivalent relevant finance/accounting qualification required; CA, CPA or CMA qualification is an advantage.
· 6-8 years of progressive accounting experience, preferably in a US GAAP environment.
· Strong experience in RTR, month-end close, journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations, variance analysis, financial reporting support, audit support and internal controls.
· Minimum 2-3 years of experience in SAP FI/CO; exposure to SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA and BlackLine is preferred.
· Experience working in transitions, transformation, process stabilization or migration activities.
· Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including advanced functions; working knowledge of Power BI is preferred.
· Experience working in a multinational or multicultural matrix organization.
· Strong analytical, problem-solving and issue-resolution skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and tight deadlines.
· Very good written and verbal communication, interpersonal and stakeholder-management skills.
· High attention to detail, ownership mindset and commitment to quality, compliance and timely delivery.
· Able to work effectively across various time zones.
Desired
· Big 4 public accounting background and/or prior exposure to a captive Finance Shared Service Centre / Global Capability Center.
· Experience in media, entertainment, production, distribution or related industries.
· Experience with finance transformation, automation, process standardization or system implementation initiatives.
· Self-driven attitude with willingness to learn, grow and take on additional responsibilities.
· Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and changing environment.
Other Requirements
· Required to be in the Hyderabad office three days a week (specific days to be determined upon hire).

jobs.description:
You are a hands-on Data Scientist with 5+ years of experience applying statistics, machine learning, and analytics to solve business problems. You are skilled at translating ambiguous questions into analytical approaches, exploring complex data, and communicating actionable findings.
You understand data engineering concepts and can work with data pipelines and cloud platforms to prepare reliable datasets and support model deployment. You enjoy collaborating across disciplines and taking ownership from problem definition through measurement of business impact.
Responsibilities
Partner with business stakeholders to frame problems, define success metrics, and translate business needs into analytical and data science solutions.
Perform exploratory data analysis, statistical analysis, hypothesis testing, and experimentation to identify patterns, drivers, and opportunities.
Design, develop, evaluate, and refine machine learning and statistical models for use cases such as forecasting, classification, segmentation, and anomaly detection.
Apply appropriate validation methods; assess model performance and limitations; and communicate uncertainty, assumptions, and trade-offs.
Prepare, transform, and integrate structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data. Develop reusable features and analytical datasets using Python and SQL.
Collaborate with data engineers to understand and improve data pipelines, data models, quality checks, lineage, and access patterns; contribute to pipeline development where needed.
Partner with ML engineers and engineering teams to operationalize models, automate workflows, and monitor model performance and data drift.
Use cloud data and analytics platforms such as BigQuery and related orchestration or processing tools to access and process data at scale.
Create visualizations, dashboards, and narratives that translate analytical results into actionable recommendations for technical and business audiences.
Apply reproducible development and MLOps practices, including version control, testing, documentation, and CI/CD, in collaboration with engineering teams.
Follow data governance, privacy, security, and responsible AI practices throughout the analytics and model lifecycle.
Explore and evaluate emerging analytical, machine learning, and generative AI techniques where they address business needs.
Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
5+ years of hands-on experience in data science, advanced analytics, applied statistics, or machine learning.
Strong proficiency in Python and SQL for data extraction, preparation, analysis, modeling, and automation.
Solid understanding of statistical inference, hypothesis testing, experimental design, and model validation.
Experience developing and evaluating predictive or statistical models using libraries such as scikit-learn, statsmodels, pandas, NumPy, and SciPy, or equivalent tools.
Working knowledge of data engineering concepts, including ETL/ELT, data pipelines, data modeling, data quality, and orchestration.
Experience working with cloud data platforms or enterprise data ecosystems, such as Google Cloud and BigQuery, or equivalent technologies.
Experience communicating insights using visualizations, dashboards, or presentations for business and technical stakeholders.
Familiarity with Git, code reviews, documentation, testing, and agile delivery practices.
Strong problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills.

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer, Cells Infrastructure
jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.
An overview of this role
We're looking for an Intermediate Site Reliability Engineer to join the Cells Infrastructure team in GitLab's Scale & Architecture organization. In this role, you'll help build and operate Cells, the architecture that lets GitLab.com scale horizontally. Cells splits GitLab.com into many independent units, each with its own application and data stack, behind a shared routing layer.
This is a build-it-and-run-it role. You'll provision cells, route traffic to them, deploy them safely, and keep them reliable in production. You'll also help move customer organizations onto Cells, one of GitLab's most important scaling initiatives.
What you'll do
Operate Cells in production: join the on-call rotation, respond to incidents, lead post-incident reviews, and drive corrective actions to completion.
Define and monitor service level objectives (SLOs) for routing and cell health, and build the dashboards, alerts, and runbooks behind them.
Provision and operate cell infrastructure on Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including Kubernetes, networking, Identity and Access Management (IAM), PostgreSQL, Redis, and object storage.
Develop infrastructure as code with Terraform, Helm, and GitOps tooling such as Argo CD.
Operate and extend the global routing layer, built on Cloudflare Workers, Envoy, and a Go service backed by Cloud Spanner, and expand routing to more protocols and services.
Improve the continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines behind ring-based deployments, covering promotion, database migrations, quality assurance validation, and rollback.
Support organization migrations by preparing destination cells and helping with dry runs and production cutovers.
Work with product teams to make their services cell-compatible, and write documentation so others can operate Cells with confidence.
Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.
What you'll bring
Professional experience running production infrastructure at scale on AWS, GCP, or both, including Kubernetes, along with strong Terraform and Helm skills.
Proficiency in Go, or strong experience in another systems language and willingness to work in Go daily.
Solid grounding in site reliability engineering (SRE) best practices: SLOs and error budgets, blameless post-incident reviews, reducing toil through automation, capacity planning, and designing for graceful degradation.
Experience owning services in production, including on-call, incident response, and monitoring with tools such as Prometheus and Grafana.
Practical knowledge of progressive delivery: how to roll changes safely across a fleet and how to roll them back.
A strong understanding of distributed-systems fundamentals, such as request routing, proxies, consistency, and failure domains.
Experience working effectively in distributed, all-remote teams: you default to asynchronous, written-first communication, document decisions in issues and merge requests, hand off work cleanly across time zones, and stay transparent about progress and blockers.
Experience with Cloudflare, Spanner, Argo CD, TypeScript, or operating GitLab at scale is a plus, not a requirement.
About the team
Every team in our organization owns its services end to end, from design through on-call.We own the control plane that tracks cells and decides where each request belongs, and keep the fleet in step with GitLab's release cadence.We work closely with delivery, database, migration, and product teams across GitLab. Feature teams own how their services behave on the platform; we own the underlying infrastructure.We're an all-remote, asynchronous team. We make decisions in GitLab issues, use directly responsible individuals (DRIs) to own technical direction, demo our work weekly, and use AI-assisted workflows every day.

Growth and Development Fund

jobs.description:
About Analog Devices
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.
Role Overview
The Staff Physical Design Engineer is role which combines deep hands-on implementation expertise with technical leadership. This role owns complex block- and/or top-level physical design for advanced-node SoCs and leads a small group of engineers to achieve high-quality, on-time delivery.
Key Responsibilities
Technical Ownership
Own end-to-end physical implementation (floorplanning, power planning, placement, CTS, routing, ECO) for complex blocks or subsystems across advanced technology nodes (e.g., 22nm, 16nm, 7nm, 5nm, 4nm).
Drive timing closure, congestion resolution, IR/EM, signal integrity, and physical verification (DRC/LVS/antenna) to meet PPA and quality targets.
Define and refine hierarchical PNR strategies, IO ring/PG structures, and integration guidelines for large SoCs.
Perform in-depth analysis and debug of tool issues, timing failures, and physical design anomalies; propose robust, scalable solutions.
Methodology and Automation
Develop, maintain, and enhance physical design methodologies, scripts, and flows (e.g., for PDN, PG, clock structure, exception handling, signoff automation).
Proactively identify opportunities for flow improvements and standardization to reduce turnaround time and error rates.
Evaluate EDA tool features and drive best practices in collaboration with CAD/enablement teams.
Technical Leadership & Team Enablement
Provide technical direction to a small group of physical design engineers, including task breakdown, priority setting, and quality expectations.
Mentor junior engineers and NCGs in PNR, STA and debug practices to build a strong second tier of technical capability.
Review floorplans, constraints, and implementation choices from team members, giving clear, actionable feedback.
Act as a go-to technical reference within the PD team.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Work closely with RTL design, STA, DFT, CAD, and packaging teams to converge on implementation-friendly architectures and constraints.
Communicate risks, options, and trade-offs clearly to project leads and managers, and help shape mitigation plans.
Participate in design reviews and signoff reviews, representing physical design status, risks, and recommendations.
Required Qualifications
Strong experience in physical design implementation for complex digital SoCs, typically 8–12+ years in physical design or equivalent level of mastery.
Proven hands-on expertise with industry-standard PNR and signoff tools (e.g., Cadence Innovus, Synopsys ICC2, Tempus/PrimeTime, RedHawk, Voltus, etc.).
Demonstrated success in closing challenging blocks/subsystems on advanced nodes (timing-, IR-, and congestion-critical designs).
Solid understanding of:
Floorplanning and partitioning strategies
Power grid and PDN methodology (including IR/EM mitigation)
Advanced clock tree/clock mesh design and constraints
STA constraints (modes/corners, exceptions, derates)
Physical verification and reliability checks
Leadership Expectations

jobs.title: ASIC Verification Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Hardware and Software Developer. The role is multifaceted - SoCV testbench Infrastructure, Bare-metal boot, Silicon Bringup Tools and CPU/SOC/GPU test frameworks. It involves a detailed understanding of the nVidia CPU, GPU, SOC system and boot architectures. The tools and technologies are complex and involve code that coordinates many IPs in the overall SOC. A key part of NVIDIA's strength is our development tools and environments that enable our incredible pace of delivering new technology to the market. We are looking for a creative and hardworking engineer who is passionate about joining a dynamic & agile SoCV/Emulation Infrastructure and test-frameworks team.
What you will be doing:
The work includes building tools, infrastructure, and test frameworks used in RTL-simulations, c-simulations, Emulation, FPGA, and on Silicon.
You will understand Tegra system architecture, with a focus on all IPs in the SOC that are involved in boot and security features.
The tools that you build give Design and Verification teams the ability to access registers/memory/DMA engines and other features in their unit. The tools also enable test re-use across multiple platforms (RTL, models, Emulation, and Silicon). The gamut of tools is wide and you also develop features used for Silicon bring up (example: FUSE, ATE, Security, Flash/DMA, Board I2Cs, USB debug devices among others). We strive for the highest quality of test frameworks and tools that we deliver from this team.
You would assess and build C-model or RTL-simulation capability that allows us to simulate the features before Silicon arrival in a pre-silicon environment.
What we need to see:
BS or MS in Computer Science or Electronics Engineering or equivalent experience with 0-2 years of experience
Strong programmer who is proficient with C, C++, Python.
Understanding of SOC and System Architecture.
Understanding of How the SOC Devices like DMA, interrupt-engines, CPU, boot-devices, MMU/IOMMU function.
Operating System and Device-Driver concepts and ability to write no-OS test frameworks - i.e tests that run directly on the bare-metal SOC.
A good programmer takes pride in building scalable and maintainable software.
Understanding Hardware and/or Software development life cycle.
Way to stand out from the crowd:
Previous experience handling Silicon Bringup and in enabling Emulation/FPGA related test frameworks.
Exposure to Testbench architectures (C++ testbenches, SV/UVM based testbenches).
Verilog and System Verilog coding skills are a plus.
