jobs.title: System Software Engineer - GPU Profiling
jobs.description:
At NVIDIA, we build groundbreaking products for the following sectors: Deep Learning, High Performance Computing, Gaming, VR, and Automotive. See your efforts in action as developers use your tools to debug, profile and analyze the performance of their systems/applications using the low-level library that you helped to craft as a member of the GPU Foundations Developer Tools team! Innovate as you develop the performance analysis capabilities of NVIDIA hardware along with the Nsight tools and the foundation library to support next generation accelerated computing at datacenter scale.
As a system software engineer in the Developer Tools group, you will be developing software that empowers GPU application developers to build outstanding applications that are recognized world-wide. We are seeking a motivated Software Engineer to join our team and contribute to the performance triage development and co-design of our software libraries in collaboration with our Hardware Architecture team. Join our team and gain exciting opportunities to work hands-on at every layer of NVIDIA's outstanding technology.
What you will be doing:
Partner with multi-disciplinary teams to design, implement, and verify performance metrics for NVIDIA GPUs
Work on developing and improving methodologies for profiling data collection from GPUs
Define, invent, and improve our GPU profiling library with new features to allow NVIDIA's customers to extract the best performance out of their applications
Read and understand HW specs to design solutions based on it
Work on software unit level tests and framework ensuring the quality of the product
Work on supporting a variety of platforms ranging from super-computers to embedded systems
What we need to see:
B.Tech. EE/CS or equivalent with 4+ years of experience, or M.Tech. with 2+ years of experience, or Ph.D.
Strong programming ability in C, C++, Python with proficiency in Data Structures and Algorithms
Solid understanding of Computer Architecture (e.g. x86, ARM CPUs, GPUs) and Operating System concepts
Knowledge of SW design principles, as that's a key as we scale!
Ways to stand out from the crowd:
Experience in Device Drivers or System Software development
Knowledge of GPU APIs such as CUDA, OpenCL, OpenGL, Direct3D, Vulkan
Prior experience authoring developer tools, particularly for GPUs
Experience in performance analysis of GPU applications
Ability to read and write in Assembly language, especially for multi-processor architectures
NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most dedicated and hard-working people in the world working with us. If the work described above excites you and you are up to the challenge, we want to hear from you. The GPU, our invention, serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services. Our work opens up new universes to explore, enables amazing creativity and discovery, and powers what were once science fiction inventions from artificial intelligence to autonomous cars. NVIDIA is looking for phenomenal people in multiple disciplines to help us accelerate the next wave of computing.
NVIDIA is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: ASIC Design and STA Engineer
jobs.description:
NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself. Our invention of the GPU sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. Today, research in artificial intelligence is booming worldwide, which calls for highly scalable and massively parallel computation horsepower that NVIDIA GPUs excel. NVIDIA is a “learning machine” that constantly evolves by adapting to new opportunities that are hard to solve, that only we can address, and that matter to the world. This is our life’s work , to amplify human creativity and intelligence. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join our diverse team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world!
NVIDIA is looking for a best-in-class ASIC STA Engineer to join our outstanding Networking Silicon engineering team, developing the industry's best high-speed communication devices, delivering the highest throughput and lowest latency for today's AI platforms! Come and take a part in designing our groundbreaking large scale and innovating chips, enjoy working in a meaningful, growing and highly professional environment where you make a significant impact in a technology-focused company.
What you will be doing:
Be in charge of full chip and/or chiplet level STA convergence from early stages to signoff.
Take part in top level floor plan and clock planning.
Optimize, together with CAD signoff flows and methodologies.
Digital Partitions' and analog IPs' timing integration, giving feedback to PD/RTL and driving convergence.
Work closely with logic design and DFT engineers to define and implement constraints for the various work modes, including their optimization for runtime and efficiency.
What we need to see:
B.SC./ M.SC. in Electrical Engineering/Computer Engineering.
3+ years of experience in physical design and STA
Proven experience in RTL2GDS and STA design and convergence
Familiarity with physical design EDA tools (such as Synopsys, Cadence, etc.)
Hands on STA experience from early stages to signoff using Synopsis Primetime. Deep knowledge in timing concepts required.
Great teammate.
NVIDIA has some of the most forward-thinking people in the world working for us. Are you a creative and autonomous engineer who loves a challenge? Are you ready to become the engineer you always wanted to be? Come and be part of the best physical design team in the industry!

jobs.title: Senior CAD Engineer
jobs.description:
NVIDIA has been redefining computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. Today, we're tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing — an era in which our GPUs act as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars. Doing what's never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world's best talent. Come join our diverse team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
We are now looking for a Physical Design Methodology and Operations Engineer! You'll join a small team that owns the infrastructure powering NVIDIA's semiconductor design flows — coordinating hundreds of thousands of jobs per day across datacenters with 10,000+ hosts, serving over 1,000 chip designers worldwide. Our platform spans job orchestration, event-driven trigger systems, global service interconnection, web interfaces to tools, and a Jenkins-like CI/CD backbone — a production system with direct stakes in GPU, CPU, SoC and networking tapeouts. You'll own a functional area within the team while contributing across broader operations. Our stack includes mature Perl and Python services alongside modern React frontends and Elasticsearch-based telemetry. We're actively modernizing, and we need someone who can think architecturally — evaluating what we have, identifying what needs to change, and driving that evolution in a way the team can execute and maintain. If you want to own something critical at scale and shape how it grows, this role is for you.
What you'll be doing:
Designing and supporting mechanisms for coordinating and maintaining large-scale semiconductor design tasks across multiple global datacenters.
Owning the architecture of one or more platform components — defining interfaces, data models, and service boundaries that can scale and evolve.
Leading the modernization of legacy services — evaluating existing Perl and Python backends, proposing migration strategies, and driving execution with the team.
Debugging and improving production services spanning web browsers, containerized microservices, and bare-metal Linux hosts.
Building and improving web interfaces to configure, launch, and analyze EDA tools and design flows.
Mining and analyzing large datasets of job execution telemetry and tool quality-of-results data to improve flows and catch regressions.
Mentoring junior engineers and contributing to design reviews and technical standards across the team.
Helping invent next-generation semiconductor design methodology.
Optionally, contributing directly to the physical design of GPU, CPU, SoC, and networking products — a rare opportunity for an infrastructure engineer.
What we want to see:
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or computer systems engineering (or equivalent experience).
5+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of designing and delivering production systems.
Strong software architecture and design skills — experience defining service boundaries, APIs, data models, and system interfaces.
Proficiency in Python and/or Perl; comfort with JavaScript and web technologies.
Experience with distributed systems at meaningful scale.
Proven ability to lead a project through its full lifecycle, from requirement solicitation to architecture design, to implementation, to maintenance and support.
Comfort owning and debugging Linux-based production services.
Ways to stand out from the crowd:
Experience with workflow orchestration systems (Airflow, Argo, Temporal, Luigi, or similar).
Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker or Kubernetes.
Familiarity with Elasticsearch / Kibana / Vega for telemetry and dashboarding.
Experience with MSSQL/Mysql/SQLite or other relational and NoSQL datastores.
Exposure to Static Timing Analysis or VLSI physical design.
NVIDIA is widely considered one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and talented people in the world working for us. If you're an engineer who thinks in systems, takes pride in designing things that last, and wants to see the silicon your work helps produce — we want to hear from you.

jobs.title: SOC Verification Engineer
jobs.description:
NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself over two decades. Our invention of the GPU in 1999 sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. More recently, GPU deep learning ignited modern AI — the next era of computing. NVIDIA is a “learning machine” that constantly evolves by adapting to new opportunities that are hard to seek, which only we can pursue, and which matter to the world. This is our life’s work: to amplify human inventiveness and intelligence. NVIDIA is now driving innovation at the intersection of visual processing, high-performance computing, and artificial intelligence.
We are currently seeking an expert Verification Engineer with strong verification fundamentals to work in NVIDIA's SOC verification team.
What you’ll be doing:
Work on NVIDIA's next generation SOC
Verify CPU, GPU, high speed interfaces, Design for Debug (DFD) and horizontal functions like Boot and Power management at subsystem or full chip testbenches including FPGA/Silicon
Develop and implement testplans collaborating with SOC architects
Work on developing verification testbenches, flows and automation, explore and implement new methodologies to support verification of groundbreaking architecture
What we need to see:
Experience with full stack development - from verifying scenarios at SW simulator level, to getting the overall end-to-end test working on silicon with a full sw stack.
Strong verification fundamentals and able to juggle working on SW simulators, full chip testbenches and on FPGA/Silicon
Experience with Verilog, SystemVerilog, C/C++ and possess strong debugging skills
Experience in creating test benches grounds up, build flows, verification infrastructure
Bachelors/Masters, or equivalent experience, in Computer Science or electrical engineering with 3+ years of industry experience
Ways to stand out from the crowd:
Experience with doing complex verification projects at subsystem and/or SOC integration levels
Knowledge of SOC integration and verification methodologies
Experience of collaborating with geographically diverse multi-functional teams
With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, we are widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most brilliant and talented people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our elite engineering teams are rapidly growing. jobs.title: Senior System Software Engineer - Boot SW Engineering
jobs.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
Join NVIDIA as a Senior System Software Engineer in our Boot SW development team in India and be part of a team that is pushing the boundaries of technology! Our System Software team is dedicated to crafting and developing the Boot SW stack for NVIDIA SoCs enabling computation products in Automotive, Embedded, and Server markets. If you are passionate about embedded system software and eager to tackle outstanding and novel challenges, this is the right opportunity for you. At NVIDIA, we are driving the new age of computing with AI, revolutionizing industries from gaming to healthcare!
What you'll be doing:
Design key aspects of the Boot SW with focus on enabling an entire range of NVIDIA SoC platforms to boot various operating systems.
Develop and productize software for CPU and memory initialization, resource management, drivers, platform configuration, and security parameters.
Collaborate with software, hardware, architecture and platform teams to define system requirements, configurations, and boot security.
Ensure the bootloader architecture maintains forward and backward compatibility, emphasizing on boot security and performance.
Contribute to achieving the best performance, efficiency in compliance with ISO26262 safety standards and ISO21434 security standards for current and next-generation NVIDIA TEGRA SoCs.
Improve work flows and processes by using AI agents and tools to establish automation frameworks and agentic work flows.
What we need to see:
B.Tech/M.Tech in Electronics/Computer Engineering or equivalent experience with 5+ years of software development.
Strong programming, debugging, and analytical skills with a deep understanding of operating systems and processor ISA.
Proficiency in C programming and low-level driver experience; expertise in system-level debugging.
Knowledge of Assemblers, binary formats (such as ELF, DWARF), and understanding of ABI.
Experience in developing Boot software or BSP for embedded, mobile, automotive products or networking products.
Familiarity with ARMv8-based processor architecture and board bring-up.
Self-learner with excellent proactive communication skills and a professional approach to technical challenges.
Inquisitive about AI tools and Agentic work flows.
Ways to stand out from the crowd:
Proven experience in bootloader development and bare metal programming.
Experience with developing and applying AI tools to automate Software development workflows and processes.
Familiarity with developing Functional Safe software for automotive applications.
Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com/

As an Electrical Design Engineer in the Systems Integration Group (SIG) of Micron Technology, Inc, you will design load boards that support semiconductor memory manufacturing, as well as resolve issues with and develop improvements to deployed automated test equipment (ATE) products.
Load boards, used for testing memory devices after they are manufactured & packaged, are the contact interface between ATE and pins of the device under test (DUT). Load boards contain the necessary components to:
setup the DUT for correct testing by the ATE;
route power, test, and response signals between the DUT and the ATE;
provide additional test capabilities that the ATE may not be able to provide; and,
alternately, testing or calibrate the ATE itself.
Load board design considerations, like other PCB assemblies, include DC power supply distribution, clock & digital routing, and high-speed signal integrity. You will apply circuit theory to design load board solutions working closely with other team members located around the world that include other engineering disciplines, technicians, procurement, planning, and external contract manufacturers.

jobs.title: Functional Safety Staff Engineer, ASIC Digital Design
jobs.description:
We Are
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
You Are
You have spent years in the space where hardware meets safety, and you know that a chip destined for an automotive system is not just about performance or power, it is about proving that when something goes wrong, the design catches it before it matters. You think in failure modes, diagnostic coverage, and safety mechanisms, not as compliance checkboxes but as engineering decisions that determine whether a product ships or gets recalled.
You have read ISO 26262 enough times that you can tell when a Technical Safety Concept is missing a dependency or when an FMEA is too shallow to survive an audit. You are comfortable sitting with architects who are sketching out a new IP block and asking the questions that surface safety gaps early, before RTL is written and before verification plans are locked. You do not wait for someone to hand you a safety requirement, you help shape it based on what the hardware can realistically deliver.
You have done the work. You have written safety analyses, reviewed fault injection results, defined safety mechanisms, and worked through assessor feedback without losing your patience or your clarity. At Synopsys, you will work on IP and SoC products where safety is not an afterthought, and where the rigor you bring will directly shape what our automotive customers can build.
What You'll Be Doing
Drive Functional Safety activities across ASIC IP and SoC development lifecycles, from early architecture through verification and release
Develop and review safety requirements, Technical Safety Concepts, and safety work products in compliance with ISO 26262
Conduct safety analyses including FMEA, FMEDA, FTA, and Dependent Failure Analysis to identify and mitigate failure modes
Define, implement, and evaluate safety mechanisms at the IP, subsystem, and SoC level to meet diagnostic coverage and fault detection targets
Collaborate with Architecture, RTL Design, and Verification teams to integrate safety into design and validation workflows
Interface with customers, cross-functional teams, and external safety assessors to support audits, reviews, and certification activities
Document safety analyses, traceability matrices, and compliance evidence for internal reviews and external assessments
The Impact You Will Have
Enable Synopsys IP and SoC products to meet automotive safety standards and support customer certification timelines
Reduce late-stage design rework by identifying safety risks early in the architecture and design phases
Improve diagnostic coverage and fault detection capabilities across safety-critical semiconductor products
Strengthen customer confidence by delivering well-documented, auditable safety work products that pass assessor scrutiny
Influence hardware safety architectures that will be deployed in next-generation automotive systems
Build internal capability by mentoring design and verification engineers on Functional Safety principles and practices
Contribute to a culture where safety is embedded in engineering decisions, not bolted on at the end
What You'll Need
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline
6 to 10 years of experience in Functional Safety engineering, with a focus on automotive semiconductor, IP, or SoC development
Strong working knowledge of ISO 26262 standards, processes, and compliance requirements across hardware development lifecycles
Proven experience developing and reviewing safety requirements, Technical Safety Concepts, and related safety work products
Hands-on expertise in FMEA, FMEDA, FTA, and Dependent Failure Analysis methodologies
Experience defining and evaluating safety mechanisms, diagnostic coverage, and fault mitigation strategies at IP or SoC level
Understanding of semiconductor product development and verification flows, and the ability to work independently with cross-functional teams, customers, and assessors. Experience with automotive IPs, networking or communication IPs, or safety-critical products is a strong plus
Who You Are
You can walk into an architecture review and spot a safety gap that others miss, not because you are looking for problems but because you understand how failures propagate
You write safety analyses that are clear enough for an assessor to follow and detailed enough to survive a technical challenge from a design lead
You do not get stuck when requirements are incomplete or when a design decision has not been finalized, you work with what you have and flag what needs to be resolved
You can explain a complex safety mechanism to an RTL engineer in a way that makes sense within their workflow, not as an abstract concept but as something they can implement and verify
You are organized enough to track safety work products across multiple IP blocks and disciplined enough to maintain traceability without cutting corners
You push back when a proposed design does not meet safety targets, and you do it in a way that moves the conversation forward instead of shutting it down
The Team You'll Be Part Of
Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process.
Rewards and Benefits
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

jobs.description:
We Are
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
You Are
You have spent the last few years deep in FPGA design and implementation, and you have learned that the real work begins when a customer's design does not compile the way they expected or when partitioning across multiple FPGAs creates timing issues no one saw coming. You are the engineer who stays on the call until the problem is solved, not because you have to, but because leaving something half-fixed bothers you.
You are comfortable reading Verilog or SystemVerilog that someone else wrote, understanding what they were trying to do, and figuring out why the synthesis tool is choking on it. You know your way around FPGA architecture well enough to explain why a design that worked fine in simulation is failing in hardware, and you can do it in a way that does not make the customer feel like they missed something obvious.
Working with customers energizes you. You like the variety of problems, the pressure of real deadlines, and the satisfaction of helping someone get unstuck. You do not need everything documented perfectly to move forward. You ask the right questions, dig into log files, reproduce issues locally, and escalate to R&D when needed with enough context that they can actually help.
At Synopsys, you will work with some of the most complex emulation and prototyping workflows in the industry, supporting global customers who depend on Zebu and Protocompiler to verify chips that power everything from automotive systems to data centers.
What You'll Be Doing
Provide technical support to global customers using Synopsys Zebu Emulation and Protocompiler Prototyping software, troubleshooting issues across partitioning, synthesis, place and route, and hardware debug
Work directly with customers to migrate their designs to new software releases, ensuring compatibility and resolving any regressions or performance issues that surface
Deploy new software features on live customer designs, helping them adopt capabilities like advanced partitioning algorithms, new debug modes, or updated FPGA target support

The Impact You Will Have

Improve product quality by surfacing real customer pain points to R&D with enough technical detail that fixes can be prioritized and implemented effectively
Build customer confidence in Synopsys HAV solutions through responsive, expert-level support that helps them solve problems they could not solve on their own
Expand adoption of new software features by showing customers how to use them on their actual designs, not just in demos
Reduce escalations and support load over time by delivering training that helps customers become more self-sufficient with the toolchain
Strengthen customer relationships by being the engineer they trust to pick up the phone when something is broken and production timelines are at risk
Contribute to the technical knowledge base and internal best practices that make the entire support organization more effective
What You'll Need
Bachelors in Electronics Engineering with 2-3 years of experience, or Master's in Electronics Engineering with 1-2 years, specifically in emulation or prototyping environments
Hands-on experience with logic design and implementation using FPGAs, including synthesis, place and route, and timing closure
Strong working knowledge of Verilog, System Verilog, or VHDL, including the ability to read, debug, and modify RTL written by others
Practical experience with FPGA architecture and back-end implementation flows, including understanding of resource utilization, clock domain crossing, and design partitioning
Exposure to Xilinx or Altera synthesis tools is a plus, as is familiarity with Synopsys Prototyping or Emulation hardware and software
Experience with interface protocols like PCIe, AXI, UART, or I2C is a plus, particularly in the context of hardware-software integration
Scripting experience in Python, Tcl, or shell is desirable for automating workflows and analyzing log files
Who You Are
You can take a vague customer complaint like 'the compile is failing' and turn it into a specific, reproducible issue with enough detail that R&D can act on it
You stay calm when a customer is frustrated or under pressure, and you focus on solving the problem rather than defending the tool
You are comfortable working across time zones and managing multiple customer issues in parallel without losing track of who needs what by when
You do not mind digging through synthesis logs, waveform dumps, or FPGA utilization reports to find the root cause of a problem
You can explain a complex technical tradeoff, like why a design needs to be repartitioned or why certain optimizations are not possible, in a way that makes sense to someone who is not an FPGA expert
You are open to occasional travel for customer support, training, or onsite troubleshooting when remote support is not enough
The Team You'll Be Part Of
You will join Synopsys Technical Sales Group (TSG) as part of the Hardware Assisted Verification (HAV) team, working alongside expert-level field engineers who support customers globally on Zebu Emulation and Protocompiler Prototyping solutions. The team works closely with R&D and directly with customers at all stages of the emulation and prototyping cycle, from pre-sales evaluation through post-deployment support. You will collaborate with engineers across geographies and gain exposure to Synopsys HAV hardware platforms as part of your technical development.

Who You Are

jobs.description:
Intuit’s Internal Audit (IA) team provides independent, objective assurance and advisory services that add value and improve Intuit’s operations. We are transforming the function from a traditional assurance model into an AI-enabled one, and our newly established Center of Excellence (CoE) drives our technology-enabled and data-driven initiatives.
As a Senior AI Developer in the Internal Audit Center of Excellence (CoE), you will be at the forefront of driving digital transformation by building next-generation agentic AI solutions. Unlike traditional generative AI tools that primarily respond to prompts, your focus will be on developing autonomous agents capable of planning, executing, and adapting actions to achieve complex audit objectives with minimal human intervention. By integrating cutting-edge AI and advanced data connectors into audit planning, fieldwork, and reporting, you will drive full-population testing and unlock data-driven predictive insights.
You will develop AI agents that plan, execute, and adapt to meet complex audit objectives with minimal human intervention. You will bridge gaps in data identification and usage for advanced machine learning and practical audit execution, moving the function from sample-based checks to AI-enabled, data-driven predictive insights.
Responsibilities
Agentic Solution Development
Design and code AI agents that autonomously navigate across systems to test controls, flag anomalies, and track transactions in near real-time.
Build multi-step planning systems capable of dynamic audit planning and scoping by analyzing risk registers, operational data, and external indicators.
Implement and manage agentic capabilities across established LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google), utilizing tools like Claude Code for enterprise-grade automation.
Develop standardized prompt libraries and internal AI-assisted reporting tools to enhance auditor productivity and coverage.
Technical Build
Utilize Python, SQL, and R to build robust data pipelines (ETL) and automation scripts for full-population data testing.
Build and extend audit tooling, including AI-powered prototypes, user-facing tools (using React, Node.js, and TypeScript), Slack bots for evidence tracking, and real-time interactive dashboards.

Working at Atlassian
Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

The Search Platform team is responsible for powering Rovo Search, knowledge discovery and search for humans and agents across all enterprise data. Our mission is to make all our customers' data across Atlassian and their external apps (i.e. third-party applications) searchable securely and reliably through an insanely fast, globally scalable, cost-efficient, enterprise grade search infrastructure. Powering search and discovery in the agentic era is a whole new challenge and this team is at the forefront for Atlassian.
As a Senior Principal Engineer in Search Platform, you will own technical roadmap, execution and outcomes for the Search Data pillar. You will help envision, build and evolve a cutting-edge platform for integrating, processing, indexing and searching massive volumes of unstructured data across 100+ sources. Your deep expertise in large-scale data platforms, streaming and batch processing and distributed systems to solve some of our most complex problems including infrastructure, data and dev/agentic productivity challenges. Data is messy and hard and its the most critical, make or break input for Search and AI.
As a senior technical leader, you will be expected to lead other engineers to define our strategic technical direction, and to own outcomes from design to launch. Your role is pivotal in identifying and driving step-change initiatives, choosing the problems to solve vs not, in order to deliver a world-class end-to-end search experience, powered by rich data which is fresh, reliable across all apps.
Responsibilities:
Collaborate with technical leads, partner teams and internal customers to define technical strategy and architecture for Search Data.
Lead the evolution of our data platform and pipelines to meet the demands of both real-time search freshness and AI/agentic retrieval at enterprise scale.
Make hard architectural trade-offs between freshness, correctness, cost, and operational simplicity - and own the outcomes.
Drive the simplification and modernization of complex, legacy data processing systems. Identify and eliminate unnecessary complexity. Design systems that are understandable, testable, and operable.
Establish design patterns and best practices for handling the inherent messiness of real-world data - schema evolution, partial failures, eventual consistency, connector variability, and data quality degradation.
Own engineering and operational excellence for the health of our systems and processes. Proactively drive opportunities for continuous improvements and own key operational metrics.
Transform developer productivity to ensure that we unleash the potential of our own team with agents. Champion a culture of high ownership, rigorous testing, safe rollouts, and data-driven engineering across Search Data teams.
Help hire and mentor engineers to build an open, innovative and operationally responsible culture.

Deep experience with distributed data frameworks (Kafka, Flink, Spark) - you have built, operated, and debugged systems processing billions of events per day. Strong background in designing data architectures that handle messy, heterogeneous data at scale - including schema evolution, data quality, idempotency, backfill/replay, and partial failure recovery.
Track record of simplifying complex systems. You have taken spaghetti systems and turned them into something engineers can reason about, test, and operate confidently.

Strong software engineering fundamentals. Fluency in at least one modern language (Java preferred). You write code, review code, and hold a high bar for engineering quality.

jobs.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

ROLE
Lead first-silicon bring-up, characterization, debug, and validation of advanced 3D NAND products. Establish whether silicon meets design intent and datasheet requirements, correlate simulation with measurements, and resolve issues that could affect product qualification, reliability, yield, or SSD/system integration.
This role provides a unique opportunity to develop end-to-end expertise across advanced NAND products, spanning circuit design concepts, mixed-signal simulations, first-silicon bring-up, silicon debug, product qualification, and manufacturing readiness. Engineers gain broad exposure to analog, mixed-signal, digital, firmware, memory-array, and system-level behavior while working closely with design, verification, firmware, product, and system teams.
RESPONSIBILITIES
• Own validation strategies, coverage, and test plans for assigned NAND circuits and functions; define expected behavior, operating corners, and pass/fail criteria from product specifications and design intent.
• Lead first-silicon bring-up, characterization, debug, and simulation-to-silicon correlation across voltage, temperature, process, timing, and workload conditions.
• Characterize and debug NAND subsystems including reference and bias generation circuits, bandgap references, oscillators, voltage regulators, charge pumps, sensing and page-buffer paths, high-voltage program/erase circuitry, memory-core drivers, control and timing logic, interface circuitry, trim and calibration functions, and firmware-controlled mixed-signal features.
• Investigate silicon failures with Design, Verification, Firmware, Test, Reliability, Product Engineering, and SSD/System teams. Form evidence-based hypotheses, design targeted experiments, identify root causes, and drive issues to verified closure through hardware, firmware, test-flow, trim, or workaround solutions.
• Convert silicon observations into engineering insight and product decisions by explaining deviations from expected behavior, assessing risk, recommending next actions, reviewing validation evidence, mentoring engineers, and improving reusable validation and debug methodologies.
Proven ability to leverage AI‑assisted (vibe) coding techniques to improve efficiency or automate design and analysis methodologies
Leverage AI tools to automate the tools and workflowApplying Artificial Intelligence in workflows to improve build efficiency
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
• BS, MS, or PhD in Electrical, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or a related field, with experience appropriate to the approved Senior Staff/Principal level.
• Strong analog and mixed-signal fundamentals with substantial experience in at least one of the following:
Mixed-signal verification
Analog/Mixed-Signal IC design
Post-silicon validation and characterization
Memory validation
• Experience with mixed-signal simulation environments, including full-chip, block-level, pre-layout, or post-layout simulations.
• Familiarity with Verilog/System-Verilog-based simulation and debug environments.
• Ability to derive tests from specifications, assess coverage, debug complex circuit behavior, and explain differences between expected and observed results.
• Experience with validation, characterization, data analysis, scripting, or automation using tools such as Python.
• Strong technical communication, problem-solving, and cross-functional leadership skills.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• NAND Flash, SSD, DRAM, or other memory technology experience, including program/read/erase operations, sensing architectures, bias generation, charge pumps, timing/control circuits, reliability characterization, or system-level integration.
• Experience with System-Verilog, Verilog-AMS, real-number modeling, SPICE, assertions, functional coverage, or simulation-to-silicon correlation methodologies.
• Hands-on experience with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, probe stations, source measurement units (SMUs), semiconductor parameter analyzers, automated test equipment (ATE), or similar silicon characterization platforms.

Project Initiation

Project Planning
Establish project governance, including sponsors, core team, and extended project team, and drive effective kickoff activities.
Facilitate business and technical requirements gathering across functional and technical stakeholder groups.
Establish and maintain project management artifacts, ensuring a well-governed and transparent tracking of project progress, risks, and dependencies
Forecast project spend, SOWs, and POs, and support financial planning and budget tracking throughout the lifecycle.
Support executive reviews and stage-gate approvals with decision-ready materials, not just status updates.
Project Execution & Closure
Manage project scope, quality, schedule, and deliverables, adapting the plan as new information emerges.
Track development, SOE, and UAT milestones, and translate progress into clear, decision-ready status for leadership.
Proactively manage risks, issues, and escalations by bringing recommendations and options, not just problems.
Provide consistent and accurate status reporting to PMO and leadership teams.
Facilitate lessons learned and drive formal project closure and approval.
Leadership and PMO Excellence
Lead cross-functional project teams and build shared alignment around the project vision.
Resolve conflicts constructively and manage resource allocation across the project team.
Provide mentorship to less experienced team members and contribute to continuous improvement in PMO process efficiency.
Actively adopt AI-enabled tools and workflows to improve planning, reporting, and delivery efficiency.
Qualifications & Skills:
5+ years of Project Management experience, including ownership of medium-to-complex, cross-functional projects.
Demonstrated ability to work independently under project or sub-function objectives, determining the best method to deliver rather than requiring step-by-step direction.
Working knowledge of Agile, Scrum, and Waterfall methodologies, applied to fit the project context.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to produce decision-ready updates for sponsors and leadership.
Strong change management capabilities and experience facilitating stakeholder alignment without formal authority.
Familiarity with AI-enabled productivity, reporting, or analytics tools applied to project or portfolio management.
Experience mentoring junior project team members
Inclusive, collaborative, and comfortable engaging with technical, non-technical, vendor, and leadership teams.
Preferred Qualifications:
PMP certification.
Experience managing enterprise-wide, cross-functional programs spanning multiple sites or geographies.
Education and Experience:
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, Engineering, Project Management, or equivalent certifications/professional experience. Related disciplines considered.
Minimum of 5 years of project management experience in enterprise technology, infrastructure, security, digital workplace, platform migration, application delivery or related programs

Success in this role is measured through strong delivery against P3 expectations, including independent decision-making, governance leadership, stakeholder influence, analytical rigor, AI-enabled PMO excellence, coaching, integrity, and measurable project outcomes.

Strong, sustained performance against the P3 competency bar, particularly independent decision-making, governance leadership, and coaching, is the primary pathway to expanded scope and future progression.

jobs.title: R&D Engineering, Sr Engineer
jobs.description:
Alternate Job Titles
Standard Cell Library Characterization Engineer
We Are
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
You Are
You have spent enough time in library characterization to know that a Liberty model is only as good as the corner cases you tested and the correlations you actually validated. You understand that when a designer's STA run fails because of a timing model mismatch, it is not just a data issue, it is hours of someone's schedule gone, and you take that seriously.
You are comfortable moving between SPICE simulations, Liberty file generation, and debugging why a CCS noise model behaves differently than expected across PVT corners. When a correlation gap shows up between characterization and static timing analysis, you do not just log it, you dig in, reproduce it, and figure out what assumption broke down.
You know the difference between running a characterization flow and owning it. Running it means you execute scripts. Owning it means you catch the issue before QA does, you spot the pattern in regression failures, and you know when a model needs another pass even if it technically meets spec.
At Synopsys, you will work on standard cell libraries that power advanced node designs across the semiconductor industry. The libraries you characterize will be used in real tapeouts, and the quality bar is not negotiable.
What You'll Be Doing
Characterize and model standard cell libraries for advanced technology nodes, generating Liberty files including NLDM, NLPM, CCS timing, CCS noise, ECSM, LVF, AOCV, POCV, spatial OCV, aging, and EM models
Handle characterization across a wide range of cell types: combinational, sequential, clock gating, synchronizers, retention, level shifters, power gating, always-on, filler, and decap cells
Debug and resolve correlation issues between characterization results, static timing analysis, and SPICE simulations, working across tool flows to identify root causes
Execute QA checks, regression analysis, and release validation to ensure library deliverables meet quality and accuracy standards before they ship
Drive methodology improvements and automation initiatives that make characterization flows faster, more reliable, and easier to maintain across multiple projects
Coordinate project execution timelines, manage deliverables, and communicate status across cross-functional teams including design, verification, and product engineering
Support library releases by validating models against design rule checks, performing sanity testing, and ensuring documentation is complete and accurate
The Impact You Will Have
Enable accurate timing closure for advanced node designs by delivering high-quality Liberty models that designers and STA tools depend on
Reduce correlation gaps between characterization and silicon behavior, improving predictability and reducing costly respins for customers
Accelerate library development cycles by building automation and improving characterization flows that scale across multiple technology nodes
Increase library quality and reliability through rigorous QA, regression testing, and validation processes that catch issues before release
Support successful tapeouts by ensuring standard cell libraries meet performance, power, and area targets across all operating conditions
Contribute to methodology evolution by identifying gaps, proposing solutions, and implementing improvements that benefit the entire characterization team
Help Synopsys maintain its leadership in library IP by delivering models that meet the precision and robustness requirements of cutting-edge semiconductor designs
What You'll Need
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, VLSI, Microelectronics, or a related technical field
2+ years of hands-on experience in standard cell library characterization and Liberty modeling
Strong understanding of Liberty file formats including NLDM, CCS, ECSM, and advanced modeling constructs like AOCV, POCV, and aging models
Experience characterizing multiple cell types: combinational, sequential, clock gating, level shifters, retention, or power management cells
Solid grasp of SPICE simulation, timing analysis concepts, and correlation methodologies between characterization tools and STA flows
Proficiency in scripting languages like Python, Tcl, or Perl for automation, data analysis, and flow development
Experience with industry-standard characterization tools and STA platforms is a strong plus
Who You Are
You can look at a Liberty file and spot when a timing arc does not make sense or a capacitance value looks off, and you know how to trace it back to the characterization setup
When a correlation issue appears, you do not wait for someone else to debug it, you pull the SPICE deck, compare waveforms, and figure out where the model diverged
You are organized enough to manage multiple library releases in parallel without losing track of which models are validated, which are in QA, and which need another pass
You can explain a complex characterization issue to a design engineer or a project lead in a way that makes sense without dumbing it down or losing the technical detail
You push back when a release timeline does not leave enough room for proper validation, because you know that shipping a bad model costs more than delaying a release by a few days
You treat automation as part of the job, not extra credit, and you are always looking for repetitive tasks that should be scripted instead of done manually
The Team You'll Be Part Of
You will join the Library Characterization team at Synopsys, a group responsible for characterization, validation, QA, release management, and methodology support for advanced standard cell libraries across multiple technology nodes. Your recruiter will share more about the team structure, current projects, and how the team collaborates with design, product engineering, and customer-facing groups during the interview process.
Rewards and Benefits
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.
At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

jobs.title: Principal Emulation Application Engineer
jobs.description:
Alternate Job Titles
Principal Emulation Application Engineer
Principal Technical Support Engineer, Emulation
Principal Field Application Engineer, ZeBu
Principal Emulation Solutions Engineer
Principal Customer Engineer, Hardware Emulation
We Are
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
You Are
You have spent years in the trenches of emulation bring-up, where the difference between a design that runs and one that stalls for three weeks often comes down to a synthesis constraint you spotted at 2am or a partitioning decision that nobody else questioned. You know ZeBu and VCS not from a training deck but from hundreds of hours spent coaxing massive SoC designs through compile, mapping them onto FPGA fabrics, and hunting down the one signal in a 50-million-gate design that is causing everything to hang.
You are the engineer customers call when their emulation run fails and they are out of ideas. You do not panic when a waveform trace is 40GB and the root cause is buried six hierarchy levels deep. You open Verdi, you methodically narrow the search space, and you find it. Debugging is not a chore for you, it is a puzzle you are genuinely good at solving.
You write Python and Tcl scripts not because someone asked you to automate something, but because you got tired of doing the same manual triage five times in one week. You build tools that make the next bring-up faster. You think in terms of reproducibility, handoff, and knowledge transfer, not just one-off heroics.
At Synopsys, you will work directly with customers running some of the most complex chip designs in the industry, and what you solve will directly unblock their tapeouts.
What You'll Be Doing
Own end-to-end SoC design bring-up on ZeBu emulation platforms, from RTL ingestion through synthesis, partitioning, place and route, and runtime execution
Diagnose and resolve complex tool issues across the emulation flow including synthesis failures, FPGA fabric mapping bottlenecks, routing congestion, and runtime performance degradation
Perform deep waveform-level debugging in Verdi to isolate RTL bugs, protocol violations, timing issues, and functional mismatches between simulation and emulation
Act as the primary technical point of contact between customers, field Application Engineers, and Synopsys R&D to drive root-cause analysis and deliver fixes or workarounds under tight timelines
Build Python, Tcl, and Shell automation scripts to streamline debug workflows, accelerate triage, and solve recurring operational problems across customer engagements
Collaborate with AE and R&D teams to reproduce customer issues in-house, document findings, and contribute to tool quality improvements and release readiness
Provide technical mentorship and knowledge transfer to customers and internal teams on emulation best practices, debug methodologies, and performance tuning techniques
The Impact You Will Have
Unblock critical customer tapeout schedules by resolving emulation bring-up issues that would otherwise delay verification by weeks or months
Reduce mean time to resolution for complex ZeBu and VCS issues through expert-level triage and direct collaboration with R&D
Improve emulation platform reliability and performance by identifying systemic tool gaps and driving product enhancements based on real customer pain points
Accelerate customer productivity by delivering reusable automation scripts and debug frameworks that become standard practice across their teams
Strengthen customer trust and product adoption by serving as a credible, responsive technical partner who consistently delivers solutions under pressure
Contribute to Synopsys product quality by feeding field intelligence back into the development cycle, shaping future ZeBu and VCS releases
Build institutional knowledge within the support and AE organizations through documentation, training, and hands-on collaboration on the hardest cases
What You'll Need
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent hands-on experience in SoC design or verification
8+ years of experience in emulation, hardware-assisted verification, or FPGA-based prototyping with deep expertise in Synopsys ZeBu and VCS
Proven ability to bring up large-scale SoC designs on emulation platforms, including RTL synthesis, FPGA partitioning, place and route, and runtime debug
Strong proficiency with Verdi for waveform analysis, signal tracing, and root-cause debug across multi-million gate designs
Hands-on scripting skills in Python, Tcl, and Shell for automation, data parsing, and workflow optimization
Experience working directly with customers in a support, application engineering, or field engineering capacity
Deep understanding of digital design fundamentals, RTL coding practices, and common verification methodologies including UVM is a plus
Who You Are
You can walk into a customer war room where a critical emulation run has been failing for two days, ask three clarifying questions, pull the right log files, and have a hypothesis within an hour
You do not need someone to tell you what to automate, when you see yourself doing the same manual task twice, you write a script before the third time
You are comfortable telling a customer 'I do not know yet, but here is what I am going to check next' and then actually following through with a clear update by end of day
You can explain a complex FPGA routing issue to an AE who has never touched the back-end flow, and also discuss the same issue with an R&D engineer using the precise technical terminology they need to reproduce it
You stay calm under pressure, when a customer is blocked and escalations are flying, you focus on the data, isolate the variables, and move methodically toward a solution
You care about leaving things better than you found them, whether that is a cleaner debug script, a better-documented workaround, or a process improvement that helps the next engineer
The Team You'll Be Part Of
Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process.
Rewards and Benefits
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.
At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

About this role
Company Description
HPS Investment Partners, a part of BlackRock, is a leading global, credit-focused alternative investment manager that seeks to provide creative capital solutions and generate attractive risk-adjusted returns for our clients. We manage various strategies across the capital structure, including privately negotiated senior debt; privately negotiated junior capital solutions in debt, preferred and equity formats; liquid credit including syndicated leveraged loans, collateralized loan obligations and high yield bonds; asset-based finance and real estate. The scale and breadth of our platform offers flexibility to invest in companies large and small, through standard or customized solutions. At our core, we share a common thread of intellectual rigor and discipline that enables us to create value for our clients.
The HPS/BlackRock Transaction brings together BlackRock’s corporate and asset owner relationships with HPS’s diversified origination and capital flexibility. BlackRock and HPS have formed a new private financing solutions business unit (“PFS”) led by Scott Kapnick, Scot French, and Michael Patterson, creating an integrated franchise with approximately $370 billion in client assets, including $205 billion of private credit assets. This combined platform, which has more than 590 investment professionals and approximately 1,300 employees globally, offers broad capabilities across senior and junior credit solutions, asset-based finance, real estate, CLOs and GP-LP solutions. As part of the HPS/BlackRock Transaction, Scott Kapnick, Scot French, and Michael Patterson have joined BlackRock’s Global Executive Committee, and Scott Kapnick has been appointed as an observer to the BlackRock Board.
Department Description
The Middle Office team (MO) within Private Financing Solutions (PFS) – Blackrock’s private credit platform – is responsible for ensuring the Fund’s positions and cash balances are accurate. They manage the lifecycle of all trades/investments. They are responsible for trade capture, trade settlement, loan administration, daily cash and position reconciliations, corporate action elections/recordings, audit requests, new mandate onboarding, and PnL break analysis and resolution with fund administrators. MO handles ad-hoc requests that come from the deal team and/or separately managed account clients. The team interacts closely with the Deal Execution, Treasury, Fund Accounting, Fund Finance, Cash Management, Portfolio Analytics, Data Analytics, Valuations and the Deal Teams daily.
Position Description
PFS is seeking to recruit an Associate to join the Middle Office Operations team based in Mumbai. The individual should be highly organized with strong attention to detail. They should have the ability to meet strict deadlines, as well as work independently and as part of a team. A desire for a fast-paced environment is crucial.
Responsibilities
Specific responsibilities will include but not be limited to the following:
Daily street side cash and position breaks vs. prime brokers & custodians
Liaise with firm custodians and prime brokers ensuring proper trading activity and settlement

jobs.description:
About this role
BlackRock is seeking a Director to lead data operations for the Assets & Opportunity pillar within the BlackRock Data Office (BDO) in Gurugram, reporting directly to the Global Head of BDO Data Operations. The BDO, part of Aladdin Data, accelerates how data is onboarded, governed, managed and consumed through the firm’s Enterprise Data Platform, so that trusted, reusable and AI-ready data can be managed as a strategic enterprise asset supporting operational excellence, analytics, AI innovation, and our 2030 strategy.
As the operational lead for the Assets & Opportunity pillar, the Director will stand up and manage a centralized data operations function to help deliver a trusted client-level and business-specific view of assets under management (AUM) and net new assets to the global enterprise, working in close partnership with the Assets & Opportunity data stewards and the BDO Engineering and Product teams. The role is accountable for operating the processes behind this view: ingesting, validating and monitoring data from third-party providers, distributors and home offices, and partnering with them to ensure the data is accurate, timely and discoverable and that client flows are attributed to the correct client, product, and client business.
The Director will also run the operations that support the Walletshare data strategy (the share of a client’s total assets that BlackRock manages versus competitors), helping unify the full “addressable wallet” view of the client to enable our client businesses’ growth goals. Job Description
At Tieto Caretech you’ll get a chance to provide patients and end users with product offerings that help them in their life, reinventing the world for good. If that sounds interesting, please keep on reading.
About us
Tieto Caretech is modernizing the Nordic health and social care sector with modular, open, and interoperable software. We develop and deliver high-quality software solutions and services that enable healthcare and welfare professionals to do their work even better and with higher efficiency - have more time to care.

In addition to working closely with our customers, we also have our own products that we build and develop for various fields in society. From enabling healthcare professionals to spend more valuable time with their patients to providing data for professional athletes to achieve even better results, we make all that possible. With us you can build technology for the good of society and make your mark on the health and wellbeing of people in need.
Within Operational Excellence, we enable efficient and harmonised ways of working across Caretech, including cybersecurity, privacy, compliance, process governance and related capabilities.
About the role
We are looking for a hands-on Senior Azure AI Developer to build and deliver secure AI applications on Microsoft Azure. The role will focus on Microsoft Foundry, AI agents and integrations, and production application development using .NET. You’ll work with architects, security specialists, and other engineers to turn requirements into reliable solutions.

Design and develop AI applications and agent-based solutions using Microsoft Foundry, MS Agent Framework and A2A.
Build backend services, APIs, and integrations using C# and .NET.
Develop production-ready generative AI features, such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool calling, and agent workflows.
Apply Azure security practices, including managed identities, Microsoft Entra ID, Key Vault, network controls, and role-based access.
Build and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform.
Use GitHub Copilot to support development, while reviewing generated code for security, quality, and correctness.
Contribute to technical design, code reviews, engineering standards, and deployment practices.
Work with Architect, security specialists and Operations Team to turn requirements into working solutions.
Monitor and improve application reliability, performance, security, and cost.
Support containerized deployment and frontend integration where needed.
What we are looking for
Approximately 8–10 years of cloud software development experience.
Strong hands-on experience building services and APIs with C# and .NET.
Practical experience developing and delivering applications on Microsoft Azure.
Experience developing AI or generative AI applications, including prompt design, grounding or RAG, and integration with models and data sources.
Hands-on experience with Microsoft Foundry or related Azure AI development services.
Strong understanding of Azure security, identity, access control, secrets management, and secure application design.
Experience using Terraform to provision and manage cloud infrastructure.
Experience with GitHub Copilot, including evaluating and validating generated code.
Ability to explain technical decisions and take features from design through deployment.
Experience with CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and production support.
Considered an advantage
Experience with Kubernetes or Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
Familiarity with responsible AI, evaluation, content safety, and governance.
Microsoft AI-103 certification.
Why join us?
This role gives you the opportunity to shape how secure software development and product security are implemented across Caretech.
You will work at the intersection of cybersecurity, software engineering and product development, helping teams build secure solutions while strengthening common practices and capabilities across the organisation.
What’s in it for you?
In addition, as a company we offer you professional growth, open and friendly culture. We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working.
Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle. We want to encourage you to keep up that curiosity and deepen your knowledge on topics you’re interested in.
Could you be our new colleague?
We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today.

Step into the role of Operations Analyst at Barclays where you'll play a pivotal role in shaping the future. Join us in our mission to safeguard our business and our customers from financial crime risks.
Have the ability to work in a “permanent night shift”, work in office 5 days a week through training and period to full production which is four to six months. (Note: The USCB Bank Operation works in the window from 4 PM IST to 5 AM IST next day across 7 days a week)
Need to have understanding of US credit card product knowledge across US Consumer Banking.
Review and process customer requests by conducting in-depth due diligence, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, and safeguarding our clients and organization with expertise and care.
Analyze documents received via mail, fax, and digital uploads and ensure correct action and routing.
Identify the nature and purpose of documents and initiate appropriate actions, including case creation where required.
Locate and validate customer accounts using enterprise systems including Salesforce, TSYS, MetaStor, and ActiveStore.
Verify customer identity using parameters such as name, address, account number, and additional security details.
Open, update, and close cases accurately in Salesforce with detailed audit‑ready notes.
Ensure all cases are processed within defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs) across multiple partner queues.
Identify risk indicators such as account status issues or fraud flags and route cases to relevant teams as required.
Compliance with internal policies and audit standards

This role is based out of Noida.

To support business areas with day-to-day processing, reviewing, reporting, trading and issue resolution.

Support various business areas with day-to-day initiatives including processing, reviewing, reporting, trading, and issue resolution.
Collaboration with teams across the bank to align and integrate operational processes.
Identification of areas for improvement and providing recommendations in operational processes.
Development and implementation of operational procedures and controls to mitigate risks and maintain operational efficiency.
Development of reports and presentations on operational performance and communicate findings to internal senior stakeholders.
Identification of industry trends and developments to implement best practice in banking operations.
Participation in projects and initiatives to improve operational efficiency and effectiveness.

To meet the needs of stakeholders/ customers through operational excellence and customer service
Perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard

jobs.description:
Join us as an "Analyst - Customer Journey Mapping”, where you'll build analytical tools to generate insight, recognise patterns and predict behaviour, and deliver content direct to users of information products. This role plays a key part in shaping a customer-centric operating model by enabling clear visualisation of various customer journeys through robust mapping and process modelling techniques.
The successful candidate will be part of a team responsible for mapping the end-to-end customer journey across the “awareness to advocacy” stages for Barclays UK (BUK) Business Banking customers. This will involve bringing together customer data, insights, and operational process flows to identify opportunities that drive measurable improvements in customer experience, operational efficiency, and control effectiveness, in alignment with Barclays’ transformation strategy.
Key Responsibilities
Information sourcing (through SME engagement and available documentation), and converting into detailed, integrated visual customer journey flows.
Map journey flows at multiple (defined) levels of detail, ensuring all relevant journey variants are accurately captured.
Gather key data points across multiple stages in the mapped journeys to generate actionable insights on customer experience and operational efficiency.
Maintain journey map lineage through robust version control and periodic updates.
Collaborate with other analysts to help establish linkages across journey maps and enable integrated multi-journey views.
Securing SME alignment on the mapped journeys.
To be successful as an "Analyst - Customer Journey Mapping" you should have experience with:
Essential Skills & Experience
Experience in process mapping and modelling experience, in Banking and financial services / Consulting / GCC.
Tooling: Expert level proficiency in Figma (UI/UX design) and Blueworks Live (process mapping).
Excellent collaboration skills, with the ability to engage effectively with cross-functional teams across multiple geographic locations to obtain relevant data references that support effective journey visualisation.
Proven ability to manage multiple priorities concurrently.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to interpret and align banking terminology across Product, Fulfilment, and Servicing teams within customer journey maps.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to detail.
Integrate multiple journey variant maps to provide a consolidated view of related customer journeys.

Prior experience of working in / with:
agile transformation environments
Customer Experience / product teams
Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Celonis, and Power BI for workflow and performance optimisation.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and technically accomplished Principal Engineer with a proven track record of leading ASIC front-end methodologies and timing constraints development across complex Subsystems and SoCs.
The ideal candidate will bring 10+ years of VLSI design experience, with deep technical expertise in developing, validating, and deploying robust timing constraints methodologies and flows, ensuring high-quality deliverables and seamless handoff to Implementation teams. This role requires close collaboration with global design teams and cross-functional stakeholders to drive the adoption, standardization, and continuous improvement of IP, Subsystem, and SoC timing constraints methodologies, ensuring consistency, scalability, and design quality across projects.
Responsibilities:
Define and lead the development and deployment of advanced ASIC front-end methodologies for timing constraints development, validation, and sign-off across Subsystems and SoCs.
Collaborate closely within Design teams to identify and resolve timing constraints issues, ensuring high-quality constraints deliverables and seamless handoff to Implementation teams.
Partner with Design Verification (DV) teams to develop and execute appropriate validation strategies for timing constraints that cannot be fully verified through static analysis.
Drive automation and optimization of design validation and quality check flows to improve efficiency, scalability, and overall design quality
Work closely with global engineering teams to define, evaluate, standardize, and continuously improve design methodologies and flows, driving consistency and adoption across projects.
Demonstrate technical leadership by representing the company at industry conferences, technical working groups, and internal innovation and recognition forums.
Required Skills and Experience:
10+ years of experience in VLSI ASIC design and methodology development and deployment.
Confirmed track record in leading the timing constraint development and validation for the complex SoC projects.
SDC and Timing Constraint knowledge, experience working with tools like TimeVision, TCM and Fishtail
Expertise in EDA tools such as SpyGlass, VC RDC, LEC, Design Compilers, and formal verification tools.
Proficiency in scripting and automation using Python, Perl, TCL.
Strong understanding of Verilog/SystemVerilog and front-end design verification techniques (CDC, RDC,Lint, FV,Synthesis).
Exceptional communication, collaborator management, and technical program leadership.
'Nice to Have' Skills and Experience:
Experience with AI flow optimization and automation in EDA environments.
Familiarity with automotive SoC programs and compliance processes.
Awards or accolades demonstrating innovation, execution excellence, and peer recognition.
Background in multi-functional collaboration with software, IT, and program management teams.

jobs.title: Staff Engineer - PNR methodology
jobs.description:
Job Overview:
Arm is at the forefront of advanced silicon and multi-die system design. As part of the Solutions Engineering team, you will drive sub-2nm technology PPA enablement for high-performance and low-power products.
In this role, you will work closely with architecture, RTL, IP, physical design, DTCO, foundry, EDA, and package/board teams to optimize technology-node entitlement across performance, power, area, utilization, routability, reliability, and design convergence. The role focuses on translating advanced-node technology capabilities into practical implementation methodologies, automation, and production-ready flows.
You will help define and deliver end-to-end Technology - PA solutions for future Arm products, including advanced-node SoCs, ultra-low voltage designs, and multi-die systems.
Responsibilities
Drive technology PPA enablement for sub-2nm and future process nodes, with focus on performance, power, area, utilization, routability, and PPA convergence.
Develop scalable methodologies and automation to evaluate and optimize technology-node tradeoffs across libraries, memories, routing resources, power delivery, clocking, design rules, and implementation constraints.
Drive cross-functional analysis of technology PPA limiters, including congestion, IR/EM, thermal, timing, leakage, dynamic power, area efficiency, and physical verification closure.
Deliver multi-die and 2.5D/3D implementation enablement where technology-node, package, power, and thermal tradeoffs impact product PPA.
Hand-on execution and delivery demonstrating achieving goals.
Build AI-assisted automation and analytics to accelerate PPA exploration, recipe optimization, debug, and design closure.
Partner with IP, DTCO, foundry, EDA, architecture, design, and physical implementation teams to identify technology entitlement gaps and drive improvements.
Support production execution by converting technology learnings into repeatable flows, checks, dashboards, and sign-off readiness criteria.
Required Skills and Experience
Strong expertise in advanced-node SoC physical implementation, technology PPA optimization, and implementation methodology development.
Strong understanding of technology-node tradeoffs, including libraries, memories, routing resources, utilization, power delivery, clocking, congestion, timing, leakage, dynamic power, and physical verification constraints.
Solid programming and scripting skills, including Python, C, EDA tools, version control systems such as Git, and distributed processing/debug environments.
Hands-on experience with low-power design methodologies, UPF-based design, chip finishing, and physical verification flows in advanced process technologies.
