jobs.description:
JOB OVERVIEW
Join Arm’s Systems Media IP team as a Verification Engineer, developing and enhancing verification environments for next-generation media hardware. You will work alongside verification engineers and RTL designers to test and improve hardware functionality.
The team develops image signal processors, display processors and video codecs for Arm Compute Subsystems used across automotive, IoT and client devices. You will also have opportunities to explore AI-assisted approaches to hardware verification.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Develop and maintain SystemVerilog and UVM verification environments for Media IP designs.
Create and run constrained-random and directed tests, including reusable test sequences, checkers and functional coverage models.
Analyse simulation results and debug functional failures with design engineers.
Contribute to verification planning, functional coverage analysis and coverage closure.
Develop scripts and automation tools to improve verification and regression efficiency.
Collaborate with verification, RTL design and other engineering teams, sharing ideas to improve verification methods.
Explore AI-assisted tools and emerging agentic AI techniques for verification workflows.
REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE
Experience in digital hardware verification, including developing and debugging testbenches, test sequences and verification components.
Working knowledge of SystemVerilog, UVM and constrained-random verification.
Understanding of digital design, computer architecture and RTL concepts, as well as functional coverage, assertions and verification planning.
Programming and scripting capability, including object-oriented concepts, and the ability to analyse technical issues and collaborate with engineering teams.
NICE-TO-HAVE SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE
Knowledge of AMBA protocols such as APB, AHB or AXI.
Familiarity with formal or assertion-based verification.
Exposure to image signal processors, display processors, video codecs or image processing algorithms.
Experience with regression automation, continuous integration, version control or Linux development environments.
Python scripting experience.
Interest or experience in generative AI, agentic AI, large language models or AI-assisted tools for verification and automation, including through projects or research.
Familiarity with functional safety or automotive hardware development.
IN RETURN
You will develop your verification skills alongside experienced engineers while working with advanced Media IP architectures and complex hardware systems. jobs.title: Engineer -Low Power CLP
jobs.description:
Job Description: In Arm's Solutions Engineering group, our primary focus extends beyond the development of advanced System-on-Chips (SoCs). In the endeavour to deliver a quality silicon we need to ensure all our signoff checks across various domains are diligently performed. Delivering quality silicon leads to quality rewards and every effort and skill is recognized and appreciated at ARM. Our responsibilities also encompass improvising methodologies, influencing EDA tools and build a knowledge base which will help in our product design. Learning and sharing knowledge is part of ARM culture and is very much appreciated and encouraged. If your interested in working with a team of collaborative and smart engineers responsible for validating RTL-to-Gate and Gate-to-GDS implementations, ensuring power intent correctness, and enabling high-quality silicon tapeout
Responsibilities:
Low Power structural check
Perform low-power verification using Cadence Conformal Low Power (CLP) or Synopsys VCLP.
Verify and validate UPF implementation across RTL, netlist, and physical design stages.
Perform power-aware equivalence checking and resolve identified issues.
Analyze, debug, and resolve CLP structural, rule-based, and power-aware verification failures.
Implement SoC-level low-power structural checks and debug issues through closure.
Logical Equivalence Checking (LEC/Formality):
Perform RTL-to-Synthesis, Synthesis-to-P&R, and ECO logic equivalence verification using Cadence Conformal LEC.
Analyze, debug, and resolve non-equivalences and aborts across different stages of the design flow.
Develop, automate, and maintain robust LEC flows and signoff methodologies.
Drive LEC failure resolution and closure, and generate comprehensive signoff reports.
Implement and debug SoC-level flat LEC runs through signoff.
Methodology and Automation:
Develop TCL, Perl, and Python scripts to automate verification tasks and improve productivity.
Build and maintain reusable verification flows and debug utilities to improve efficiency and scalability.
Drive methodology enhancements for low-power verification signoff and efficient resolution of verification aborts.
Required Skills and Experience :
We are looking for a candidate with 5+ years of relevant experience in logical signoff and low-power structural verification for sophisticated SoC and IP development programs.
Strong experience with low-power design and verification, including hands-on knowledge of UPF/CPF and SystemVerilog.
Hands-on experience with low-power verification tools such as Cadence Conformal Low Power (CLP) or Synopsys VCLP.
Experience with Logic Equivalence Checking (LEC) and power-aware LEC, with strong skills in analyzing and resolving verification failures.
Ability to effectively debug CLP/VCLP and LEC issues and drive them through closure.
Understanding of synthesis and Place & Route (P&R) flows is an advantage.
Ability to collaborate across design, verification, and implementation teams to support successful signoff of complex SoC and IP designs.

ㅤ
The Manager, Record to Report for Controllership will provide end-to-end ownership for the Record-to-Report accounting and controllership activities. This role will be based in Hyderabad and will be responsible for ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant financial reporting, strong balance sheet governance, effective internal controls, and successful delivery of close, reporting, audit support, and compliance requirements.
This is a critical role within the Accounting COE and will play a key part in transitioning, stabilizing, and scaling controllership activities including transition from other regions. The Manager will partner closely within Controllership, Global Business Services (GBS), and other global and regional stakeholders to deliver high-quality financial outcomes at scale.
The role requires a strong controllership mindset, technical accounting knowledge, proven people leadership, and the ability to operate effectively in a complex, matrixed, global environment. The successful candidate will be expected to lead transition of accounting work to WBD’s Hyderabad center, drive operational discipline, process standardization, automation, continuous improvement, and a culture of accountability, quality, and compliance.
This role will manage ~5 Asst Manager and Sr Associate accounting positions in Hyderabad, supporting the controllership function. Your normal hours of work are 3:00 p.m IST. to 11:00 p.m IST. Monday to Friday. However, due to business needs, you may be required to work outside these hours and on holidays for the proper performance of your role without any additional pay. Subject to any applicable laws, the Company reserves the right to change your hours of work where this is essential to business needs and upon reasonable notice to you.
Your Role Accountabilities…
Controllership, Close and Reporting Leadership
Manage RTR accounting and controllership activities.
Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes, ensuring accuracy, completeness, timeliness, and compliance with applicable accounting and reporting requirements.
Manage intercompany reconciliations and resolve out-of-balance items with WBD counterparts.
Ensure strong balance sheet governance, account reconciliation quality, variance analysis, management reporting, and timely issue resolution.
Analyze financial results against expectations and provide meaningful insights to controllership and business stakeholders.
Review monthly and quarterly Balance Sheets and Income Statements, including part of footnotes disclosures and supplemental schedules, ensuring completeness and accuracy.
Ensure accounting implications of business transactions are assessed timely.
Responsible for system/manual reconciliations between the Business Unit boundary systems and SAP, ensuring data consistency and accuracy
Continuous support in identifying, designing, and implementing process improvements and standardizations across areas of responsibility to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.
Review and approve journal entries, applying independent judgment to determine appropriate accounting treatment in line with US GAAP and internal policies.
Governance, Controls and Audit Readiness
Maintain a strong internal control environment and ensure compliance with SOX requirements.
Partner with internal and external auditors to support audit planning, walkthroughs, testing, information requests, and timely closure of audit matters.
Proactively identify financial reporting, compliance, and control risks and ensure appropriate escalation and resolution.
Transition and Operating Model Buildout
Lead the transition, stabilization, and scaling of accounting activities being from other region into the Hyderabad Accounting COE.
Establish clear ownership, process documentation, KPIs, service levels, governance routines, and escalation mechanisms.
Partner with global and regional stakeholders to ensure business continuity, knowledge transfer, and successful transition outcomes.
Stakeholder Management and Business Partnership
Act as the key connection point between the Hyderabad Accounting COE and business Controllership.
Collaborate with leadership to set department priorities and assist in problem resolution
Understand the business model and operating drivers to provide informed controllership advice and support decision-making.
Ensure effective communication of accounting decisions, process impacts, deadlines, and risks across relevant stakeholder groups.
Serve as a liaison between Controllership and cross-functional groups including FP&A, Tax, and Corporate Financial Reporting.
Transformation, Process Excellence and Systems
Drive process standardization, simplification, automation, and continuous improvement across RTR activities.
Identify opportunities to improve close efficiency, reporting quality, control effectiveness, and team productivity.
Support system implementations, ERP-related changes, integrations, reorganizations, and other finance transformation initiatives.
Lead process improvement initiatives in partnership with controllership.
People Leadership and Talent Development
Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of accounting professionals.
Set clear goals, performance expectations, priorities, and accountability standards.
Build strong succession depth and develop controllership capability within the Hyderabad COE.
Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, integrity, continuous improvement, and high-quality execution.
Assess workload, resource requirements, and capacity needs, and recommend changes as required.
Provide training and guidance to team members on accounting processes, systems, and best practices to build a high-performing team.
Support ad hoc projects and requests from senior management as needed.
Qualifications & Experience…
Required
Chartered Accountant, CPA, MBA or equivalent professional accounting qualifications.
12+ years of progressive accounting, controllership, financial reporting, or audit experience with at least 3 years of supervisory role.
Strong experience in RTR, close, balance sheet governance, financial reporting, audit support, and internal controls.
Deep understanding of US GAAP, and SOX control requirements, including intercompany and foreign currency accounting.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel
Proven experience leading accounting teams.
Prior controllership experience in a multinational, matrixed, global organization.
Strong stakeholder management experience with the ability to influence senior finance and business leaders.
Demonstrated ability to operate in a fast-paced environment, manage competing priorities, deliver against tight deadlines, and manage composure under deadline pressure.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, present solution, and decision-making skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with high level transparency
High attention to detail, strong ownership mindset, and commitment to quality and compliance.
Able to work effectively across various time zones.
Desired
Experience in media, entertainment, production, distribution, or related industries.
Experience with SAP or other large ERP platforms.
Experience in managing finance transformation, automation, process standardization, or system implementation initiatives.
About Skydance
Skydance is a next-generation global media and entertainment company, comprised of three business segments: Studios, Direct-to-Consumer, and TV Media. Skydance's portfolio unites legendary brands, including Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and HBO Max, Paramount+, Pluto TV, CBS, CNN, CBS Sports, TNT Sports, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network, MTV, Food Network, BET, HGTV, and Comedy Central.
Some Important Details

jobs.title: Technical Architect- Salesforce Devops
jobs.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.
Job Category
Customer Success
Job Details
About Salesforce
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
The Experience
The DevOps Architect — Migration Hub is the strategic owner of the CI/CD, environment management and release governance framework that powers all migration wave delivery across the Hub. Sitting at the intersection of platform engineering and delivery operations, this role designs and governs the DevOps infrastructure that enables concurrent migration teams — across Marketing Cloud Next, Agentforce Revenue Management, ITSM and Tableau Next tracks — to deploy, test, validate and release Salesforce configuration, code and data changes at Hub velocity.
Unlike the hands-on DevOps Engineer (who operates day-to-day pipelines within a single track), the DevOps Architect operates at the Hub level — defining branching strategy, environment topology, pipeline standards, test automation frameworks, deployment governance and cross-wave dependency management that apply consistently to every track team.
This role is accountable for ensuring the Hub never becomes a bottleneck — that release pipelines are fast, reliable, auditable and capable of supporting multiple concurrent go-lives within the same programme window.
The DevOps Architect is also responsible for the platform development tooling contribution model — governing how Apex, LWC, Flow and integration code built by track teams is developed, reviewed, tested and promoted through Hub environments to production.
What You'll Actually Be Doing
CI/CD Pipeline Architecture — Hub Standard: Design, build and own the Hub-wide CI/CD pipeline framework using Salesforce DX, GitHub Actions and Gearset/Copado — defining the standard pipeline stages (develop → validate → test → UAT → staging → production) that apply to every migration track, wave and release.
Environment Topology Design: Design and manage the Hub environment topology — defining the number, purpose and refresh cadence of Developer, CI, SIT, UAT, Staging and Production environments across all active migration waves, balancing environment costs with delivery velocity requirements.
Branching Strategy & Version Control Governance: Define and enforce the Hub-wide Git branching strategy — including branch naming conventions, merge policies, pull request standards, conflict resolution protocols and release tagging — ensuring all Salesforce DX source code, metadata and configuration is correctly version-controlled.
Scratch Org Strategy: Design the Hub’s Salesforce DX scratch org usage model — defining scratch org definitions, feature flags, shape parameters and lifecycle policies that enable track teams to develop and test in isolated, reproducible environments at scale.
Deployment Governance & Release Management: Own the release management process for all migration wave deployments — defining change freeze windows, deployment sequencing, dependency maps, rollback procedures, approval gates and production deployment runbooks used across all concurrent waves.
Test Automation Framework: Design and implement the Hub-wide automated test suite — including Apex test class standards, code coverage requirements, UI automation (LWC Jest, Selenium), data validation scripts and post-deployment smoke tests — integrated into every CI/CD pipeline stage.
Static Code Analysis & Quality Gates: Implement and maintain static code analysis tooling (PMD, Salesforce Code Analyser, ESLint) as mandatory quality gates within the Hub pipeline — enforcing Apex best practices, Governor Limit awareness, LWC standards and security vulnerability detection before any code progresses to UAT.
Multi-Org & Multi-Track Pipeline Management: Manage the complexity of concurrent multi-org pipelines across 4–5 active migration tracks — designing dependency management, cross-track metadata conflict resolution and coordinated deployment sequencing for shared Salesforce org components.
Data Migration Pipeline Integration: Integrate data migration pipeline execution (ETL job scheduling, bulk load sequencing, reconciliation validation) into the Hub CI/CD framework — ensuring data migration jobs are tracked, versioned, automated and auditable alongside metadata deployments.
Secrets & Credential Management: Design and enforce secure secrets management for all Hub environments — including connected app credentials, API keys, org authentication certificates, ETL connection credentials and third-party integration tokens using vault-based or CI/CD-native secrets management.
Monitoring & Observability: Design the Hub’s deployment monitoring and observability framework — including pipeline run dashboards, deployment success/failure metrics, apex test trend monitoring, environment health checks and post-deployment alert routing for track teams and programme leadership.
DevOps Engineer Mentoring & Standards: Act as the technical lead and mentor for DevOps Engineers embedded in each migration track — setting development standards, reviewing pipeline configurations, conducting DevOps design reviews and ensuring consistent tooling adoption across all track teams.
Platform Development Contribution: Design and build reusable Salesforce platform components for Hub DevOps tooling — including LWC-based deployment dashboards, Apex utilities for automated org health checks, custom metadata-driven pipeline configuration frameworks and Salesforce Flow automations for release approval workflows.
Champion an AI-first development and DevOps workflow by integrating AI coding assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate Apex, LWC, Flows, and integration development.
Continuous Improvement — Hub Feedback: Capture DevOps lessons learned after every migration wave — pipeline failures, deployment blockers, environment contention, test coverage gaps
Tooling Evaluation & Adoption: Evaluate and recommend new DevOps tooling, Salesforce release management platforms and automation frameworks — maintaining the Hub’s DevOps toolkit at the leading edge of Salesforce delivery practice.
You're Our Person If...
Salesforce DX & Source-Driven Development: Expert knowledge of Salesforce DX — scratch org management, SFDX project structure, package development model (unlocked packages, managed packages), metadata API formats and CLI operations for automated deployments.
CI/CD Pipeline Engineering: Hands-on expertise building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for Salesforce deployments — using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps or CircleCI combined with Gearset, Copado or custom SFDX scripting for automated validate-test-deploy workflows.
Gearset or Copado: Deep practical experience with at least one enterprise Salesforce release management platform — Gearset or Copado — including pipeline configuration, org comparison, deployment validation, rollback management and test execution integration.
Git & Branching Strategy: Expert-level Git proficiency — branching model design (GitFlow, trunk-based, environment-branching), merge policy enforcement, PR review standards, release tagging and conflict resolution for Salesforce metadata and Apex code repositories.
Salesforce Environment Management: Proven ability to design and manage multi-org environment topologies for large programme delivery — including sandbox refresh automation, org dependency mapping, data masking for lower environments and environment capacity planning.

AI TRANSFORMATION: Make Jira the agent-native system of record and control plane for human and agent teamwork, designing systems that enable people and AI agents to work together effectively.

jobs.description:
What success looks like in this role:
Install, configure and maintain Splunk forwarders (127 in the estate) and onboard new data sources.
Administer Splunk Cloud: app and version upgrades, certificates and RBAC.
Plan and execute ACSC-approved changes in the change window, with rollback plans and post-change validation.
Validate, remediate and execute change for Splunk vulnerabilities, including zero-day vulnerabilities, highest priority first.
Support ITSI services, KPIs and episodes.
Support OpenTelemetry collectors and Splunk Observability Cloud.
Monitor Splunk system health using built-in and custom monitoring scripts and dashboards.
Raise and track Splunk vendor cases once ACSC authorizes named Unisys personnel on the ACSC Splunk account.
Write and maintain runbooks and service documentation; automate repeat work through ACSC-approved changes.
Hand over work in progress to Shift B during the 05:00-06:00 PT warm handover.
Deploy, and maintain Splunk Enterprise and Splunk Cloud, including indexer clusters, search head clusters, heavy and universal forwarders, deployment servers, and license masters.
Manage capacity, performance tuning, and data retention. Monitor platform health and troubleshoot indexing, search, and forwarding issues.
Onboard and normalize data sources (syslog, HEC, cloud logs, application and infrastructure logs). Write props/transforms and parsing configurations, and map data to CIM.
Automate deployments, upgrades, and configuration management with tools such as Ansible, Terraform, Git, and CI/CD pipelines.
Build and maintain apps, add-ons, dashboards, alerts, and reports. Write efficient SPL for stakeholders.
Implement role-based access control, SSO/LDAP integration, encryption, and audit controls.
Plan and execute upgrades, patching, migrations, and disaster recovery.
Partner with security, SRE, and application teams. Document standards and runbooks, and mentor junior engineers.
Participate in the on-call rotation for platform incidents.
#LI-SN1
You will be successful in this role if you have:
BA/BS degree and 5+ years’ relevant experience OR equivalent combination of education and experience.
Over 4 years of Hands-on Splunk administration, including Splunk Cloud and universal and heavy forwarders
Forwarder deployment and configuration management at scale (deployment server or equivalent).
Splunk app, version and certificate management; role-based access control.
Linux and Windows administration sufficient to troubleshoot forwarder hosts.
Change management discipline in an ITIL-style environment, including working to approved change records.
Familiarity with vulnerability remediation and patch validation.
Clear written and spoken English; comfortable working a night-time shift pattern aligned to Pacific Time.
Preferred
Splunk Certified Admin or Splunk Core Certified Power User or higher.
ITSI and Splunk Observability Cloud experience; OpenTelemetry collector configuration.
Scripting (Python, Bash or PowerShell) and automation tooling.
Experience with ServiceNow or a comparable ticketing system.
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and containers (Kubernetes, Docker).
Experience with Splunk ITSI, Enterprise Security, SOAR, or Observability Cloud.
Knowledge of OpenTelemetry, Cribl, Kafka, or other data pipeline tools.
Experience with ITIL or Agile practices.

jobs.title: Principal Functional Consultant
jobs.description:
Your work days are brighter here.
We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.
About the Team
Workday’s Consulting teams are driven by a passion for our products and the success of our customers in implementing our best-in-class cloud solutions. We’re a diverse group of people, with an invaluable mix of experience and backgrounds, located across multiple locations within the region. We are often remote from one another but that doesn’t stop our sense of collaboration, supportiveness, and fun!
About the Role
We are looking for a hardworking, innovative, and collaborative HCM Functional Consultant to join our team. In this role you will ensure the successful implementation of the Workday HCM solution with customers through product and implementation expertise. The ideal candidate for this position should have extensive experience implementing or supporting HCM systems, requirements capturing, configuration, data conversion and testing. You should be detail oriented, self-motivated, proactive, results oriented and able to successfully partner with customers and your project team. Be ready to be challenged and have fun!
About You
Basic Qualifications
Minimum 10+ years of functional experience in any of HCM, Benefits, Compensation, Recruiting, Talent, Performance Management, Time & Absence software solutions or systems
Should have worked as Solution Architect in an end-to-end implementation.
Previous consulting experience preferred either as an internal consultant or with a consulting / software organization in another ERP application (e.g. Workday, SAP, Oracle, PeopleSoft, Ultimate Software, ADP, Ceridian or similar application).
Should have experience in at-least 4 full cycle client implementations
Proven track record of successfully implementing and supporting HCM solutions
Other Qualifications
Passion for customer service
Validated project management experience
Functional experience
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Business analysis and requirements gathering abilities.
Ability to learn technology quickly through instruction and self-training.
Experience deploying multiple projects simultaneously a plus
Bachelor’s degree or relevant experience required
Ability to work across different SKU’s simultaneously
Work with the customer to help convert legacy data into Workday.
Assist the Integration Consulting team in helping to configure and test integrations between Workday and third-party/custom solutions.
Creation and execution of lifecycle test scenarios for all testing cycles in scope through partnership with the Test Lead
Ensure optimal test coverage and test execution, enabling a smooth and timely transition to production.
Mentor and share product knowledge with other consultants.
Help deliver successful project outcomes and lasting customer relationships.
Great team player
Our Approach to Flexible Work
With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in-office each week, we simply spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). jobs.title: Manager, Business Operations
jobs.description:
The Company
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.
Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.
Job Summary:
What do you need to know about the role
The Core Platforms Technology team is looking for a talented, self-driven, and analytically minded Business Operations professional. Reporting to the Chief of Staff, the Business Operations Analyst will partner with engineering leaders and cross-functional teams to improve operating discipline, generate actionable insights, and enable data-driven decision-making across the organization.
This role combines business operations, data analysis, workforce and capacity planning, portfolio governance, communications, and program execution.
Meet Our Team
The Business Operations team supports the Core Platforms Technology leadership team and helps the organization operate effectively at scale. We partner closely with Engineering, Product, Finance, People, Strategy, and other Business Operations teams to translate business priorities into measurable plans and coordinated execution.
Job Description:

Lead functional projects and programs to optimize operational processes.
Identify issues and recommend best practices for process improvements.
Partner with various departments to understand business trends.
Drive business or process improvements within the function.
Provide oversight and support for planning and management of financial, budget, and headcount targets.

Promote transparent reporting and foster a culture of data-driven decision-making by defining key metrics and evaluating progress.
Minimum Qualifications:
5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.
Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:
Your Day-to-Day Responsibilities
In this role, you will:
Prepare, analyze, and interpret organizational and operational data, including workforce census, OKRs, KPIs, capacity, investment plans, roadmaps, delivery health, and other leadership reporting.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Site Reliability Engineering
jobs.description:
The Senior Manager will be responsible for building and developing a high-performing SRE team, establishing engineering best practices, and driving initiatives that improve service availability, resilience, operational efficiency, and customer experience. The role requires strong people leadership, engineering management, and the ability to translate operational challenges into sustainable engineering improvements.
A key focus will be defining and executing the SRE reliability roadmap, strengthening incident prevention and recovery capabilities, reducing operational toil, and driving automation and AI-led operational improvements. The manager will also lead engineering participation in modernization iSupports team members in designing and architecting infrastructure and service and shares guidance on practices for reliability and functionality. Provides direction to ensure accurate forecasting and ensure systems have adequate resources, identifying resource gaps. Maintains a collaborative relationship with the software development team to create reliable, scalable infrastructures. Monitors data collection and ensures team members optimize operations and infrastructure reliability. Aids in incident response activities to ensure service reliability. Monitors health and performance reports. Implements standards for identifying and recommending automation. Ensures team members communicate information and articulate the impact of changes. Serves as a senior management point and shares expectations for documentation. Sets expectations for experimenting with new technology, executing improvements, building site reliability knowledge, and providing clear data.
Key Responsibilities
1. People Leadership and Team Development
Lead, mentor, and develop a geographically distributed team of SREs and database engineers.
Drive hiring, onboarding, performance management, career development, and succession planning.
Establish clear team objectives, ownership, accountability, and performance expectations aligned with organizational priorities.
Build engineering capabilities across reliability engineering, automation, observability, cloud technologies, and operational excellence.
Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, continuous learning, and engineering ownership.
Manage team capacity, operational coverage, and resource allocation while balancing production support with strategic engineering initiatives.
2. SRE Strategy and Reliability Engineering
Define and execute the SRE strategy and reliability improvement roadmap aligned with organizational priorities and business objectives.
Lead the evolution of SRE practices from reactive operational support toward proactive, engineering-driven reliability, emphasizing automation, incident prevention, and continuous improvement.
Define measurable reliability objectives and track key metrics, including service-level objectives (SLOs), incident trends, mean time to detect (MTTD), mean time to recover (MTTR), recurring incidents, and operational toil.
Leverage operational insights, service health metrics, customer impact, and technical risk assessments to prioritize engineering improvements and drive accountability.
Drive proactive problem management, technical debt reduction, and systemic engineering improvements to prevent recurring incidents and strengthen service resilience.
Partner with engineering, architecture, and infrastructure teams to improve long-term platform stability, scalability, and reliability.
3. Operational Excellence and Incident Management
Provide leadership oversight for 24×7 operational readiness, monitoring, incident response, escalation, and service recovery.
Ensure effective operational coverage, shift handoffs, escalation procedures, and coordination with established incident-management teams.
Lead critical incident escalations, ensuring timely service restoration, effective stakeholder communication, and minimal customer impact.
Establish strong root-cause analysis (RCA), corrective and preventive action (CAPA), and problem-management practices.
Drive standardization and continuous improvement of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), runbooks, operational workflows, and knowledge management.
Improve operational efficiency through proactive problem identification, automation, and measurable improvements in incident prevention and recovery.
4. Automation and AI Transformation
Define and execute an automation-first SRE strategy to eliminate repetitive manual tasks, reduce operational toil, and improve engineering productivity.
Drive automation of operational workflows, maintenance activities, monitoring, health checks, diagnostics, and recovery procedures.
Strengthen observability through proactive monitoring, actionable dashboards, intelligent alerting, and standardized diagnostic workflows.
Lead adoption of AI-assisted diagnostics, intelligent automation, and AI-driven operational improvements with appropriate governance and controls.
Promote reusable engineering tools, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD pipelines, and standardized automation frameworks.
Measure automation effectiveness through toil reduction, incident prevention, faster recovery, and improved operational efficiency.
5. Engineering Delivery and Technology Transformation
Own engineering priorities, roadmaps, delivery commitments, milestones, dependencies, and execution risks across SRE initiatives.
Lead SRE engineering participation in DB migrations, OCI Transformation, cloud modernization, and infrastructure transformation programs.
Partner with database architects, cloud engineering, application development, and infrastructure teams to ensure migration readiness, risk mitigation, validation, and operational handover.
Translate organizational objectives into actionable engineering plans with measurable outcomes and clear accountability.
Establish engineering best practices, including source control, code reviews, testing, CI/CD, documentation, and change management.
Balance production support, reliability improvements, technical debt reduction, and strategic engineering initiatives.
Drive cross-functional collaboration, stakeholder alignment, and transparent communication of engineering progress, risks, and delivery milestones.
6. Service Reliability, Performance, and Resilience
Drive continuous improvements in database service availability, performance, scalability, and operational resilience.
Establish proactive service health monitoring, reliability reviews, capacity planning, and preventive engineering practices.
Ensure high-availability and disaster recovery readiness, including regular validation of backup, restore, failover, and recovery procedures.
Track service recovery capabilities against agreed Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO).
Partner with database specialists, architecture, and infrastructure teams to address systemic performance issues, capacity constraints, and reliability risks.
Ensure appropriate operational governance, configuration standards, security controls, and compliance practices across supported services.
Drive measurable improvements in service stability, recovery performance, customer impact, and long-term platform reliability.
Basic Qualifications
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Proven experience managing SRE, platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, or database operations teams, including hiring, mentoring, performance management, and career development.
Strong engineering leadership skills, including defining team objectives, prioritizing initiatives, managing resources, and driving measurable outcomes.
Strong understanding of SRE principles, service reliability, incident management, root-cause analysis, observability, automation, and operational excellence.
Experience leading business-critical production services in cloud, hybrid-cloud, or enterprise infrastructure environments.
Demonstrated experience driving automation, operational efficiency, incident prevention, and reliability improvement initiatives.
Experience leading cloud modernization, infrastructure transformation, or large-scale engineering programs.
Proven ability to manage critical incidents, technical escalations, engineering projects, cross-functional dependencies, and delivery commitments.
Experience establishing operational processes, SOPs, engineering standards, and continuous improvement practices.
Strong communication, stakeholder-management, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with experience leading geographically distributed teams.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience leading SRE or platform engineering teams supporting large-scale, highly available, business-critical services.
Familiarity with Oracle Database technologies, high-availability architectures, disaster recovery, and database operational environments.
Knowledge of enterprise cloud platforms.
Experience driving cloud migrations, infrastructure modernization, and technology transformation initiatives.
Knowledge of infrastructure automation, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD pipelines, configuration management, and scripting technologies.
Experience implementing observability platforms, proactive monitoring, operational dashboards, and automated diagnostic solutions.
Experience with AI-assisted diagnostics, intelligent automation, and AI-driven operational improvements.
Experience establishing SRE metrics, service-level objectives, reliability engineering programs, and operational efficiency measurements.
Strong understanding of capacity planning, service resilience, disaster recovery, security, and operational governance.
Experience supporting healthcare technology platforms or other highly regulated, mission-critical enterprise environments.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
As a Senior Mechanical Design Engineer in the Development Engineering team at Micron Systems Integration Group (SIG), you will be responsible for designing and developing mechanical fixtures, mechanisms, and finished equipment for semiconductor testing. You will also perform analytical studies to determine optimal design considerations while directing support personnel in the preparation of detailed design, design testing, prototype fabrication and field implementation/distribution. This position will include new design/development activities, concurrent engineering, and sustaining engineering functions for legacy equipment.
Responsibilities and Tasks
Mechanical design of automated/semi-automated equipment, tooling, fixturing, and support assemblies. The output being design documents to include requirement specifications, CAD models, fabrication prints, detailed assembly prints, end use documentation, and test/check-out specifications.
Mechanical design and analysis computations (stress, strain, deflection, safety factors).
Finite Element Analysis (FEA), thermal design via calculation, and validation of thermal models using design of experiments.
Perform Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) to determine optimal air/fluid thermal designs.
Advanced development of mechanical design using novel thermal materials and thermal design approaches.
Responsible for performing design work/analysis as a mechanical discipline lead on SIG projects.
Work with program managers to help build and update detailed project schedules.

jobs.title: Data Engineer II
jobs.description:
About NCR Atleos
NCR Atleos, headquartered in Atlanta, is a leader in expanding financial access. Our dedicated 20,000 employees optimize the branch, improve operational efficiency and maximize self-service availability for financial institutions and retailers across the globe.
Key Expectations
Data Engineering — the foundation
Ingestion & integration
Build and operate ingestion pipelines from enterprise source systems — cloud and on-premise ERP, CRM, ITSM, billing/revenue, planning and quoting platforms, and third-party operational systems — into the enterprise data lakehouse.
Work across multiple ingestion patterns — change data capture (CDC), orchestrated batch pipelines, event streaming, packaged analytics/replication tooling, and API-based ingestion — and select the pattern that fits the latency, volume, and cost profile of the use case, including near-real-time ingestion where the business value justifies it.
Own new-source onboarding end to end: source system analysis with application and ERP teams, schema and field availability confirmation, ingestion design, historical backfill, incremental load strategy, and exposure through the curated serving layers.
Modeling & curation
Build and extend the medallion architecture — raw landing, cleansed/conformed, and curated business layers — including a conformed star-schema layer of facts and dimensions and a denormalized, query-optimized serving layer consumed by BI tools and downstream applications.
Write and optimize SQL/stored-procedure and Spark-based transformations; model dimensional entities and conformed keys (customer, supplier, product, order, contract, site) so data joins cleanly across Finance, Sales, Service and Supply Chain domains.
Build the semantic and reporting layer, landing business definitions, hierarchies and metric logic once in the curated layer with documented ownership — so definitions are reusable and AI-consumable rather than rebuilt inside every tool.
Data quality, reconciliation & observability
Build and extend source-to-target reconciliation frameworks — record counts, change-timestamp deltas, and critical-column matching — and push beyond count-based recon toward content-level sync validation across replication, packaged-analytics and API-sourced data.
Implement data accuracy, completeness and freshness/recency metrics per data domain and surface them through the platform's observability layer.
Investigate and resolve production data disconnects end to end — isolate root cause across source, pipeline and curation; repair or reprocess; and put a control in place so the same failure doesn't recur.
Reliability, performance & cost
Tune long-running transformations and reduce compute consumption; contribute to platform right-sizing, storage cleanup and cost-optimization work.
Manage schema drift and upstream release changes — programmatically detect deprecated or altered objects, assess downstream impact, and regression-test pipelines across lower environments before production.
Work within CI/CD and Git-based change control, with automated test generation and validation rather than manual regression cycles.
Support production: monitoring, alerting, incident triage and RCA for the pipelines you own, including month-end and quarter-close critical windows.
Automation
Automate what the team does repeatedly — period-close processes, report generation, reconciliation, environment and admin workflows, infrastructure-as-code, and test generation — rather than absorbing the manual effort.
AI Systems Engineering
Context engineering: assemble what enters each model call — facts, history, retrieved knowledge, state — favoring signal over volume.
Harness & scaffolding: build components of the runtime around the model — tool/action interfaces, state handling, retries, error handling, stop conditions.
Evaluations: write automated evals, groundedness checks, and regression tests so quality regressions are caught before users see them.
Guardrails: apply input/output constraints, permission gates, and human-in-the-loop review per platform standards.
Observability: instrument tracing and telemetry; investigate failures instead of retrying blindly.
Work cost-aware — understand token and compute spend and where it goes.

Join Barclays as Regulatory Controller Analyst role, where to gather, analyze, and present risk data in a clear and concise manner to stakeholders across the organization, facilitating informed decision-making, risk mitigation, and regulatory compliance. At Barclays, we don't just anticipate the future - we're creating it.

Internal Control Procedures.
Regulatory Reporting. Regulatory Process.
Basel 1, BASEL 2, BASEL 3 reporting/ Pillar I, Pillar II reporting.

Regulatory Compliance.
Regulatory Techniques.

Identification and assessment of prudential regulatory reporting risks arising from the bank's activities, products, and services. Development and implementation of strategies to mitigate prudential regulatory reporting risks, ensuring compliance with all applicable laws, regulations, and internal control policies, and conduct regular compliance reviews and audits to identify and address potential compliance gaps or violations.
Assessment of the effectiveness of the bank’s internal control processes and governance framework, including addressing any weaknesses or gaps that could lead to regulatory reporting non-compliance, and implementation of measures to strengthen internal controls.
Preparation and submission of regulatory reports to authorities, and provision of support to other departments in their preparation and review of regulatory reports.
Analysis and presentation of regulatory data to provide insights into business performance, identify trends, and support decision-making.
Development and implementation of training programmes to educate employees on regulatory requirements and compliance responsibilities.
Communication and liaising with regulatory bodies, prompt responses to inquiries and provision of requested information, and representation of the bank in meetings with regulators.
Management of the selection, implementation, and maintenance of regulatory reporting systems and software applications, including collaboration with IT colleagues to integrate regulatory reporting systems with other enterprise systems.

To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.

Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

jobs.title: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer

The Security Central team builds and operates services that help OCI teams understand their security posture, identify risks, and drive remediation across cloud infrastructure. The Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer designs, implements, and optimizes distributed system components, backend services, data pipelines, and integrations with an emphasis on scalability, resiliency, and operability.
The role includes owning features and service components from design through production, delivering load and performance tests, and using data plane platforms and distributed state tools for high-volume retrieval, storage, and processing. Responsibilities include building fault-tolerant paths through redundancy, replication, synchronization, and automatic failover; applying recovery-oriented design principles; and implementing retries, circuit breakers, and timeouts.
Operational ownership includes proactively detecting and mitigating issues through tests, alarms, dashboards, and telemetry; authoring runbooks; and participating in incident response and root cause analysis. The role also involves developing automation and Infrastructure as Code for deployment, troubleshooting, and maintenance, and implementing security controls for encryption, access management, and remediation while meeting change management, compliance, and documentation standards.
Close collaboration with security and engineering teams is essential to translate requirements into practical solutions. Contributions include technical design reviews, peer implementation reviews for scalability and reliability, and ongoing improvements to engineering and operational practices.
This role is ideal for an engineer with strong software development fundamentals, experience with distributed systems, and an interest in building secure, reliable cloud services.

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.
An overview of this role
As Manager, SOX PMO - Business Process, you'll lead Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance for assigned business processes as part of GitLab's second line. This is advisory work, not repeatable testing: you'll deeply understand how processes work, evaluate risks as the business changes, and help control owners design and remediate controls that hold up to audit. Judgment matters more than procedure. You'll form well-supported conclusions, align with control owners and Internal Audit, and defend positions to external auditors. GitLab already uses AI extensively, and the next phase brings AI agents into our SOX processes. You'll help teams adopt them with confidence, finding creative ways to enable new ways of working while maintaining compliance. You'll also partner with the information technology (IT) SOX PMO on readiness for new systems and applications. This role reports to the Senior Director, SOX PMO, within the Chief Accounting Officer's organization.
What You’ll Do  
Lead SOX compliance for assigned business processes as the second-line subject matter expert, advising control owners who own and operate the controls. Deeply understand each process, its systems and data flows, and resolve open questions and assumptions early.
Monitor risks from new and changing processes, products, and systems. Help control owners design, strengthen, or right-size controls, and contribute to the annual SOX risk assessment and scoping.
Evaluate control deficiencies individually and in aggregate, identify root causes, and prepare well-supported severity assessments. Work with management to develop, implement, and monitor remediation plans.
Prepare auditor-ready technical memos on sampling methodology, scoping, and control rationalization, using independent analysis and sound conclusions. Prepare reports and presentations on SOX compliance status for leadership.
Lead business walkthroughs and stakeholder meetings, and coordinate with Internal Audit and external auditors throughout the audit. Anticipate questions, support positions with data and judgment, and escalate risks and auditor comments promptly with a recommended path forward.
Advise on controls for AI-enabled processes and processes that use AI agents. Find opportunities to automate SOX work using AI tools, and validate their output.
Partner with the IT SOX PMO to assess new systems and controls, including application controls and key reports.
Develop and maintain accurate process narratives, flowcharts, and risk and control matrices as processes change. Collaborate with Finance, Operations, Legal, Human Resources, Sales, Engineering, and IT leaders to help them design and maintain effective business controls.
What You’ll Bring 
Hands-on SOX and internal controls experience in control design, remediation, and deficiency evaluation, beyond testing alone. Experience in the software or technology industry is required; SOX PMO, Big Four risk advisory, or assurance experience is a strong plus.
A bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; an active Certified Public Accountant (CPA) credential (strongly preferred) or Certified Internal Auditor (CIA) credential.
A strong understanding of SOX requirements and internal control frameworks, such as the Committee of Sponsoring Organizations of the Treadway Commission (COSO) framework.
Professional judgment and skepticism: verifying facts against source documents, testing the reasonableness of data and conclusions, and recognizing missing information.
A track record of independently solving ambiguous, novel problems, from defining an approach through overcoming obstacles and driving resolution. Curiosity to understand how processes actually work and keep learning as the business changes.
Clear written and verbal communication, including concise, accurate, auditor-ready memos and actionable recommendations. Confidence partnering with senior stakeholders and external auditors, including working through pushback.
A practical, innovative approach to helping the business adopt new technologies, products, and ways of working while maintaining compliance. Experience using AI tools to improve efficiency and validating their output.
Experience with usage-based billing or AuditBoard is a plus.
About the team
The SOX PMO is part of the Chief Accounting Officer's organization. In this role, you'll advise business control owners and partner with the IT SOX PMO, Internal Audit, and external auditors to keep GitLab compliant as processes, systems, and AI use evolve. GitLab is an all-remote company, with flexibility to work from home or wherever you're most productive. You'll need to be available to collaborate with teammates during core US Pacific (PT) and Eastern (ET) business hours.

About the Company and Team
Oracle is a global technology company delivering enterprise software, database technologies, and cloud infrastructure that help organizations run critical business applications and services.
Join Oracle's Database organization and contribute to the development and operation of scalable, reliable, cloud-native services.
The role combines modern backend engineering, infrastructure automation, DevOps practices, and production operations. Engineers contribute across the full software lifecycle, from architecture and development through deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
The team also embraces AI-assisted software development, using tools such as Codex to accelerate engineering workflows while maintaining strong standards for code quality, security, and reliability.
As platform capabilities evolve, engineers will have opportunities to contribute to Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and integrations that connect cloud services with AI agents.
Job Summary
Oracle India is seeking a Principal Software Engineer (IC4) with 7+ years of professional software engineering experience to design, develop, deploy, and operate highly available cloud-native backend services.
You will work on complex engineering challenges involving Java, SQL, distributed systems, microservices, infrastructure automation, and production service reliability.
In this hands-on role, you will build scalable backend capabilities, improve deployment automation, strengthen observability, and troubleshoot complex production incidents. You will collaborate with engineering, Support, and Operations stakeholders to deliver reliable services and continuous platform improvements.
You will also use Codex and other agentic development tools for code exploration, implementation, testing, debugging, and documentation, while independently reviewing and validating generated output.
As the team's capabilities expand, you will contribute to the design, development, and operation of MCP servers and AI-agent integrations.
The role is suited to an experienced engineer who combines strong backend development fundamentals with practical cloud engineering, production ownership, and a continuous-improvement mindset.
Key Responsibilities
1. Develop cloud-native backend services: Design, build, test, and maintain reliable, scalable services using modern cloud technologies, Java, SQL, and Agile engineering practices.
2. Automate infrastructure and deployments: Develop scripts, infrastructure configurations, and automated deployment workflows using technologies such as Terraform and CI/CD pipelines to support repeatable global service deployments.

6. Collaborate across engineering and operations: Partner with Support, Operations, and project stakeholders to resolve technical challenges, coordinate service improvements, and maintain operational readiness.
7. Drive engineering quality: Participate in code reviews, provide constructive feedback, improve engineering practices, and create technical and operational documentation that makes services easier to maintain and operate.

Ability to collaborate with Support and Operations teams during incidents and service improvements.

Strong technical communication, documentation, collaboration, and continuous-improvement skills.

This role directly impacts yield, uptime, safety, and customer audit outcomes.
Core Responsibilities
Fab Facilities & Critical Utilities Operations/Maintenance and Engineering
Lead operations of bulk & specialty gas systems, chemical distribution systems, UPW, process cooling water, wastewater treatment, Electrical System, Building Infrastructure HVAC, and cleanroom environmental systems.
Ensure continuous availability of all utilities required for Manufacturing with minimal production impact.
On Time Hook Up of Production tools
Own facility incident response and serve as first responder for site‑wide facilities and hook up events.
2. Cleanroom & Environmental Control
Maintain clean room temperature, humidity, pressure, and contamination control within fab‑defined limits.
Coordinate filter maintenance, airflow verification, and critical environmental alarms to protect yield‑sensitive operations.
Support particulate, AMC (Airborne Molecular Contamination), and vibration control programs aligned with fab standards (as referenced in semiconductor cleanroom roles).
3. EHSS & Regulatory Compliance
Ensure full compliance with EHSS, hazardous gas, chemical safety, wastewater discharge, and environmental regulations concerning semiconductor manufacturing.
Maintain 100% EHSS training certification for all facilities staff and contractors.
Lead corrective and preventive actions following incidents, audits, or near‑miss events.
4. Team Leadership & Capability Development
Lead, mentor, and develop facilities technicians, engineers, and supervisors in a shift‑based 24×7 operation.
Drive standardization of operating procedures, maintenance practices, and commissioning processes.
Implement succession planning and skill‑depth development for critical systems ownership.
5. Maintenance, Reliability & Performance Management
Establish and govern preventive and corrective maintenance programs for all fab utilities and infrastructure.
Leverage artificial intelligence to track and drive KPIs such as uptime, MTBF, response time, safety metrics, and PM compliance
Lead root‑cause analysis (RCA) for utility‑related excursions impacting production.
6. Commissioning, Projects & Expansion Support
Lead commissioning of new fab utilities, equipment, and facility expansions supporting ramp‑up or technology node changes.
Partner with construction, operational, and equipment groups to integrate facilities systems with minimal disruption.
7. Financial & Vendor Management
Own facilities budget, forecasting, and cost‑optimization initiatives.
Handle strategic vendors providing gas, chemical, UPW, waste, and maintenance services.
Ensure contract compliance and SLA alignment for critically important services.
8. Customer & Audit Readiness
Represent the site during customer audits, ISO, EHSS, and certification reviews.
Act as the site’s voice in global facilities forums to align with corporate standards.

Required
Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical) or equivalent.
12–15+ years of experience in semiconductor fab facilities or similar high‑reliability industrial environments.
Proven understanding of gases, chemicals, UPW, wastewater systems, Electrical System, HVAC, and cleanroom facilities.
Preferred
Exposure to BMS / FMS / CMMS / SCADA systems.
Knowledge of local and international EHSS standards applicable to semiconductor fabs.
Key Competencies
Mission‑critical operations leadership
Safety‑first perspective
Incident & emergency management
Multi-functional collaboration with Manufacturing, Process, and Equipment teams
Data‑driven reliability improvement
Typical benchmarks
Fab utility uptime
Safety & EHSS compliance score
Incident response time
PM compliance rate
Cost optimization vs budget

NCR Atleos is a global leader in self-service financial access and ATM solutions, providing technology and services to financial institutions and retailers. The company supports ATM deployment, maintenance, managed services, cash management, transaction processing infrastructure, and end-to-end ATM operations.
For the PNB Dispute Management Executive position, the role contributes to operational accuracy and customer service by supporting transaction verification, ATM reconciliation, excess cash investigation, CIT coordination, CCTV verification, and timely closure of GL, suspense, and sundry differences.
Position Summary
The Dispute Management Executive will be responsible for the day-to-day reconciliation, and closure of ATM transaction disputes and related operational differences for the PNB process. The role requires timely investigation of failed transactions, excess cash cases, reconciliation differences, and suspense/sundry items while coordinating with relevant internal and external stakeholders for resolution.
Key Areas of Responsibility
1, Failed Transaction Verification
Perform daily verification of failed ATM transactions.
Investigate transaction discrepancies and ensure timely resolution of identified exceptions.
2 Excess Cash Verification
Check and validate excess cash through C3R and Electronic Journal (EJ) counters.
Identify discrepancies between transaction records and reported cash positions.
3 CIT Follow-up
Follow up with the CIT team/vendor when excess cash is not reported.
Obtain the reason, confirmation, and acceptance for identified excess cases and track them through closure.
4 CCTV Verification
Review CCTV footage for suspected or disputed transaction cases wherever investigation requires visual verification.
Maintain appropriate records/evidence in accordance with applicable process requirements.
5 Daily Reconciliation
Perform reconciliation across Core Banking System (CBS), C3R closing balances, and Switch records.
Investigate mismatches and coordinate for timely resolution of reconciliation differences.
6 GL Difference Closure
Monitor and resolve General Ledger (GL) related differences.
Ensure open reconciliation items are appropriately investigated, documented, and closed within defined timelines.
7 Suspense & Sundry Management
Review and work on suspense and sundry files.
Follow up on outstanding entries and ensure timely closure of pending items with appropriate supporting documentation.
Basic Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in any discipline from a recognized university.
3–5 years of relevant experience, preferably in banking operations, ATM operations, transaction reconciliation, or dispute management.
Working knowledge of transaction reconciliation and exception handling.
Ability to analyze transaction-level discrepancies and follow cases through to closure.
Preferred Qualifications
Previous experience in ATM dispute management, reconciliation, or banking operations.
Practical knowledge of C3R, EJ, Switch, GL, suspense, and sundry reconciliation.
Experience coordinating with CIT agencies/vendors for cash-related discrepancies.
Understanding of failed ATM transactions, excess cash investigation, and transaction dispute processes.
Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including reconciliation and data analysis.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple cases and meet TATs.

Are you an analytics champion with a deep toolset who thrives on helping business partners strategize, implement and measure data-driven initiatives? Do you relish the opportunity to dive headfirst into vast, high-impact projects and make foundational contributions across analytics, strategy and operations? Are you energized working closely with the business to turn data into beautiful, high impact visualizations to power leadership decisions? If so, this role is for you!

Focus on developing hypotheses through analytical approaches, different methodologies, frameworks, and technical approaches to test them.
Define, understand, and test opportunities to improve the products and business and influence roadmaps through insights and recommendations.
Partner with cross-functional teams to inform, influence, and execute strategy decisions

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
The Position
Patient Journey Partner- Malignant Hematology / Oncology
Location: All Locations
The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.
We are seeking candidates to join our team as Patient Journey Partner. In this role, you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on patient care by connecting Roche’s capabilities and resources to co-create solutions with key stakeholders involved in the patient journey. Your role is multifaceted, addressing diverse patient journey needs such as accelerating access to treatments, streamlining decision making. This role is locally embedded in the ecosystem, it is an integrated role, functionally agnostic, (i.e. it does not fit into the traditional concepts of Commercial/Sales or Medical Affairs). The PJP focuses on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. They also bring the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem.
Your Opportunity
You will be responsible for end to end management of Top Therapy Area Expert relations and legitimate needs through right identification of challenges, belief, motivators.
You will be a one point of contact for specific accounts of the state. You will be creating and executing strategies for the related public & private accounts, aligning with and support state teams for effective execution of the state strategies, so as to serve and maximize patients with Roche Innovations.
You will be building relationships with key decision makers in the account Identifying and resolving business issues in top accounts and implementing strategies and driving results for enhancing access to Roche innovations.
You will be leading collaboration in field through co-creation of solutions for key accounts.
Who you are
You are someone who has a relevant graduate/ post graduate degree in Science. From an experience standpoint having more than 5 years’ experience with 2+ years in Commercial Role or similar preferred.
You must exhibit strong collaboration and networking skills, process orientation and alliance management.
Core Role Capabilities:
Insight Generation (Intermediate): Translates multiple data points into actionable insights, prioritizes key drivers, and connects them to business decisions.
Situational Analysis (Intermediate): Connects account data, HCP dynamics, and patient barriers to form coherent recommendations.
Customer Segmentation (Intermediate): Leverages segmentation (potential, penetration, needs) to drive targeted engagement.
Patient Journey Mapping (Advanced): Identifies critical moments that matter across the journey and shapes strategic priorities.
Value Proposition (Intermediate): Connects customer needs to tailored value propositions for priority segments.
Omnichannel Engagement (Advanced): Creates personalized, seamless experiences aligned to desired behavior shifts.
Ecosystem / Account Planning (Intermediate): Develops coherent strategies connecting stakeholder needs, value opportunities, and resource allocation.
Key Functional Focus Areas:
Marketing & Strategy: Defining target outcomes, mapping the patient journey, and executing tailored omnichannel campaigns to drive brand adoption.
Medical & Scientific Engagement: Acting as the bridge to bring "Roche expertise, science and knowledge" directly to Therapy Area Experts, challenging paradigms and shifting clinical behaviors.
Access & Reimbursement: Identifying and actively resolving business/access bottlenecks (e.g., ESI caps, scheme funding) in key public and private accounts to accelerate patient access to therapies.
Key Account Management: Serving as the single point of contact for top state accounts, managing end-to-end relations, directional forecasting, and co-creating holistic ecosystem solutions
Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
