jobs.title: LEAD, MSI Warehouse
jobs.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
As a Warehouse Lead, you will be responsible for the day-to-day execution of inbound and internal warehouse operations, including receiving of materials, storage, inventory management, cycle counting and on-time fulfilment of manufacturing floor requirements. You will lead a team of warehouse associates on the shop floor, ensuring that every material is received, stored, issued and accounted for accurately in the system, and that production lines never stop due to material unavailability.
You will drive a culture of 6S, safety, discipline and continuous improvement in the warehouse, and act as the first point of contact for Production, Planning, Quality, Procurement and Finance teams on material-related matters during your shift.
1. Receiving of Materials
Plan and manage inbound dock schedule, vehicle unloading and material receipt as per PO, ASN, invoice and packing list
Ensure physical verification of quantity, part number, lot/batch, date code and packaging condition before acceptance
Ensure timely GRN / goods receipt posting in ERP/WMS (e.g., SAP) within defined TAT
Coordinate with Incoming Quality (IQC) for inspection, and segregate quarantine, hold, rejected and damaged material
Handle receiving discrepancies (shortage, excess, damage, wrong part) and raise them with Procurement, Supplier and Logistics teams
Ensure correct handling of ESD-sensitive, moisture-sensitive, temperature-controlled, shelf-life and hazardous materials as per SOP
Ensure labelling and barcode identification of all received material before put-away
2. Storage and Location Management
Ensure system-directed put-away of material to correct bin/location within defined TAT
Maintain bin location master and optimise space utilisation (racking, slotting, fast/slow movers)
Ensure storage conditions are met (temperature, humidity, ESD, dry cabinets, segregation of hazardous material)
Enforce FIFO / FEFO and monitor shelf-life and expiry of materials
Ensure safe stacking, material handling equipment usage and load-bearing limits
Identify and report slow-moving, non-moving, obsolete and expired stock for disposition
3. Inventory Management and Cycle Count
Maintain 100% system-to-physical inventory accuracy for all materials under warehouse custody
Plan and execute daily/weekly cycle counts based on ABC classification and the approved cycle count calendar
Investigate count variances, perform root cause analysis and drive corrective actions
Process inventory adjustments with proper approval and documentation as per Finance and audit requirements
Support periodic wall-to-wall physical inventory, internal audits and external/statutory audits
Monitor stock levels and raise alerts for shortages, critical parts and excess inventory to Planning and Procurement
Ensure all inventory transactions (receipt, transfer, issue, return, scrap) are recorded accurately and on time
4. Fulfilment of Manufacturing Floor Requirements
Ensure on-time and accurate issue of materials to the production floor as per work order, material requisition, kitting list and production plan
Plan picking, kitting and line-feeding / replenishment (Kanban, min-max) to ensure zero line stoppage due to material
Coordinate with Production and Planning on daily build plan, priority changes and urgent requirements
Manage return of unused, excess and rejected material from the floor with proper system transactions
Track and escalate material shortages, and follow up with Planning, Procurement and Suppliers for closure
Ensure traceability of issued material (lot/batch/reel ID) to work orders
5. 6S, Safety and Housekeeping
Implement and sustain 6S (Sort, Set in Order, Shine, Standardise, Sustain, Safety) across the warehouse
Conduct daily 6S walks and periodic 6S audits; track and close observations
Ensure visual management – floor marking, location labels, signage and display boards
Ensure compliance with EHS requirements, PPE usage, MHE (forklift, stacker, pallet jack) safety and safe material handling
Report near-misses, unsafe acts and unsafe conditions, and drive corrective actions
Ensure ESD compliance in material storage and handling areas
6. Team Leadership
Lead, allocate and monitor daily work of warehouse associates and material handlers in the shift
Conduct shift start meetings / Tier-1 huddles covering safety, priorities, KPIs and issues
Train team members on SOPs, system transactions, safety, ESD and 6S; maintain skill matrix and training records
Monitor attendance, productivity and discipline; provide feedback, coaching and recognition
Support the Supervisor in manpower planning, shift handover and performance reviews
Drive teamwork, ownership and a "right first time" culture
7. Systems, Compliance and Continuous Improvement
Follow and maintain warehouse SOPs, work instructions and documentation; support SOP updates
Ensure compliance with quality, customs/bonded warehouse (where applicable), audit and statutory requirements
Prepare and publish daily/weekly warehouse reports and KPI dashboards
Identify process gaps and lead Kaizen, Lean and error-proofing (Poka-Yoke) improvements
Support RCA and CAPA for warehouse-related incidents, customer/internal complaints and audit findings
Support system enhancements, barcode/scanner usage and digital tools (WMS, Power BI, Copilot) for efficiency
Using Artificial Intelligence
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) :
Inventory record accuracy (system vs. physical)
Cycle count plan adherence and variance closure
GRN / receiving TAT and put-away TAT
On-time, in-full material issue to production (zero line stoppage due to material)
Picking / issue accuracy
6S audit score
Safety – zero lost-time incidents; near-miss reporting and closure
Audit findings – zero major non-conformance
Team training completion and skill-matrix coverage
Education Desired :
Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Engineering, Commerce or related field
Certification in Lean, 6S, Inventory Management or Warehouse Operations is an advantage
Experience Desired :
4–7 years of experience in warehouse / stores operations in a manufacturing environment (semiconductor, electronics, automotive or similar preferred)
Minimum 2 years in a team lead / shift lead role
Hands-on experience in receiving, inventory control, cycle counting and production line feeding
Skills and Competencies :
Working knowledge of ERP/WMS (SAP MM/WM/EWM preferred), barcode and RF scanning systems
Good understanding of inventory control principles – FIFO/FEFO, ABC analysis, min-max, Kanban
Knowledge of 6S, Lean, Kaizen and basic problem-solving tools (5 Why, Fishbone, 8D)
Knowledge of ESD, MSL and safe material handling practices; MHE operation awareness
Proficiency in MS Excel and reporting; exposure to Power BI / digital tools is a plus
Strong leadership, communication and people management skills
High attention to detail, ownership and ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment
Willingness to work in shifts

Job Purpose
The Facilities Operations Manager is responsible for continuous, safe, and compliant operation of all fab facilities and critical utilities supporting semiconductor manufacturing. This includes bulk and high-purity gas distribution systems, chemicals, Ultra‑Pure Water (UPW), wastewater treatment, HVAC and cleanroom environmental control, electrical systems, and building infrastructure in a 24×7,
This role directly impacts yield, uptime, safety, and customer audit outcomes.
Core Responsibilities
Fab Facilities & Critical Utilities Operations
Lead operations of bulk & specialty gas systems, chemical distribution systems, UPW, process cooling water, wastewater treatment, Electrical System, Building Infrastructure HVAC, and cleanroom environmental systems.
Ensure continuous availability of all utilities required for Manufacturing with minimal production impact.
Own facility incident response and serve as first responder for site‑wide facilities events.
2. Cleanroom & Environmental Control
Maintain clean room temperature, humidity, pressure, and contamination control within fab‑defined limits.
Coordinate filter maintenance, airflow verification, and critical environmental alarms to protect yield‑sensitive operations.
Support particulate, AMC (Airborne Molecular Contamination), and vibration control programs aligned with fab standards (as referenced in semiconductor cleanroom roles).
3. EHSS & Regulatory Compliance
Ensure full compliance with EHSS, hazardous gas, chemical safety, wastewater discharge, and environmental regulations concerning semiconductor manufacturing.
Maintain 100% EHSS training certification for all facilities staff and contractors.
Lead corrective and preventive actions following incidents, audits, or near‑miss events.
4. Team Leadership & Capability Development
Lead, mentor, and develop facilities technicians, engineers, and supervisors in a shift‑based 24×7 operation.
Drive standardization of operating procedures, maintenance practices, and commissioning processes.
Implement succession planning and skill‑depth development for critical systems ownership.
5. Maintenance, Reliability & Performance Management
Establish and govern preventive and corrective maintenance programs for all fab utilities and infrastructure.
Leverage artificial intelligence to track and drive KPIs such as uptime, MTBF, response time, safety metrics, and PM compliance
Lead root‑cause analysis (RCA) for utility‑related excursions impacting production.
6. Commissioning, Projects & Expansion Support
Lead commissioning of new fab utilities, equipment, and facility expansions supporting ramp‑up or technology node changes.
Partner with construction, operational, and equipment groups to integrate facilities systems with minimal disruption.
7. Financial & Vendor Management
Own facilities operations budget, forecasting, and cost‑optimization initiatives.
Handle strategic vendors providing gas, chemical, UPW, waste, and maintenance services.
Ensure contract compliance and SLA alignment for critically important services.
8. Customer & Audit Readiness
Represent the site during customer audits, ISO, EHSS, and certification reviews.
Act as the site’s voice in global facilities forums to align with corporate standards.
Qualifications & Experience
Required
Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical) or equivalent.
12–15+ years of experience in semiconductor fab facilities or similar high‑reliability industrial environments.
Proven understanding of gases, chemicals, UPW, wastewater systems, Electrical System, HVAC, and cleanroom facilities.
Preferred
Exposure to BMS / FMS / CMMS / SCADA systems.
Knowledge of local and international EHSS standards applicable to semiconductor fabs.
Key Competencies
Mission‑critical operations leadership
Safety‑first perspective
Incident & emergency management
Multi-functional collaboration with Manufacturing, Process, and Equipment teams
Data‑driven reliability improvement
Typical benchmarks
Fab utility uptime
Safety & EHSS compliance score
Incident response time
PM compliance rate
Cost optimization vs budget

Support energy security, grid reliability, alternate supply arrangements, and energy price risk management. Lead ISO 50001 implementation and employ Agentic AI for renewable energy dashboards.
B. Projects in Renewable Energy
Identify, evaluate, and implement renewable energy projects including Rooftop/Ground-mounted Solar PV, Wind and Solar-Wind Hybrid, Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), Captive and Group-Captive Projects, Third-Party Open Access Arrangements, Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs) and Environmental Attributes. Conduct technical and commercial feasibility studies by reviewing load profiles, contracted demand, grid connectivity, land availability, and future demand. Prepare project concepts, scope, specifications, generation estimates, and cases supporting project viability. Evaluate proposals based on cost, tariff savings, reliability, environmental benefits, and regulatory feasibility. Coordinate due diligence, project progress, commissioning, performance testing, monitoring, and handover. Monitor generation, availability, degradation, curtailment, contractual performance, and renewable energy claims. Maintain project register, capacity, generation, CODs, and benefits delivered.

Evaluate Physical PPAs, Virtual PPAs, Open Access PPAs, Captive/Group-Captive models, and On-site Renewable Agreements. Develop load forecasts and procurement scenarios. Prepare RFIs/RFPs and assess tariff, blocking issue, tenure, capacity, generation profile, banking, wheeling, transmission, scheduling, forecasting, and settlement. Perform financial analysis including NPV, IRR, payback, sensitivity, and landed-cost comparison. Assess regulatory, market, counterparty, curtailment, generation, credit, and change-in-law risks. Coordinate with Procurement, Finance, and Legal teams on negotiations and contracts. Review contractual clauses including capacity, tariff, term, COD, guarantees, supply commitments, payment security, change in law, force majeure, default, termination, and renewable attribute ownership. Monitor invoices, energy credits, open-access charges, and regulatory changes.

Lead the establishment, implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of ISO 50001 EnMS. Define EnMS scope and boundaries, identifying static factors and variables affecting energy performance. Integrate energy considerations into the building, procurement, equipment selection, and modifications. Conduct awareness programs, training, audits, compliance reviews, management reviews, and certification audits.
Manage non-conformities, corrective actions, closure evidence, and documentation. Coordinate with corporate and site energy teams.

Evaluate VFDs, efficient motors, heat recovery, heat pumps, automation, advanced controls, power management, and demand-response systems.
F. Energy Data & Digitalization

G. Regulatory & Collaborator Management
Track electricity, renewable energy, captive power, open access, and energy-efficiency regulations. Collaborate with utilities, regulators, agencies, consultants, transmission entities, and load-dispatch centers. Job description
Function: Mechanical
Location: Sanand
Experience: 12 to 15 Years
Qualification: Mechanical Engineering, Bachelor of Engineering degree
Industry Preference: Semiconductor Plant
The role requires an experienced engineer to lead the composition coordination, quality implementation, and installation oversight for all utility hook-up systems connected to semiconductor manufacturing tools. The candidate should be capable of handling cross-functional coordination for mechanical, electrical, network, water, and gas systems while ensuring conformity with engineering standards, cleanroom requirements, Working on AI-Enabled tools (such as Copilot and Power BI), safety rules, and project timelines.
Role purpose
This position is responsible for end-to-end coordination of tool hook-up works, from building review through installation, inspection, testing, and handover. In semiconductor projects, tool hook-up is a critical integration stage because each production tool must be accurately connected to utilities such as electrical power, process gases, chilled or process water, DIW, drain system, exhaust, and communication/data systems before startup and qualification can begin.
Key responsibilities
Review tool utility requirements and coordinate hook-up development for mechanical, electrical, network, water, and gas systems.
Verify layouts, installation drawings, hook-up packages, utility routing, and interface points with tool suppliers, facility teams, and project collaborators.
Manage field implementation of tool hook-up operations and verify adherence to approved drawings, quality plans, and safety guidelines.
Coordinate installation activities related to power supply, earthing, cables, data/network connectivity, water lines, gas lines, mechanical supports, and associated utility connections.
Ensure cleanroom protocols, contamination control practices, and semiconductor installation standards are maintained during execution.
Support QA/QC activities including inspections, punch listing, leak testing, pressure testing, continuity checks, flushing, and utility verification.
Work with OEMs, construction teams, quality teams, and facility engineers during startup, commissioning support, interlock verification, and handover.
Prepare and maintain engineering documentation such as checklists, as-built drawings, progress reports, inspection records, deviation logs, and turnover dossiers.
Apply industrial engineering methods to improve workflow, resource planning, installation sequencing, productivity, and execution efficiency.
Identify execution risks, resolve field issues, and drive corrective and preventive actions to maintain schedule and quality targets.
Required qualifications
Mechanical Engineering degree
12–15 years of experience in managing projects, facilities engineering, tool installation, or tool hook-up activities is required.
Strong knowledge of building review, field execution, quality assurance, and coordination across multidisciplinary utility systems is required.
Proficiency with AI tools (such as Copilot and Power BI) is required.
Preferred experience in semiconductor plants, cleanroom environments, or high-tech manufacturing facilities.
Ability to understand engineering drawings, utility layouts, P&IDs, single-line diagrams, and hook-up documents is preferred.
Working knowledge of testing, commissioning support, turn-on documentation, and vendor coordination is required.
Good communication, planning, team coordination, and problem-solving skills are essential.
Preferred candidate profile
The ideal candidate should have direct experience with semiconductor projects and a solid understanding of facility backbone systems. These include power, water, gas, and mechanical utilities that support fab operations. Candidates with cleanroom tool hookup, OEM coordination, utility interface management, and efficiency improvement experience are especially suited. Join us to be part of an ambitious team driving world-class innovations!

jobs.title: NVMQRA Solid State Drive (SSD) Quality and Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
Job Description
As a Non-Volatile Memory QRA (NVMQRA) Solid State Drive (SSD) Quality and Reliability Engineer at Micron Technology, Inc., you will you will be responsible for managing quality and reliability of Micron SSD products as these products enter into high volume production phase of product lifecycle.
You will perform reliability testing and data analysis on material associated with sustaining qualifications through change requests, product proliferations, special work requests and conversions. You will also take part in the management of product deviation events, through participation in product containment activities and providing quality and reliability evaluation plans for risk assessment.
You will also manage the outgoing quality and reliability (OQRM) metrics. You are expected to conduct failure analysis from qualification, evaluation and OQRM failures and report the resulting data. You can expect to conduct global meetings to determine product priorities or product dispositions.
In this role you will work with various Engineering and Quality Reliability Assurance Groups to provide technical support, expertise, consultation and training. You should expect to support customers both internal and external to Micron on an on-going basis.
Responsibilities And Tasks
Manage Reliability evaluations for deviation management
Determine a reliability evaluation/trials plan
Identify and manage material for sampling
Perform data analysis of reliability tests results and/or by conducting failure analysis
Close out evaluation and provide feedback to stakeholders
Identify deviated material within Material Review Board (MRB)
Take part in containment activities
Determine a reliability evaluation/trials plan
Identify and manage material for sampling
Perform data analysis of reliability tests results and/or by conducting failure analysis
Determine disposition of materials
Close out evaluation and provide feedback to stakeholders
Manage and coordinate various inputs from various stakeholders in Quality Reliability
Collaborate with discrete component product quality and reliability team for product reliability evaluations/trials/plans
Collaborate with package quality and reliability team for package-related reliability evaluations/trials/plans
Manage Product Outgoing Quality and Reliability Monitoring
Provide the plan for operations to execute for SSD product OQRM data collection
Analyze the data from Micron Manufacturing Execution System (MES) such as MAM
Use statistical analysis tools to provide conclusions and verify results
Summarize the reult of analyzed data through a regular OQRM metrics report
Digital & AI Tool Usage
Leverage AI-powered tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, agentic AI platforms, and other generative AI solutions) to enhance engineering effectiveness, automate routine tasks, analyze large datasets, and improve decision quality.
Drive adoption of AI-enabled workflows to increase productivity, reduce cycle time, and improve knowledge sharing within the organization.
Provide Expertise, Consultation and Training
Communicate Globally with NAND, Firmware, BUs and Engineering Groups for priority management
Provide training to engineers and technicians within and outside of the group
Maintain knowledge base (lessons learned) within the group for each SSD market segment
Stay abreast of Quality and Reliability issues of Micron NAND components
Provide consultation for audits, RMA, and customer issues
Education
Required: Masters’ Degree in Electrical / Electronics/ Computer Engineering
Desired: PhD in Electrical/Electronics/Computer Engineering
Candidates without a Master's degree may also be considered if they possess relevant experience in Product Engineering Failure Analysis (EFA) and a strong semiconductor industry background
Experience
2-7 years of experience in any of the following:
Solid State Drives Product/Device engineering
Non-volatile Memory Product/Device engineering
Non-volatile Memory Process integration engineering
Quality/Reliability engineering in semiconductor area
Demonstrated ability to effectively utilize Generative AI and Agentic AI platforms (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent tools) to enhance failure analysis efficiency, automate workflows, accelerate data-driven decision making, and improve technical documentation.
Candidates should be comfortable integrating AI-assisted solutions into daily engineering activities while applying appropriate technical judgment and data governance practices.
Qualifications
Basic knowledge and understanding of wafer fabrication process
Basic knowledge and understanding of device physics
Basic knowledge and understanding of NAND device operation
Basic knowledge and understanding of solid state drive operation
Knowledge of various Solid State drive protocol standards such as SATA, PCIe, or NVMe
Strong knowledge and understanding of semiconductor reliability statistics
Good verbal and written communication skills
Good time management and multi-tasking skills

As a GenAI Design Technologist, you will pioneer the intersection of Generative AI and creative production - shipping tools and workflows that transform how product images and videos are created at scale. We are operationalizing Generative AI for visual content creation. This team partners with world-class artists and scientists to push what's possible with image generation, video synthesis, and multimodal AI systems. You will work at the rare intersection where creative craft meets technical depth. In This Role, You Will Develop, optimize, and scale Generative AI workflows and pipelines for production-grade visual content Act as the bridge between creative teams and AI/ML engineering - translating artistic intent into scalable technical solutions Build automation that removes bottlenecks and enables content creators to focus on what they do best Evaluate emerging foundational models and translate the latest research breakthroughs into production-ready capabilities Partner with engineers and scientists on prompt engineering frameworks and centralized GenAI tooling This role is ideal for someone who's equal parts technologist and creative problem solver - someone who can evaluate output quality with a trained eye while optimizing the pipeline that produces it. You will ship work that directly impacts the shopping experience for hundreds of millions of customers worldwide. Key job responsibilities Develop, test, and optimize Generative AI workflows and pipelines for visual content production using inference platforms and services Act as a bridge between creative teams and AI/ML engineering - translating production needs into technical requirements and delivering working solutions Build and maintain automation scripts and tools that resolve workflow bottlenecks, improve content quality, and increase creator productivity Evaluate AI-generated output for visual quality, brand consistency, and production readiness - applying both technical metrics and creative judgment Support the fine-tuning, testing, and evaluation of foundational models and LLMs for image generation, video synthesis, and multimodal content creation Design and implement prompt engineering frameworks that enable consistent, high-quality results at scale across content types Collaborate with engineers and scientists to contribute to a centralized suite of GenAI tools used across visual content workflows Research and prototype emerging Generative AI capabilities - assessing production viability and recommending adoption paths to creative leadership Develop batch processing solutions and content pipelines that enable teams to generate, review, and publish AI-created assets efficiently Document workflows, best practices, and technical specifications to enable partner teams to adopt generative workflows independently Participate in cross-functional reviews to align AI tooling development with evolving creative standards and business requirements A day in the life In this role, you will move between creative and technical work. You might review AI-generated image outputs -tuning prompts and parameters to improve quality and consistency. Then shift to prototyping a workflow with a creative lead and ML engineer, translating a creative brief into a scalable technical solution. You could also be evaluating a new foundational model for production readiness or helping a partner team adopt your automation pipeline. Throughout it all, you will collaborate closely with creative directors, applied scientists, and content producers - solving the gap between what AI can technically generate and what meets the visual quality bar at scale. About The Team Our team builds how hundreds of millions of customers see products - through photography, video, CGI, and increasingly through Generative AI. We are a global network of creatives, technologists, and scientists unified by one mission: make every product look its best, at extraordinary scale. Our culture values builders who are curious, collaborative, and comfortable navigating ambiguity. We ship fast, learn from what breaks, and believe the best creative work happens when art and technology push each other forward. Basic Qualifications Bachelor's degree or above in computer science or equivalent 3+ years of experience in front-end technology, engineering, or UX prototyping Coding samples in front-end programming languages Available online portfolio demonstrating relevant work Experience with web, mobile web, or mobile app front-end development Experience with UI design for complex workflows and for end users Experience building scripts, tooling, and automation for large-scale computing environments Experience with prompt engineering techniques for content generation Preferred Qualifications Knowledge of technologies such as JavaScript/Node.js, HTML/CSS, Responsive/Adaptive Design Knowledge of Python, JavaScript, and source control (Git) Experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution Experience as a mentor, tech lead, or leading an engineering team Knowledge of video production, live streaming technologies, studio workflows, edit and post-production techniques, production calendars and staffing Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. Company - ASSPL - Haryana - C77 Job ID: A10516971

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineering Expert - Application/AI/ML Engineering, SAP Industry AI
jobs.description: We help the world run better At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed. In this role, you design, build, and operate AI native enterprise applications that combine cloud native software engineering with production grade machine learning and agentic AI capabilities being embedded directly within customer environments and fast-moving delivery teams. You work closely with customers to translate ambiguous business and operational requirements into secure, scalable, and reliable solutions, to solve complex real world business problems at speed owning technical delivery from discovery and prototyping through deployment, stabilization, and successful handover to platform or operations teams. You are accountable for the technical quality, reliability, and impact of application solutions within your scope. Working closely with product, data, ML, and customer teams, you apply modern AI assisted engineering practices and architectural guardrails aligned with SAP standards to enable responsible and scalable AI adoption. What You Bring You bring 14+ years of hands-on experience in software and application engineering across cloud-native, enterprise, and SaaS environments, along with a strong understanding of architectural principles such as scalability, security, and reliability. You have a proven ability to design and deliver AI-native applications using large language models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, vector databases, and agentic systems to transform enterprise workflows. You are proficient in widely used AI/ML Python libraries and frameworks and have experience with data pipelines and MLOps practices. You are skilled at integrating Agentic AI into complex business processes while ensuring the responsible and effective use of AI within enterprise operations. You possess a solid foundation in cloud platforms, distributed systems, scalability, security, and reliability, and you have experience owning solutions across the full application lifecycle, from design and implementation to deployment and production operations. You excel at collaborating with cross-functional teams and customer stakeholders, communicating complex technical concepts with clarity and influence. You bring a strong learning mindset, technical leadership, and accountability to high-impact, ambiguous environments, and you proactively leverage AI in your daily work, ensuring high-quality outcomes through thoughtful context design, prompt engineering, and system integration. What You Build In this role, you will: You will design, develop, and operate production-grade, cloud-native enterprise applications that integrate AI capabilities such as large language models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and agent-based workflows. You will embed directly within customer projects and fast-moving cross-functional teams to rapidly understand business processes, technical landscapes, and operational challenges. Working closely with stakeholders, you will translate business and product requirements into robust application architectures that balance speed, quality, security, and long-term maintainability. You will rapidly prototype, iterate, and productionize solutions in customer environments, adapting reference architectures and reusable assets to meet real-world enterprise constraints. You will own the end-to-end delivery of applications, from problem framing and prototyping through deployment, observability, and production operations. You will apply AI-assisted engineering practices, evaluation frameworks, and architectural guardrails to ensure compliant, trustworthy, and high-quality solutions. You will be responsible for meeting delivery milestones, quality standards, and technical objectives while proactively managing risks and technical escalations. As a key technical interface for customers and internal stakeholders, you will clearly communicate solution approaches, trade-offs, and progress. Additionally, you will contribute to engineering standards, best practices, and reusable components that improve efficiency, quality, and consistency across solutions. Where you Belong You will be part of a growing AI and industry expert team dedicated to serving customers across the region (Americas, Europe, Asia). We are building a collaborative, high-impact environment that brings together deep AI expertise, strong industry knowledge, and regional understanding to help customers innovate, transform, and lead in their markets. This team thrives on working together to turn complex business challenges into practical, scalable solutions. You will find an environment that values curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning , where new ideas are encouraged and real-world impact matters. This is a place for people who enjoy building something new. You will thrive here if you are customer-centric, motivated by meaningful outcomes, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a fast-evolving AI landscape. We work closely with decision-makers, challenge assumptions with data, and give data scientists room to influence strategy—not just produce analysis. We value sharp thinking, business curiosity, and clear communication. #SAPAICareers Bring out your best SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best. We win with inclusion SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world. SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e-mail with your request to Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap.com. For SAP employees: Only permanent roles are eligible for the SAP Employee Referral Program, according to the eligibility rules set in the SAP Referral Policy. Specific conditions may apply for roles in Vocational Training. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their age, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, et al), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or disability, in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local legal requirements. Successful candidates might be required to undergo a background verification with an external vendor. AI Usage in the Recruitment Process For information on the responsible use of AI in our recruitment process, please refer to our Guidelines for Ethical Usage of AI in the Recruiting Process. Please note that any violation of these guidelines may result in disqualification from the hiring process. jobs.title: Generative AI Forward Deployed Engineer, Google Cloud
jobs.description: In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India; Pune, Maharashtra, India; Bengaluru, Karnataka, India . Minimum qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 8 years of experience in cloud computing or a technical customer-facing role. Experience building pipelines for structured and unstructured data using both vector databases and RAG-like architectures to power enterprise AI solutions. Experience taking production-grade AI-driven solutions from conception to launch and architecting AI systems on cloud platforms (e.g., Google Cloud Platform (GCP)). Experience leading technical discovery sessions. Preferred qualifications: Master’s or PhD in AI, Computer Science, or a related technical field. Experience implementing multi-agent systems using frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, ADK) and complex patterns (e.g., ReAct, self-reflection, hierarchical delegation). Knowledge of "LLM-native" metrics (e.g., tokens/sec, cost-per-request) and techniques for optimizing state management and granular tracing. About The Job As a GenAI Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Google Cloud, you will be an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier AI products and production-grade reality within customers. Unlike traditional advisory roles, you will function as an "innovator-builder," moving beyond high-level architecture to code, debug, and jointly ship bespoke agentic solutions directly within the customer’s environment. This role is designed for high-agency engineers with a founder’s mindset. You will address blockers to production including solving the integration complexities, data readiness issues, and state-management challenges that prevent AI from reaching enterprise-grade maturity. By embedding with strategic accounts, you will serve a dual purpose: providing "white glove" deployment of complex AI systems and acting as a critical feedback loop, transforming real-world field insights into Google Cloud’s future product roadmap. It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours. Responsibilities Serve as a developer for complex AI applications, transitioning from rapid prototypes to production-grade agentic workflows (e.g., multi-agent systems, model context protocol (MCP) servers) that drive measurable return on investment (ROI). Architect and code the "connective tissue" between Google’s AI products and customer's live infrastructure, including APIs, legacy data silos, and security perimeters as part of an expert team. Build high-performance evaluation pipelines and observability frameworks to ensure agentic systems meet rigorous requirements for accuracy, safety, and latency. Identify repeatable field patterns and friction points in Google’s AI stack, converting them into reusable modules or formal product feature requests for the Engineering teams. Co-build with customer engineering teams to instill Google-grade development best practices, ensuring long-term project success and high end-user adoption. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

jobs.title: AI/ML/GEN AI Engineer
jobs.description: Strong proficiency in Python for data processing, automation, and model development. Deep understanding of ML model lifecycle: training, evaluation, and deployment. Strong proficiency in Python and ML frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn). Good to have experience integrating GenAI capabilities into enterprise applications using platforms like Microsoft Copilot Studio. Good to have experience in monitoring model performance and conduct thorough evaluations using metrics such as Precision, Recall, F1 Score, and BLEU Understanding of Responsible AI practices including model fairness, transparency, and auditability. Hands-on experience with Python-based web applications for AI/ML use cases. Solid knowledge of cloud-based AI services (Azure, AWS, GCP). Perform data collection, profiling, exploration data analysis (EDA), and data preparation. Apply a range of ML techniques including supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning. Design, develop, and deploy machine learning models using Python and popular ML frameworks Implement NLP solutions using NLP techniques like preprocessing, tokenization, vectorization, and semantic analysis. Develop and deploy GenAI solutions such as RAG systems and Agentic AI. Monitor model performance in production and implement retraining strategies. Adhere to and implement Responsible AI principles in all ML workflows. Present analytical insights to business stakeholders and project teams. Propose ML-based solutions and provide effort estimates for new use cases. Collaborate with data scientists and engineers on model training, evaluation, and deployment. Utilize AI services from cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, and GCP. Experience with MLOps frameworks for model lifecycle, versioning, deployment, and monitoring – such as Azure Machine Learning or AWS Sagemaker. Experience with Python-based web frameworks such as Flask and Django is essential, and familiarity with front-end technologies like Angular or React.js is a valuable addition. Hands-on experience in fine-tuning large language models (LLM) using techniques such as LoRA and QLoRA is highly valued. Experience with Kubernetes, docker containerization, and Kafka is preferred. Knowledge on model optimization, model distillation, quantization is an advantage.

jobs.title: Data Scientist-Artificial Intelligence
jobs.description: Introduction A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences. jobs.description: Description Alexa Connections is on a mission to become the world's most trusted communication agent, spanning across calls, text, email, and the ever-expanding surfaces where people connect. We're building intelligence that keeps customers connected effortlessly to their network and beyond, while putting their trust and privacy first. A central part of this is modeling each customer's personal connections graph, a privacy-first representation of their relationships and communication patterns, and using it to power an assistant that is context-aware and grows more helpful over time. You'll draw on large language models, agentic reasoning, and personalization to anticipate who, when, and how a customer wants to connect, and to act on their behalf across calls, text, and email. It's open-ended research applied to a real product, turning advances in personalization and memory into an agent that genuinely understands the people in a customer's life. About The Team We're building up the Alexa Connections science team, so you'll join early and grow alongside it. You'll work closely with experienced scientists and engineers invested in your development, with plenty of mentorship, room to broaden your skills, and the chance to own meaningful problems as you grow. jobs.title: AI Engineer - Assistant Manager- Global Markets IT
jobs.description: Job Title: AI Engineer Department: ISPL Data Office, CIB IT Transversal About Business Line/Function Global Markets The Global Markets business of BNP Paribas helps its corporate and institutional clients leverage capital markets across the globe for their financing, risk management and investment needs. This encompasses a wide range of financial products ranging from Foreign exchange to complex Equity Derivatives that are traded in financial markets across the globe 24/7. IT systems are integral to the business and are a key part of the value proposition to clients. These IT systems range from industry standard products for standard process automation to internally developed, often, market leading IT applications. The IT teams owning these IT systems are made up of functions that include Technical and Application production support, Business Analysis & Project Management, Development & Maintenance and Quality Control. BNP Paribas India Solutions is an equal partner in these IT functions along with colleagues in other locations including Paris, London, New York, Tokyo, Singapore & Hong Kong. This partnership ranges from sharing the IT work load, executing global strategy to owning global applications offshore. The technology and engineering landscape is wide, encompassing almost all techniques and platforms. It continues to evolve and transform with the market with the business continuing to invest in it. Position Purpose The AI Engineer will design, build and deploy production-grade data and AI solutions. The role combines strong Python and data engineering fundamentals (ETL, relational databases, REST APIs) with hands-on development of AI capabilities such as LLM-powered applications, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and agentic workflows. The position requires working in a virtual team and international environment and is multidisciplinary in nature. It involves coordination with other locations and divisions of BNP Paribas as necessary. The candidate should have strong engineering discipline, a problem-solving mindset and the ability to turn business requirements into reliable, secure and scalable solutions. Responsibilities Direct Responsibilities Design, develop and maintain scalable Python applications and data pipelines using Pandas for data extraction, transformation and loading (ETL). Build and expose secure, well-documented REST APIs using FastAPI, applying data validation (e.g. Pydantic) and API best practices. Write efficient SQL and work with relational databases such as Oracle, PostgreSQL and MS SQL Server, including data modelling, query optimization and performance tuning. Containerize applications using Docker and support deployment across development, test and production environments. Develop Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions – LLM-based applications, RAG pipelines, and multi-agent workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph or CrewAI. Integrate Large Language Models through provider APIs (e.g. OpenAI / Azure OpenAI) and open-source models (e.g. Hugging Face), applying prompt engineering, structured outputs and function / tool calling. Build natural-language interfaces to data (e.g. Text-to-SQL agents) that allow business users to query databases in plain English. Automate business workflows by combining AI capabilities with APIs, scheduling / workflow tools (e.g. n8n) and messaging integrations. Integrate AI solutions with enterprise data sources and tools, including vector databases and Model Context Protocol (MCP) based tool integrations. Implement LLM observability, tracing and evaluation (e.g. Langfuse) to monitor quality, cost, latency and reliability of AI applications. Develop, train and evaluate Machine Learning models where appropriate, using libraries such as Scikit-learn, TensorFlow and NumPy. Follow sound engineering practices: version control with Git, code reviews, unit / integration testing and clear technical documentation. Contribute to CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions / Jenkins) and support deployment of AI services on on-premise or cloud platforms (AWS / GCP / Azure). Translate business requirements into technical designs and work closely with business users, data teams and other stakeholders throughout implementation and delivery. Contributing Responsibilities Contribute to the design of reusable components, frameworks and best practices for data engineering and AI development within the team. Ensure solutions comply with the Group’s standards on data security, privacy, Responsible AI, risk and compliance. Identify opportunities for automation and process improvement, and propose AI-driven solutions. Participate in knowledge sharing, mentoring and cross-training to build AI capabilities within the team. Stay up to date with the evolving AI / LLM ecosystem and assess new tools and techniques for adoption. Technical & Behavioral Competencies Strong programming skills in Python, with hands-on experience in data manipulation and analysis using Pandas. Solid working knowledge of SQL and relational databases – Oracle / PostgreSQL / MS SQL Server. Experience designing and building REST APIs, preferably with FastAPI. Good understanding of ETL concepts, data pipelines, data quality and data integration. Practical experience with Docker and Git based development workflows. Exposure to LLM APIs (OpenAI / Azure OpenAI), Hugging Face models, prompt engineering, LLM application frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI), RAG pipelines, vector databases and LLM observability tools (e.g. Langfuse) is a strong plus. Familiarity with ClickHouse, front-end frameworks (React / Angular), Machine Learning libraries (Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, NumPy), CI/CD and cloud platforms (AWS / GCP / Azure) is an added advantage. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail; ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Specific Qualifications Minimum 7 years of hands-on experience in Python development / data engineering, with Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT or a related field, or equivalent experience. Hands-on experience building or contributing to AI / LLM based applications (Generative AI, RAG, Agentic AI) will be preferred. Prior experience in the Banking / Financial Services domain is desirable. Technical Skills Skills Referential (Required knowledge, skills and abilities) Must Have Python Pandas Oracle / PostgreSQL / MS SQL Server REST API FastAPI Docker Git ETL Concepts Good to Have ClickHouse React / Angular Agentic AI – LangGraph, CrewAI, LangChain LLM APIs – OpenAI / Azure OpenAI; Prompt Engineering Hugging Face (open-source LLMs, embeddings) Text-to-SQL / Natural-language data querying agents LLM Observability – Langfuse Model Context Protocol (MCP) RAG Pipelines and Vector Databases Machine Learning – Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, NumPy Pydantic Workflow Automation – n8n CI/CD – GitHub Actions / Jenkins Cloud Platforms – AWS / GCP / Azure Behavioral Skills Communication skills – oral & written Analytical Ability Problem Solving / Critical Thinking Team Player / Ability to collaborate Ability to deliver / Results driven Adaptability and continuous learning Education Level: Bachelor Degree or equivalent (B.E. / B.Tech / MCA / M.Sc. in Computer Science, IT or related field) Location: Mumbai About BNP Paribas Group BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability. About BNP Paribas India Solutions Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions. Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work. We prohibit Discrimination and Harassment of any kind and our policies promote equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants, irrespective of, but not limited to their gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, colour, national origin, age, religion, social status, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status etc. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next. Overview As a Lead Data Architect, you will help shape how connected data drives business action across General Mills by designing scalable, sustainable data solutions and advancing modern data architecture practices. You will work closely with data engineers, business analysts, architects, and cross-functional partners to define technical direction, enable strategic initiatives, and bring new data capabilities to life across global teams. Partner with business analysts and architects to define technical architectures for strategic projects and initiatives. Lead the design and implementation of scalable data pipelines, data modelling and data quality frameworks. Develop communication and education plans that help technical teams adopt technologies and processes across the data engineering ecosystem. Contribute as an active member of product teams to support current solutions and shape future capabilities. Mentor and guide data engineers, fostering innovation, technical excellence, and strong engineering practices within the team. jobs.title: Technical Architect
jobs.description: Role Summary We seek Senior Consultants and Architects to help enterprise customers migrate from Adobe Campaign Classic (ACC) and Adobe Campaign Standard (ACS) to Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) and Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO). Because AJO is built on AEP, little moves as-is: most schemas, audiences, workflows, and content must be rebuilt or redesigned, while some functionality is retained or handled through integrations. You will lead discovery, architecture, implementation, coexistence, cutover, and enablement; explain product boundaries; surface gaps early; and recommend the right path per use case: Journeys (profile-centric, event-driven), Orchestrated Campaigns (batch, relational, multi-step), or retaining Campaign v8. What You’ll Do Assess and plan: Inventory campaigns, workflows, data, and custom logic; classify each as reuse, redesign, rebuild, integrate, defer, or retain; document rationale, risks, and roadmaps; advise on Campaign v8 or ACS-transition coexistence. Architect and build: Design XDM, identity, and ingestion; build journeys and Orchestrated Campaigns (relational schemas, CDC); configure channels and providers; build secure custom actions and integrations. Migrate: Move profiles, consent, and suppression data; rebuild workflows, Handlebars/PQL personalization, and offers (ACC Interaction/Offer Decisioning to AJO Decisioning); convert landing pages and preference centers. Deliver: Run phased migration with dual-run, testing, deliverability and domain migration, reporting, cutover, documentation, and coaching, keeping live programs running. Required Technical Expertise And Skills Candidates need delivery experience on both sides: ACC and/or ACS, plus AEP, AJO, Offer Decisioning, and Orchestrated Campaigns. Experience on only one side is not sufficient. Required: workflows, schemas, and typologies; XDM and identity; journey and campaign design; decisioning; REST/JSON/XML integrations; Handlebars/PQL; HTML/CSS; JavaScript or Node.js; Python or Java; SQL and DDL; data modeling. Preferred: native mobile, CI/CD and Git, regex, API tooling, and shell scripting. Role Expectations And Qualifications You will own target-state architecture, lead fit/gap analysis and estimates, guide workstreams, escalate risks early, and mentor customer teams. Recommended experience: 8+ years in marketing technology or enterprise implementation. 4+ years hands-on Campaign and 2+ years AEP/AJO. Orchestrated Campaigns and Offer Decisioning experience; strong ACC experience with demonstrated ramp-up will be considered. Messaging providers (SMS, RCS, WhatsApp, push); Adobe certifications desirable. Success means traced designs, parity and reconciled counts, and cutovers that protect consent, suppression, and deliverability. Strong communication and distributed-team experience are expected. AI, Coworker, and Migration Automation Candidates should have practical AI experience that speeds migration while preserving expert review. Coworker: Experience using Adobe Coworker for eligible AJO tasks (journey creation and analysis, simulation, version comparison, decisioning investigation), with clear prompts and validation of all output; it supports, not replaces, discovery and testing. Migration automation: Experience building accelerators to inventory assets, draft mappings, reconcile data, transform HTML and personalization, and produce source-to-target reports, with human review, least-privilege access, PII minimization, and auditable change control. jobs.description: Job Purpose: Enterprise AI (EAI) builds AI products that combine real modelling work with user-facing applications, and ships them to production. Full Stack Engineers move across data, models, platforms, APIs and interfaces in a single workflow. In our operating model, digital workers do much of the hands-on build. They generate services, APIs, interface components and tests, run evaluations and monitor what is in production. Our engineers set the architecture and standards that work is built to, and own the quality of what ships. EAI products and agents draw on a governed context layer that makes data, meaning, permissions and history retrievable at the moment they are needed. Full Stack Engineers build the products and agents that consume it, and decide how that context reaches users. The Full Stack Engineer II independently builds and ships AI-integrated features, working closely with GSK business teams to prototype against real data and workflows at a days-to-weeks cadence. The role owns the quality of what digital workers deliver in those features, makes evidence-based calls on what to continue or stop, and contributes reusable components others adopt. Responsibilities: Own use cases from problem framing through working prototype and first production version, at a days-to-weeks cadence and without close supervision. Qualify incoming asks: challenge underspecified problems, assess feasibility and define scope before committing to work. At the end of each piece of work, form and defend an evidence-based recommendation to continue or stop, presented clearly to business and EAI leadership. Work closely with business teams, prototyping against real data and workflows and building trusted relationships with product owners and engineering leads. Required skills: 16+ years of overall professional experience & 10+ years of full-stack or AI/ML engineering experience, including production deployments. Demonstrated ability to take ideas from sketch to working software at speed, independently and under time pressure. A startup, lab or innovation-team background is an advantage. Strong proficiency in Python and at least one of TypeScript, JavaScript, Go or similar, with experience designing and shipping backend services and complete UI features. Hands-on experience with GenAI patterns: agents, multi-agent orchestration, RAG, tool use, prompt engineering and evaluation, including evaluation pipelines and LLM-specific monitoring in production. Daily use of AI coding agents as the primary mode of development, with sound judgement on what to accept, change or reject. A track record of raising team standards through code review and documentation, and of contributing reusable engineering patterns that others adopted. Education : Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Preferred skills: Prior experience as a Full Stack Engineer, Customer Engineer or Solutions Architect, ideally at an AI-native company or hyperscaler. Experience in regulated industries, such as life sciences, healthcare or financial services, and familiarity with GxP, GDPR and SOX. Working knowledge of fine-tuning fundamentals and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Framework Integrations
jobs.description: AI frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, and n8n are quickly becoming the default way developers build with AI — and MongoDB wants to be the data platform that shows up everywhere they build. As part of the AI Builders Experience (ABX) org, we're standing up a brand new engineering team in Gurugram to make that happen, and we're looking for Senior Software Engineers to be among its founding members. The team owns the connective layer between MongoDB and third-party AI frameworks, platforms, and tools — the integrations that let developers use MongoDB effectively with the AI stack they've already chosen. That means shipping into some of the fastest-moving open-source ecosystems in tech, working mostly in Python and TypeScript, and partnering with the Database Experience (DBX) org when an integration needs new driver, platform, or product capability underneath it. This is a self-sufficient team by design. You and your engineering manager will be based in Gurugram, and the group is set up to own its area end to end: to decide how integrations get built, tested, released, and maintained, without waiting on another time zone to unblock the day-to-day. You'll work closest with the engineers sitting next to you, pairing on hard problems, reviewing each other's code, and dividing up a broad portfolio, while collaborating with product, partners, field teams, and open source maintainers as the work requires. You'll integrate with fast-moving, often unproven technologies, make pragmatic calls in the face of ambiguity, and own high-visibility projects with minimal guidance. Priorities can shift week to week based on framework changes, customer demand, and partner needs, so we're looking for product-minded engineers who thrive on autonomy and take pride in shipping. Much of your work will happen in public: sending pull requests to upstream repositories, working through external maintainer review cycles, and representing MongoDB in developer communities. MongoDB engineering teams pride themselves on building high-quality software and living our cultural values every day — we value intellectual curiosity, intellectual honesty, customer empathy, and building together in an environment that prioritizes collaboration over competition. We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model. Position expectations Design, build, test, and ship MongoDB integrations across a broad AI framework ecosystem that includes technologies like LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, n8n, and Mastra, owning them from first exploratory spike through production release and ongoing maintenance. Take ownership of ambiguous problems and drive them to completion independently, making sound decisions as requirements, frameworks, and customer needs evolve. Do the initial, exploratory work: assess a new framework, define the smallest useful version of an integration, get it in front of users quickly, and make a clear recommendation about whether and how to invest further. Contribute high-quality code upstream to repositories MongoDB doesn't own, maintaining a high standard of professionalism and courtesy while working through external maintainer review cycles. Build and maintain the team's engineering practices for a broad integration portfolio, including CI/CD, automated testing across framework and server versions, version compatibility awareness, and release readiness. Own the operational health of the integrations you build — monitoring, upgrades, breaking-change response, issue triage, and follow-through after launch. Partner with the Database Experience (DBX) org to define the driver, platform, and product capabilities your integrations depend on, making the case for what's needed and why. Work with product management, product design, partners, field teams, and open source maintainers to define the first version and future evolution of these integrations. Raise the technical bar within the team: shape architecture and development practices, give thorough code reviews, share what you know, and mentor peers and less experienced engineers. Stay current with the Python, TypeScript, and broader AI builder ecosystems and bring what you learn back to the team's roadmap. Bring a research and discovery mindset: notice emerging opportunities in the ecosystem, surface them early, and make the case for where MongoDB should show up next. Flag issues, risks, and resource needs early and clearly, both within the team and to cross-functional partners in other regions. Qualifications Strong background in building core components for scalable, high-availability services, developer platforms, or libraries 7+ years of experience building backend systems or developer-facing libraries, with strong proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript Proven success in designing, writing, testing, debugging, and performance tuning software in large, long-lived code bases, including code that other developers depend on Track record of identifying problems, implementing solutions, and delivering complex projects independently with minimal guidance A product-minded approach to engineering, with the judgment to make pragmatic tradeoffs between fast time-to-market and long-term maintainability, and the comfort to operate amid ambiguity and rapidly evolving technologies Demonstrated ability to context switch across a portfolio of projects while maintaining sound prioritization and quality. Strong and demonstrated interest in modern AI builder workflows and the developer tooling landscape: AI frameworks, agentic patterns, RAG and retrieval, embedding, vector search, or adjacent areas. Excellent verbal and written technical communication skills, including the ability to write things down clearly for partners you won't always overlap with in real time. jobs.description: Job Purpose: Enterprise AI (EAI) builds AI products that combine real modelling work with user-facing applications, and ships them to production. At DuPont, our purpose is to empower the world with essential innovations to thrive. We work on things that matter. Why Join Us | DuPont Careers Job Summary The Digital Innovation Technical Program Manager (TPM) leads the end-to-end planning, execution, and delivery of complex AI and Digital Innovation programs across the enterprise. This role translates strategic business and technology priorities into executable programs, with clear roadmaps, milestones, dependencies, governance, and measurable outcomes. The TPM will play a central role in advancing enterprise AI priority programs and delivering AI platforms and products at scale. Operating at the intersection of business strategy, technology, product delivery, and program execution, the TPM coordinates across business and technical stakeholders and is accountable for driving execution, enabling timely decisions, resolving risks and dependencies, and ensuring programs deliver intended business value while meeting enterprise governance, security, privacy, and responsible AI expectations. Primary Responsibilities Lead end-to-end execution of complex AI and Digital Innovation programs, establishing clear program objectives, scope, roadmaps, milestones, releases, dependencies, governance, and success measures. Drive enterprise AI priority programs from strategic direction through execution, coordinating multiple workstreams and ensuring alignment to business priorities, technology strategy, and expected outcomes. Coordinate delivery of enterprise AI platforms and products, partnering with product, engineering, data, AI, architecture, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and business teams. Partner with AI Data Science on feasibility, solution evaluation, model hand-offs, and performance requirements, while retaining accountability for program delivery rather than AI solution quality or model performance. Translate business and technology priorities into executable technical programs by defining delivery plans, sequencing work, clarifying ownership, and establishing the decisions and dependencies required for successful execution. Orchestrate cross-functional execution across business, IT, product, engineering, data and AI, architecture, cybersecurity, infrastructure, governance, Centers of Excellence, and external partners to maintain alignment and accelerate delivery. Lead program-level governance and delivery reviews, providing visibility into program health, resource needs, dependencies, trade-offs, risks, decisions, and delivery commitments. Contribute program information and recommendations to Operations-led intake, portfolio reviews, governance forums, and leadership reviews without assuming ownership of the portfolio operating system. Manage complex cross-program dependencies and resource constraints, identifying conflicts early, evaluating impacts, and driving resolution or escalation to maintain delivery momentum. Identify and resolve program risks and execution barriers, bringing the appropriate business and technical leaders together to make timely decisions and address issues before they materially affect outcomes. Ensure responsible delivery of AI-enabled capabilities by integrating cybersecurity, data privacy, compliance, responsible AI, architecture, and governance requirements into program planning and execution. Maintain current program scope, owners, timelines, milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions, and actions in Jira as the single source of program status. Provide concise, decision-ready metrics, dashboards, risk assessments, and recommendations to support Operations-led portfolio reporting and executive reviews. Apply Agile and product delivery practices appropriate to each initiative, coordinating releases, testing, deployment, and go-live decisions through defined readiness gates. Partner with AI Digital Enablement on training, communications, business readiness, adoption, and feedback, while that team leads change management, upskilling, and adoption. Partner with external vendors and strategic technology providers to align deliverables, dependencies, performance expectations, and timelines. Track program outcomes and contribute to business value measurement led by AI Digital Enablement, working with business owners to validate realized value and feed lessons learned into future intake and delivery planning. Contribute to and apply a standard delivery playbook with repeatable roadmaps, stage gates, and governance practices, capturing lessons learned to make subsequent AI programs faster and more predictable. Lead regular program syncs and track milestones delivered on commitment, program health, and escalation decision cycle time. Surface capacity constraints and cross-team trade-offs to the TPM Team Lead and Operations Manager for leadership decisions. Education Experience - Required Bachelor s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience. 7+ years of experience in technical program management, technology delivery, or related roles leading complex, cross-functional technology initiatives. Demonstrated experience leading programs that span multiple business and technical teams, with accountability for roadmaps, milestones, dependencies, risks, resources, and delivery outcomes. Experience delivering programs involving AI, data, cloud, digital products, enterprise platforms, or related technologies. Deep engineering expertise across these disciplines is not required. Strong working knowledge of Agile, Scrum, and product delivery practices, with the ability to apply the appropriate delivery approach based on program needs. Demonstrated ability to translate strategic business priorities and technical objectives into structured, executable programs and drive those programs through delivery. Experience operating in complex enterprise technology environments and coordinating across business, IT, engineering, product, architecture, cybersecurity, data, governance, and other technical functions. Proven ability to identify and manage complex dependencies, risks, resource constraints, competing priorities, and decisions across multiple teams and workstreams. Experience working with senior and executive stakeholders, including communicating program status, framing decisions, escalating risks, and presenting clear recommendations. Strong communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to drive alignment across teams with different priorities and areas of expertise.
