About us For well over a century, ExxonMobil has been at the heart of creating and growing a modern world. We embrace the power and promise of technology, pushing the boundaries of whats possible. For billions around the world, lives are better and last longer because of the innovative problem solving and reliable energy we provide. And when it comes to developing industrial solutions to reduce carbon emissions, ExxonMobil is truly the leader. We dont stop at "good enough." We are committed to doing whats right, even if its difficult or unpopular. We hold ourselves to high standards, challenge whats possible and invest in innovation to meet societys critical needs. Real change begins with bold questions, drive, and ambition. Here, your talent, determination and contributions shape how far youll go and the impact youll make along the way. Our future success depends on exceptional people. We invest in developing talent through meaningful work, challenging assignments, mentorship, and experiences that help build the next generation of leaders. Our Culture We are uniquely ExxonMobil. Integrity, care, excellence, resilience and courage, these core values determine how we work every day. At ExxonMobil, our values arent just words- theyre how we show up, focused on delivering the right answer, the right way, every day. Job Group Capability Process Engineering Products Job Group Process Engineering Job Role Description The Engineering Lead is Plant modification project role and is co-located within the engineering contractor s office and is responsible for the effective delivery of engineering (e.g., overall contractor performance and project-specific outcomes) by the contractor for an assigned Project or portfolio of Projects. This role is contractor-facing and is responsible for engineering work process at contractor office with support of the design lead Remote project engineers, who remains accountable for overall project delivery. This role is expected to have a strong understanding of engineering management and related activities within the engineering contractor s office. This enables the Engineering Lead to make appropriate technical guidance to contractor, drive day-to-day progress, metrics, and quality for overall program. The Engineering Lead works closely with their project team and the engineering contractor to drive efficient engineering execution, issue resolution, and escalation. The role serves as a team lead for the ExxonMobil engineering team assigned to their Project(s), including discipline and delivery engineers. The role works in coordination with the PMP Supervisors to support overall contractor performance, standardization, and continuous improvement across the Plant modification portfolio. Co-ordinate with Design leads Remote project engineers responsible for contractor delivery of project-specific engineering outcomes. Serves as the primary engineering interface with contractor teams for the program. Supports the Design Leads (PM, RPE, PE, DL ), who retains accountability for overall project delivery and integration. Proven ability to lead multi disciplinary design team, managing interfaces, oversight project schedule cost control monitoring. jobs.title: Lead Financial Analyst-OneStream
jobs.description:
Experience range: 10-19 Yrs
ABOUT GENERAL MILLS We make food the world loves: 100 brands. In 100 countries. Across six continents. With iconic brands like Cheerios, Pillsbury, Betty Crocker, Nature Valley, and Hagen-Dazs, weve been serving up food the world loves for 155 years (and counting). Each of our brands has a unique story to tell. How we make our food is as important as the food we make. Our values are baked into our legacy and continue to accelerate us into the future as an innovative force for good. General Mills was founded in 1866 when Cadwallader Washburn boldly bought the largest flour mill west of the Mississippi. That pioneering spirit lives on today through our leadership team who upholds a vision of relentless innovation while being a force for good. For more details check out http://www.generalmills.com General Mills India Center (GIC) is our global capability center in Mumbai that works as an extension of our global organization delivering business value, service excellence and growth, while standing for good for our planet and people. With our team of 1800+ professionals, we deliver superior value across the areas of Supply chain (SC) , Digital & Technology (D&T) Innovation, Technology & Quality (ITQ), Consumer and Market Intelligence (CMI), Sales Strategy & Intelligence (SSI) , Global Shared Services (GSS) , Finance India and Human Resources Shared Services (HRSS).For more details check out https://www.generalmills.co.in We advocate for advancing equity and inclusion to create more equitable workplaces and a better tomorrow. JOB OVERVIEW Function Overview The Finance organization partners across General Mills to provide financial expertise to guide and govern the company. We bring a distinctive skill set to help the company sustainably drive strong returns on investment, whether thats brand investments, capital investments or resource investments. We hold ourselves accountable for the areas where we are uniquely positioned to drive results what we call our Strategic Priorities but we never lose sight of the fact that we only truly win when the company wins. The Finance function operates as a global team through the partnership of a series of enterprise-focused and business-embedded groups. Purpose of the role The General Mills Financial Systems Integration (FSI) team oversees a global financial systems, data and process ecosystem that enables business growth and evolution, with uncompromising fiduciary integrity. The agile & experienced team governs systems and data, leads close and consolidation processes and provides strategic guidance on key enterprise and portfolio shaping initiatives. General Mills is in the process of transitioning our global close & consolidation platform from HFM to the OneStream platform. We are seeking a motivated individual to assist in building, sustaining and optimizing this new core platform. The Global Consolidation Administrator (OneStream) will report to the Global Consolidation Steward and oversee the administration and day-to-day support of the OneStream application. This role is integral to the Financial Systems Integration (FSI) Team and involves close collaboration with various members of the global finance and accounting organization across the company. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES Perform primary duties within OneStream application, including, but not limited to, entity hierarchies, rules, workflows, dashboards, and reporting views/packages. Develop and maintain various reporting solutions (OneStream Cube Views and Excel Add-in) as needed by Accounting and other Finance teams. Create, maintain, and update financial reports and forms and perform training and end-user education of the system functionality, as needed Troubleshoot and partner with D&T resources on technical issues related to the OneStream system. Support integrations and data quality processes (validations, mappings, transformations, confirmations) from source systems (SAP, other) in OneStream. Partner with SOX team to ensure internal control governance (including SOX requirements), documentation and coordination with internal and external auditors as it relates to system access and change management. Provide support for users and maintain system protocols in troubleshooting data validation, access, and reporting issues. MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS Education – Full time graduation from an accredited university (Mandatory- Note: This is the minimum education criteria which cannot be altered) Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field 5+ years of experience in Financial Consolidation system administration, specifically in OneStream, with experience in Hyperion HFM is a plus Strong documentation and communication skills, to support interaction with Finance customers and IT partners A strong background in accounting and finance Detail oriented, highly accurate, and conscientious with strong written and verbal communication skills Exhibit strong problem solving, deductive reasoning and decision-making skills Work independently as well as in a team environment Demonstrate our core values of ambition, innovation, integrity and teamwork

jobs.description: Summary Position Summary Cyber Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Position Summary Job Title: SeniorConsultant - Cloud AI Security - GCP Are you interested in working in a dynamic environment that offers opportunities for professional growth and new responsibilities? Join Deloitte's Cyber Cloud AI Security team and become a member of the largest group of cybersecurity professionals worldwide. Work you’ll do As a Cloud AI Security Senior Consultant, you will lead and support client engagements focused on securing AI, generative AI, and ML workloads across cloud platforms. You will bring deep experience across cloud security, AI security architecture, governance, compliance, platform controls, and monitoring to help clients design, assess, and implement secure AI capabilities at scale. You will be expected to contribute to solutioning and client delivery, and provide actionable recommendations across the AI lifecycle, including data ingestion, model development, validation, deployment, runtime monitoring, and retraining. Responsibilities as a Cloud AI Security Senior Consultant will include: Drive the design and implementation of AI security solutions within cloud environments aligned to client business objectives, enterprise architecture, regulatory expectations, and security requirements. Execute AI security assessments for cloud-hosted AI/ML and GenAI workloads, evaluating controls against frameworks and standards such as NIST CSF, CSA CCM, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001. Define and implement AI security controls across identity, access, network segmentation, encryption, key management, secrets management, logging, monitoring, workload protection, and secure configuration management. Support threat modeling and security architecture reviews for AI and GenAI solutions, including risks related to prompt injection, jailbreaks, insecure output handling, excessive agent permissions, sensitive data exposure, model misuse, and insecure tool or connector usage. Design and review secure AI architectures spanning model endpoints, APIs, retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, vector stores, plugins, agent frameworks, orchestration layers, and external tool integrations. Support secure deployment and configuration of cloud-native AI services including Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, and Google Vertex AI. Implement and review platform-specific controls such as private connectivity, encryption with customer-managed keys, tenant isolation, access restrictions, content safety controls, and service-native logging and monitoring capabilities. Drive DevSecOps, MLOps, and MLSecOps integration efforts by embedding policy validation, secrets handling, secure model promotion, compliance checks, and security testing into CI/CD and ML pipelines. Define and implement secure AI lifecycle controls across data ingestion, model training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, incident response, drift review, and retraining, including protections against data poisoning, model tampering, and supply-chain risk. Support AI governance and compliance activities including model inventory, risk classification, approval workflows, traceability, documentation standards, and control mapping aligned to NIST AI RMF and ISO 42001. Support clients in implementing responsible AI and model governance controls related to data protection, access control, model usage restrictions, prompt security, content filtering, and audit readiness. Execute AI security posture management efforts using cloud-native tooling, CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, and related controls to identify misconfiguration, data exposure, anomalous model activity, and policy violations. Support AI-specific monitoring and incident response by helping define detections, alerts, escalation paths, and remediation activities for suspicious prompt behavior, agent abuse, unauthorized model access, and sensitive data leakage. Conduct or support AI security testing activities including misuse-case testing, control validation, prompt attack testing, model guardrail validation, and red-team support for AI-enabled applications. Work directly with client stakeholders across security, cloud engineering, DevOps, data, ML engineering, privacy, risk, and architecture teams to translate requirements into implementable designs and remediation plans. The team Deloitte Cyber team helps complex organizations more confidently pursue their growth, innovation and performance agendas through proactive management of the associated cyber risks. Our professionals provide advisory and implementation services that integrate risk, regulatory, and technology skills to help clients transform their legacy programs into proactive cyber risk programs. Join the team developing the future state of cyber risk solutions. Learn more about Deloitte Advisory’s Cyber Risk Services practice. Required: 7+ years of experience in cloud security, cybersecurity consulting, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, or closely related disciplines. Demonstrated experience leading or owning workstreams in client-facing security engagements. Strong hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform and working knowledge of the other leading platforms: AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud. Strong understanding of AI/ML and GenAI security concepts, including prompt injection, model misuse, data leakage, secure model access, agent security, and responsible AI fundamentals. Experience implementing cloud security controls across IAM, network security, encryption, key management, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and policy enforcement. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical risks and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Deep hands-on experience with identity and access management, including AWS IAM, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, and Google Cloud IAM. jobs.description: We help the world run better At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed. Data and Applied Science Expert The context engine that makes AI enterprise ready. Anyone can build an AI agent. What makes SAP's agents different is accuracy grounded in the richest enterprise data and process context in the world. As a Data and Applied Scientist at SAP, you'll build the context engine grounded in SAP’s Business ontology: the semantic infrastructure that transforms raw business data into the knowledge layer powering SAP's AI agents and assistants. What You'll Build The semantic and contextual foundation of SAP's AI. While generic AI agents operate on surface-level patterns, SAP agents are accurate because they understand the real semantics of enterprise business master data, process flows, and domain relationships. You'll build and scale the layer that makes that possible. Design and maintain enterprise ontologies and semantic models that give AI agents accurate, grounded understanding of SAP and connected business landscapes harmonizing data from SAP, Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow, MES/IoT systems, and external providers into unified semantic layers. Build AI capabilities including RAG pipelines, embeddings, vector databases, and enterprise knowledge grounding that make SAP's agents accurate and reliable in production. Develop AI capabilities including generative AI and LLM-based solutions using enterprise business data, knowledge graphs, business process intelligence, and other structured and unstructured data assets. Leverage SAP's deep data and process context including SAP data models, metadata structures, and business process semantics across Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Record-to-Report, and Plan-to-Produce to ground AI solutions in real enterprise reality. Work with cloud and data platforms including Databricks, SAP Datasphere, SAP HANA Cloud, AWS, Azure, and GCP to support reliable, scalable AI workflows. Partner across product, engineering, business, and customer-facing teams to translate ambiguous business challenges into concrete AI solutions from concept through deployment and continuous improvement. Apply machine learning, deep learning, and statistical modeling to develop and evaluate AI solutions using real-world enterprise datasets. What You'll Bring 10 + years of experience in knowledge engineering, semantic data systems, applied AI, or data science in industry, research labs, or advanced academic environments. Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field Hands-on experience designing enterprise ontologies and semantic models; proficiency in at least one graph query language (SPARQL, Cypher, or GQL); understanding of trade-offs between RDF triple stores and property graph databases. Hands-on experience with modern GenAI systems RAG, embeddings, vector databases, semantic retrieval, and enterprise knowledge grounding. Strong Python and SQL skills with production-grade development practices; experience with ML libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit-learn. Proven track record deploying and operating AI/ML solutions in production including handoff, lifecycle support, and continuous improvement. Experience with big data infrastructure and cloud environments Databricks or equivalent, plus at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP). jobs.description: Cyber Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat design, and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance. Job Title: Manager - Cloud AI Security - AWS Are you interested in working in a dynamic environment that offers opportunities for professional growth and new responsibilities? If so, Deloitte could be the place for you. Traditional security programs have often been unsuccessful in unifying the need to both secure and support technology innovation required by the business. Join Deloitte's Cyber Cloud AI Security team and become a member of the largest group of cybersecurity professionals worldwide. Work you’ll do As a Cloud AI Security Manager, you will lead client engagements focused on securing AI, generative AI, and ML workloads across cloud platforms. You will help clients define and implement secure AI strategies, architectures, governance models, and control frameworks across the AI lifecycle, including data ingestion, model development, validation, deployment, runtime monitoring, and retraining. You will be expected to lead engagement delivery, manage senior client stakeholders, guide cross-functional teams, mentor junior practitioners, and drive high-quality outcomes across AI security, cloud security, governance, compliance, and risk management. Responsibilities as a Cloud AI Security Senior Consultant will include: Lead client engagements focused on AI, GenAI, and ML security across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud environments. Lead the design and implementation of AI security solutions aligned to client business objectives, enterprise architecture, regulatory expectations, and security requirements. Oversee AI security assessments for cloud-hosted AI/ML and GenAI workloads, evaluating controls against frameworks and standards such as NIST CSF, CSA CCM, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001. Lead threat modeling, architecture reviews, and control design for AI and GenAI solutions, including risks related to prompt injection, jailbreaks, insecure output handling, excessive agent permissions, sensitive data exposure, model misuse, and insecure tool or connector use. Define secure AI reference architectures spanning model endpoints, APIs, retrieval pipelines, vector stores, plugins, agent frameworks, orchestration layers, and external integrations. Guide secure deployment and configuration of cloud-native AI services including Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, and Google Vertex AI. Oversee implementation of platform-specific controls such as private connectivity, encryption, key management, secrets management, access restrictions, tenant isolation, content safety controls, and service-native logging and monitoring. Lead DevSecOps, MLOps, and MLSecOps integration by embedding security checks, policy validation, secrets handling, model governance, and compliance controls into CI/CD and ML pipelines. Establish secure AI lifecycle controls across data ingestion, training, validation, deployment, runtime monitoring, incident response, drift review, and retraining. Lead AI governance and compliance activities including model inventory, risk classification, approval workflows, traceability, control mapping, audit readiness, and policy alignment. Drive AI security posture management using cloud-native tooling, CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, and related capabilities to identify misconfiguration, data exposure, anomalous activity, and policy violations. Oversee AI-specific monitoring and incident response capabilities for suspicious prompt behavior, agent misuse, unauthorized model access, data leakage, and control failures. Lead or coordinate AI security testing activities including misuse-case testing, prompt attack validation, model guardrail reviews, red-team support, and remediation planning. Manage client stakeholders across security, cloud engineering, DevOps, architecture, data, ML engineering, privacy, legal, and risk teams. Lead teams of analysts, consultants, and senior consultants by assigning work, reviewing outputs, coaching team members, and ensuring quality of delivery. Contribute to business development, proposals, solutioning, thought leadership, reusable assets, and practice development initiatives related to cloud AI security. The team Deloitte Cyber team helps complex organizations more confidently pursue their growth, innovation and performance agendas through proactive management of the associated cyber risks. Our professionals provide advisory and implementation services that integrate risk, regulatory, and technology skills to help clients transform their legacy programs into proactive cyber risk programs. Join the team developing the future state of cyber risk solutions. Learn more about Deloitte Advisory’s Cyber Risk Services practice. Required: 9+ years of experience in cloud security, cybersecurity consulting, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, AI security, or related disciplines. Demonstrated experience leading client-facing engagements or major workstreams in security, cloud, or AI-related programs. Experience designing, assessing, or implementing security controls for cloud-hosted applications, platforms, and AI/ML environments. Strong experience with one or more major cloud platforms, with working knowledge across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud. Strong understanding of AI/ML and GenAI security concepts, including prompt injection, model misuse, data leakage, secure model access, agent security, model governance, and responsible AI controls. Experience implementing cloud security controls across IAM, network security, encryption, key management, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and policy enforcement. Experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Bash, and PowerShell. Experience with DevSecOps, CI/CD, and secure engineering practices, including policy validation, secrets handling, and continuous compliance. Familiarity with cloud AI services such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Azure OpenAI, Mythos, Anthropic, and Vertex AI. Familiarity with governance and security frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, and related control frameworks. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience communicating technical and risk matters to executive and non-technical stakeholders. Experience leading teams, mentoring junior practitioners, and managing quality across client deliverables. Preferred: Experience leading AI security assessments, architecture reviews, control design, remediation programs, or transformation initiatives across one or more major cloud platforms. Deep hands-on experience with identity and access management, including AWS IAM, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, and Google Cloud IAM. Experience designing governance and guardrails for cloud AI environments using services such as AWS Organizations, AWS Control Tower, Azure Policy, Security Command Center, and equivalent policy enforcement capabilities. Experience with cloud-native monitoring and security tooling such as AWS Security Hub, CloudTrail, AWS Config, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, and Google Security Command Center. Experience with CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, vulnerability management, container security, and posture management tools supporting AI workloads. Experience with prompt security, content safety, model guardrails, AI runtime monitoring, and agent security for generative AI applications. Exposure to AI red teaming, misuse-case testing, prompt attack validation, or adversarial testing of LLM-enabled applications. Experience securing containerized, API-driven, and agent-based AI applications. Knowledge of privacy, legal, and data governance considerations relevant to AI workloads, including data residency, retention, sensitive data handling, and auditability. Experience establishing AI governance processes such as AI inventory, model classification, approval gates, traceability, documentation standards, and audit support. Experience contributing to proposals, solution development, go-to-market offerings, and practice-building activities. Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, AWS Certified Security – Specialty, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, Microsoft Azure security certifications, or comparable senior-level cloud and security credentials. jobs.title: Cloud AI Security - Microsoft - Senior Consultant
jobs.description: Cyber Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat design, and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance. Position Summary Job Title: Senior Consultant - Cloud AI Security - Microsoft Are you interested in working in a dynamic environment that offers opportunities for professional growth and new responsibilities? If so, Deloitte could be the place for you. Traditional security programs have often been unsuccessful in unifying the need to both secure and support technology innovation required by the business. Join Deloitte's Cyber Cloud AI Security team and become a member of the largest group of cybersecurity professionals worldwide. Work you’ll do As a Cloud AI Security Senior Consultant, you will lead and support client engagements focused on securing AI, generative AI, and ML workloads across cloud platforms. You will bring deep experience across cloud security, AI security architecture, governance, compliance, platform controls, and monitoring to help clients design, assess, and implement secure AI capabilities at scale. You will be expected to contribute to solutioning and client delivery, and provide actionable recommendations across the AI lifecycle, including data ingestion, model development, validation, deployment, runtime monitoring, and retraining. Responsibilities as a Cloud AI Security Senior Consultant will include: Drive the design and implementation of AI security solutions within cloud environments aligned to client business objectives, enterprise architecture, regulatory expectations, and security requirements. Execute AI security assessments for cloud-hosted AI/ML and GenAI workloads, evaluating controls against frameworks and standards such as NIST CSF, CSA CCM, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001. Define and implement AI security controls across identity, access, network segmentation, encryption, key management, secrets management, logging, monitoring, workload protection, and secure configuration management. Support threat modeling and security architecture reviews for AI and GenAI solutions, including risks related to prompt injection, jailbreaks, insecure output handling, excessive agent permissions, sensitive data exposure, model misuse, and insecure tool or connector usage. Design and review secure AI architectures spanning model endpoints, APIs, retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, vector stores, plugins, agent frameworks, orchestration layers, and external tool integrations. Support secure deployment and configuration of cloud-native AI services including Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, and Google Vertex AI. Implement and review platform-specific controls such as private connectivity, encryption with customer-managed keys, tenant isolation, access restrictions, content safety controls, and service-native logging and monitoring capabilities. Drive DevSecOps, MLOps, and MLSecOps integration efforts by embedding policy validation, secrets handling, secure model promotion, compliance checks, and security testing into CI/CD and ML pipelines. Define and implement secure AI lifecycle controls across data ingestion, model training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, incident response, drift review, and retraining, including protections against data poisoning, model tampering, and supply-chain risk. Support AI governance and compliance activities including model inventory, risk classification, approval workflows, traceability, documentation standards, and control mapping aligned to NIST AI RMF and ISO 42001. Support clients in implementing responsible AI and model governance controls related to data protection, access control, model usage restrictions, prompt security, content filtering, and audit readiness. Execute AI security posture management efforts using cloud-native tooling, CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, and related controls to identify misconfiguration, data exposure, anomalous model activity, and policy violations. Support AI-specific monitoring and incident response by helping define detections, alerts, escalation paths, and remediation activities for suspicious prompt behavior, agent abuse, unauthorized model access, and sensitive data leakage. Conduct or support AI security testing activities including misuse-case testing, control validation, prompt attack testing, model guardrail validation, and red-team support for AI-enabled applications. Work directly with client stakeholders across security, cloud engineering, DevOps, data, ML engineering, privacy, risk, and architecture teams to translate requirements into implementable designs and remediation plans. The team Deloitte Cyber team helps complex organizations more confidently pursue their growth, innovation and performance agendas through proactive management of the associated cyber risks. Our professionals provide advisory and implementation services that integrate risk, regulatory, and technology skills to help clients transform their legacy programs into proactive cyber risk programs. Join the team developing the future state of cyber risk solutions. Learn more about Deloitte Advisory’s Cyber Risk Services practice. Required: 7+ years of experience in cloud security, cybersecurity consulting, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, or closely related disciplines. Demonstrated experience leading or owning workstreams in client-facing security engagements. Experience designing, assessing, or implementing security controls for cloud-hosted applications, platforms, or AI/ML environments. Strong hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform and working knowledge of the other leading platforms: AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud. Strong understanding of AI/ML and GenAI security concepts, including prompt injection, model misuse, data leakage, secure model access, agent security, and responsible AI fundamentals. Experience implementing cloud security controls across IAM, network security, encryption, key management, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and policy enforcement. Experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Bash, and PowerShell. Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, and secure engineering practices, including policy validation, secrets handling, and continuous compliance. Familiarity with cloud AI services such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Azure OpenAI, Mythos, Anthropic, and Vertex AI. Familiarity with AI governance and security frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical risks and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Preferred: Experience conducting AI security assessments, architecture reviews, control design, and remediation programs across AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud. Deep hands-on experience with identity and access management, including AWS IAM, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, and Google Cloud IAM. Experience designing governance and guardrails for cloud AI environments using services such as AWS Organizations, AWS Control Tower, Azure Policy, Security Command Center, and equivalent policy enforcement capabilities. Experience with cloud-native monitoring and security tooling such as AWS Security Hub, CloudTrail, AWS Config, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, and Google Security Command Center. Experience with CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, vulnerability management, container security, and posture management tools supporting AI workloads. Experience with prompt security, content safety, model guardrails, and AI runtime monitoring for generative AI applications. Exposure to AI red teaming, misuse-case testing, prompt attack validation, or adversarial testing of LLM-enabled applications. Experience securing containerized, API-driven, and agent-based AI applications. Knowledge of privacy, legal, and data governance considerations relevant to AI workloads, including data residency, retention, sensitive data handling, and auditability. Experience establishing AI governance processes such as AI inventory, model classification, approval gates, traceability, and documentation aligned to AI risk management practices. Relevant certifications such as: AWS Certified Security – Specialty Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate Google Cloud Certified – Professional Cloud Security Engineer Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate Google Cloud Certified – Professional Machine Learning Engineer AWS Certified AI Practitioner (AIF-C01) CISSP, CCSP, or comparable senior security certifications Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple client priorities independently. jobs.title: Software Dev Engineer II - Advertising
jobs.description: DESCRIPTION Job summary Love to work in Digital Advertising; one of the biggest revenue drivers for internet giants of the world and Amazon’s fastest-growing business with an explosive growth? Love to conceptualise and build applications from grounds-up? Like to develop real-time, distributed and large-scale applications? Like to interact with worldwide advertising customers to build systems that makes advertising and it's functions automated and frictionless? Then, Software Development team that builds Tier-1 Advertising Experience wants you! Amazon Advertising is looking for an entrepreneurial Software Development Engineer who shares Amazon Advertising’s passion for building and delivering a global, scaleable, extensible, and secure platform that singularly manages the Sourcing, Storage, Supply, Aggregation, Processing, Reporting of billions of clicks and impressions across multiple Advertising Billing, Budgeting, Financial and Payments services. You will build and ship software that directly impacts our end customer experience. You'll develop your team of highly motivated and talented multi-functional builders who can collaborate with product managers, technical specialists, and principals across the company. You will participate in defining the technology roadmap for our advertising billing strategy, and shape building technology tools that can disrupt the billing industry. You should be comfortable with a degree of ambiguity that’s higher than most projects and relish the idea of solving problems that, frankly, haven’t been solved at scale before - anywhere. You will encounter challenging, novel situations every day and given the size of this initiative, you’ll have the opportunity to work with multiple technical teams at Amazon in different locations. We’re looking for entrepreneurs who are passionate about innovating on behalf of customers, can demonstrate a high degree of ownership, and want to have fun while they make history and craft beautiful products. A successful candidate will have strong technical skills, and a history of growing their talent, and ability go hands-on with their technologies to identify the real problems you're solving. Written and verbal communication in this role are critical: you will author narratives that will be consumed by Amazonians at all levels, including executive leadership. Key Technical Challenges: Distributed and Scalable Architecture: Looking at advertising international expansion and business growth plans for next year, we expect this traffic to grow 10X in near future. Billing and Budgeting system should be easily scalable to manage exponential increase in traffic and extensible to support different business needs. High Availability: Downtime of Billing and Budgeting system can cause a huge loss in revenue and loss of business opportunity for our advertisers. High Availability architecture is to make sure that the system is configured to handle different loads and different failures with minimal or no downtime. Precision: Every click or impression needs to be counted, accounted, invoiced, and charged in near real-time, without any exception. It impacts both revenue and regulatory compliance. We need to build generic and extensible reconcilers for any anomaly detection and raising an appropriate alarm. Tags: SDE, SDE-II, Software Development Engineer Key job responsibilities Design, build and run distributed services for the Advertising Billing and Budgeting platform. The Alexa AI org in India is seeking a talented, self-directed Software Development Engineer to help us pioneering new machine learning tools and processes through an iterative research and development cycle. You will build scalable, self-serve applications for use across the Alexa, Customer & Technology organization. You will have significant influence on our overall strategy as you work with a small team of subject matter experts and engineers to define features, system architecture and best practices. You will work with the other engineers on the team to execute our technical vision and create a world class product. Creating reliable, scalable, and high performance products requires exceptional technical expertise, a sound understanding of the fundamentals of Computer Science, and practical experience building large-scale distributed systems. The ideal candidate will be a self-starter who can dive into a project with limited guidance and is able to design and implement inventive, simple solutions to complex problems. They will be passionate about new technologies and have a track record of delivering valuable software features and products in a fast-paced, highly iterative environment. A commitment to team work, hustle, and strong communication skills (to both business and technical partners) are absolute requirements. Key job responsibilities Collaborate with experienced cross-disciplinary Amazonians to conceive, design, and bring innovative products and services to market. Design and build innovative technologies in a large distributed computing environment and help lead fundamental changes in the industry. Create solutions to run predictions on distributed systems with exposure to innovative technologies at incredible scale and speed. Build distributed storage, index, and query systems that are scalable, fault-tolerant, low cost, and easy to manage/use. Design and code the right solutions starting with broadly defined problems. Work in an agile environment to deliver high-quality software. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience 3+ years of Video Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience Experience programming with at least one software programming language PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.description: Job Description About Persistent We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what’s next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 18 of the Fortune 50 companies, 7 of the 10 top US banks, 9 of the 10 technology companies, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem. Our disruptor’s mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We have delivered 26 sequential quarters of growth with $487.6M in Q2 FY27 revenue, up 7.8% Q-o-Q and 20.0% Y-o-Y. Our 29,500+ global team members, located in 21 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We received five awards at the ISG (Information Services Group) Provider Lens™ Awards 2026 and, for the second year in a row, were awarded the Growth Honor of the Year at the Everest Group Elevate 2026. About Position: We are looking for an experienced IP/MPLS Network Test & Validation Engineer to work on complex service-provider networking solutions. This role requires strong hands-on expertise in IP routing, MPLS, Segment Routing, Traffic Engineering, VPN services, and controller based network configuration, along with excellent testing and troubleshooting capabilities. Role: Manual QA Engineer - IP/MPLS Location: All Persistent Locations Experience: 6 to 14 Years Job Type: Full-Time Employment What You'll Do: Validate and test complex IP/MPLS networking solutions, covering end-to-end feature functionality, interoperability, scalability, and service behavior. Configure and validate Traffic Engineering technologies including RSVP, SR-TE, SRv6, and SR-ODN using CLI and controller-based platforms such as Cisco NSO/CNC. Configure, test, and troubleshoot VPN services including VPWS, EVPN, VPLS, and IPVPN, along with tunnel-to-service mapping. Validate routing and transport technologies including IS-IS, OSPF, BGP, IPv4, IPv6, BGP-LS, BGP-LU, PCE, and Inter-AS Options A/B/C. Design comprehensive Test Plans (TPs) that provide strong coverage of individual features as well as the overall networking solution and customer use cases. Execute functional, integration, regression, negative, and end-to-end testing for complex network features and services. Perform in-depth debugging and root-cause analysis of routing, signaling, service, controller, and configuration issues, driving problems independently through resolution. Work with Cisco testing and defect-management processes/tools, including TIMS, CDETS, and Jira. Where applicable, validate IP and optical network interworking involving NCS 2K/EPNM, NCS 1010/ONC, ZR optics, OCH/OTU/ODU/ETH services, transponders, and LLDP snooping. Expertise You'll Bring: Strong hands-on experience in IP/MPLS networking, preferably in service-provider, telecom, or large-scale routing environments. Deep understanding of RSVP-TE, Segment Routing (SR-TE), SRv6, SR-ODN, and related traffic-engineering concepts. Strong knowledge of Layer 2/Layer 3 VPN technologies such as VPWS, EVPN, VPLS, and IPVPN/L3VPN. Hands-on expertise with IS-IS, OSPF, BGP, IPv4, and IPv6. Good understanding of BGP-LS, PCE/controller-based path computation, BGP-LU, and Inter-AS Options A, B, and C. Experience configuring network services through device CLI and/or Cisco NSO/CNC controllers. Strong understanding of how tunnels are mapped to services, including the operational and traffic-engineering reasons for selecting different tunnel paths. Excellent network debugging and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to independently investigate complex protocol and service failures. Experience developing detailed test strategies and test plans with strong feature, integration, negative, and end-to-end coverage. Familiarity with Cisco TIMS, CDETS, and Jira or comparable test/defect-management environments. Good to have: Optical networking knowledge covering NCS 2K, EPNM, NCS 1010, ONC, OCH, OTU, ODU, ZR optics, optical line systems, transponders, and LLDP snooping. Ability to work independently, take ownership of execution, and drive testing and troubleshooting without continuous supervision. We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles. Our office is accessibility-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities. jobs.title: Staff GenAI Engineer - Evaluation & Trust
jobs.description: Staff GenAI Engineer - Evaluation & Trust JR-164651 Hybrid Bengaluru Technology Full time Who are we? Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet. A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future. Help us challenge assumptions, uncover bias, and remove barriers—because progress starts with fresh ideas. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work. Job Summary Designs, develops and deploys the evaluation and trust capabilities of Equinix's GenAI platform. Builds platform features that let teams evaluate their agents at scale: golden datasets, synthetic test data, scoring with LLM-as-judge, and monitoring of agent quality in production. Builds and tests the trust controls that agents run on, including agent identity, access, guardrails and data boundaries. Traces agent failures to their root cause and fixes them in the platform. Works in a team with senior engineers and with product, platform and security partners to turn defined problems into robust, secure, observable and performant solutions. Knowledge and Application Applies solid knowledge of software engineering practice and of LLM and agent concepts (prompting, retrieval, tool and function calling, orchestration, MCP). Understands evaluation methods (code-based checks, LLM-as-judge, human review, golden datasets, regression suites) and evaluation statistics (sampling, variance across runs, agreement between reviewers). Understands AI security risks such as prompt injection and data leakage, and identity concepts such as OAuth and per-user access. Follows established standards and suggests improvements. Complexity and Problem Solving Works on problems of defined scope where analysis requires evaluation of identifiable factors. Traces an agent failure to its cause (retrieval, tool call, prompt, model, data or infrastructure) using logs and traces, and follows it until it is fixed. Judges whether a metric reflects real quality. Escalates unusual or high-impact issues. Work is reviewed at defined checkpoints. Collaboration and Interaction Works with AI engineers, product managers, forward-deployed engineers, platform and security teams. Turns the needs of agent builders into platform features. Explains results, defects and risks to partners who are not familiar with the subject. Asks for guidance early and shares knowledge with the team. Responsibilities Evaluation platform (primary focus) Build platform features for evaluation: dataset creation and versioning, golden datasets, synthetic test data and reusable metric templates Build scoring for agents: code-based checks, LLM-as-judge, tool-call accuracy and grounding checks Build human-review features that compare judge scores against human reviewers, and recalibrate when agreement is low Run evaluations at scale: before release, on every change to a prompt, model or tool, and on agents in production Build evaluation playbooks so agent builders can evaluate their agents without specialist help Keep results traceable to the agent, model, prompt and dataset versions tested, with a record of who approved each release Trust and safety Build and test the platform's trust controls: agent identity, per-user access to connected systems, tool permissions, guardrails and data boundaries Run adversarial tests and red-teaming (prompt injection, out-of-scope requests, data-boundary tests), and turn findings into fixes and regression tests Work with security and governance teams to turn policy requirements into automated checks Root-cause analysis and quality Investigate agent failures and performance problems end to end, and follow them until the cause is fixed Build test and performance tooling: end-to-end agent tests, load and latency tests, and failure diagnostics Turn production failures and user feedback into regression tests, so the same defect does not return Quality and responsible practice Write tested, reviewed and documented code, and contribute to shared libraries and tooling Test and build to security, data-privacy and responsible-AI requirements Qualifications Required 3 - 6 years in AI/ML or software engineering (internships and applied research count) Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, data science, mathematics or a related field, or equivalent experience Proficiency in Python, with solid habits: version control, testing, code review. Experience building backend services or platform features Hands-on experience building, not only using, evaluations or test systems for ML or LLM applications, including reading failures from logs or traces Working knowledge of LLM applications (prompting, retrieval, agents) Working knowledge of evaluation statistics (sampling, confidence intervals, variance across runs) and of measuring agreement between reviewers Ability to write SQL and analyze results Clear written and verbal communication Nice to have Experience building evaluation or observability features used by many teams or at scale Experience with LLM evaluation and observability tools, and tracing standards such as OpenTelemetry Experience with red-teaming or adversarial testing of LLM systems Experience with identity and access (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, delegated access) Experience with performance, load or test engineering Experience with agent frameworks, MCP or A2A Experience with Google Cloud (Vertex AI, GKE) and Kubernetes Familiarity with AI risk frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001) MS in a related field What success looks like Platform features ship on schedule, with tests and documentation Teams can evaluate their agents on the platform without specialist help Every agent release carries an evaluation record with criteria, results, open defects and approver Judge scores agree with human reviewers, and teams use them to make release decisions Trust controls are enforced by the platform and covered by automated tests Defects found in evaluation become regression tests, and the same defect does not return The engineer takes on larger, less defined work each quarter with decreasing guidance Equinix is committed to ensuring that our employment process is open to all individuals, including those with a disability. If you are a qualified candidate and need assistance or an accommodation, please let us know by completing form. jobs.title: Principal Engineer – GenAI in SDLC (Java & Agentic AI)
jobs.description: About this role: Wells Fargo is seeking a Principal Engineer to lead the transformation of software engineering through AI-Augmented and Agentic Software Development. This role will define and drive the enterprise strategy, architecture, and implementation of Generative AI, AI Agents, AI Teammates, and Intelligent Automation across the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC). As a key technical leader, you will establish enterprise-wide engineering patterns that enable developers to leverage AI safely, effectively, and at scale. You will partner across Developer Platforms, Internal Developer Portal (IDP), CI/CD, Knowledge Foundation, and Agentic Engineering initiatives to accelerate software delivery, improve developer productivity, enhance engineering quality, and advance Wells Fargo's AI-first engineering transformation. In this role, you will: Act as the enterprise technical authority for AI-Augmented SDLC, Agentic Engineering, and AI-Native Software Development practices. Define the technical vision, architecture, and roadmap for integrating Generative AI capabilities across the software development lifecycle. Lead enterprise-wide adoption of AI Agents, AI Teammates, Developer Assistants, and Intelligent Automation platforms. Establish reusable frameworks, standards, governance models, and reference architectures for AI-enabled engineering solutions. Design and implement autonomous and semi-autonomous AI Agents supporting software planning, development, testing, code review, vulnerability remediation, release automation, documentation generation, and knowledge discovery. Define Multi-Agent and Human-in-the-Loop architectures that balance automation, engineering productivity, and operational risk management. Build enterprise integrations leveraging Model Context Protocol (MCP), Knowledge Foundation platforms, retrieval systems, and developer productivity tooling. Drive the integration of Generative AI capabilities across Internal Developer Portals, CI/CD platforms, IDEs, developer workflows, and release pipelines. Establish self-service AI engineering capabilities that enable development teams to accelerate software delivery while improving quality and consistency. Develop enterprise observability, telemetry, adoption, and value realization strategies for AI-enabled engineering solutions. Partner with Security, Risk, Compliance, Architecture, and Technology leadership teams to establish responsible AI governance and controls. Influence engineering strategy across multiple technology organizations and serve as a trusted advisor to senior technology executives. Mentor Principal Engineers, Distinguished Engineers, Architects, and Engineering leaders while establishing enterprise standards for AI-Native Software Engineering. Required Qualifications: 7+ years of Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education Strong Software Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education. 5+ years of experience architecting and building enterprise-scale distributed systems and cloud-native platforms. Extensive experience designing and scaling developer platforms, software engineering ecosystems, and enterprise engineering capabilities. Demonstrated success defining technology strategy and influencing architecture decisions across large, complex organizations. Strong expertise in Java-based engineering, microservices architecture, cloud-native application development, and modern software engineering practices. Experience implementing enterprise DevOps, CI/CD, platform engineering, and developer productivity solutions. Experience evaluating, implementing, or scaling AI-enabled engineering capabilities, developer assistants, or intelligent automation platforms. Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and enterprise architecture communication skills. Desired Qualifications: Experience leading enterprise AI transformation, AI-Augmented SDLC, or Agentic Engineering initiatives. Deep understanding of Generative AI platforms, Large Language Models (LLMs), and AI application architectures. Experience with AI coding platforms including GitHub Copilot Enterprise, Devin AI, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar AI-assisted development tools. Expertise with Agentic AI frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, or OpenAI Agents Framework. Experience building Multi-Agent Systems, Human-in-the-Loop architectures, AI Teammates, and autonomous workflow orchestration solutions. Knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP), enterprise tool integration, context engineering, and developer workflow automation. Experience implementing Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), enterprise search, semantic search, and knowledge foundation capabilities. Experience with vector databases and AI retrieval platforms including Azure AI Search, Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, or similar technologies. Deep understanding of AI governance, AI observability, model evaluation, prompt engineering, agent evaluation, and responsible AI practices. Financial services or highly regulated industry experience preferred. Strong thought leadership demonstrated through enterprise transformation initiatives, technical publications, conference presentations, or industry contributions. Job Expectations: Lead the enterprise roadmap and technical strategy for AI-Augmented SDLC and Agentic Engineering capabilities. Drive adoption and measurable business outcomes from AI-enabled engineering solutions across multiple technology organizations and business lines. Establish enterprise engineering standards, governance patterns, and operating models for AI-Native Software Development. Influence the future direction of Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, and Intelligent Software Delivery capabilities. Partner closely with senior technology leadership, risk, compliance, and security organizations to ensure responsible and scalable implementation of AI capabilities. Mentor and develop senior technical talent across Engineering, Architecture, and Platform organizations. Ability to communicate complex technical concepts effectively to executive leadership, technical teams, and cross-functional stakeholders. jobs.description: Hyderabad, Telangana, India Category Engineering Hire Type Employee Job ID 19863 Date posted 11/21/2026 Verification Applications Engineer Customer Success Engineer, Verification Technical Applications Engineer, EDA Field Applications Engineer, Design and Verification We Are Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. You Are You have spent time in verification environments where the difference between a clean tape-out and a schedule slip often comes down to how fast someone can debug a simulation failure at 2am. You know your way around SystemVerilog testbenches, and you have stared at waveforms long enough to spot the signal toggle that should not be there. You are the person teammates come to when something breaks in a way that does not make sense yet. Working directly with customers energizes you. You do not just want to hand over a solution, you want to understand the problem first, ask the right questions, and propose something that actually fits their flow. You are comfortable on a call with a design team in another timezone, walking through a debug scenario or explaining why a coverage hole matters. You learn fast. New methodologies, new tools, new customer designs, you adapt without needing six months of ramp time. You understand that successful chip development extends beyond simulation and debug. Exposure to RTL quality and design sign-off methodologies such as Lint, Clock Domain Crossing (CDC), and Reset Domain Crossing (RDC) analysis is valuable, and you appreciate how these technologies complement verification flows in achieving tape-out readiness. You are also curious about emerging AI technologies and how AI-assisted and agentic solutions can improve engineering productivity and customer success. At Synopsys, you will work with verification engineers who are solving real problems on real chips, and the solutions you help deliver will directly affect whether those chips make it to production on time. What You'll Be Doing Support customers using Synopsys verification and design sign-off tools such as VCS, Verdi, and VC SpyGlass, diagnosing simulation issues, debug challenges, coverage gaps, RTL quality concerns, and Lint/CDC/RDC issues in their design flows Work with customers on RTL sign-off methodologies including Lint, Clock Domain Crossing (CDC), and Reset Domain Crossing (RDC) analysis, helping identify root causes and improve design quality before tape-out Analyze customer testbenches and design environments to identify root causes of verification failures and propose technical solutions that fit their methodology Work on verification challenges involving SystemVerilog, UVM, low power verification, and coverage-driven workflows across diverse customer projects Collaborate with Synopsys R&D teams to escalate complex issues, contribute to product improvements, and bring customer feedback into the development cycle Build scripts in Tcl, Python, or Perl to automate workflows, replicate customer issues, demonstrate best practices, and improve engineering productivity through automation and AI-assisted workflows Guide customers through tape-out cycles, helping them stay on schedule by resolving verification bottlenecks quickly and effectively Travel occasionally to customer sites for onsite technical engagements, training, or critical project support The Impact You Will Have You will directly reduce time to tape-out for customers by solving verification issues that would otherwise stall their schedules for days or weeks Your technical guidance will help design teams adopt better debug and coverage practices, improving the quality and efficiency of their verification environments You will influence product roadmaps by surfacing real customer pain points to R&D, ensuring future releases address the problems that matter most The solutions you deliver will enable customers to verify complex, multi-million gate designs with confidence, reducing costly respins You will help customers adopt advanced verification methodologies and low power techniques that directly impact chip performance and power efficiency You will help customers improve RTL quality and sign-off readiness by addressing lint, CDC, and RDC challenges early in the design cycle, reducing silicon risk and improving tape-out confidence You will help customers adopt innovative automation and AI-assisted engineering workflows that improve productivity and accelerate problem resolution Your work will strengthen customer relationships and trust in Synopsys tools, contributing to long-term partnerships and renewals You will build a knowledge base of customer use cases and solutions that benefits the broader applications engineering team across global locations What You'll Need Bachelor's degree in Electronics Engineering or related field with 2+ years of experience in verification, digital design, or design sign-off, or a Master's degree in Electronics Strong fundamentals in digital design and hands-on experience with Verilog or VHDL Working knowledge of SystemVerilog and dynamic simulation concepts, including testbench development and debug Proficiency in UNIX or Linux environments and scripting with Tcl, Python, or Perl Excellent written and verbal communication skills, you will be interfacing directly with customers to understand their challenges and explain technical solutions clearly Experience or exposure to RTL sign-off methodologies including Lint, Clock Domain Crossing (CDC), and Reset Domain Crossing (RDC) analysis is highly desirable Experience with Synopsys tools such as VCS, Verdi, or VC SpyGlass is a strong plus Exposure to UVM, coverage-driven verification, low power verification flows, or RTL sign-off methodologies is advantageous Awareness of Generative AI technologies, AI-powered engineering workflows, or agentic solutions is an added advantage Who You Are You can take a vague customer complaint like "simulation is slow" or "design checking reports thousands of CDC violations" and turn it into a specific diagnosis with a proposed fix You are comfortable working across timezones and cultures, partnering with engineers in different locations without losing clarity or momentum You stay organized when juggling multiple customer cases at once, and you know which issue needs attention first based on impact and urgency You do not wait for perfect information to start solving a problem, you dig in, replicate the issue, and work iteratively toward a solution You are comfortable learning and ing new technologies, including AI-assisted engineering tools and agentic solutions, to improve efficiency and solve customer challenges You are willing to travel occasionally for customer visits, training sessions, or critical project support when the situation calls for it You bring an innovative mindset to recurring problems, always looking for ways to automate, simplify, or improve the process for the next time The Team You'll Be Part Of You will join the Customer Success Group in Hyderabad, a team focused on building strong technical partnerships with customers and helping them solve high-value verification challenges. You will work closely with domain experts across global locations, including R&D, sales, and other applications engineers, in a collaborative environment where knowledge sharing and continuous learning are part of the culture. The team supports customers throughout their tape-out schedules, and your role will directly contribute to their success in verifying complex chip designs on time. jobs.title: Sr. Creative Technologist
jobs.description: At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. DESIGN@LILLY | CREATIVE TECHNOLOGIST Sr. Creative Technologist | 3-5 years Eli Lilly is a global healthcare leader that unites caring with discovery to create medicines that make life better for people around the world. We’re leveraging cutting-edge technologies and innovative platforms to develop next-generation therapeutic ecosystems, connected devices, data, and analytics to transform patient experiences and improve treatment outcomes. As a member of Design at Lilly within the Digital Office, you will be at the forefront of crafting intuitive, accessible, and impactful digital experiences. We work across every function of the organization, applying design thinking to solve complex challenges and create meaningful solutions for patients, healthcare professionals, and the people who care for them. Our team combines user insight with design expertise to ensure the human element is at the core of everything we build. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Creative Technologist at Lilly, you will combine design thinking and technical craft to translate ideas and user insights into tangible, functional prototypes, and tooling that will enable new ways of working. You'll work at the intersection of design intent and technical feasibility building high-fidelity experiences that validate design decisions, communicate product direction, and accelerate development, and establish tooling that expand team capabilities. This role requires fluency in front-end technologies, proficiency with modern prototyping tools, deep empathy for human needs, the desire and ability to stay abreast of new and emerging technologies with an eye toward application to enhance the creative process, and the ability to operate in ambiguous, cross-functional environments where design and technology must work together seamlessly. The goal is not simply to code. The goal is to bridge the gap between design vision and technical reality. Path/Level: R3 CORE RESPONSIBILITIES Great design at Lilly starts here. These are the responsibilities we expect from Creative Technologists across levels: Multiply the capabilities of designers and partners by building the tools, systems, and workflows that change how design gets produced, validated, and shipped. Combine design and code craft with deep empathy for human needs to prototype solutions that meet the needs of patients, healthcare professionals, researchers, and Lilly employees. Identify and outline edge cases, contingencies, and resolution paths across user flows and scenarios, helping determine when existing patterns should deploy versus when novel solutions are required. Actively participate in concept development and design ideation to influence direction, offer alternative solutions, and raise concerns early regarding feasibility and implementation. Lead exploration of new and emerging technologies, frameworks, and tools that can enhance design workflows, concept creation, prototyping, design validation, or development efficiency. Evangelize high-fidelity prototyping as an intrinsic part of the design process throughout the organization, primarily through delivery of compelling functional exemplars. Collaborate across disciplines while maintaining technical quality, design integrity, and user-centered judgment. Contribute to a culture of technical excellence through peer review, documentation, shared learning, and candid feedback. Raise the AI fluency of the design organization by guiding designers and non-technical partners by translating new capabilities into adoptable practices. Plan and deliver complex prototypes or tools with minimal oversight, demonstrating proficiency with frameworks, platforms, and design systems to select the right technology for each challenge. Evaluate feasibility, preserve design intent under constraints, generate documentation both designers and engineers trust, and raise concerns when requirements are unclear or technically risky. Mentor less experienced technologists and contribute meaningfully to team standards and shared technical practices. Build AI-assisted tooling for the team to move from consuming AI to producing capability with AI. WHAT YOU WILL BRING 3+ years of hands-on experience as a design technologist, creative coder, or front-end engineer. A degree in Design, Computer Science, Interactive Media, or related field. Equivalent practical experience is also acceptable. Hands-on experience with AI tools and platforms including generative AI, LLM APIs, and AI-assisted design or coding tools along with a clear perspective on where they add value and where they fall short. Ability to assess, adopt, and operationalize emerging technologies for a design team by translating complex capabilities into accessible tools and workflows Experience building internal tooling, automations, or integrations that improve team workflows through scripting, API integrations, Figma plugins, or custom applications. Hands-on experience with front-end frameworks (e.g., React, Vue, Svelte) and animation tools to demonstrate design intent through high-fidelity prototypes.Fluency with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with deep familiarity with modern technologies such as Flexbox, CSS Grid, CSS Animations, and JavaScript frameworks. Extensive experience translating design intent into real user experiences in both web and native mobile app environments. Familiarity with modern design and prototyping tools such as Figma, Claude Design, Paper, and similar platforms. Experience using or developing plugins and tools for Figma, or similar design environments. Ability to quickly turn concepts into robust prototypes that clearly communicate design intent with passion for getting details right. Familiarity with product development lifecycles and how prototyping fits into design validation and development acceleration. Ability to collaborate and build strong relationships with peers, designers, product managers, engineers, and business partners. A pragmatic mindset that balances design fidelity with technical feasibility, timeline, and business context. Lilly is dedicated to helping individuals with disabilities to actively engage in the workforce, ensuring equal opportunities when vying for positions. If you require accommodation to submit a resume for a position at Lilly, please complete the accommodation request form (https://careers.lilly.com/us/en/workplace-accommodation) for further assistance. Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response. Lilly does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. #WeAreLilly

jobs.description: About the Team Data License is Bloomberg's enterprise data delivery platform, powering financial institutions worldwide with reference, pricing, regulatory, and alternative data — covering over 50 million securities across portfolio accounting, risk, compliance, and trading use cases. We build the data ingestion pipelines, embeddings infrastructure, AI agents, and MCP tool servers that give engineers and LLMs structured, query able access to operational data. Our systems power incident triage, semantic search over tickets and documentation, pipeline health analytics, and self-service data onboarding for partner teams across Data License. We are expanding our engineering presence into Pune and the broader APAC region — a greenfield initiative where engineers will collaborate closely with colleagues in Dublin, London, and New York, helping shape the culture and technical direction of this hub from day one. What's the role? You'll join a team at the intersection of data infrastructure, reliability engineering, and applied AI — building systems that make Bloomberg's data delivery more reliable, intelligent, and scalable. Reliability Engineering: GenAI-powered tooling for incident triage, root-cause analysis, and blast radius assessment — exposing live pipeline data to LLM agents via MCP tool servers. Data Analytics & AI: Ingestion pipelines into Apache Iceberg, semantic search over operational data using vector databases and embedding models, and automated KPI tracking to surface platform health and anomalies. We'll trust you to: Build GenAI tools and AI agents — RAG pipelines, contextual embedding systems, and MCP tool servers that give LLM agents structured access to live pipeline data Build and maintain data ingestion pipelines into Apache Iceberg, orchestrated via Apache Airflow Develop semantic search capabilities using vector databases and hosted embedding models Build self-service ingestion APIs enabling partner teams to onboard to the platform without managing Iceberg or storage infrastructure Design microservices and backend APIs — with opportunities to contribute to React/TypeScript interfaces embedded in production tools Instrument systems with OpenTelemetry and contribute to anomaly detection capabilities on the near-term roadmap Technologies Languages & Frameworks: Python (3.11 / 3.12 / 3.13), TypeScript, FastAPI, React Data & Orchestration: Apache Iceberg, Apache Airflow, PyArrow, PyIceberg, Spark, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Parquet Databases: PostgreSQL, vector databases, Redis, Solr, distributed SQL Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes, NGINX, OpenTelemetry Cloud: GCP, AWS (S3, Redshift), Snowflake, Databricks AI & ML: RAG frameworks, embedding models, contextual chunking, semantic search, LLM integration Agent Frameworks: MCP (Model Context Protocol), Agent-to-Agent (A2A) You'll need to have: 6+ Software engineering experience in production environments Proficiency in Python or a similar language Familiarity with relational databases and SQL Interest or experience in data engineering — pipelines, batch processing, or data lake technologies Understanding of distributed systems and service architecture Interest in AI/ML — particularly LLMs, RAG, or embedding-based search We'd love to see: Experience with Apache Iceberg, PyArrow, or data lake engineering Familiarity with Apache Airflow or workflow orchestration Experience with vector databases, embedding models, or semantic search Background in anomaly detection or data quality frameworks Exposure to MCP, A2A, or agent communication protocols Experience with observability tooling — tracing, metrics, structured logging Curiosity about financial data and reliability
