jobs.title: Software Development Engineer , PaySec, StoreSec
jobs.description: DESCRIPTION Come build the future with us! In Payments Security (PaySec), we protect the foundational systems and products that allow Amazon to accept payments for all goods, content, and services that people buy at Amazon and around the world. International Emerging Stores Payments (IESP) brings Amazon's payments products to customers in some of the fastest-growing markets in the world, across the Middle East and North Africa (MENA), Asia Pacific (APAC) including India, and South America. These markets run on real-time payment rails such as UPI, on local wallets, cards, bill payments, and lending products, and on regulatory regimes that differ from one country to the next. Every one of those transactions depends on customer trust, and IESP Payments Security exists to earn and keep it. Payments Security owns full-stack Product Security for Payments across Amazon and its business units. We are part of Amazon's broader Stores Security organization, responsible for protecting Amazon's global information assets. We partner with Payments builder teams to make applications and infrastructure secure-by-design from concept to launch and into continuous operations, and we build the mechanisms, guardrails, and automation that let thousands of engineers do the right thing by default. As a software engineer on IESP Payments Security, you will build the software that makes security automatic for Amazon's payments businesses in MENA, APAC including India, and South America. Imagine writing the code that stops a vulnerability before it is merged, or an AI agent that scans hundreds of production applications and finds payment data stored where it should not be. You will work on three kinds of problems. First, controls-as-code: security rules and guardrails that run on every code change, including code written with AI assistance. Second, detection agents: AI-assisted services that find sensitive data, vulnerable patterns, and risky configurations across production. Third, onboarding acquired stacks: tooling that brings newly acquired businesses onto Amazon's standard engineering and security platforms. You will work side by side with security engineers, and your work will show up directly in fewer vulnerabilities and less time builders spend fixing them. You will own features and components end to end, from design through operation, and help mentor newer engineers. Key job responsibilities Design, build, test, deploy, and operate secure, highly available services that handle sensitive payments data. Build controls-as-code and code-creation security rules that catch common vulnerability patterns before code is merged. Build AI-assisted detection agents that find sensitive payment data and vulnerable code patterns across production applications, with high precision. Build tooling that onboards acquired businesses' code, cloud accounts, and pipelines onto Amazon's standard security tooling. Build automated remediation that proposes or writes the fix for a finding, not just flags it, so builders spend minutes instead of days. Meet directly with security engineers and service teams to understand their requirements, and design solutions that make them more productive. Estimate engineering effort, plan implementation, and roll out changes that meet requirements for performance, scalability, and reliability. Work with security engineers to turn threat models and findings into automated mechanisms. Contribute to operational excellence through code reviews, testing, monitoring, and on-call. Mentor other engineers and interns on the team. A day in the life You will spend most of your time building: designing services, writing and reviewing code, and shipping. You will pair with security engineers who bring a threat model or a class of findings, and together you will decide what can be automated and how to measure that it works. You will meet the service teams who use our tools, hear where security slows them down, and fix it. The team runs regular architecture reviews and knowledge shares, and you will learn security from people who do it every day. About the team IESP Payments Security is a single-threaded Business Security Team for all of International Emerging Stores Payments. We are security engineers, technical program managers, and software engineers working as one team. We own security for regulated payments and lending businesses, for acquired companies joining Amazon, and for new markets as they launch. We believe security scales through mechanisms and automation, not headcount. As AI writes more of the code our builders ship, we move security into the moment code is created and replace episodic reviews with continuous assurance. We invest in each other's growth as much as we invest in protecting our customers. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience Experience programming with at least one software programming language 3+ years of Video Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent, or 3+ years of computer science fundamentals experience (object-oriented design, data structures, algorithm design, problem solving, and complexity analysis). PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Master's degree in computer science or equivalent 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language 4+ years of leading development of applications backed by AWS services or using other cloud based technologies and services experience Experience with any combination of the following: application security frameworks, identity and access controls, incident response, mobile security, cloud computing and security, AI security, threat intelligence, and penetration testing Knowledge of customer experience, listening to customers' voice and work backwards to improve business process and operations Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. Implement and evolve BPMN/DMN workflows using Flowable for complex multi-step approval and validation processes. Write and maintain database migrations (Liquibase) and optimize PostgreSQL queries across a database-per-service topology. Collaborate with business analysts, model validators, and risk stakeholders to translate regulatory requirements into software. Contribute to platform evolution — service extraction, legacy migration, and architectural improvements. Maintain high code quality through automated testing, SonarQube, and peer review. To be successful in this role, you should meet the following requirements: 15+ years of backend development in Java (17+, ideally 21). Strong experience with Spring Boot, Spring Data JPA, and Spring Cloud. Solid understanding of microservice architecture — service decomposition, API design, inter-service communication patterns. Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL — schema design, query optimization, migrations. Proficiency with Git (trunk-based development, branching strategies, code reviews) and CI/CD pipelines (build, test, deploy automation). Exposure to automated test frameworks such as REST Assured, Playwright, or similar — comfortable writing and maintaining unit, integration, and end-to-end test suites. Experience with Flowable, Camunda, or similar BPMN/DMN workflow engines.Familiarity with hexagonal architecture (ports & adapters) in practice. Exposure to Feign or declarative HTTP clients. Experience with Liquibase or Flyway for schema versioning. Experience with event-driven architecture (Pub/Sub, Kafka). Familiarity with Maven multi-module builds and shared library management. Background in financial services, risk management, or regulatory technology. Understanding of model risk management concepts (model validation, tiering, governance). Experience migrating or modernizing legacy platforms. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. You Are You have spent the last few years building verification environments that actually close coverage, not just pass tests. Protocols like PCIe, UCIe, or DDR are not abstract specs to you, they are state machines with edge cases you have debugged at the transaction level in Verdi. You write UVM code that other engineers can extend without breaking, and you know the difference between a scoreboard that checks transactions and one that catches the bugs that matter. You think in coverage models and assertions, not just directed tests. At Synopsys, you will work on high-speed interconnect IP that ships in real silicon, and the verification you own keeps bugs out of the lab. What You'll Be Doing Own verification planning and execution for UCIe, PCIe, or DDR IP blocks, translating protocol specs into test plans, checkers, and SystemVerilog Assertions. Build and extend UVM testbenches including agents, sequencers, scoreboards, factories, and coverage models that other engineers will use and maintain. Write constrained-random and directed tests in SystemVerilog, debug failing regressions, and close functional and code coverage using VCS and URG. Perform root-cause analysis on RTL bugs, protocol compliance failures, and testbench issues using Synopsys Verdi for waveform, transaction-level, and protocol debug. Contribute to regression infrastructure, coverage closure strategies, and first-silicon readiness activities. The Impact You Will Have Your verification catches silicon-impacting bugs before tape-out, saving months of respins and lab debug time. The UVM environments you build become reusable across product generations, accelerating time-to-market for future IP releases. Your coverage models and assertions close gaps that design reviews and code inspection miss, improving overall IP quality. The test plans you write become the blueprint for regression suites that run thousands of times across multiple projects. Solid UVM methodology experience building agents, sequencers, scoreboards, coverage models, and constrained-random stimulus in SystemVerilog. Proven debug skills using Synopsys Verdi for waveform analysis, transaction-level debug, and protocol-specific investigation. Experience with industry simulators like VCS, Xcelium, or Questa, and familiarity with regression and coverage tools such as URG. Direct experience verifying UCIe PHY, PCIe controllers, or DDR memory controllers is a strong plus, as is familiarity with VIP integration or formal verification. Who You Are You can look at a failing regression, open Verdi, and find the root cause without needing someone to point you to the right signal. You write UVM code that other engineers can read and extend six months later without asking you how it works. jobs.description: Company Description It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started. Join us to put AI to work for people. Job Description ServiceNow seeks a senior staff-level product security engineer to serve as a senior technical authority within the Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT). PSIRT is ServiceNow's awareness, response, and investigation capability for post-release vulnerabilities in ServiceNow-developed products and service offerings. This role is for a recognized expert who can operate independently and as part of a team on the most significant security issues facing the platform—vulnerabilities that require evaluating intangibles. You will lead deep-dive investigations, coordinate resolution across engineering, product, and release teams, and demonstrate calm, decisive leadership during significant security events. This is a role for someone who already understands product development cycles and the engineering and product relationships that drive them—and will use that fluency to lead fixes to completion under incident pressure. You will help shape how ServiceNow responds to product security vulnerabilities at scale and the technical rigor of the entire response capability. The coverage provided by this role is: Sunday: 10:00 - 18:00 UTC. /15:30–23:30 IST Monday: 08:00 - 16:00 UTC/13:30–21:30 IST Tuesday: 08:00 - 16:00 UTC/13:30–21:30 IST Wednesday: 08:00 - 16:00 UTC/13:30–21:30 IST Thursday: 08:00 - 16:00 UTC/13:30–21:30 IST Due to the nature of incident response and needs of the business, coverage may change. Additional coverage outside of stated hours may be required in response to significant incidents. Model Adaptation & Continuous Learning Build pipelines for data collection, fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and model adaptation. Support training, evaluation, and serving of domain-specific AI models. Drive continuous improvement using production feedback and evaluation insights. Collaboration & Leadership Partner with product and engineering teams to develop reusable platform capabilities. Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership across AI platform initiatives. Promote AI-first engineering practices and developer self-service capabilities. Requirements AI Platform & LLM Infrastructure Experience building and operating: Model gateways (LiteLLM or equivalent) AI model serving platforms (vLLM, Triton, managed endpoints) Vector databases and retrieval systems RAG architectures Agentic AI Systems Hands-on experience with frameworks such as: LangGraph OpenAI Agent SDK Semantic Kernel CrewAI Strong understanding of: Tool calling Multi-agent systems Model Context Protocol (MCP) Agent orchestration patterns AI Evaluation Engineering Experience implementing: Evaluation harnesses Golden datasets Regression testing frameworks CI/CD quality gates LLM-as-a-Judge methodologies Model Fine-Tuning & Post-Training Experience with one or more of the following: Fine-tuning LLMs Reinforcement learning pipelines Synthetic data generation Preference optimization Domain adaptation techniques AI-First Development Demonstrated use of AI coding assistants and AI-enabled software engineering practices. Experience leveraging AI tools to accelerate development and platform operations. Preferred Qualifications Experience with AI observability and guardrail frameworks such as: LangSmith Braintrust NeMo Guardrails OpenTelemetry for GenAI Experience in: RLHF/RLAIF Reward modeling Model distillation and optimization Small Language Models (SLMs) Expertise in multi-tenant SaaS platforms, metering, and usage-based billing. Prior experience in Banking, Insurance, Payments, FinTech, Cybersecurity, or other regulated industries. Benefits Competitive compensation and benefits package: Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses Comprehensive benefits package Career development and training opportunities Flexible work arrangements (remote and/or office-based) Dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally renowned group Private Health Insurance Pension Plan Paid Time Off Training & Development Note: Benefits differ based on employee level. jobs.description: Who We Are At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. You will be responsible for overseeing batch processing, console monitoring, incident management, and operational support across complex production systems. ensuring that we provide the highest level of service to our customers. What You Will Do Manage and monitor mainframe batch workloads using both ZEKE and CA7 scheduling tools. Execute MVS/JES2 commands for system and job control Support key operational activities including JCL troubleshooting, IPL activities, Disaster Recovery (DR) exercises, and production support. Provide L3 support for job abends and system issues. Perform spool management and subsystem start/stop activities. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure uninterrupted business operations during critical transition and steady-state phases. If you have a passion for technology and a desire to continually improve your skills – this is the position for you. You will work with a talented team of professionals and collaborate on exciting projects that are shaping the future of our industry. Your Future at Kyndryl As a Mainframe Batch & Console Operations Lead, you will collaborate with global delivery teams, infrastructure specialists, automation engineers, and technical leaders to support mission-critical mainframe environments. This role offers significant opportunities to expand your expertise in enterprise operations, workload automation, system resiliency, and service delivery. Who You Are You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others. Required Technical and Professional Expertise 10+ years of experience in Mainframe Operations, with expertise in batch processing, console monitoring, incident management, and production support within enterprise mainframe environments. Minimum 5 years of mandatory experience in both ZEKE and CA7 is required. Experience in monitoring and managing Batch job execution and recovery ,Console operations, Job queues and enqueue conditions, CPU utilization and workload performance, SLA-driven production schedules. Proficiency in performing JCL overrides, reruns, job restarts, and batch recovery activities. Hands-on experience performing z/OS IPL activities (manual and automated). Experience with HMC operations, including IPL and Stand-Alone Dump procedures. Experience monitoring SYSLOG, console buffers, connectivity issues, and contention situations. Ability to work in a 24x7 rotational support model and handle critical production incidents independently. Preferred Technical and Professional Experience Exposure to CICS, DB2, and related subsystem monitoring and operational support. Experience supporting Disaster Recovery (DR) exercises, business continuity testing, and recovery operations. Experience monitoring and supporting IBM TS7700 Virtual Tape Storage environments. Knowledge of SMF reporting, system performance analysis, and operational reporting. Knowledge of ITIL-based incident, problem, and change management processes. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. jobs.description: What success looks like in this role: Job Title: Senior Cybersecurity Auditor Location: India-Remote Who we are: Unisys is a global information technology company that builds high-performance, security-centric solutions for the most digitally demanding businesses and governments on Earth. Unisys’ offerings include security software and services; digital transformation and workplace services; industry applications and services; and innovative software operating environments for high-intensity enterprise computing. Unisys builds better outcomes securely for its clients across the Government, Financial Services and Commercial markets. For more information, visit www.unisys.com . Creativity: We look past routine ways of doing things. Client-Centricity: Our clients’ success is our success. Integrity: We act ethically and honestly. Position Summary: Unisys is looking for a seasoned Cybersecurity Auditor, based in India and part of the global CISO team, who will act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) and independently plan, execute and drive cybersecurity audits across the organisation’s security, infrastructure, application and cloud environments, with a strong emphasis on technical depth. The role partners with the CISO, GIS, Infrastructure (CIT) and Business Unit teams across the globe through the full audit lifecycle: scoping, planning, execution, reporting and remediation tracking. The role demands strong stakeholder and leadership engagement. The candidate will present audit results and risk exposure to senior management and the CISO, negotiate findings and remediation timelines, and handle challenging stakeholders across regions and cultures with credibility, objectivity and composure, while keeping the audit programme on schedule. The candidate will provide regular status updates on audits to senior management, highlighting key risks, challenges and the actions being taken to address them. Working relationship with Internal and External Teams Work with the CISO and GIS and CIT teams globally – Infrastructure, Applications, Security Architecture, GIS Leadership team, Security Operations team Work with BISOs of the four Business Units and Business Unit leadership across regions Work with other global CISO team members, and with Risk, Compliance and Legal teams as required External – Certifying agencies, vendors, client auditors, client account teams and external audit firms Key Responsibilities: Plan and Execute Cybersecurity Audits – 65% Independently own and drive end-to-end cybersecurity audits as the SME, from scoping to closure, with minimal supervision. Manage the internal security audit programme based on requirements from international standards such as ISO, NIST, NIST-CSF, NIS2, Cyber-Essentials Plus, PCI, SSAE 18 etc. using a risk-based audit approach. Prepare, review and maintain the annual audit calendar, audit plans, audit management documentation and audit lifecycle in line with risk priorities and business commitments across regions. Define audit scope, objectives, criteria and sampling approach in consultation with the CISO, GIS and CIT teams. Perform audits based on criteria defined in ISO 27001, ISO 9001, ISO 22301, ISO 20000, NIST, NIST-CSF, NIS2,, SSAE 18 SOC1/SOC2, SOX, Cyber-Essentials Plus, PCI-DSS etc., including audit planning, evidence gathering, field notes and documentation of findings. Perform technical audits for various security domains, for example Vulnerability and Patch Management, Identity and Access Management, Application Development, DevSecOps, Network and Infrastructure Security, Security Operations and Incident Response, Crisis Management and BC/DR. Perform cloud security audits across Azure, AWS and GCP environments, covering identity and access management and privileged entitlements, network segmentation and perimeter controls, data protection (encryption and key management), logging and monitoring, security configuration and posture, and the shared responsibility model. Audit cloud-native and modern platform controls, including container and Kubernetes security, CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code, and SaaS/PaaS security, against criteria such as CIS Benchmarks, CSA CCM and NIST. Use technical testing and data analysis (configuration reviews, scripts, CLI and query-based evidence collection, log analysis) to validate controls rather than relying only on documentation and interviews. Work with GIS teams to identify the scope of infrastructure and application services to be covered by technical audits. Evaluate control design and operating effectiveness, perform root cause analysis, and assess the risk rating and business impact of findings. Stakeholder Engagement, Reporting and Remediation – 20% Lead audit kick-off, execution, closing and status meetings with IT, infrastructure, security teams and business units, working across global time zones. Prepare clear, risk-focused audit reports and executive summaries and review them with stakeholders and leadership on a regular basis. Hold leadership-level conversations with the CISO and senior management on audit results, risk exposure and trends, and escalate unresolved or high-risk issues in a timely way. Manage difficult or resistant stakeholders across regions: negotiate and agree findings, remediation plans and timelines, and drive accountability for closure. Track remediation actions to closure, validate the evidence of fixes, and report on overdue items and repeat findings. Audit Programme Governance and Continuous Improvement – 15% Track audit metrics and KPIs, identify recurring themes, and recommend improvements to the control environment. Continuously improve audit methodology, templates and workpapers, and monitor changes in standards, regulations and the threat landscape that affect the audit plan. Include AI security in audit scope and work with AI governance to ensure AI security requirements are covered by audits. Mentor junior team members and share audit best practices with the global CISO team. You will be successful in this role if you have: Knowledge and Qualifications: Education and Experience Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Engineering in Computer Science or a related field. Overall experience of 12–15 years, with at least 6 years of technical experience working on infrastructure or application systems. Minimum of 8 years of relevant experience in cybersecurity and IT audits based on industry standards, including leading audits independently as a subject matter expert. Must have performed technical audits hands-on, including at experience in auditing cloud environments (Azure, AWS or GCP). Demonstrated experience in the full audit lifecycle (scoping, planning, fieldwork, reporting and remediation follow-up) and in risk-based audit methodologies. Experience working in a global organisation with stakeholders across regions, cultures and time zones. Technical Skills Strong technical depth in at least four of the following: Identity and Access Management, Vulnerability and Patch Management, Network and Infrastructure Security, Application Security and DevSecOps, Security Operations and Incident Response, BC/DR, Data Protection and Cryptography. Hands-on knowledge of cloud security architecture and controls on Azure, AWS or GCP, including IAM and privileged access, network security, encryption and key management, logging and monitoring, and security posture management; multi-cloud exposure is preferable. Working Knowledge of CSPM, EDR, IAM, Vulenerability Management tools like Wiz, Crowdstrike, MS Defender, MS Entra, Tenable, etc Working knowledge of containers and Kubernetes, CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code security, and operating system, database and network device hardening. Ability to independently assess technical evidence (configurations, logs, scan outputs, scripts) and to challenge technical teams credibly on control gaps. Working knowledge of ITGC and SSAE 18 SOC1/SOC2. Working knowledge of SOX, PCI-DSS, NIST 800-53 and CIS Benchmarks is preferable. Knowledge and experience in AI security and AI security audits. Working knowledge of GRC and compliance automation tools for Audits, Risks Management Certifications Must have CISA and CISSP certification (or equivalent senior-level security certification). Cloud security certification, for example CCSP, Azure Security Engineer (AZ-500), AWS Certified Security – Specialty or Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, is strongly preferred. ISO 27001 Lead Auditor is an added advantage. Other technical certifications such as CCSK, CISM, CRISC, GSNA, CEH or OSCP are a plus. Leadership and Interpersonal Skills Proven ability to engage the CISO and senior leadership, present audit results and risk, and handle conflict and pushback from challenging stakeholders while maintaining audit independence. Excellent oral, written and presentation skills including the ability to write concise executive-level reports. Excellent interpersonal and teamwork capabilities with strong negotiation, influencing and conflict-resolution skills. Ability to indirectly manage by influencing larger groups. Ability to work individually but also to collaborate in a virtual global team, with vendors and clients across time zones, including flexibility for early or late calls. Good change management and project management skills. Help contribute to the broader ML community through publications, conference submissions, and internal knowledge sharing. A day in the life As an Applied Science Manager on the Alexa Sensitive Content team, you'll lead a team of scientists and ML engineers building AI systems that keep Alexa safe and trustworthy for millions of users worldwide. within the Systems Solutions Group The Impact You Will Have Enable customers to achieve first-pass silicon success by catching design-for-test issues before tapeout, not during bring-up Reduce production test costs and time-to-market for SoCs powering high-performance computing, automotive, and aerospace systems Build reusable DFT methodologies and best practices that scale across multiple customer projects and design teams Improve test coverage and yield outcomes through architecture decisions that balance area, power, and testability constraints Grow the technical capability of the DFT team through hands-on mentorship and real-world problem solving on customer projects Strengthen Synopsys customer relationships by delivering test solutions that work in production, not just in simulation Influence the development of Synopsys EDA tools and IP by feeding real customer use cases and pain points back to product teams What You'll Need Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field +10 years of hands-on experience in SoC DFT, with proven expertise across scan and ATPG, memory BIST, logic BIST, and analog test Deep understanding of the full SoC design flow from microarchitecture definition through RTL design, verification, timing analysis, and physical implementation Experience leading DFT implementation on complex SoCs that have taped out and gone to production Strong working knowledge of Synopsys DFT tools such as TetraMAX, DFT Compiler, or BIST Architect is a plus Demonstrated ability to work with refine production test programs is a plus Who You Are You can walk into a design review, spot untestable logic in a block diagram, and explain the fix in a way that makes the designer want to jobs.title: Senior Risk Manager, AI Assurance & Inspections, FORGE
jobs.description: DESCRIPTION Amazon is seeking a Senior Risk Manager to join the Finance Operations Risk, Governance and Experience (FORGE) team within Finance Operations (FinOps). This is a strategic, high ownership risk leadership role that strengthens Amazon's risk and control environment across complex, global Finance Operations processes. You will operate at the intersection of risk management, internal audit, controllership, process transformation, technology, and business operations. You will assess processes end to end, identify emerging and material risks, evaluate control effectiveness, and partner with stakeholders to design and implement sustainable solutions. This role is built for someone who thrives in ambiguity. The risks are not always obvious, ownership often spans multiple organizations, and the right answer frequently requires connecting data, processes, systems, policies, and controls across the company. You will not just identify problems. You will architect solutions, influence stakeholders, and drive measurable risk reduction. Key job responsibilities Run end-to-end assessments that cover process design, policy, organization structure, systems, AI components, regulatory requirements, and internal controls. Evaluate whether controls are well designed and working, identify control gaps and policy exceptions, quantify their impact, and recommend proportionate mitigation. Assess risks from AI-enabled and agentic automations, including hallucination, model drift, prompt injection, data leakage, excessive agent permissions, bias, and loss of human oversight. Design and test AI-specific controls such as human-in-the-loop approval gates, output validation, least-privilege tool access, traceability, and model performance monitoring. Inspect AI solutions against Amazon security, privacy, and controllership requirements (such as security, privacy, SOX, ITGCs etc.,), and confirm that AI-driven steps have clear ownership, evidence, and auditability. Design, build, and maintain audit agents that continuously monitor process controls, test full transaction populations, and flag anomalies and control failures in near real time. Build and use AI capabilities across the audit lifecycle, and set validation and governance standards so that AI-generated findings are reliable, explainable, and defensible. Own cross-functional risk programs from problem definition through closure, defining success criteria and risk reduction metrics, including coverage and detection metrics for automated monitoring. Partner with Finance, Controllership, Technology, InfoSec, GFRC/SOX, and Internal Audit to drive remediation, support external audit requests, and influence leaders to adopt scalable, AI-enabled controls. A day in the life You will start your morning reviewing overnight alerts from the audit agents that monitor SOX and operational controls, separating true exceptions from noise and escalating confirmed control failures to process owners. Much of your day involves moving between deep analysis and hands-on building. You might lead a pre-launch risk review of a new agentic automation, checking its data access, tool permissions, and human approval points before it goes live. Then you might work with Technology partners to tune an audit agent or extend it to cover a new control. Later, you could walk through a complex process with business owners, using generative AI to speed up documentation and testing, or challenge a remediation plan that fixes the symptom but not the root cause. You will also carve out time to write a concise narrative for senior leadership on emerging AI risks and inspection results, and to look for the next control that can move from periodic sampling to continuous monitoring, so FinOps assurance scales as fast as the business automates. Experience with API and backend testing (RestAssured, Postman) and SQL, plus CI/CD experience with Harness and device clouds such as BrowserStack. Strong knowledge of SDLC/STLC, risk-based testing, test planning, and defect management using JIRA and TestRail. Experience debugging mobile issues with Logcat, Xcode logs, and network tools, and handling production issues and hotfixes. Clear communication and the ability to work with developers, product managers, and other teams, and to mentor less experienced engineers. Ownership, accountability, and a habit of improving how the team tests. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer III, PaySec, StoreSec
jobs.description: DESCRIPTION Come build the future with us! In Payments Security (PaySec), we protect the foundational systems and products that allow Amazon to accept payments for all goods, content, and services that people buy at Amazon and around the world. International Emerging Stores Payments (IESP) brings Amazon's payments products to customers in some of the fastest-growing markets in the world, across the Middle East and North Africa (MENA), Asia Pacific (APAC) including India, and South America. These markets run on real-time payment rails such as UPI, on local wallets, cards, bill payments, and lending products, and on regulatory regimes that differ from one country to the next. Every one of those transactions depends on customer trust, and IESP Payments Security exists to earn and keep it. Payments Security owns full-stack Product Security for Payments across Amazon and its business units. We are part of Amazon's broader Stores Security organization, responsible for protecting Amazon's global information assets. We partner with Payments builder teams to make applications and infrastructure secure-by-design from concept to launch and into continuous operations, and we build the mechanisms, guardrails, and automation that let thousands of engineers do the right thing by default. As a software engineer on IESP Payments Security, you will build the software that makes security automatic for Amazon's payments businesses in MENA, APAC including India, and South America. Imagine writing the code that stops a vulnerability before it is merged, or an AI agent that scans hundreds of production applications and finds payment data stored where it should not be. You will work on three kinds of problems. First, controls-as-code: security rules and guardrails that run on every code change, including code written with AI assistance. Second, detection agents: AI-assisted services that find sensitive data, vulnerable patterns, and risky configurations across production. Third, onboarding acquired stacks: tooling that brings newly acquired businesses onto Amazon's standard engineering and security platforms. You will work side by side with security engineers, and your work will show up directly in fewer vulnerabilities and less time builders spend fixing them. As a senior engineer, you will set the technical direction for the team's systems, lead designs that span multiple components and teams, and mentor other engineers. Key job responsibilities Lead the architecture and technical direction of the team's security tooling, and make trade-offs between precision, coverage, latency, and builder experience. Design, build, test, deploy, and operate secure, highly available services that handle sensitive payments data. Build controls-as-code and code-creation security rules that catch common vulnerability patterns before code is merged. Build AI-assisted detection agents that find sensitive payment data and vulnerable code patterns across production applications, with high precision. Build tooling that onboards acquired businesses' code, cloud accounts, and pipelines onto Amazon's standard security tooling. Build automated remediation that proposes or writes the fix for a finding, not just flags it, so builders spend minutes instead of days. Meet directly with security engineers and service teams to understand their requirements, and design solutions that make them more productive. Estimate engineering effort, plan implementation, and roll out changes that meet requirements for performance, scalability, and reliability. Work with security engineers to turn threat models and findings into automated mechanisms. Contribute to operational excellence through code reviews, testing, monitoring, and on-call. Lead designs that span multiple teams, including integration with Amazon's central security and developer platforms. Work with stakeholders to gather and document requirements, and take part in strategic planning for the team's roadmap. Grow and coach engineers on the team, and raise the bar in design and code reviews. A day in the life You will spend most of your time building: designing services, writing and reviewing code, and shipping. You will pair with security engineers who bring a threat model or a class of findings, and together you will decide what can be automated and how to measure that it works. You will meet the service teams who use our tools, hear where security slows them down, and fix it. The team runs regular architecture reviews and knowledge shares, and you will learn security from people who do it every day. About the team IESP Payments Security is a single-threaded Business Security Team for all of International Emerging Stores Payments. We are security engineers, technical program managers, and software engineers working as one team. We own security for regulated payments and lending businesses, for acquired companies joining Amazon, and for new markets as they launch. We believe security scales through mechanisms and automation, not headcount. As AI writes more of the code our builders ship, we move security into the moment code is created and replace episodic reviews with continuous assurance. We invest in each other's growth as much as we invest in protecting our customers. Experience building with large language models or AI agents in production. Proven programming ability in Java, C++, Python, Go, TypeScript, or related. You will build and drive robust verification plans, develop scalable reusable environments, and take direct accountability for quality and schedule on your assigned blocks. You will work closely with architecture, design, and software teams and are expected to contribute across traditional discipline boundaries. This role requires strong DV depth, solid protocol knowledge, hands-on coding strength, and growing ability to mentor junior engineers. AI-assisted workflows are part of everyday development here. Consistent execution against schedule and quality goals is expected. Business group You will join the Central Engineering Group (CEG), which drives critical technical solutions across Intel's products and services. The team focuses on developing and validating IPs, subsystems, and systems to enable Intel's leadership in semiconductor innovation. By ensuring the quality and functionality of designs, this group supports Intel's broader mission of delivering world-class technologies that enrich lives globally. Key Responsibilities: - Own verification planning and execution for assigned IP blocks and features at IP and subsystem level; drive test plans through coverage closure with direct accountability for quality. - Lead coherency verification of the coherent fabric and its agents. - Architect coherency-aware verification infrastructure including but not limited to: reference and memory models, coherency and data-integrity checkers, protocol monitors and scoreboards, and constrained-random stimulus targeting address collisions, false sharing, evictions, back-invalidations, and snoop races. - Collaborate closely with architecture, design, and software teams on spec reviews, feature clarification, bug triage, and closure; contribute outside strict DV boundaries when needed to unblock progress. - Analyze simulation failures, root-cause issues quickly, and drive fixes to closure with clear technical communication, own debug for your blocks end-to-end. - Define the functional coverage strategy, including cross coverage of coherency states, transitions, and race windows; drive coverage closure and present verification status, risk, and signoff readiness to program leadership. - Continuously improve verification automation, regression quality, and development efficiency. - Begin mentoring junior engineers on verification practices, debugging techniques, and code quality. Qualifications: Minimum Qualifications - Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field and 12+ years of relevant experience, or Master's degree with 10+ years of relevant experience, or PhD with 6+ years of relevant experience. - Demonstrated expertise in IP design verification and subsystem/SoC verification, utilizing simulation-based methodologies like UVM, ABV, Co-simulation, and Low Power verification, including end-to-end ownership of coherent IP or subsystem verification through coverage closure and signoff. - Proficiency in SystemVerilog/UVM, SW programming languages (C/C++), scripting languages (Python), and advanced EDA tools. - Proven experience verifying coherent and non-coherent interconnects, caches, and memory subsystems, including protocols such as AMBA (CHI, ACE, AXI), PCIe, UCIe, and CXL. - Extensive hands-on experience verifying cache-coherent designs. - Strong understanding of memory consistency and ordering models. Experience building coherency checkers, memory reference models, and data-integrity scoreboards. Preferred Qualifications - Experience working with formal verification and emulation teams to develop multimodal verification strategies. This includes formal proofs of coherence invariants and deadlock freedom, and emulation-based coherency stress with system-level workloads. - Strong organizational and communication skills, with a track record of delivering high-quality silicon on schedule. Join us in delivering innovative solutions that shape the future of technology. Apply today to become part of Intel's journey to redefine what's possible. Job Type: Experienced Hire Shift: Shift 1 (India) Primary Location: India, Bangalore Additional Locations: Posting Statement: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, religious creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military and veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender, gender expression, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by local law, regulation, or ordinance. Position of Trust N/A Work Model for this Role This role will be eligible for our hybrid work model which allows employees to split their time between working on-site at their assigned Intel site and off-site. * Job posting details (such as work model, location or time type) are subject to change. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: Intel is committed to Responsible Business Alliance (RBA) compliance and ethical hiring practices. We do not charge any fees during our hiring process. Candidates should never be required to pay recruitment fees, medical examination fees, or any other charges as a condition of employment. If you are asked to pay any fees during our hiring process, please report this immediately to your recruiter.

jobs.description: We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer This role is Hybrid, Hyderabad Office Senior Software Engineer Our Services Engineering team designs and builds technical solutions that solve real business challenges for our customers and help them get more value from their technology investments. The core work spans data and platform migration, system integrations and custom solution development: moving learning, talent and HR data from legacy or third-party systems, connecting systems across the customer's technology ecosystem, and building extensions, automations and tools tailored to each customer's needs. Building on this engineering foundation, our engagements are steadily extending into technical consulting and AI-enabled solutions as customers modernise how their people learn and work. Working with project teams, internal stakeholders and customer contacts, you build a clear understanding of data, systems and processes, then design, build and deliver technical solutions, migrations and integrations that run in production. As the practice evolves, you help shape how consulting and AI development become part of the value we deliver. As a Senior Software Engineer, you own migrations and customer engagements end to end, lead solution design decisions, and mentor other engineers on the team. How the Role Is Evolving Migration and implementation work gives you deep knowledge of the Cornerstone platform, customer data and the business processes behind them. That knowledge is exactly what customers need when they look for advice on improving their learning programmes and adopting AI. As customers adopt AI, our engagements are naturally moving from migrating and integrating data to advising on how to use it and building AI agents and automations around it. You grow with this shift at the pace our customers set, bringing your migration and platform expertise into broader consulting and AI work over time. Key Responsibilities Solution building, migration and implementation Plan and lead migrations of learning, talent and HR data from legacy or third-party systems onto the Cornerstone platform, covering scoping, data mapping, transformation, validation and cutover. Build repeatable migration tooling, scripts and ETL pipelines with SQL Server, Python and APIs, including reconciliation and audit checks that prove data arrived complete and correct. Apply working knowledge of learning platform concepts, such as learning objects, curricula, enrolments, transcripts, certifications and compliance training, to configure and extend the platform for customer needs. Manage migration risks, rollback plans and data quality issues with customers, and keep stakeholders informed through each phase. Integration and solution engineering Design, build and deploy integrations, extensions and supporting solutions on cloud platforms (Azure, AWS or GCP), using sound software design and solution architecture principles. Own solution architecture for customer engagements and review designs and code from other engineers. Build and maintain API integrations between the Cornerstone platform and customer systems, with attention to security, resilience and performance. Write efficient SQL Server queries and data logic, and lead performance tuning across application and database layers. AI development and consulting Building on your platform and data expertise, you help customers get more value from the Cornerstone platform through AI and automation. Design and deliver AI agents and copilots with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry and Python, using models such as Azure OpenAI (GPT) and Anthropic Claude. Define agent orchestration patterns: multi-agent hand-offs, tool and connector calls, grounding on enterprise data and human-in-the-loop checkpoints. Set the prompt engineering and evaluation approach that keeps agents accurate, consistent and safe, and choose the right model for each use case. Analyse customer business processes and identify where workflow automation and AI can remove manual effort or improve decisions. Advise customers on AI adoption: identify high-value use cases, assess data and process readiness, and shape a practical roadmap. Use AI to speed up and improve migration work, such as assisted data mapping, validation and documentation. Customer engagement Lead workshops with customers to gather and analyse migration and integration requirements, assess options and recommend the right approach. Act as the trusted technical advisor on engagements, managing stakeholder expectations and setting technical direction. Lead the investigation of complex customer issues across code, configuration, integrations and data, and drive them to resolution. Build rapid prototypes and proofs of concept that let customers see value early and shape the final solution. Mentor engineers, raise team standards, and feed field learning back into the product with product, support, consulting and customer success teams. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. jobs.title: Sr Serviceability Engineer - Life Cycle Manager (LCM)
jobs.description: About Nutanix Nutanix is building a world where infrastructure is invisible, and organizations can focus on the work that matters. Our hybrid multicloud platform helps customers run applications and manage data across private, public, and distributed clouds with simplicity and control. About the Team The Serviceability Engineer role is part of the Service Strategy & Enablement team at Nutanix, based in Bangalore. The team is made up of engineers who improve product serviceability, diagnostics, reliability, and the overall customer experience. Serving as a critical bridge between Support and Engineering, the team ensures that serviceability and usability are considered throughout the product lifecycle. By analyzing customer issues, monitoring field performance, validating releases, and incorporating customer feedback, the team drives improvements that make Nutanix products easier to deploy, upgrade, troubleshoot, and operate. You will report to the Manager, Service Strategy & Enablement. The team works in a hybrid environment that encourages collaboration, technical learning, and ownership. Your Role As a Senior Serviceability Engineer for Life Cycle Manager (LCM) , you will help make upgrades predictable, diagnosable, and safe across Nutanix software and hardware environments. You will work closely with Engineering, Product Management, Quality Assurance, Release Management, and Support to improve the serviceability of LCM from product definition through release and post-deployment adoption. LCM provides a cluster-aware framework for inventorying and updating software and firmware across a Nutanix environment. This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys understanding complex distributed systems, investigating customer-impacting failures, improving product diagnostics, and influencing teams to prevent recurring issues. The role involves performing duties requiring the application of professional expertise and the exercise of independent judgment/discretion, creativity, problem-solving, and decision-making in carrying out responsibilities, as applicable to the position. The specific responsibilities of the role may vary based on business needs and role requirements. Employees can refer to the applicable guidelines and career frameworks for additional information regarding role expectations and responsibilities. What You’ll Do Define and maintain serviceability requirements for LCM features, upgrade workflows, inventory, prechecks, compatibility validation, recovery, and diagnostics. Partner with Product Management and Engineering during product planning and development to ensure customer troubleshooting and operational needs are addressed early. Lead serviceability validation for LCM releases, including upgrade-path testing, upgrade and inventory workflows, precheck coverage, failure and recovery scenarios, interoperability, scale, and upgrade resiliency. Build and maintain representative test matrices across Nutanix software, hypervisors, server platforms, firmware components, cluster configurations, and supported deployment models. Review field issues, support cases, telemetry, and diagnostic data to identify trends, customer impact, recurring failure modes, and opportunities for product improvement. Investigate complex LCM failures by correlating application logs, task and workflow data, cluster state, system events, network behavior, and firmware or hardware-management responses. Work with Engineering to isolate root causes, reproduce issues, define corrective actions, and drive critical and deferred defects to closure. Review precheck and compatibility behavior to ensure that failures are actionable, accurately classified, and supported by clear remediation guidance. Evaluate upgrade rollback, recovery, and partial-failure scenarios and help define safe customer outcomes when an upgrade does not complete as expected. Collaborate with Quality Assurance and test automation teams to improve coverage for upgrade paths, dependency conflicts, hardware variants, network conditions, disconnected or restricted environments, and negative scenarios. Partner with Release Management and Documentation teams on release readiness, known issues, upgrade guidance, troubleshooting content, and Support enablement. Translate complex technical findings into clear requirements, defect reports, troubleshooting guides, executive summaries, and customer-safe recommendations. Represent the customer and Support perspective in design reviews, technical discussions, defect triage, and release decisions. Mentor engineers and promote serviceability practices that reduce customer effort, support case volume, time to resolution, and avoidable upgrade risk. What You’ll Bring 5+ years of experience in enterprise software, platform engineering, systems engineering, quality engineering, technical support, or serviceability. Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline; equivalent practical experience will also be considered. Experience working with complex infrastructure products, distributed systems, virtualization platforms, cloud infrastructure, or data-center operations. Strong experience troubleshooting customer-impacting issues across multiple layers of a technology stack and converting investigation findings into durable product improvements. Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence Engineering, Product Management, Quality, and Support without relying solely on formal authority. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with engineers, technical support teams, product leaders, and executive stakeholders. Technical Requirements Life Cycle Management and Upgrade Workflows Strong understanding of software and firmware lifecycle management, including inventory, repositories, package or bundle management, prechecks, dependencies, compatibility, upgrade sequencing, and post-upgrade validation. Experience testing or troubleshooting upgrade workflows involving failure handling, partial completion, recovery, retry, and resumption scenarios. Understanding of the operational risks associated with infrastructure upgrades and the importance of clear customer-facing diagnostics and remediation guidance. Virtualization and Nutanix Technologies Hands-on experience with one or more virtualization or hypervisor technologies, such as Nutanix AHV/KVM or VMware ESXi. Familiarity with enterprise infrastructure concepts such as clusters, controllers, virtual machines, storage, networking, high availability, and rolling maintenance. Experience with Nutanix technologies such as AOS, Prism, AHV, or LCM is a plus. Systems and Infrastructure Troubleshooting Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills, including process, service, filesystem, permissions, networking, and system-resource analysis. Ability to analyze logs, task histories, service states, configuration files, alerts, and diagnostic bundles to identify failure patterns. Familiarity with server hardware, firmware, boot processes, out-of-band management, and hardware-management interfaces such as Redfish or IPMI is preferred. Understanding of network fundamentals relevant to infrastructure upgrades, including DNS, routing, firewalls, proxies, TLS certificates, repositories, and connectivity validation. Automation, APIs, and Diagnostics Proficiency in Python, Shell, or another scripting language for test automation, log analysis, data extraction, and operational tooling. Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, authentication, error handling, and API-driven infrastructure workflows. Familiarity with observability, telemetry, log collection, diagnostic bundles, and metrics used to detect and troubleshoot product issues. Experience building or improving automated validation for upgrade, compatibility, failure-injection, or recovery scenarios. Serviceability and Quality Engineering Experience defining test strategies, test plans, acceptance criteria, release gates, and validation metrics for complex products. Proven ability to review and prioritize defects using customer impact, frequency, severity, reproducibility, and business risk. Ability to create high-quality defect reports with clear symptoms, impact, reproduction steps, evidence, suspected scope, and validation criteria. Experience using tools such as Jira, Confluence, or equivalent systems for defect tracking, documentation, and cross-functional execution. Experience using AI to automate workflows, build task-oriented agents, or analyze defects, bugs, and diagnostic data. Preferred Qualifications Experience with infrastructure lifecycle management, firmware orchestration, server vendors, or data-center management platforms. Experience supporting or validating air-gapped, dark-site, proxy-based, or restricted-network environments. Knowledge of upgrade compatibility models, dependency graphs, release branches, backward compatibility, and interoperability testing. Experience with CI/CD, test frameworks, continuous validation, or quality dashboards. Background in technical support, escalation engineering, site reliability engineering, or customer-facing engineering for enterprise infrastructure products. Experience creating technical documentation, knowledge base content, troubleshooting guides, or Support readiness material. Why This Role Matters Infrastructure upgrades are high-trust operations for customers. In this role, you will help ensure that LCM does more than execute an upgrade: it should explain what is happening, identify risks early, recover safely when conditions change, and give customers and Support a clear path to resolution. If you enjoy solving difficult infrastructure problems, working across product boundaries, and turning field experience into better engineering outcomes, this is an opportunity to have a direct impact on the reliability and usability of Nutanix products. Nutanix is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: Who Are We? Postman is the world’s leading API platform, used by more than 45 million+ developers and 500,000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration—enabling users to create better APIs, faster. The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore - where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman.com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman. P.S: We highly recommend reading The "API-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman. About the Team The Identity and Access Management team is responsible for building a secure, reliable, and seamless identity platform for all Postman users. This team owns the systems behind authentication, session management, access control, service accounts, invites, and other foundational identity capabilities that power the product. Postman’s identity layer is a critical part of the product experience. It sits on the path of every authenticated request and enables users, teams, and systems to access Postman securely and collaborate effectively. The team works on a mix of core platform improvements, new product capabilities, and reliability/security investments. What You’ll Do Build and maintain backend systems that power Postman’s identity and authentication platform. Work with Product, Design, and Engineering teams to scope, implement, test, and launch new features and platform improvements. Contribute to the design and development of scalable, reliable services and APIs. Improve system quality by writing tests, fixing bugs, and strengthening observability and monitoring. Participate in production support, debugging, incident investigation, and follow-through on fixes. Work on performance, scalability, and reliability improvements for the services owned by the team. Take ownership of well-defined projects and components, and drive them with support from senior engineers and your manager. Contribute to code reviews and team discussions, and adopt strong software engineering practices. Collaborate with other engineers to break down work, resolve ambiguity, and deliver iteratively. About You You have 2+ years of experience building backend or distributed systems in production environments. You have a solid foundation in software engineering fundamentals such as data structures, algorithms, networking, and system design basics. You are comfortable writing clean, testable, maintainable code. You have experience working with backend services, APIs, and databases. You are able to work through ambiguity with guidance and ask the right questions to move work forward. You care about quality, reliability, and learning how systems behave in production. You collaborate well with engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders. You have good written and verbal communication skills. You are curious, eager to learn, and motivated to grow in a platform engineering environment. Technical Experience We Value Experience with backend technologies such as Node.js, Java, Python, Go, or Ruby Familiarity with distributed systems and cloud infrastructure Experience building or maintaining microservices and APIs Familiarity with databases, caching, queues, or event-driven systems Exposure to testing, monitoring, debugging, and production support Familiarity with authentication, authorization, identity, RBAC, access control, or security-sensitive systems is a plus, but not required What Else? In addition to Postman's pay-on-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team-building events will keep you connected, while our donation-matching program can support the causes you care about. We’re building a long-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves. At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year. We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in-person that cannot be replicated via zoom. Our Values At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. We are dedicated to delivering the best products we can. Equal Opportunity Postman is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. Postman does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes. Postman will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Postman.
